examples.text: Na minha classe há vinte e cinco alunos.

translations.de: In meiner Klasse sind fünfundzwanzig Schüler.
translations.en: There are twenty-five students in my class.
translations.fr: Ma classe compte vingt-cinq élèves.

examples.text: Saímos da aula há meia hora.

translations.de: Wir haben den Unterricht vor einer halben Stunde verlassen.
translations.en: We left class half an hour ago.
translations.fr: Notre cours s'est terminé il y a une demi-heure.

examples.text: Em turco, não há pronomes relativos.

translations.de: Im Türkischen gibt es keine Relativpronomen.
translations.en: In Turkish, there are no relative pronouns.
translations.fr: En turc, il n'existe pas de pronoms relatifs.

examples.text: Ele começou a estudar turco há poucos dias.

translations.de: Er hat vor ein paar Tagen angefangen, Türkisch zu lernen.
translations.en: He started studying Turkish a few days ago.
translations.fr: Il a commencé à étudier le turc il y a quelques jours.

examples.text: Amanhã chegaremos à metade do ano.

translations.de: Morgen erreichen wir die Hälfte des Jahres.
translations.en: Tomorrow we will reach the halfway point of the year.
translations.fr: Demain, nous atteindrons la mi-année.

examples.text: O silêncio das florestas nos convida à reflexão.

translations.de: Die Stille der Wälder lädt uns zum Nachdenken ein.
translations.en: The silence of the forests invites us to reflect.
translations.fr: Le silence des forêts nous invite à la réflexion.

examples.text: A beleza é inerente à estrutura da realidade.

translations.de: Schönheit ist der Struktur der Realität inhärent.
translations.en: Beauty is inherent in the structure of reality.
translations.fr: La beauté est inscrite dans la structure même de la réalité.

examples.text: Sinto-me melhor graças à aromaterapia.

translations.de: Dank der Aromatherapie fühle ich mich besser.
translations.en: I feel better thanks to aromatherapy.
translations.fr: Je me sens mieux grâce à l'aromathérapie.

more.definition: contraction of a (“to”) + a f sg (“the”): feminine singular of ao

senses.gloss: contração da preposição a com o artigo definido feminino a

examples.text: Eu não vou à escola de ônibus.

translations.de: Ich fahre nicht mit dem Bus zur Schule.
translations.en: I don't go to school by bus.
translations.fr: Je ne vais pas à l'école en bus.

examples.text: Há um banco em frente à estação.

translations.de: Vor dem Bahnhof gibt es eine Bank.
translations.en: There's a bank in front of the station.
translations.fr: Il y a une banque devant la gare.

examples.text: Eu não sei responder à sua pergunta.

translations.de: Ich kann deine Frage nicht beantworten.
translations.en: I can't answer your question.
translations.fr: Je ne sais pas répondre à ta question.

examples.text: Não ate o cavalo à jaula do urso.

translations.de: Binde das Pferd nicht an den Käfig des Bären.
translations.en: Do not tie the horse to the bear's cage.
translations.fr: N'attachez pas le cheval à la cage de l'ours.

more.definition: forms adverbs meaning "in a manner related or resembling"; ellipsis of à moda (“way, manner, -style”); accented preposition, the preposition a is accented when it comes before feminine words in prepositional, adverbial and conjunctive phrases; in

examples.text: Você também é uma loura linda.

translations.de: Sie sind auch eine schöne Blondine.
translations.en: You are also a beautiful blonde.
translations.fr: Vous êtes aussi une belle blonde.

examples.text: Inglês também é estudado na China.

translations.de: Englisch wird auch in China gelernt.
translations.en: English is studied in China, too.
translations.fr: L'anglais est aussi étudié en Chine.

examples.text: De amor também se morre.

translations.de: Auch Menschen können an der Liebe sterben.
translations.en: You can also die from love.
translations.fr: On peut aussi mourir d'amour.

examples.text: Eu também não entendi nada.

translations.de: Ich habe auch nichts verstanden.
translations.en: I, too, didn't understand anything.
translations.fr: Moi non plus, je n'ai rien compris.

more.definition: too; also (in addition; as well); not only … but also
more.etymology: Inherited from Old Galician-Portuguese tan ben, from tan (“as, so”) (modern tão) + ben (“well”) (modern bem). Compare with Spanish también and English as well.

examples.text: Eu jogo futebol e também toco violão.

translations.de: Ich spiele Fußball und ich spiele auch Gitarre.
translations.en: I play soccer and I also play the guitar.
translations.fr: Je joue au football et je joue aussi de la guitare.

examples.text: O carro branco também é meu.

translations.de: Der weiße Wagen gehört auch mir.
translations.en: The white car is mine too.
translations.fr: La voiture blanche est aussi à moi.

examples.text: Eu também tenho um cão preto.

translations.de: Ich habe auch einen schwarzen Hund.
translations.en: I also have a black dog.
translations.fr: Moi aussi j'ai un chien noir.

examples.text: A sua esposa também é canadense?

translations.de: Ist deine Frau auch Kanadierin?
translations.en: Is your wife a Canadian, too?
translations.fr: Est-ce que ta femme est canadienne aussi ?

more.definition: of course; no wonder (implying that an outcome was expected)
more.etymology: Inherited from Old Galician-Portuguese tan ben, from tan (“as, so”) (modern tão) + ben (“well”) (modern bem). Compare with Spanish también and English as well.

examples.text: Isso aconteceu às três horas da madrugada.

translations.de: Dies geschah um drei Uhr morgens.
translations.en: This happened at three o'clock in the morning.
translations.fr: Cela s'est passé à trois heures du matin.

examples.text: Eu te amarei para sempre, não importa o que aconteça.

translations.de: Ich werde dich immer lieben, egal was passiert.
translations.en: I'll always love you, no matter what happens.
translations.fr: Je t'aimerai toujours quoi qu'il arrive.

examples.text: O que de fato está acontecendo é declarada guerra contra a humanidade.

translations.de: Was tatsächlich geschieht, ist ein erklärter Krieg gegen die Menschheit.
translations.en: What is actually happening is a declaration of war against humanity.
translations.fr: Ce qui se passe en réalité est une guerre déclarée contre l’humanité.

examples.text: O milagre aconteceu. Ele ficou feliz. Acendeu uma vela.

translations.de: Das Wunder geschah. Er war glücklich. Er zündete eine Kerze an.
translations.en: The miracle happened. He was happy. He lit a candle.
translations.fr: Le miracle se produisit. Il était heureux. Il alluma une bougie.

more.definition: to happen; to occur; to take place; to become famous or successful
more.etymology: Vulgar Latin *contigīreder. Derived from Vulgar Latin *contigīre, from Latin contingere. Compare Galician acontecer and Spanish acontecer.

examples.text: Tenho quarenta e cinco anos de idade.

translations.de: Ich bin fünfundvierzig Jahre alt.
translations.en: I am forty-five years old.
translations.fr: J'ai quarante-cinq ans.

examples.text: Janeiro é o primeiro mês do ano.

translations.de: Januar ist der erste Monat des Jahres.
translations.en: January is the first month of the year.
translations.fr: Janvier est le premier mois de l'année.

examples.text: Dezembro é o último mês do ano.

translations.de: Dezember ist der letzte Monat des Jahres.
translations.en: December is the last month of the year.
translations.fr: Décembre est le dernier mois de l'année.

examples.text: Com quantos anos morreu Lev Yachine?

translations.de: Wie alt war Lew Jaschin, als er starb?
translations.en: How old was Lev Yashin when he died?
translations.fr: Quel âge avait Lev Yachine lorsqu'il est mort ?

more.definition: year
more.etymology: From Old Galician-Portuguese ano (“year”), from Latin annus (“year”), from Proto-Italic *atnos (“year”), from Proto-Indo-European *h₂et-nos-, probably from *h₂et- (“to go”). Cognate with Galician ano, Spanish año, Catalan any, Occitan, French, and Romanian an, Italian anno.

senses.gloss: período de tempo correspondente à revolução da Terra em torno do Sol que equivale a 365 dias, 6 horas, 13 minutos e 53 segundos

more.definition: credit; belongings; assets
more.etymology: Inherited from Old Galician-Portuguese aver, from Latin habēre. Compare Galician haber. Cognate of Spanish haber, French avoir, and Italian avere.

examples.text: Se não fosse a linguagem, não haveria pensamento.

translations.de: Wenn es keine Sprache gäbe, gäbe es keine Gedanken.
translations.en: But for language, there would be no thought.
translations.fr: Si le langage n'existait pas, la pensée n'existerait pas.

examples.text: Após o terremoto, houve um incêndio.

translations.de: Nach dem Erdbeben gab es ein Feuer.
translations.en: After the earthquake, there was a fire.
translations.fr: Après le tremblement de terre, il y a eu un incendie.

examples.text: No galinheiro havia três galos, nove galinhas e quinze pintinhos.

translations.de: Im Hühnerstall befanden sich drei Hähne, neun Hennen und fünfzehn Küken.
translations.en: In the henhouse, there were three roosters, nine hens, and fifteen chicks.
translations.fr: Dans le poulailler, il y avait trois coqs, neuf poules et quinze poussins.

examples.text: Não pode haver causa mais justa para as minhas lágrimas.

translations.de: Es gibt keinen gerechteren Grund für meine Tränen.
translations.en: There can be no fairer cause for my tears.
translations.fr: Il ne peut y avoir de cause plus juste pour mes larmes.

more.definition: there be; exist; there be; to happen; to occur; ago (indicates the time since something occurred)
more.etymology: Inherited from Old Galician-Portuguese aver, from Latin habēre. Compare Galician haber. Cognate of Spanish haber, French avoir, and Italian avere.

senses.gloss: ser bem-sucedido na consecução de; obter

examples.text: O pai do Tom é muito severo.

translations.de: Toms Vater ist sehr streng.
translations.en: Tom's dad is very strict.
translations.fr: Le père de Tom est très sévère.

examples.text: Tu conheces os pais de Tom?

translations.de: Kennst du Toms Eltern?
translations.en: Do you know Tom's parents?
translations.fr: Connais-tu les parents de Tom ?

examples.text: Se eu tivesse dado ouvido aos meus pais!

translations.de: Wenn ich nur auf meine Eltern gehört hätte!
translations.en: If I'd only listened to my parents!
translations.fr: Si seulement j'avais écouté mes parents !

examples.text: Estou muito orgulhoso do meu pai.

translations.de: Ich bin sehr stolz auf meinen Vater.
translations.en: I'm very proud of my father.
translations.fr: Je suis très fier de mon père.

more.definition: father (male who sires a child); one's father; parent (either a mother or a father)
more.etymology: From Old Galician-Portuguese pay < *pade, child-speech forms of padre, from Latin patrem, the accusative of pater (“father”), from Proto-Indo-European *ph₂tḗr (“father”). Doublet of padre. Compare mãe (“mother”), which underwent a similar phonetic reduction from its root (Latin mater), and, in addition, was nasalized, perhaps because it was more frequently used than this word.

senses.gloss: homem que tem filhos, naturais ou adotivos

examples.text: Você quer ser a minha namorada?

translations.de: Willst du meine Freundin werden?
translations.en: Do you want to be my girlfriend?
translations.fr: Est-ce que tu veux être ma petite-amie ?

examples.text: Você quer me fazer um favor?

translations.de: Willst du mir einen Gefallen tun?
translations.en: Do you want to do me a favor?
translations.fr: Voulez-vous me faire une faveur ?

examples.text: Eu quero o que você quer.

translations.de: Ich will, was du willst.
translations.en: I want what you want.
translations.fr: Je veux ce que tu veux.

examples.text: Onde quer que você vá, eu o seguirei.

translations.de: Wohin du auch immer gehst, werde ich dir folgen.
translations.en: Wherever you go, I will follow you.
translations.fr: Où que tu ailles, je te suivrai.

more.definition: whether … or
more.etymology: Da terceira pessoa singular do presente do indicativo do verbo querer.

examples.text: Tenho dois irmãos e três irmãs.

translations.de: Ich habe zwei Brüder und drei Schwestern.
translations.en: I have two brothers and three sisters.
translations.fr: J'ai deux frères et trois sœurs.

examples.text: Quantos são duas vezes dois?

translations.de: Was ist zwei mal zwei?
translations.en: What is two times two?
translations.fr: Combien font deux fois deux ?

examples.text: Melhor um pássaro na mão do que dois voando.

translations.de: Besser ein Vogel in der Hand als zehn in der Luft.
translations.en: A bird in the hand is worth two in the bush.
translations.fr: Mieux vaut le passereau dans la main que la grue qui vole au loin.

examples.text: Quanto é dois vezes dois?

translations.de: Was ist zwei mal zwei?
translations.en: What is two times two?
translations.fr: Combien font deux fois deux ?

more.definition: second
more.etymology: Alteration of dous, from Old Galician-Portuguese dous, from Latin duōs (“two”), from Proto-Italic *duō, from Proto-Indo-European *dwóh₁.

examples.text: O carro dele tem dois anos.

translations.de: Sein Wagen ist zwei Jahre alt.
translations.en: His car is two years old.
translations.fr: Sa voiture a deux ans.

examples.text: Sou casada e tenho dois filhos.

translations.de: Ich bin verheiratet und habe zwei Söhne.
translations.en: I am married and I have two sons.
translations.fr: Je suis mariée et j'ai deux fils.

examples.text: De dois males escolha o menor.

translations.de: Wähle das kleinere Übel von beiden!
translations.en: Of two evils, choose the lesser.
translations.fr: De deux maux, choisissez le moindre.

examples.text: Nenhum dos dois compareceu à reunião.

translations.de: Keiner von beiden hat am Treffen teilgenommen.
translations.en: Both of them were not present at the meeting.
translations.fr: Aucun des deux n'a assisté à la réunion.

more.definition: deuce (card with two spots); deuce (side of a die with two spots); two (the character or digit ‘2’)
more.etymology: Alteration of dous, from Old Galician-Portuguese dous, from Latin duōs (“two”), from Proto-Italic *duō, from Proto-Indo-European *dwóh₁.

examples.text: Eu tenho um cachorro e dois gatos.

translations.de: Ich habe einen Hund und zwei Katzen.
translations.en: I have a dog and two cats.
translations.fr: J'ai un chien et deux chats.

examples.text: Ela tem um filho e duas filhas.

translations.de: Sie hat einen Sohn und zwei Töchter.
translations.en: She has a son and two daughters.
translations.fr: Elle a un fils et deux filles.

examples.text: O dois países do oriente estão em guerra.

translations.de: Die beiden östlichen Länder befinden sich im Krieg.
translations.en: The two eastern countries are at war.
translations.fr: Les deux pays de l'Est sont en guerre.

examples.text: Vocês dois são um belo casal.

translations.de: Ihr zwei seid ein wunderschönes Paar.
translations.en: You two are a beautiful couple.
translations.fr: Vous êtes un beau couple.

more.definition: two (cardinal number 2)
more.etymology: Alteration of dous, from Old Galician-Portuguese dous, from Latin duōs (“two”), from Proto-Italic *duō, from Proto-Indo-European *dwóh₁.

senses.gloss: número equivalente a um mais um; cardinalidade de um conjunto que contenha um elemento e um outro elemento distinto; representado pelo símbolo 2 (algarismos indo-arábicos) ou II (algarismos romanos); seu feminino é duas

examples.text: Ela nasceu pra me fazer feliz.

translations.de: Sie wurde geboren, um mich glücklich zu machen.
translations.en: She was born to make me happy.
translations.fr: Elle est née pour me rendre heureux.

examples.text: É muito longe pra ir caminhando?

translations.de: Ist es zu weit, um zu laufen?
translations.en: Is it too far to walk?
translations.fr: Est-ce trop loin pour marcher ?

examples.text: Isso é pra mim?

translations.de: Ist das für mich?
translations.en: Is that for me?
translations.fr: Est-ce pour moi ?

examples.text: Deixe pra lá, é um caso perdido.

translations.en: Never mind, it's a hopeless case.
translations.fr: Laisse tomber, c'est un cas désespéré.

more.definition: syncopic form of para
more.etymology: Syncopic form of para. Compare Galician pra.

examples.text: O Ken ainda não lavou o carro.

translations.de: Ken hat das Auto immer noch nicht gewaschen.
translations.en: Ken still hasn't washed the car.
translations.fr: Ken n'a toujours pas lavé la voiture.

examples.text: Volte a dormir, meu filho, é madrugada ainda.

translations.de: Schlaf weiter, mein Sohn, es ist noch früh am Morgen.
translations.en: Go back to sleep, my son, it's still early morning.
translations.fr: Recouche-toi, mon fils, il est encore tôt.

examples.text: Será que ela ainda pensa neste velho amigo?

translations.de: Denkt sie noch an ihren alten Freund?
translations.en: Does she still think about her old friend?
translations.fr: Pense-t-elle encore à ce vieil ami ?

examples.text: Meu irmão mais novo ainda não tem filhos.

translations.de: Mein jüngerer Bruder hat noch keine Kinder.
translations.en: My younger brother has no children yet.
translations.fr: Mon petit frère n'a pas encore d'enfant.

more.definition: still, yet (up to a time); even (emphasises a comparative); someday (at some time in the future)
more.etymology: From Old Galician-Portuguese aynda, from paragogic a- + inda, from Latin inde (“thenceforth”).

senses.gloss: até o momento em que se fala

examples.text: As pessoas nem sempre cumprem o que prometem.

translations.de: Nicht alle Menschen halten ihre Versprechen.
translations.en: People don't always keep their promises.
translations.fr: Les gens ne tiennent pas toujours leurs promesses.

examples.text: Eu quero ser uma pessoa honesta.

translations.de: Ich will ein aufrichtiger Mensch sein.
translations.en: I want to be an honest person.
translations.fr: Je veux être une personne honnête.

examples.text: A desconfiança crescia entre as pessoas.

translations.de: Das Misstrauen im Volk wuchs.
translations.en: Distrust was growing among the people.
translations.fr: La méfiance grandissait parmi la population.

examples.text: Eu não gosto de pessoas arrogantes.

translations.de: Ich mag keine arroganten Menschen.
translations.en: I don't like arrogant people.
translations.fr: Je n'aime pas les gens arrogants.

more.definition: person (an individual being, especially a human); person (someone’s physical body); person (either the speaker, those spoken to or the subject of the discussion)
more.etymology: From Old Galician-Portuguese pessõa, from Latin persōna (“mask used by actor; role, part, character”), perhaps a loanword from Etruscan 𐌘𐌄𐌓𐌔𐌖 (φersu, “mask”), from Ancient Greek πρόσωπον (prósōpon). Doublet of persona.

senses.gloss: indivíduo consciente de si e distinto dos demais

examples.text: A mente humana não consegue conceber o não-ser absoluto.

translations.de: Der menschliche Verstand kann sich das absolute Nichtsein nicht vorstellen.
translations.en: The human mind cannot conceive of absolute nothingness.
translations.fr: L'esprit humain ne peut concevoir le néant absolu.

examples.text: Eu consigo fazer sozinho!

translations.de: Ich kann es selbst machen!
translations.en: I can do it by myself!
translations.fr: Je peux le faire moi-même !

examples.text: Não posso acreditar que ele consiga trabalhar tanto já naquela idade.

translations.de: Ich kann nicht glauben, dass er in diesem Alter so hart arbeiten kann.
translations.en: I can't believe he can work so hard at that age.
translations.fr: Je n'arrive pas à croire qu'il puisse travailler aussi dur à cet âge.

examples.text: Há muitas maneiras de conseguir isso. Todos os caminhos levam a Roma.

translations.de: Es gibt viele Möglichkeiten, dies zu erreichen. Alle Wege führen nach Rom.
translations.en: There are many ways to achieve this. All roads lead to Rome.
translations.fr: Il existe de nombreuses façons d'y parvenir. Tous les chemins mènent à Rome.

more.definition: to get, obtain; to achieve; to be able to, can
more.etymology: From Old Galician-Portuguese [Term?], from Vulgar Latin *cōnsequīre or cōnsequere, from Latin cōnsequī. By surface analysis, con- (“co-”) + seguir (“to follow”).

examples.text: Tom não corre tão rápido quanto Bill.

translations.de: Tom läuft nicht so schnell wie Bill.
translations.en: Tom doesn't run as fast as Bill.
translations.fr: Tom ne court pas aussi vite que Bill.

examples.text: Nada é tão precioso quanto a saúde.

translations.de: Nichts ist so wertvoll wie Gesundheit.
translations.en: Nothing is so precious as health.
translations.fr: Rien n'est aussi précieux que la santé.

examples.text: Você é tão estudioso quanto eu.

translations.de: Sie sind genauso fleißig wie ich.
translations.en: You are as studious as I am.
translations.fr: Vous êtes aussi studieux que moi.

examples.text: Ninguém é tão velho que não possa aprender.

translations.de: Es ist nie zu spät zum Lernen.
translations.en: No man is so old he cannot learn.
translations.fr: Personne n'est trop vieux pour apprendre.

more.definition: so (to a great extent); as … as; eye dialect spelling of então
more.etymology: Proto-Indo-European *sóder. Inherited from Old Galician-Portuguese tan, from Latin tam (“so”).

examples.text: A luz dos olhos alegra a alma.

translations.de: Das Licht der Augen erfreut die Seele.
translations.en: The light of the eyes brightens the soul.
translations.fr: La lumière des yeux réjouit l'âme.

examples.text: A coroa é o símbolo dos reis.

translations.de: Die Krone ist das Symbol der Könige.
translations.en: The crown is the symbol of kings.
translations.fr: La couronne est le symbole des rois.

examples.text: O leão é o rei dos animais.

translations.de: Der Löwe ist der König der Tiere.
translations.en: The lion is the king of animals.
translations.fr: Le lion est le roi des animaux.

examples.text: É um dos meus filmes favoritos.

translations.de: Das ist einer meiner Lieblingsfilme.
translations.en: It's one of my favorite movies.
translations.fr: C'est l'un de mes films préférés.

more.definition: contraction of de + os, literally “of/from the (masculine plural)”: masculine plural of do

examples.text: Eu bebi cerveja ontem à noite.

translations.de: Ich habe letzte Nacht Bier getrunken.
translations.en: I drank beer last night.
translations.fr: J'ai bu de la bière hier soir.

examples.text: As noites estão ficando mais longas porque o outono está chegando.

translations.de: Die Nächte werden länger, denn der Herbst steht vor der Tür.
translations.en: The nights are getting longer because autumn is coming.
translations.fr: Les nuits s'allongent car l'automne arrive.

examples.text: O que você vai fazer hoje à noite?

translations.de: Was machst du heute Abend?
translations.en: What are you going to do tonight?
translations.fr: Qu'allez-vous faire ce soir ?

examples.text: Ele acordou no meio da noite.

translations.de: Mitten in der Nacht wachte er auf.
translations.en: He woke up in the middle of the night.
translations.fr: Il se réveilla au milieu de la nuit.

more.definition: night (period between sunset and sunrise); nightlife
idioms: não ter senão a noite e o dia
more.etymology: Inherited from Old Galician-Portuguese noite, from Latin noctem, from Proto-Italic *nok⁽ʷ⁾ts, from Proto-Indo-European *nókʷts.

senses.gloss: período do dia entre o anoitecer e a meia-noite

examples.text: O homem não para de fabricar o Apocalipse.

translations.de: Der Mensch hört nie auf, die Apokalypse zu fabrizieren.
translations.en: Man never stops manufacturing the Apocalypse.
translations.fr: L’homme n’arrête jamais de fabriquer l’Apocalypse.

examples.text: Os homens estão a almoçar.

translations.de: Die Männer essen zu Mittag.
translations.en: The men are eating lunch.
translations.fr: Les hommes sont en train de déjeuner.

examples.text: Cresce o menino, torna-se homem, vejo Deus.

translations.de: Der Junge wächst, wird ein Mann, ich sehe Gott.
translations.en: The boy grows, becomes a man, I see God.
translations.fr: Le garçon grandit, devient un homme, je vois Dieu.

examples.text: O homem e a mulher têm um filho.

translations.de: Der Mann und die Frau haben ein Kind.
translations.en: The man and the woman have a child.
translations.fr: L'homme et la femme ont un enfant.

more.definition: manly (displaying stereotypical characteristics of a male)
more.etymology: Inherited from Old Galician-Portuguese ome, from earlier Old Galician-Portuguese omẽe, from Latin hominem (“a human”), from Proto-Italic *hemō, from Proto-Indo-European *ǵʰm̥mṓ (“an earthling”).

examples.text: É inevitável que o homem morra.

translations.de: Es ist unvermeidlich, dass der Mensch sterben wird.
translations.en: Man will inevitably die.
translations.fr: Il est inévitable que l'homme meure.

examples.text: Em geral, as mulheres são mais gentis que os homens.

translations.de: Im Allgemeinen sind Frauen freundlicher als Männer.
translations.en: In general, women are kinder than men.
translations.fr: En général, les femmes sont plus gentilles que les hommes.

examples.text: Você conhece o homem nesta fotografia?

translations.de: Kennst du den Mann auf diesem Foto?
translations.en: Do you know the man in this picture?
translations.fr: Connais-tu l'homme sur cette photo ?

examples.text: Quando cessa o pensamento, o homem deixa de existir.

translations.de: Wenn das Denken aufhört, hört der Mensch auf zu existieren.
translations.en: When thought ceases, man ceases to exist.
translations.fr: Quand la pensée cesse, l'homme cesse d'exister.

more.definition: male (human of masculine gender); man (adult male human); a person; a human being
more.etymology: Inherited from Old Galician-Portuguese ome, from earlier Old Galician-Portuguese omẽe, from Latin hominem (“a human”), from Proto-Italic *hemō, from Proto-Indo-European *ǵʰm̥mṓ (“an earthling”).

senses.gloss: pessoa do sexo ou gênero masculino, geralmente, mas não exclusivamente, adulta

examples.text: Me manda uma foto sua, por favor.

translations.de: Bitte schick mir ein Foto von dir.
translations.en: Please send me a picture of yourself.
translations.fr: S'il vous plaît envoyez-moi une photo de vous.

examples.text: Podes chamar um táxi, por favor?

translations.de: Könnten Sie bitte ein Taxi rufen?
translations.en: Could you call a taxi, please?
translations.fr: Pourriez-vous appeler un taxi, s'il vous plaît ?

examples.text: Por favor, não façam comentários insultuosos.

translations.de: Bitte macht keine beleidigenden Kommentare.
translations.en: Please do not make insulting comments.
translations.fr: Veuillez ne pas faire de commentaires insultants.

examples.text: Por favor, espera aqui um momento.

translations.de: Bitte warte hier ein wenig.
translations.en: Please wait here for a while.
translations.fr: S'il vous plaît, attendez un peu ici.

more.definition: please (seen on warnings and the like)
more.etymology: From Latin favor (“favour; good will”), from faveō (“to favour”), from Proto-Indo-European *gʰoweh₁ (“to notice”).

examples.text: Por favor, responda em chinês ou em inglês.

translations.de: Bitte antworte auf Chinesisch oder Englisch.
translations.en: Please reply in Chinese or English.
translations.fr: S'il vous plaît, répondez en chinois ou en anglais.

examples.text: Vinte mil ienes, por favor.

translations.de: Zwanzigtausend Yen, bitte!
translations.en: Twenty thousand yen, please.
translations.fr: Vingt mille yens, s'il vous plaît.

examples.text: Pedi a ele um favor.

translations.de: Ich bat ihn um einen Gefallen.
translations.en: I asked him a favor.
translations.fr: Je lui ai demandé une faveur.

examples.text: Por favor, mude a frase.

translations.de: Bitte ändern Sie den Satz.
translations.en: Please change the sentence.
translations.fr: Change la phrase, s'il te plait.

more.definition: favor (instance of voluntarily assisting someone); favor; goodwill (benevolent regard)
more.etymology: From Latin favor (“favour; good will”), from faveō (“to favour”), from Proto-Indo-European *gʰoweh₁ (“to notice”).

examples.text: Costumamos passar o domingo fora da cidade.

translations.de: Normalerweise verbringen wir den Sonntag außerhalb der Stadt.
translations.en: We usually spend Sunday outside the city.
translations.fr: Nous passons généralement le dimanche en dehors de la ville.

examples.text: A ideia numa me passou pela cabeça.

translations.de: Die Idee ist mir nie in den Sinn gekommen.
translations.en: The idea never came into my head.
translations.fr: Cette idée ne m'est jamais passée par la tête.

examples.text: A vida passa sem ser sentida.

translations.de: Das Leben vergeht, ohne dass man es merkt.
translations.en: Life passes without being felt.
translations.fr: La vie passe sans qu'on s'en aperçoive.

examples.text: Muitos alemães passam férias na Espanha.

translations.de: Viele Deutsche fahren in den Ferien nach Spanien.
translations.en: A lot of Germans go on vacation in Spain.
translations.fr: Beaucoup d'allemands vont en vacances en Espagne.

more.definition: to pass; to pass by (to move past); to overtake (to move ahead of); to cross (to move beyond)
more.etymology: Proto-Indo-European *peth₂-der. Latin -ereinflu. English passsl. Inherited from Old Galician-Portuguese passar. Verb sense 17 is a semantic loan from English pass. Compare Galician and Spanish pasar.

examples.text: O senhor fala alemão?

translations.de: Sprechen Sie Deutsch?
translations.en: Do you speak German?
translations.fr: Parlez-vous allemand ?

examples.text: O senhor come carne?

translations.de: Essen Sie Fleisch?
translations.en: Do you eat meat?
translations.fr: Mangez-vous de la viande ?

examples.text: Bom dia, senhor!

translations.de: Guten Tag, mein Herr!
translations.en: Hello sir!
translations.fr: Bonjour Monsieur !

examples.text: Os senhores falam francês?

translations.de: Sprechen die Herren Französisch?
translations.en: Do you know French?
translations.fr: Parlez-vous français ?

more.definition: a man (an adult male human); gentleman (a respectable man); an old man
more.etymology: Inherited from Old Galician-Portuguese senhor m or f by sense, from Latin senior, seniōrem (“older (one)”, “elder (one)”, used as a title of respect in Medieval Latin), the comparative of senex (“old”), from Proto-Indo-European *sénos (“old”). Doublet of sénior /sênior. Compare Occitan senhor, sénher, signour, Spanish and Galician señor.

senses.gloss: tratamento deferente ou sem caráter de intimidade dado à pessoa com quem se fala ou a quem se escreve

examples.text: Essa mulher é uma flor sem coração.

translations.de: Diese Frau ist eine herzlose Blume.
translations.en: This woman is a heartless flower.
translations.fr: Cette femme est une fleur sans cœur.

examples.text: A alma pode existir sem o corpo.

translations.de: Die Seele kann ohne den Körper existieren.
translations.en: The soul can exist without the body.
translations.fr: L'âme peut exister sans le corps.

examples.text: O esperanto é, sem dúvida, uma língua funcional.

translations.de: Esperanto ist zweifellos eine funktionierende Sprache.
translations.en: Esperanto is undoubtedly a functioning language.
translations.fr: L'espéranto est sans aucun doute une langue fonctionnelle.

examples.text: Jogaram no meu colo uma granada sem pino.

translations.de: Sie warfen mir eine Granate ohne Sicherungsstift in den Schoß.
translations.en: They threw a live grenade into my lap.
translations.fr: Ils ont lancé une grenade sans goupille sur mes genoux.

more.definition: -less; without (not having, containing, characteristic of, etc.); without (not doing or not having done something); no (indicates lack of possibility or allowance)
more.etymology: From Old Galician-Portuguese sen, from Latin sine, from Proto-Indo-European *sene.

examples.text: Me apressei para pegar o primeiro trem.

translations.de: Ich beeilte mich, um den ersten Zug zu kriegen.
translations.en: I hurried in order to catch the first train.
translations.fr: Je me dépêchai pour avoir le premier train.

examples.text: Dido pega a espada e transpassa o peito.

translations.de: Dido nimmt das Schwert und durchbohrt ihre Brust.
translations.en: Dido takes the sword and pierces her chest.
translations.fr: Didon prend l'épée et se transperce la poitrine.

examples.text: A pergunta de Tom pegou Mary de surpresa.

translations.de: Toms Frage überraschte Maria.
translations.en: Tom's question took Mary by surprise.
translations.fr: La question de Tom prit Mary par surprise.

examples.text: Este é o maior peixe que eu já peguei.

translations.de: Das ist der größte Fisch, den ich je gefangen habe.
translations.en: This is the biggest fish that I have ever caught.
translations.fr: C'est le plus gros poisson que j'ai jamais attrapé.

more.definition: to grab, hold; to discover someone doing something; to pick up
idioms: pegar na cabra para outro mamar
more.etymology: Inherited from Latin picāre (“smear with pitch”), from pix (“pitch”).

examples.text: Ele sempre bate na porta antes de entrar.

translations.de: Er klopft immer an die Tür, bevor er eintritt.
translations.en: He always knocks on the door before entering.
translations.fr: Il frappe toujours à la porte avant d'entrer.

examples.text: Oito é o número entre sete e nove.

translations.de: Acht ist die Zahl zwischen sieben und neun.
translations.en: Eight is the number between seven and nine.
translations.fr: Huit est le nombre entre sept et neuf.

examples.text: A bola não entra por acaso.

translations.de: Der Ball geht nicht zufällig rein.
translations.en: The ball doesn't go in by chance.
translations.fr: Le ballon n'entre pas par hasard.

examples.text: O cachorro entrou no armário.

translations.de: Der Hund betrat den Schrank.
translations.en: The dog entered the cupboard.
translations.fr: Le chien est entré dans le placard.

more.definition: to enter; to go into
more.etymology: Inherited from Old Galician-Portuguese entrar, intrar, from Latin intrāre.

examples.text: Na política, o novo quase sempre tem cara de pão dormido.

translations.de: In der Politik sieht das Neue fast immer wie altes Brot aus.
translations.en: In politics, the new almost always looks like stale bread.
translations.fr: En politique, la nouveauté ressemble presque toujours à du pain rassis.

examples.text: A gasolina está muito cara.

translations.de: Das Benzin ist sehr teuer.
translations.en: Gasoline is very expensive.
translations.fr: L'essence est très chère.

examples.text: Esta câmera é muito cara.

translations.de: Diese Kamera ist sehr teuer.
translations.en: This camera is very expensive.
translations.fr: Cet appareil photo est très cher.

examples.text: Você conhece aquele cara?

translations.de: Kennst du diesen Kerl?
translations.en: Do you know that guy?
translations.fr: Connaissez-vous ce type ?

more.definition: dude!
more.etymology: Inherited from Old Galician-Portuguese cara, from Late Latin or Vulgar Latin cara, from Ancient Greek κάρα (kára, “head, face”), ultimately from Proto-Indo-European *ḱrh₂esn.

examples.text: A gasolina está muito cara.

translations.de: Das Benzin ist sehr teuer.
translations.en: Gasoline is very expensive.
translations.fr: L'essence est très chère.

examples.text: As casas são muito caras na cidade.

translations.de: Häuser sind in der Stadt sehr teuer.
translations.en: Houses are very expensive in town.
translations.fr: Les maisons sont très chères en ville.

examples.text: Esta câmera é muito cara.

translations.de: Diese Kamera ist sehr teuer.
translations.en: This camera is very expensive.
translations.fr: Cet appareil photo est très cher.

examples.text: Você conhece aquele cara?

translations.de: Kennst du diesen Kerl?
translations.en: Do you know that guy?
translations.fr: Connaissez-vous ce type ?

more.definition: face; heads (side of coin); resemblance, appearance; look (perceived characteristic of a person, object or situation)
idioms: cara de quem comeu e não gostou
more.etymology: Inherited from Old Galician-Portuguese cara, from Late Latin or Vulgar Latin cara, from Ancient Greek κάρα (kára, “head, face”), ultimately from Proto-Indo-European *ḱrh₂esn.

senses.gloss: parte anterior da cabeça, desde a testa ao queixo; rosto

examples.text: Meu pai ouve música clássica.

translations.de: Mein Vater hört klassische Musik.
translations.en: My father listens to classical music.
translations.fr: Mon père écoute de la musique classique.

examples.text: Não podemos falar uma língua que não ouvimos ou entendemos.

translations.de: Wir können keine Sprache sprechen, die wir nicht hören oder verstehen.
translations.en: We cannot speak a language we have never heard or understood.
translations.fr: On ne peut pas parler une langue qu'on n'a pas entendue ou qu'on ne comprend pas.

examples.text: Você quer ouvir música?

translations.de: Möchtest du Musik hören?
translations.en: Do you want to listen to music?
translations.fr: Tu veux écouter de la musique ?

examples.text: Você ouviu alguma coisa?

translations.de: Haben Sie etwas gehört?
translations.en: Have you heard anything?
translations.fr: Avez-vous entendu quelque chose ?

more.definition: to hear (to perceive with the ear, without necessarily paying attention to it); to pay attention to; to take into account, take into consideration
more.etymology: From Old Galician-Portuguese ouvyr, oyr, from earlier ouir, from Latin audīre, a compound of Proto-Indo-European *h₂ewis (“clearly, manifestly”) (from the root *h₂ew- (“to see, perceive”)) and *dʰh₁-ye/o- (“to render”). Cognate with Galician ouvir, Spanish oír, Catalan oir, Occitan ausir, French ouïr, Italian udire and Romanian auzi.

examples.text: Lev Yashin foi talvez o maior goleiro da história.

translations.de: Lew Jaschin war vielleicht der größte Torwart der Geschichte.
translations.en: Lev Yashin was perhaps the greatest goalkeeper in history.
translations.fr: Lev Yachine était peut-être le plus grand gardien de but de l'histoire.

examples.text: Fernando Pessoa é talvez o mais genial dentre os grandes poetas.

translations.de: Fernando Pessoa ist vielleicht der genialste der großen Dichter.
translations.en: Fernando Pessoa is perhaps the most brilliant among the great poets.
translations.fr: Fernando Pessoa est peut-être le plus brillant des grands poètes.

examples.text: Você talvez tenha de esperar um pouco.

translations.de: Möglicherweise müssen Sie eine Weile warten.
translations.en: You might have to wait a little.
translations.fr: Vous devrez peut-être attendre un peu.

examples.text: A espécie humana talvez possa se salvar, se dela ainda aparecer nova edição.

translations.de: Vielleicht kann die menschliche Spezies gerettet werden, wenn eine neue Ausgabe davon erscheint.
translations.en: The human species may perhaps be able to save itself, if a new edition of it still appears.
translations.fr: L’espèce humaine pourra peut-être se sauver elle-même, si une nouvelle édition en paraît encore.

more.definition: perhaps; maybe (indicates possibility or doubt)
more.etymology: From tal (“such”) + vez (“time”).

examples.text: O cachorro salvou a vida da menina.

translations.de: Der Hund rettete das Leben des Mädchens.
translations.en: The dog saved the girl's life.
translations.fr: Le chien a sauvé la vie de la fille.

examples.text: As vidas negras são importantes.

translations.de: Schwarze Leben sind wichtig.
translations.en: Black lives matter.
translations.fr: Les vies noires sont importantes.

examples.text: Eu não quero arriscar a minha vida.

translations.de: Ich will mein Leben nicht riskieren.
translations.en: I don't want to risk my life.
translations.fr: Je ne veux pas risquer ma vie.

examples.text: Ela arriscou sua vida para salvá-lo.

translations.de: Sie riskierte ihr Leben, um ihn zu retten.
translations.en: She risked her life to save him.
translations.fr: Elle a risqué sa vie pour le sauver.

more.definition: state of being alive; lifetime (period during which someone is alive or something exists); living conditions
idioms: entre a vida e a morte
estar entre a vida e a morte
para a vida e para a morte
more.etymology: Proto-Indo-European *gʷeyh₃-der. Inherited from Old Galician-Portuguese vida, from Latin vīta, from Proto-Italic *gʷītā.

senses.gloss: propriedade que caracteriza os organismos cuja existência evolui do nascimento até a morte

examples.text: O que você está tentando fazer?

translations.de: Was versuchst du zu tun?
translations.en: What are you trying to do?
translations.fr: Que cherches-tu à faire ?

examples.text: Ela não tentou traduzir a carta.

translations.de: Sie versuchte nicht, den Brief zu übersetzen.
translations.en: She didn't try to translate the letter.
translations.fr: Elle n'essaya pas de traduire la lettre.

examples.text: É melhor tentar e falhar do que nunca tentar.

translations.de: Versuchen und scheitern ist besser, als nie etwas zu versuchen.
translations.en: It's better to try and fail, than never try at all.
translations.fr: Mieux vaut tenter et échouer que de ne jamais tenter.

examples.text: Eu tentei sem sucesso traduzir aquela frase para Toki Pona.

translations.de: Ich habe erfolglos versucht, diesen Satz ins Toki Pona zu übersetzen.
translations.en: I unsuccessfully tried to translate this sentence into Toki Pona.
translations.fr: J'ai essayé en vain de traduire cette phrase en toki pona.

more.definition: to try, go for, attempt; to tease, tempt; to dare, challenge
more.etymology: Inherited from Old Galician-Portuguese tentar, from Latin temptāre.

examples.text: O Tom ama os filhos da Mary.

translations.de: Tom liebt Marias Kinder.
translations.en: Tom loves Mary's children.
translations.fr: Tom aime les enfants de Marie.

examples.text: Hoje meu filho montou num pônei.

translations.de: Heute ist mein Sohn auf einem Pony geritten.
translations.en: Today my son rode a pony.
translations.fr: Aujourd'hui, mon fils a fait du poney.

examples.text: Tenho uma filha e um filho.

translations.de: Ich habe eine Tochter und einen Sohn.
translations.en: I have one daughter and one son.
translations.fr: J'ai une fille et un fils.

examples.text: Minha irmã tem três filhas.

translations.de: Meine Schwester hat drei Töchter.
translations.en: My sister has three daughters.
translations.fr: Ma sœur a trois filles.

more.definition: son (male offspring); child (offspring of any sex); term of address for a younger male; son
more.etymology: Inherited from Old Galician-Portuguese filho (“son”), from Latin fīlius (“son”), from Old Latin fīlios (“son”), from Proto-Indo-European *dʰeh₁y-li-os (“sucker”), a derivation from the verbal root *dʰeh₁(y)- (“to suck”). Compare Galician fillo, Spanish hijo and Sicilian figghiu.

senses.gloss: indivíduo do sexo masculino em relação aos seus pais ou a cada um deles

examples.text: Poucos erros comete aquele que pouco escreve.

translations.de: Wer wenig schreibt, macht wenige Fehler.
translations.en: The one who writes little makes few mistakes.
translations.fr: Celui qui écrit peu fait peu d'erreurs.

examples.text: Esta livraria é nova, aquela biblioteca é velha.

translations.de: Diese Buchhandlung ist neu, jene Bibliothek ist alt.
translations.en: This bookstore is new; that library is old.
translations.fr: Cette librairie est neuve, cette bibliothèque est ancienne.

examples.text: Olhe aquelas montanhas, entre as quais passa o rio!

translations.de: Schauen Sie sich diese Berge an, zwischen denen der Fluss fließt!
translations.en: Look at those mountains, between which the river runs!
translations.fr: Regardez ces montagnes entre lesquelles coule la rivière !

examples.text: Ambos vivemos sem preocupação aqueles momentos de carinho e de paixão.

translations.de: Wir beide erlebten diese Momente der Zuneigung und Leidenschaft unbeschwert.
translations.en: We both lived those moments of affection and passion without worry.
translations.fr: Nous avons tous deux vécu ces moments d'affection et de passion sans nous soucier de rien.

more.definition: that (far from the speaker and listener)
more.etymology: Inherited from Old Galician-Portuguese aquele, from Vulgar Latin *eccum ille, from Latin eccum + ille. Cognate with Spanish aquel.

examples.text: Por que você parou de estudar aquela língua?

translations.de: Warum haben Sie aufgehört, diese Sprache zu lernen?
translations.en: Why did you stop studying that language?
translations.fr: Pourquoi avez-vous arrêté d'étudier cette langue ?

examples.text: Eu vejo aquele cachorro quase todos os dias.

translations.de: Ich sehe diesen Hund fast jeden Tag.
translations.en: I see that dog almost every day.
translations.fr: Je vois le chien presque tous les jours.

examples.text: Todas aquelas personagens vivem num mundo de mentiras e decepções.

translations.de: Alle diese Figuren leben in einer Welt voller Lügen und Täuschung.
translations.en: All those characters live in a world of lies and deceptions.
translations.fr: Tous ces personnages vivent dans un monde de mensonges et de tromperies.

examples.text: Ele tenta ensinar tudo aquilo que aprende.

translations.de: Er versucht, alles zu lehren, was er lernt.
translations.en: He tries to teach everything he learns.
translations.fr: Il essaie d'enseigner tout ce qu'il apprend.

more.definition: that over there, yon (far from the speaker and the listener)
more.etymology: Inherited from Old Galician-Portuguese aquele, from Vulgar Latin *eccum ille, from Latin eccum + ille. Cognate with Spanish aquel.

senses.gloss: pessoa ou coisa de gênero masculino que está distante do interlocutor e do ouvinte, por oposição a este e a esse

examples.text: Quem é Tatoeba? A sua nova namorada?

translations.de: Wer ist Tatoeba? Deine neue Freundin?
translations.en: Who's Tatoeba? Your new girlfriend?
translations.fr: C'est qui Tatoeba ? Ta nouvelle petite amie ?

examples.text: Vejo que você tem um novo chapéu.

translations.de: Ich sehe, dass du einen neuen Hut hast.
translations.en: I see you've got a new hat.
translations.fr: Je vois que tu as un nouveau chapeau.

examples.text: Precisamos de novas maneiras de apoiar os artistas.

translations.de: Wir brauchen neue Wege, um Künstler zu unterstützen.
translations.en: We need new ways to support artists.
translations.fr: Nous avons besoin de nouvelles façons de soutenir les artistes.

examples.text: Tom está usando sapatos novos.

translations.de: Tom trägt neue Schuhe.
translations.en: Tom is wearing new shoes.
translations.fr: Tom porte des nouvelles chaussures.

more.definition: recently made or created; not previously worn or used; recently discovered
more.etymology: Inherited from Old Galician-Portuguese novo, from Latin novum (“new”), from Proto-Italic *nowos, from Proto-Indo-European *néwos. Compare Galician novo and Spanish nuevo.

examples.text: Que há de novo no grupo de enxadristas?

translations.de: Was gibt es Neues in der Schachgruppe?
translations.en: What's new in the chess group?
translations.fr: Quoi de neuf dans le groupe d'échecs ?

examples.text: O novo coronavírus é muito infeccioso.

translations.de: Das neue Coronavirus ist sehr infektiös.
translations.en: The new coronavirus is very infectious.
translations.fr: Le nouveau coronavirus est très contagieux.

examples.text: Nada de novo sob o Sol.

translations.de: Nichts Neues unter der Sonne.
translations.en: Nothing new under the sun.
translations.fr: Rien de neuf sous le soleil.

examples.text: Você é mais novo que ele?

translations.de: Bist du jünger als er?
translations.en: Are you younger than him?
translations.fr: Es-tu plus jeune que lui ?

more.definition: new ideas or things; novelties
more.etymology: Inherited from Old Galician-Portuguese novo, from Latin novum (“new”), from Proto-Italic *nowos, from Proto-Indo-European *néwos. Compare Galician novo and Spanish nuevo.

examples.text: Ela encontrou uma mulher que a ajudou.

translations.de: Sie fand eine Frau, die ihr half.
translations.en: She found a woman who helped her.
translations.fr: Elle a trouvé une femme qui l'a aidée.

examples.text: E concordaram em se encontrar pessoalmente em breve.

translations.de: Und sie vereinbarten, sich bald persönlich zu treffen.
translations.en: And they agreed to meet in person soon.
translations.fr: Et ils ont convenu de se rencontrer en personne bientôt.

examples.text: A minha língua não se encontra na lista!

translations.de: Meine Sprache ist nicht in der Liste!
translations.en: My language is not on the list!
translations.fr: Ma langue ne se trouve pas dans la liste !

examples.text: Nesta ilha encontrei caranguejos vermelhos.

translations.de: Auf dieser Insel habe ich rote Krabben gefunden.
translations.en: On this island, I found red crabs.
translations.fr: Sur cette île, j'ai trouvé des crabes rouges.

more.definition: to meet; to find; to locate; to be located
more.etymology: From Old Galician-Portuguese encontrar, from Vulgar Latin *incontrāre, from Latin in + contrā. Compare Italian incontrare, Old French encontrer, Spanish encontrar.

examples.text: Balançando a criança, a mãe tranquilizou-a.

translations.de: Indem sie das Kind schaukelte, beruhigte die Mutter es.
translations.en: Rocking the child, the mother soothed her.
translations.fr: En berçant l'enfant, la mère l'a rassuré.

examples.text: O próximo domingo é o Dia das Mães.

translations.de: Am kommenden Sonntag ist Muttertag.
translations.en: Next Sunday is Mother's Day.
translations.fr: Dimanche prochain, c'est la fête des mères.

examples.text: A mãe dele é professora de inglês.

translations.de: Seine Mutter ist Englischlehrerin.
translations.en: His mother is an English teacher.
translations.fr: Sa mère est prof d'anglais.

examples.text: Vi sua mãe por acaso na biblioteca.

translations.de: Ich habe deine Mutter zufällig in der Bücherei gesehen.
translations.en: I ran into your mother in the library.
translations.fr: J'ai vu ta mère par hasard à la bibliothèque.

more.definition: mother (female who gives birth to or parents a child); one's mother; mother (source or origin)
more.etymology: From Old Galician-Portuguese mãy, nasalization of earlier *mae < *made, child-speech forms of madre, from Latin mātrem, the accusative of māter (“mother”). Doublet of madre. Compare pai (“father”), which underwent a similar phonetic reduction from its root (Latin pater), but was not nasalized. Cognate with Galician mai, nai, Mirandese, Leonese, and Aragonese mai and Asturian ma.

senses.gloss: mulher que tem ou teve filhos, naturais ou adotivos

examples.text: Você conhece alguém que não esteja no Facebook?

translations.de: Kennst du jemanden, der nicht auf Facebook ist?
translations.en: Do you know anyone who's not on Facebook?
translations.fr: Connais-tu quelqu'un qui n'est pas sur Facebook ?

examples.text: Eu conheço alguém que fala francês muito bem.

translations.de: Ich kenne jemanden, der sehr gut Französisch spricht.
translations.en: I know somebody who speaks French very well.
translations.fr: Je connais quelqu'un qui parle très bien français.

examples.text: Acaso alguém pensou que poderia, simplesmente, viver sem poesia?

translations.de: Hat jemals jemand daran gedacht, einfach ohne Poesie leben zu können?
translations.en: Has anyone ever imagined that it would be possible to live without poetry?
translations.fr: Quelqu'un a-t-il jamais pensé pouvoir vivre sans poésie ?

examples.text: Conheço alguém que pode me ajudar a fazer isso.

translations.de: Ich kenne jemanden, der mir dabei helfen kann.
translations.en: I know someone who can help me do that.
translations.fr: Je connais quelqu'un qui peut m'aider à faire ça.

more.definition: somebody; someone (some person)
more.etymology: From Old Galician-Portuguese alguen, conflation of algũ and quen. Compare Spanish alguien, Galician alguén.

examples.text: A guerra estúpida e sangrenta chega ao fim.

translations.de: Der dumme und blutige Krieg geht zu Ende.
translations.en: The stupid and bloody war comes to an end.
translations.fr: La guerre stupide et sanglante touche à sa fin.

examples.text: Se chegares tarde ao aeroporto, perderás o avião.

translations.de: Wenn Sie zu spät am Flughafen ankommen, verpassen Sie das Flugzeug.
translations.en: If you arrive late at the airport, you will miss your plane.
translations.fr: Si vous arrivez en retard à l'aéroport, vous manquerez votre avion.

examples.text: Ele chegou atrasado à escola ontem.

translations.de: Er kam gestern zu spät zur Schule.
translations.en: He was late for school yesterday.
translations.fr: Il était en retard à l'école hier.

examples.text: Corri para chegar a tempo.

translations.de: Ich bin gerannt, um es noch rechtzeitig zu schaffen.
translations.en: I ran in order to be on time.
translations.fr: J'ai couru pour être à l'heure.

more.definition: to arrive (at); to reach (to conclude moving to a destination); to arrive (to reach the present time); to reach (to extend to as far as)
more.etymology: Inherited from Old Galician-Portuguese chegar, apheresis of Latin applicāre. Compare Galician chegar and Spanish llegar. See also the doublets pregar and plicar.

examples.text: O Tom está escrevendo para um amigo.

translations.de: Tom schreibt einem Freund.
translations.en: Tom is writing to a friend.
translations.fr: Tom écrit à un ami.

examples.text: Nossos amigos de infância são amigos para sempre.

translations.de: Unsere Kindheitsfreunde bleiben Freunde fürs Leben.
translations.en: Our childhood friends are friends forever.
translations.fr: Nos amis d'enfance sont des amis pour toujours.

examples.text: Nossa amiga Eli tem cinquenta anos.

translations.de: Unsere Freundin Eli ist fünfzig Jahre alt.
translations.en: Our friend Eli is fifty years old.
translations.fr: Notre amie Eli a cinquante ans.

examples.text: Yumi é uma de minhas amigas.

translations.de: Yumi ist eine meiner Freundinnen.
translations.en: Yumi is one of my friends.
translations.fr: Yumi est une de mes amies.

more.definition: friendly (characteristic of friendliness); friendly (of or relating to friendlies); beneficial (helpful or good to something or someone)
more.etymology: From Old Galician-Portuguese amigo, from Latin amīcus (“friend; friendly”), from amō (“to love”) + -icus. Compare Catalan amic, French ami, Italian amico, Romanian amic and Spanish amigo.

senses.gloss: que tem ligação com outrem por amizade

examples.text: Tenho um amigo que mora em Londres.

translations.de: Ich habe einen Freund, der in London lebt.
translations.en: I have a friend living in London.
translations.fr: J'ai un ami qui vit à Londres.

examples.text: O Tom tem uma amiga turca.

translations.de: Tom hat eine türkische Freundin.
translations.en: Tom has a Turkish friend.
translations.fr: Tom a une amie turque.

examples.text: Todos os meus amigos têm filhos.

translations.de: Alle meine Freunde haben Kinder.
translations.en: All my friends have children.
translations.fr: Tous mes amis ont des enfants.

examples.text: Nós somos os campeões, meu amigo.

translations.de: Wir sind die Champions, mein Freund.
translations.en: We are the champions, my friend.
translations.fr: Nous sommes les champions, mon ami.

more.definition: friend (person whose company one enjoys); friend (an associate or thing which provides assistance); a state with good relations with another state
more.etymology: From Old Galician-Portuguese amigo, from Latin amīcus (“friend; friendly”), from amō (“to love”) + -icus. Compare Catalan amic, French ami, Italian amico, Romanian amic and Spanish amigo.

senses.gloss: pessoa à qual se tem amizade ou afeição

examples.text: Esse é o cachorro que matou meu gato.

translations.de: Das ist der Hund, der meine Katze getötet hat.
translations.en: This is the dog that killed my cat.
translations.fr: Voici le chien qui a tué mon chat.

examples.text: As palavras emocionam. Os olhos encantam. As mãos matam.

translations.de: Worte wecken Gefühle. Augen verzaubern. Hände töten.
translations.en: Words evoke emotion. Eyes enchant. Hands kill.
translations.fr: Les mots suscitent des émotions. Les yeux enchantent. Les mains tuent.

examples.text: O suspense está me matando!

translations.de: Die Spannung bringt mich noch um!
translations.en: The suspense is killing me!
translations.fr: Le suspense me tue !

examples.text: Minha mulher vai me matar.

translations.de: Meine Frau bringt mich noch um.
translations.en: My wife's going to kill me.
translations.fr: Ma femme va me tuer.

more.definition: to kill (to cause to die); to kill; to eradicate; to destroy; to kill (to cause extreme pain, distress or exhaustion in)
idioms: matar dois coelhos com uma só cajadada
matar dois coelhos com uma caixa d'água só
more.etymology: From Old Galician-Portuguese matar, probably from Latin mactāre (through Vulgar Latin *mattāre). The development of -ct- would be irregular, however. Hence possibly derived from or influenced by Late Latin mattus (“drunk, intoxicated”), related to madidus. Another possibility is an influence by Arabic مَاتَ (māta, “to die”).

examples.text: Você pode me ajudar, por favor?

translations.de: Kannst du mir bitte helfen?
translations.en: Can you help me, please?
translations.fr: Peux-tu m'aider, s'il te plaît ?

examples.text: Ele ajudou a irmã com a mudança.

translations.de: Er hat seiner Schwester beim Umzug geholfen.
translations.en: He helped his sister with the move.
translations.fr: Il a aidé sa sœur à déménager.

examples.text: Vá ajudar sua mãe. Ela está no jardim.

translations.de: Geh und hilf deiner Mutter. Sie ist im Garten.
translations.en: Go and help your mom. She's in the garden.
translations.fr: Va aider ta mère. Elle est dans le jardin.

examples.text: Me ajude a mover essa pedra.

translations.de: Hilf mir, diesen Stein zu versetzen.
translations.en: Help me move this stone.
translations.fr: Aide-moi à déplacer cette pierre.

examples.text: Pedi a Mike que me ajudasse.

translations.de: Ich fragte Mike mir zu helfen.
translations.en: I asked Mike to help me.
translations.fr: J’ai demandé à Mike de m’aider.

examples.text: Tom está ajudando a esposa.

translations.de: Tom hilft seiner Frau.
translations.en: Tom is helping his wife.
translations.fr: Tom aide sa femme.

more.definition: to help, aid; to assist
collocations: dar uma mão — to lend a hand
more.etymology: Proto-Indo-European *-h₂tiinflu. Inherited from Old Galician-Portuguese ajudar, from Latin adiūtāre. Compare Asturian ayudar, Catalan ajudar, Ladino ayudar, Occitan ajudar, Spanish ayudar.

examples.text: Tom não se parece nem um pouco com o pai.

translations.de: Tom ist seinem Vater überhaupt nicht ähnlich.
translations.en: Tom doesn't look like his father at all.
translations.fr: Tom ne ressemble pas du tout à son père.

examples.text: As borboletas vivem pouco.

translations.de: Schmetterlinge haben ein kurzes Leben.
translations.en: Butterflies have short life spans.
translations.fr: Les papillons ont la vie courte.

examples.text: O leite ainda está muito quente. Espere um pouco para beber.

translations.de: Die Milch ist noch sehr heiß. Warten Sie einen Moment, bevor Sie sie trinken.
translations.en: The milk is still too hot. Wait a little while before drinking it.
translations.fr: Le lait est encore très chaud. Attendez un peu avant de le boire.

examples.text: Ouvi um barulho estranho, mas durou pouco. Logo tudo voltou ao normal.

translations.de: Ich hörte ein seltsames Geräusch, aber es dauerte nur kurz. Bald war alles wieder normal.
translations.en: I heard a strange noise, but it didn't last long. Soon, everything went back to normal.
translations.fr: J'ai entendu un bruit étrange, mais il a été de courte durée. Tout est vite rentré dans l'ordre.

more.etymology: Do latim paucu⁽ˡᵃ⁾.

examples.text: Eu entendo um pouco de japonês.

translations.de: Ich verstehe ein wenig Japanisch.
translations.en: I understand Japanese a little.
translations.fr: Je comprends un peu le japonais.

examples.text: A sua opinião está um pouco fora de moda.

translations.de: Deine Ansicht ist ein wenig altmodisch.
translations.en: Your opinion is somewhat old-fashioned.
translations.fr: Ton opinion est un peu démodée.

examples.text: Beba um pouco de chá.

translations.de: Trinken Sie ein bisschen Tee.
translations.en: Drink some tea.
translations.fr: Buvez un peu de thé.

examples.text: As alegrias duram pouco.

translations.de: Die Freuden sind von kurzer Dauer.
translations.en: The joys are short-lived.
translations.fr: Les joies sont éphémères.

more.definition: little (not much or not often); for a short duration
more.etymology: Inherited from Old Galician-Portuguese pouco, from Latin paucus, from Proto-Italic *paukos, ultimately from the Proto-Indo-European *peh₂w- (“few”, “little”). Compare Galician pouco and Spanish poco.

examples.text: Há muitos peixes no mar e poucas nuvens no céu.

translations.de: Es gibt viele Fische im Meer und wenige Wolken am Himmel.
translations.en: There are many fish in the sea and few clouds in the sky.
translations.fr: Il y a beaucoup de poissons dans la mer et peu de nuages dans le ciel.

examples.text: O estádio ainda há pouco estava completamente vazio, mas já está lotado.

translations.de: Das Stadion war vor einem Augenblick noch völlig leer, aber jetzt ist es schon wieder voll.
translations.en: The stadium was empty just a short while ago, but now it is packed.
translations.fr: Le stade était complètement vide il y a un instant, mais il est déjà plein à craquer.

examples.text: Pouca importa quanto isto custa.

translations.de: Egal wie viel es kostet.
translations.en: No matter how much it costs.
translations.fr: Peu importe combien ça coûte.

examples.text: Ele começou a estudar turco há poucos dias.

translations.de: Er hat vor ein paar Tagen angefangen, Türkisch zu lernen.
translations.en: He started studying Turkish a few days ago.
translations.fr: Il a commencé à étudier le turc il y a quelques jours.

more.definition: little; few (not many)

examples.text: Se os humanos cantassem mais um pouco, este mundo seria menos louco.

translations.de: Wenn die Menschen etwas mehr singen würden, wäre diese Welt weniger verrückt.
translations.en: If humans sang a little more, this world would be less crazy.
translations.fr: Si les humains chantaient un peu plus, ce monde serait moins fou.

examples.text: Cada dia que termina nos aproxima um pouco mais de nossa morte.

translations.de: Jeder Tag, der zu Ende geht, bringt uns unserem Tod ein Stück näher.
translations.en: Every day that ends brings us a little closer to our death.
translations.fr: Chaque jour qui se termine nous rapproche un peu plus de notre mort.

examples.text: Poucos erros comete aquele que pouco escreve.

translations.de: Wer wenig schreibt, macht wenige Fehler.
translations.en: The one who writes little makes few mistakes.
translations.fr: Celui qui écrit peu fait peu d'erreurs.

examples.text: Tom precisa perder um pouco de peso.

translations.de: Tom muss ein bisschen abnehmen.
translations.en: Tom needs to lose a bit of weight.
translations.fr: Tom a besoin de perdre un peu de poids.

more.etymology: Do latim paucu⁽ˡᵃ⁾.

examples.text: Tom precisa perder um pouco de peso.

translations.de: Tom muss ein bisschen abnehmen.

translations.fr: Tom a besoin de perdre un peu de poids.

examples.text: Há um pouco de dinheiro na bolsa.

translations.de: In der Tasche ist ein bisschen Geld.

translations.fr: Il y a un peu d'argent dans le sac.

examples.text: Eu traduziria um pouco menos literalmente.

translations.de: Ich würde es etwas weniger wörtlich übersetzen.

translations.fr: Je le traduirais un peu moins littéralement.

examples.text: Só quero pegar um pouco de ar fresco.

translations.de: Ich will einfach nur etwas frische Luft schnappen.
translations.en: I just want to get a little fresh air.
translations.fr: Je veux simplement prendre un peu d'air frais.

more.definition: little of something; a short while
more.etymology: Inherited from Old Galician-Portuguese pouco, from Latin paucus, from Proto-Italic *paukos, ultimately from the Proto-Indo-European *peh₂w- (“few”, “little”). Compare Galician pouco and Spanish poco.

examples.text: O gato foi domesticado pelos egípcios.

translations.de: Die Katze wurde von den Ägyptern domestiziert.
translations.en: The cat was domesticated by the Egyptians.
translations.fr: Le chat a été domestiqué par les Égyptiens.

examples.text: A armadura de Marte foi fabricada pelos ciclopes.

translations.de: Die Rüstung des Mars wurde von den Zyklopen hergestellt.
translations.en: Mars' armor was made by the Cyclopes.
translations.fr: L'armure de Mars a été fabriquée par les Cyclopes.

examples.text: Detroit é famosa pela sua indústria automobilística.

translations.de: Detroit ist berühmt für seine Automobilindustrie.
translations.en: Detroit is famous for its car industry.
translations.fr: Détroit est célèbre pour son industrie automobile.

examples.text: Movido pelo ciúme, ele agrediu violentamente o rival.

translations.de: Von Eifersucht getrieben, griff er seinen Rivalen heftig an.
translations.en: Driven by jealousy, he violently assaulted his rival.
translations.fr: Poussé par la jalousie, il attaqua violemment son rival.

more.definition: contraction of por + o; by the; for the; through the
more.etymology: Inherited from Old Galician-Portuguese pello, from Vulgar Latin *per (“by; through”) + *lo (“the”).

examples.text: O gato foi domesticado pelos egípcios.

translations.de: Die Katze wurde von den Ägyptern domestiziert.

examples.text: A bola voou pelo ar.

examples.text: A armadura de Marte foi fabricada pelos ciclopes.

translations.en: Mars' armor was made by the Cyclopes.
translations.fr: L'armure de Mars a été fabriquée par les Cyclopes.

examples.text: Acelera-se a corrida global pelo aperfeiçoamento da inteligência artificial.

translations.de: Der globale Wettlauf um die Verbesserung künstlicher Intelligenz beschleunigt sich.
translations.en: The global race to advance artificial intelligence is accelerating.
translations.fr: La course mondiale pour améliorer l'intelligence artificielle s'accélère.

more.definition: hair (filament which grows on the skin of mammals), except hair on top of humans’ heads, which is called cabelo; hair; fur (an animal’s hair as a whole)
more.etymology: Inherited from Old Galician-Portuguese pelo, from Latin pilus, from Proto-Indo-European *pil-. The retention of single Latin /l/ in intervocalic position is irregular and may be the product of analogy with the near-synonym cabelo < Latin capillus.

examples.text: Estou começando a entender o espírito de Toki Pona.

translations.de: Ich fange an, den Geist von Toki Pona zu verstehen.
translations.en: I'm starting to understand the spirit of Toki Pona.
translations.fr: Je commence à comprendre l'esprit du toki pona.

more.etymology: Do infinitivo latino intendere.

examples.text: Embora você entenda francês, não entende espanhol.

translations.de: Auch wenn Sie Französisch verstehen, verstehen Sie kein Spanisch.
translations.en: Even though you understand French, you don't understand Spanish.
translations.fr: Bien que tu comprennes le français, tu ne comprends pas l'espagnol.

examples.text: Não é fácil entender as suas ideias.

translations.de: Es ist nicht leicht, seine Gedanken zu verstehen.
translations.en: It isn't easy to understand his ideas.
translations.fr: Il n'est pas facile de comprendre ses idées.

examples.text: Não entendo o significado desta frase.

translations.de: Ich verstehe die Bedeutung dieses Satzes nicht.
translations.en: I don't understand the meaning of this phrase.
translations.fr: Je ne comprends pas cette phrase.

examples.text: Desculpe, porém devo confessar que não entendi bem seu comentário.

translations.de: Es tut mir leid, aber ich muss gestehen, dass ich Ihren Kommentar nicht ganz verstanden habe.
translations.en: Sorry, but I must confess that I didn't quite understand your comment.
translations.fr: Désolé, mais je dois avouer que je n'ai pas bien compris votre commentaire.

more.definition: to understand, to grasp, to comprehend; to have a good or satisfactory relationship (with someone)
more.etymology: Inherited from Old Galician-Portuguese entender, from Latin intendere. Doublet of intender, a borrowing.

senses.gloss: perceber o significado de algo; compreender

examples.text: O que é isto?

translations.de: Was ist das?
translations.en: What is this?
translations.fr: C'est quoi ?

examples.text: Isto vale um milhão de ienes.

translations.de: Dies ist eine Million Yen wert.
translations.en: This is worth one million yen.
translations.fr: Ceci vaut un million de yen.

examples.text: Isto é um mau sinal.

translations.de: Das ist kein gutes Zeichen.
translations.en: This is a bad sign.
translations.fr: C'est mauvais signe.

examples.text: Isto não é um jogo.

translations.de: Das hier ist kein Spiel.
translations.en: This is not a game.
translations.fr: Ce n'est pas un jeu.

more.definition: that’s right, that’s correct; akin to English this!; yeah! (expresses happiness with an outcome)
more.etymology: From Old Galician-Portuguese isto, from Latin istud, neuter of iste (“that”).

examples.text: Por que é que fizeste isto?

translations.de: Warum hast du's getan?
translations.en: Why have you done this?
translations.fr: Pourquoi l'as-tu fait ?

examples.text: Alguém pode me explicar o que isto significa?

translations.de: Kann mir jemand erklären, was das bedeutet?
translations.en: Can anyone explain to me what this means?
translations.fr: Quelqu'un peut-il m'expliquer ce que cela signifie ?

examples.text: Não tenho tempo para isto.

translations.de: Ich habe keine Zeit dafür.
translations.en: I've got no time for that.
translations.fr: Je n'ai pas le temps pour ça.

examples.text: Mas o que tudo isto tem a ver com Tatoeba?

translations.de: Aber was hat das alles mit Tatoeba zu tun?
translations.en: But what does all this have to do with Tatoeba?
translations.fr: Mais en quoi tout ceci est-il relié à Tatoeba ?

more.definition: this (the thing here); this (the thing being discussed; the current situation)
more.etymology: From Old Galician-Portuguese isto, from Latin istud, neuter of iste (“that”).

examples.text: A natureza sempre supera a imaginação humana.

translations.de: Die Natur übertrifft stets die menschliche Vorstellungskraft.
translations.en: Nature always surpasses human imagination.
translations.fr: La nature dépasse toujours l'imagination humaine.

examples.text: O quarto de meu irmão está sempre desarrumado.

translations.de: Das Zimmer meines Bruders ist immer unordentlich.
translations.en: My brother's room is always messy.
translations.fr: La chambre de mon frère est toujours en désordre.

examples.text: Traduzir literalmente nem sempre é a melhor opção.

translations.de: Wörtliches Übersetzen ist nicht immer die beste Option.
translations.en: Translating literally is not always the best option.
translations.fr: Traduire littéralement n’est pas toujours la meilleure option.

examples.text: O anoitecer sempre me traz melancolia.

translations.de: Die Abenddämmerung bereitet mir immer Melancholie.
translations.en: Nightfall always brings me melancholy.
translations.fr: Le crépuscule m'apporte toujours de la mélancolie.

more.definition: always (at all times); always (regularly at stated intervals)
more.etymology: Proto-Indo-European *sem-der. Inherited from Old Galician-Portuguese sempre, from Latin semper. Compare Catalan sempre and Spanish siempre.

examples.text: Eles moram em uma cidade grande.

translations.de: Sie wohnen in einer großen Stadt.
translations.en: They live in a big city.
translations.fr: Ils habitent dans une grande ville.

examples.text: Esta camisa é grande demais para mim.

translations.de: Dieses Hemd ist mir zu groß.
translations.en: This shirt is too big for me.
translations.fr: Cette chemise est trop grande pour moi.

examples.text: Marina foi o grande amor da minha vida.

translations.de: Marina war die große Liebe meines Lebens.
translations.en: Marina was the great love of my life.
translations.fr: Marina a été le grand amour de ma vie.

examples.text: Os carros americanos são muito grandes.

translations.de: Amerikanische Autos sind sehr groß.
translations.en: American cars are very big.
translations.fr: Les voitures américaines sont très grandes.

examples.text: Paris é uma grande capital cultural.

translations.de: Paris ist eine große Kulturhauptstadt.
translations.en: Paris is a large cultural capital.
translations.fr: Paris est une grande capitale culturelle.

examples.text: Estou assando o grande peixe azul.

translations.de: Ich brate den großen blauen Fisch.
translations.en: I'm roasting the big blue fish.
translations.fr: Je fais rôtir le gros poisson bleu.

more.definition: large; great; big (of great size or extent); large; big; numerous (numerically large); great (of great importance)
more.etymology: From Old Galician-Portuguese grande, from Latin grandis, of uncertain origin.

senses.gloss: que tem dimensões mais que ordinárias

examples.text: O cachorro do Ken é muito grande.

translations.de: Kens Hund ist sehr groß.
translations.en: Ken's dog is very big.
translations.fr: Le chien de Ken est très grand.

examples.text: As vacas têm grandes olhos, tristes e pensativos.

translations.de: Kühe haben große Augen, traurig und nachdenklich.
translations.en: Cows have large, sad, and thoughtful eyes.
translations.fr: Les vaches ont de grands yeux, tristes et pensifs.

examples.text: Uma grande aranha estava tecendo uma teia.

translations.de: Eine große Spinne spann ein Netz.
translations.en: A big spider was spinning a web.
translations.fr: Une grosse araignée tissait une toile.

examples.text: O Japão importa grande quantidade de petróleo.

translations.de: Japan importiert große Mengen Rohöl.
translations.en: Japan imports great quantities of crude oil.
translations.fr: Le Japon importe une grande quantité de pétrole.

more.definition: A term of address for someone
more.etymology: From Old Galician-Portuguese grande, from Latin grandis, of uncertain origin.

examples.text: Chegou a hora da verdade.

translations.de: Der Moment der Wahrheit ist gekommen.
translations.en: The moment of truth has arrived.
translations.fr: Le moment de vérité est arrivé.

examples.text: Ele diz que é viúvo, mas não é verdade.

translations.de: Er sagt, er ist verwitwet, aber das stimmt nicht.
translations.en: He says he's widowed, but it's not true.
translations.fr: Il dit qu'il est veuf, mais ce n'est pas vrai.

examples.text: Se ele disse a verdade, afogou Ramsés em desespero.

translations.de: Wenn er die Wahrheit gesagt hat, hat er Ramses in seiner Verzweiflung ertränkt.
translations.en: If he told the truth, he drowned Ramses in despair.
translations.fr: S'il a dit la vérité, il a noyé Ramsès dans le désespoir.

examples.text: Isso é a pura verdade.

translations.de: Das ist die reine Wahrheit.
translations.en: That's the absolute truth.
translations.fr: C'est la pure vérité.

more.definition: true, exactly, indeed (expressing agreement)
more.etymology: Inherited from Old Galician-Portuguese verdade, from Latin vēritātem (“truth”).

examples.text: É verdade que a Terra é redonda.

translations.de: Es ist wahr, dass die Erde rund ist.
translations.en: It's true that the earth is round.
translations.fr: Il est vrai que la Terre est ronde.

examples.text: Arrependo-me de ter dito a verdade.

translations.de: Ich bereue, dir die Wahrheit gesagt zu haben.
translations.en: I regret having spoken the truth.
translations.fr: Je regrette de t'avoir dit la vérité.

examples.text: A verdade destrói todos os grilhões.

translations.de: Die Wahrheit zerstört alle Fesseln.
translations.en: Truth destroys all shackles.
translations.fr: La vérité détruit toutes les chaînes.

examples.text: Eu não sei se é verdade.

translations.de: Ich weiß nicht, ob es wahr ist.
translations.en: I don't know if it is true.
translations.fr: Je ne sais pas si c'est vrai.

more.definition: truth (conformity to fact or reality); truth (true facts); a true statement or fact
more.etymology: Inherited from Old Galician-Portuguese verdade, from Latin vēritātem (“truth”).

senses.gloss: condição daquilo que corresponde à realidade

translations.fr: Les matins sont plus lumineux que les après-midis.

translations.fr: Le salon est lumineux, mais j'ai trouvé la cuisine trop sombre.

translations.fr: Est-ce que c'est clair ?

examples.text: A biografia dele foi traduzida para dez idiomas.

translations.de: Seine Biografie wurde in zehn Sprachen übersetzt.
translations.en: His biography has been translated into ten languages.
translations.fr: Sa biographie a été traduite en dix langues.

examples.text: Todos nós podemos nos beneficiar da experiência dele.

translations.de: Wir können alle von seiner Erfahrung profitieren.
translations.en: We can all benefit from his experience.
translations.fr: Nous pouvons tous bénéficier de son expérience.

examples.text: O gato viu um rato e correu atrás dele.

translations.de: Die Katze sah eine Maus und lief ihr nach.
translations.en: The cat saw a mouse and ran after it.
translations.fr: Le chat a vu une souris et a couru après elle.

examples.text: Este é o carro dele.

translations.de: Das ist sein Auto.
translations.en: This is his car.
translations.fr: C'est sa voiture.

examples.text: A borboleta é uma flor leve que esvoaça.

translations.en: The butterfly is a light flower that flutters.
translations.fr: Le papillon est une fleur légère qui vole.

examples.text: Este ônibus te levará ao museu.

translations.de: Dieser Bus bringt dich zum Museum.
translations.en: This bus will take you to the museum.
translations.fr: Ce bus vous emmènera au musée.

examples.text: Acho que vai chover. Vou levar o guarda-chuva.

translations.de: Ich glaube, es wird regnen. Ich nehme meinen Regenschirm mit.
translations.en: I think it's going to rain. I'll take my umbrella.
translations.fr: Je crois qu'il va pleuvoir. Je vais prendre mon parapluie.

examples.text: Meu marido está levando as crianças para a escola.

translations.de: Mein Mann fährt die Kinder zur Schule.
translations.en: My husband is taking the children to school.
translations.fr: Mon mari emmène les enfants à l'école.

examples.text: Vocês acreditavam nas mentiras que ele lhes contava.

translations.en: You used to believe the lies he used to tell you.
translations.fr: Vous croyiez aux mensonges qu'il vous racontait.

translations.fr: Je vais te dire un secret.

translations.de: Ich habe ein Facebook-Profil.
translations.en: I have a Facebook account.
translations.fr: J'ai un compte Facebook.

examples.text: Me conte como você resolveu o problema.

translations.fr: Dis-moi comment tu as résolu le problème.

senses.gloss: enumerar os elementos de uma série

examples.text: Pela amostra se conhece o pano.

translations.en: The fabric can be identified by the sample.
translations.fr: Le tissu peut être identifié par l'échantillon.

examples.text: Não conheço a bandeira deste país.

translations.de: Ich kenne die Flagge dieses Landes nicht.
translations.en: I don't know this country's flag.
translations.fr: Je ne connais pas le drapeau de ce pays.

examples.text: Tu não conhecias esta palavra?

translations.de: Du kanntest dieses Wort nicht?
translations.en: Didn't you know this word?
translations.fr: Tu ne connaissais pas ce mot ?

examples.text: Tom não conhecia a Mary.

translations.de: Tom kannte Mary nicht.
translations.en: Tom didn't know Mary.
translations.fr: Tom ne connaissait pas Mary.

translations.de: Er rauchte nach dem Mittagessen eine Zigarre.
translations.en: He smoked a cigar after lunch.
translations.fr: Il fumait un cigare après le déjeuner.

examples.text: A primavera vem depois do inverno.

translations.de: Der Frühling kommt nach dem Winter.
translations.en: Spring comes after winter.
translations.fr: Le printemps vient après l'hiver.
