translations.de: Montag ist der Tag nach Sonntag.
translations.en: Monday is the day that comes after Sunday.
translations.fr: Le lundi est le jour qui suit le dimanche.

examples.text: Sábado é o dia que vem depois da sexta-feira.

translations.de: Samstag ist der Tag nach Freitag.
translations.en: Saturday is the day that comes after Friday.
translations.fr: Le samedi est le jour qui suit le vendredi.

more.definition: later (afterwards in time); besides; after all; immediately beyond, just after
more.etymology: From Old Galician-Portuguese depois, depos, from Vulgar Latin dē post. Compare Spanish después, French depuis.

senses.gloss: mais tarde; em uma outra oportunidade

examples.text: Nossa consciência deve existir antes de nossa capacidade computacional algorítmica.

translations.de: Unser Bewusstsein muss vor unserer algorithmischen Computerkapazität existieren.
translations.en: Our consciousness must exist prior to our algorithmic computer capacity.
translations.fr: Notre conscience doit exister avant notre capacité informatique algorithmique.

examples.text: Ela corre todas as manhãs, antes do café da manhã.

translations.de: Sie geht jeden Morgen vor dem Frühstück joggen.
translations.en: She goes jogging every morning before breakfast.
translations.fr: Elle va courir chaque matin avant le petit-déjeuner.

examples.text: Pense bem antes de tomar essa decisão, senão poderá se arrepender.

translations.de: Überlege es dir gut, bevor du diese Entscheidung triffst – sonst könntest du es bereuen.
translations.en: Think carefully before making this decision; otherwise you might regret it.
translations.fr: Réfléchissez bien avant de prendre cette décision, sinon vous risquez de le regretter.

examples.text: Vocês não deveriam estar rindo. Antes, deveriam estar chorando.

translations.de: Ihr solltet nicht lachen. Ihr solltet vielmehr weinen.
translations.en: You shouldn't be laughing. You should be crying instead.
translations.fr: Vous ne devriez pas rire. Au contraire, vous devriez pleurer.

more.definition: before (at an earlier time); in the past; previously; preferably, better, rather
more.etymology: Inherited from Old Galician-Portuguese antes, from ante with the adverbial -s, the former from Proto-Indo-European *h₂énti.

examples.text: Me desculpe, minha mãe não está em casa.

translations.de: Ich bedauere, meine Mutter ist nicht zu Hause.
translations.en: I'm sorry, my mother's not at home.
translations.fr: Je suis désolé, ma mère n'est pas à la maison.

examples.text: Eu não tenho de me desculpar. Ele está errado.

translations.de: Ich muss mich nicht entschuldigen. Er irrt sich.
translations.en: I don't have to apologize. He's wrong.
translations.fr: Je n'ai pas à m'excuser. Il a tort.

examples.text: Desculpem meus erros. Tenho pressa. Meu prazo está vencendo.

translations.de: Ich bitte um Entschuldigung für meine Fehler. Ich bin in Eile. Meine Frist läuft ab.
translations.en: Please excuse my mistakes. I'm in a hurry. My deadline is approaching.
translations.fr: Excusez mes erreurs. Je suis pressé. Mon délai expire bientôt.

examples.text: É um erro de digitação. Desculpe.

translations.de: Das ist ein Tippfehler. Entschuldigung!
translations.en: That's a typo. Sorry.
translations.fr: C'est une faute de frappe. Désolé.

more.definition: to forgive; to justify; to apologise (to make an apology or excuse)
more.etymology: (Morfologia) des- + culpar

examples.text: Ele estará de volta em uma hora.

translations.de: Er wird in einer Stunde zurück sein.
translations.en: He will be back in an hour.
translations.fr: Il sera de retour dans une heure.

examples.text: A que horas chega o ônibus?

translations.de: Um wie viel Uhr kommt der Bus?
translations.en: At what time does the bus come?
translations.fr: À quelle heure arrive le bus ?

examples.text: Tudo estará pronto em uma hora.

translations.de: In einer Stunde ist alles fertig.
translations.en: Everything will be ready in an hour.
translations.fr: Tout sera prêt dans une heure.

examples.text: Ele corria todos os dias durante uma hora.

translations.de: Er rannte jeden Tag eine Stunde lang.
translations.en: He used to run every day for an hour.
translations.fr: Il courait tous les jours pendant une heure.

more.definition: hour (period of sixty minutes); time (point in time)
more.etymology: Ancient Greek ὥρᾱ (hṓrā)bor. Inherited from Old Galician-Portuguese ora, from Latin hōra. Doublet of ora.

senses.gloss: período de sessenta minutos de tempo; unidade de medida de tempo

examples.text: Qual o lugar mais bonito do mundo?‎

translations.de: Wo ist der schönste Ort der Welt?
translations.en: What's the most beautiful place in the world?
translations.fr: Quel est le plus bel endroit du monde ?

examples.text: Aqui você está protegida. Este lugar é seguro.

translations.de: Hier bist du in Sicherheit. Dieser Ort ist sicher.
translations.en: You are protected here. This place is safe.
translations.fr: Ici, vous êtes protégée. Cet endroit est sûr.

examples.text: Ele terminou em décimo primeiro lugar no torneio.

translations.de: Er belegte im Turnier den elften Platz.
translations.en: He finished eleventh in the tournament.
translations.fr: Il a terminé onzième du tournoi.

examples.text: Eles escolheram um lugar para fundar uma cidade.

translations.de: Sie wählten einen Ort, um eine Stadt zu gründen.
translations.en: They chose a place to found a city.
translations.fr: Ils ont choisi un lieu pour fonder une ville.

more.definition: place (a location or position); available room; place (a position within a rank)
more.etymology: Inherited from Old Galician-Portuguese logar, from Late Latin locālem (“local”), from Latin locus (“place”), from Latin stlocus, from Proto-Indo-European *stel- (“to put”). Compare Galician lugar, Fala lugal, Asturian llugar, and Spanish lugar. Doublet of local.

examples.text: Ainda não comecei a ler o teu livro.

translations.de: Ich habe noch nicht angefangen, dein Buch zu lesen.
translations.en: I haven't started reading your book yet.
translations.fr: Je n'ai pas encore commencé à lire ton livre.

examples.text: Você começou a estudar francês?

translations.de: Hast du angefangen, Französisch zu lernen?
translations.en: Have you begun studying French?
translations.fr: As-tu commencé à étudier le français ?

examples.text: O experimento tem de começar.

translations.de: Das Experiment muss losgehen.
translations.en: The experiment has to begin.
translations.fr: L'expérience doit commencer.

examples.text: A língua turca começa a revelar-me os seus segredos.

translations.de: Die türkische Sprache beginnt mir ihre Geheimnisse zu offenbaren.
translations.en: The Turkish language is beginning to reveal its secrets to me.
translations.fr: La langue turque commence à me dévoiler ses secrets.

more.definition: to start; to begin; to commence; to begin; to start to do; to start; to initiate (to cause something to begin)
more.etymology: Inherited from Old Galician-Portuguese começar, from Vulgar Latin *cominitiāre, from com- + Latin initiāre. Compare Galician comezar. It has been supposed that the Portuguese form developed via an unattested *comẽeçar, but this appears unlikely. The loss of /n/ was likely due to analogy with the synonym empeçar (cf. Spanish comenzar, diphthongally influenced by empezar).

examples.text: Acenda logo a lareira. Estamos morrendo de frio!

translations.de: Zündet schnell den Kamin an! Uns ist eiskalt!
translations.en: Light the fireplace quickly. We're freezing!
translations.fr: Allumez vite la cheminée. Nous mourons de froid.

examples.text: Já não penso em morrer, quero muito viver.

translations.de: Ich denke nicht mehr ans Sterben, ich möchte wirklich leben.
translations.en: I don't think about dying anymore, I really want to live.
translations.fr: Je ne pense plus à mourir, j'ai vraiment envie de vivre.

examples.text: Podemos dizer que ele morreu feliz.

translations.de: Man kann sagen, dass er als glücklicher Mensch gestorben ist.
translations.en: We can say that he died a happy man.
translations.fr: On peut dire qu'il est mort heureux.

examples.text: Ai de mim! Se me abandonares, morrerei de tristeza.

translations.de: Wehe mir! Wenn du mich verlässt, werde ich vor Kummer sterben.
translations.en: Alas! If you abandon me, I will die of grief.
translations.fr: Malheur à moi ! Si tu m'abandonnes, je mourrai de chagrin.

more.definition: to die (to stop living); to die; to break down (to stop working); to be dead to (to lose all social ties with)
more.etymology: Inherited from Old Galician-Portuguese morrer, morer, from Latin morī (via a de-deponentized *morĕre).

examples.text: Se você estiver resfriado, qual remédio você toma?

translations.de: Welches Medikament nehmen Sie, wenn Sie erkältet sind?
translations.en: If you have a cold, what medicine do you take?
translations.fr: Si vous êtes enrhumé, quels médicaments prenez-vous ?

examples.text: Em qual pasta salvaste o arquivo?

translations.de: In welchen Ordner hast du die Datei gespeichert?
translations.en: In which folder did you save the file?
translations.fr: Dans quel dossier as-tu enregistré le fichier ?

examples.text: Quais são os nomes delas?

translations.de: Wie heißen die?
translations.en: What are their names?
translations.fr: Quels sont leurs noms ?

examples.text: A natureza é tal qual o corpo de Deus.

translations.de: Die Natur ist genau wie Gottes Körper.
translations.en: Nature is just like the body of God.
translations.fr: La nature est comme le corps de Dieu.

more.definition: which
more.etymology: Inherited from Old Galician-Portuguese qual, from Latin quālis (“which”).

examples.text: Para qual competição vocês treinavam?

translations.de: Für welchen Wettbewerb habt ihr trainiert?
translations.en: Which competition did you use to train for?
translations.fr: Vous vous entraîniez pour quelle compétition ?

examples.text: É o computador no qual ele escreveu seu artigo.

translations.de: Mit dem Computer schreibt er seine Artikel.
translations.en: That's the computer he used to write the article.
translations.fr: C'est l'ordinateur sur lequel il écrit son article.

examples.text: Qual é a cor do Mar Negro?

translations.de: Welche Farbe hat das Schwarze Meer?
translations.en: What colour is the Black Sea?
translations.fr: Quelle est la couleur de la Mer Noire ?

examples.text: Qual é o som da voz dela?

translations.de: Wie klingt ihre Stimme?
translations.en: What does her voice sound like?
translations.fr: À quoi ressemble sa voix ?

more.definition: which (what one)
more.etymology: Inherited from Old Galician-Portuguese qual, from Latin quālis (“which”).

senses.gloss: quem, que; o pronome qual enfatiza a eleição entre várias possibilidades

examples.text: O avião era apenas um pequenino ponto no céu.

translations.de: Das Flugzeug war nur ein winziger Punkt am Himmel.
translations.en: The plane was just a tiny dot in the sky.
translations.fr: L’avion n’était qu’un petit point dans le ciel.

examples.text: Ela sabe muitas línguas, mas escreve apenas em sua língua materna.

translations.de: Sie beherrscht viele Sprachen, schreibt aber nur in ihrer Muttersprache.
translations.en: She knows many languages, but writes only in her native tongue.
translations.fr: Elle connaît de nombreuses langues, mais n'écrit que dans sa langue maternelle.

examples.text: Nesta foto, eu me lembro, meu netinho tinha apenas cinco anos.

translations.de: Auf diesem Foto, ich erinnere mich, war mein Enkelsohn gerade einmal fünf Jahre alt.
translations.en: In this photo, I remember my grandson was only five years old.
translations.fr: Sur cette photo, je me souviens que mon petit-fils n'avait que cinq ans.

examples.text: O árbitro daquela partida não foi apenas incompetente, ele foi tendencioso.

translations.de: Der Schiedsrichter in diesem Spiel war nicht nur inkompetent, er war auch voreingenommen.
translations.en: The referee in that match was not just incompetent, he was biased.
translations.fr: L’arbitre de ce match n’était pas seulement incompétent, il était partial.

more.definition: only; just; merely (no more than); barely (by a small margin)
more.etymology: From Vulgar Latin *ad poenam, with an additional adverbial /-s/ (compare entrementes, ultimately from Latin interim).

examples.text: As primeiras cem frases são as mais difíceis.

translations.de: Die ersten hundert Sätze sind die schwierigsten.
translations.en: The first hundred sentences are the most difficult.
translations.fr: Les cent premières phrases sont les plus difficiles.

examples.text: Minha primeira professora chamava-se Iracema.

translations.de: Meine erste Lehrerin hieß Iracema.
translations.en: My first teacher was called Iracema.
translations.fr: Ma première institutrice s'appelait Iracema.

examples.text: Primeiro, ensinamos à Inteligência Artificial. Depois, aprendemos com ela.

translations.de: Zuerst bringen wir der künstlichen Intelligenz etwas bei. Dann lernen wir von ihr.
translations.en: First, we teach Artificial Intelligence. Then, we learn from it.
translations.fr: D'abord, nous enseignons à l'intelligence artificielle. Ensuite, nous apprenons d'elle.

examples.text: Aquela mulher que está na primeira fila é brasileira.

translations.de: Die Frau in der ersten Reihe ist Brasilianerin.
translations.en: That woman in the front row is Brazilian.
translations.fr: Cette femme au premier rang est brésilienne.

more.definition: first (ordinal form of um (“one”))
more.etymology: Inherited from Old Galician-Portuguese primeiro, from Latin prīmārius (“one of the first”), from prīmus (“first”). Doublet of primário and premiê. By surface analysis, primo + -eiro.

senses.gloss: refere-se àquele que ocupa a posição inicial em uma série; o mais antigo; o que vem antes

examples.text: O Primeiro Ser, a Fonte, o Criador é o que chamamos Deus.

translations.de: Das erste Wesen, die Quelle, der Schöpfer ist das, was wir Gott nennen.
translations.en: The First Being, the Source, the Creator is what we call God.
translations.fr: L'Être premier, la Source, le Créateur est ce que nous appelons Dieu.

examples.text: O exército de uniforme branco sempre faz o primeiro lance do jogo.

translations.de: Die Armee in weißer Uniform macht immer den ersten Zug im Spiel.
translations.en: The army in white uniform always makes the first move in the game.
translations.fr: L'armée en uniforme blanc fait toujours le premier pas dans le jeu.

examples.text: Me apressei para pegar o primeiro trem.

translations.de: Ich beeilte mich, um den ersten Zug zu kriegen.
translations.en: I hurried in order to catch the first train.
translations.fr: Je me dépêchai pour avoir le premier train.

examples.text: Janeiro é o primeiro mês do ano.

translations.de: Januar ist der erste Monat des Jahres.
translations.en: January is the first month of the year.
translations.fr: Janvier est le premier mois de l'année.

more.definition: first (before all others); first of all (used to introduce the first of a series of remarks, often with an angry tone)
more.etymology: Inherited from Old Galician-Portuguese primeiro, from Latin prīmārius (“one of the first”), from prīmus (“first”). Doublet of primário and premiê. By surface analysis, primo + -eiro.

senses.gloss: antes de tudo; antes que mais nada; em primeiro lugar

examples.text: Dê o primeiro passo.

translations.de: Mach den ersten Schritt.
translations.en: Take the first step.
translations.fr: Fais le premier pas.

examples.text: Estamos no vigésimo primeiro ano do século vinte e um.

translations.de: Wir sind im einundzwanzigsten Jahr des einundzwanzigsten Jahrhunderts.
translations.en: We are in the twenty-first year of the twenty-first century.
translations.fr: Nous sommes dans la vingt et unième année du vingt et unième siècle.

examples.text: Mulheres e crianças primeiro!

translations.de: Frauen und Kinder zuerst!
translations.en: Women and children first!
translations.fr: Les femmes et les enfants d'abord !

examples.text: É primeiro de abril.

translations.de: Es ist der erste April.
translations.en: It's April first.
translations.fr: C'est le premier avril.

more.definition: the first one; first (the first day of the month)
more.etymology: Inherited from Old Galician-Portuguese primeiro, from Latin prīmārius (“one of the first”), from prīmus (“first”). Doublet of primário and premiê. By surface analysis, primo + -eiro.

examples.text: Levantei-me mais cedo do que o habitual para apanhar o primeiro comboio.

translations.de: Ich stand früher als normal auf, um den ersten Zug zu nehmen.
translations.en: I got up earlier than usual so that I might catch the first train.
translations.fr: Je me suis levé plus tôt que d'habitude afin d'attraper le premier train.

examples.text: Ele terminou em décimo primeiro lugar no torneio.

translations.de: Er belegte im Turnier den elften Platz.
translations.en: He finished eleventh in the tournament.
translations.fr: Il a terminé onzième du tournoi.

examples.text: Primeiro as damas.

translations.de: Die Frauen zuerst.
translations.en: Ladies first.
translations.fr: Honneur aux dames.

examples.text: Dê o primeiro passo.

translations.de: Mach den ersten Schritt.
translations.en: Take the first step.
translations.fr: Fais le premier pas.

more.etymology: Do acusativo latino primarĭum com metátese do i gerando o descendente em português; primarĭu(m) > *primairo > *primâiro e com apofonia de ai para ei tornando primeiro. Comparado com o francês primaire e todos do latim primarĭus.

examples.text: Não falo nem francês nem alemão.

translations.de: Ich spreche weder Französisch noch Deutsch.
translations.en: I can speak neither French nor German.
translations.fr: Je ne parle ni français ni allemand.

examples.text: Você nem sequer me ofereceu uma xícara de chá.

translations.de: Du hast mir nicht einmal eine Tasse Tee gekauft.
translations.en: You didn't even treat me to a cup of tea.
translations.fr: Tu ne m'as même pas offert une tasse de thé.

examples.text: Eu não bebo nem fumo.

translations.de: Weder trinke ich, noch rauche ich.
translations.en: I don't drink or smoke.
translations.fr: Je ne bois ni ne fume.

examples.text: Não bebo nem fumo.

translations.de: Ich trinke und rauche nicht.
translations.en: I don't drink or smoke.
translations.fr: Je ne bois ni ne fume.

more.definition: not even (introduces an emphatic negation); do not even (introduces an emphatic negative command); neither … nor
more.etymology: Latin necder. Inherited from Old Galician-Portuguese nen, from Latin nec. Compare Galician nin, Catalan, French, and Spanish ni, Italian né.

examples.text: A alma não se vende nem se compra.

translations.de: Die Seele kann weder verkauft noch gekauft werden.
translations.en: The soul cannot be sold or bought.
translations.fr: L'âme ne se vend ni ne s'achète.

examples.text: O equilíbrio nem sempre é fácil.

translations.de: Balance zu halten ist nicht immer einfach.
translations.en: Balance isn't always easy.
translations.fr: L'équilibre n'est pas toujours facile.

examples.text: Nem o Tom nem a Mary falam espanhol.

translations.de: Weder Tom noch Maria spricht Spanisch.
translations.en: Neither Tom nor Mary speaks Spanish.
translations.fr: Ni Tom ni Mary ne parlent espagnol.

examples.text: Ele sempre come ovos sem sal nem pimenta.

translations.de: Er ißt die Eier immer ohne Salz und Pfeffer.
translations.en: He always eats eggs without salt or pepper.
translations.fr: Il mange les œufs toujours sans sel ni poivre.

more.definition: nor; and not (introduces a further negative statement); nor (introducing each except the first term of a series, indicating none of them is true)
more.etymology: Latin necder. Inherited from Old Galician-Portuguese nen, from Latin nec. Compare Galician nin, Catalan, French, and Spanish ni, Italian né.

senses.gloss: conjunção que liga orações ou termos, negando conjuntamente ambas as orações ou qualidades dos termos

examples.text: Não fumo nem bebo.

translations.de: Ich rauche und trinke nicht.
translations.en: I don't smoke or drink.
translations.fr: Je ne fume ni ne bois.

examples.text: A comida não deve ficar nem muito salgada nem sem sal.

translations.de: Das Essen sollte weder zu salzig noch zu fade sein.
translations.en: The food shouldn't be too salty or too bland.
translations.fr: Les aliments ne doivent être ni trop salés ni fades.

examples.text: Sossega, coração, contudo! Dorme! O sossego não quer razão nem causa.

translations.de: Doch sei still, Herz! Schlaf! Dem Frieden bedarf es weder Grund noch Ursache.
translations.en: Be still, heart, however! Sleep! Peace wants neither reason nor cause.
translations.fr: Reste calme, mon cœur ! Dors ! La paix ne manque ni de raison ni de cause.

examples.text: Os ricos nem sempre são mais felizes do que os pobres.

translations.de: Reiche sind nicht immer glücklicher als Arme.
translations.en: The rich are not always happier than the poor.
translations.fr: Les riches ne sont pas toujours plus heureux que les pauvres.

more.definition: nah, no
more.etymology: Latin necder. Inherited from Old Galician-Portuguese nen, from Latin nec. Compare Galician nin, Catalan, French, and Spanish ni, Italian né.

examples.text: Quando o sonho acabar, que afinal terei sido?

translations.de: Wer werde ich gewesen sein, wenn der Traum endet?
translations.en: When the dream ends, who will I have been, after all?
translations.fr: Quand le rêve prendra fin, qui aurai-je été, au final ?

examples.text: Onde se queimam livros, acaba-se queimando pessoas.

translations.de: Wo man Bücher verbrennt, verbrennt man auch am Ende Menschen.
translations.en: Where they burn books, they will eventually burn people.
translations.fr: Là où l'on brûle les livres, on finit aussi par brûler des hommes.

examples.text: Ele acabou de sair.

translations.de: Er ist gerade gegangen.
translations.en: He went out just now.
translations.fr: Il vient de partir.

examples.text: Acabaram-se as maçãs e as bananas em casa.

translations.de: Wir haben zu Hause keine Äpfel und Bananen mehr.
translations.en: We've run out of apples and bananas at home.
translations.fr: Nous n'avons plus de pommes ni de bananes à la maison.

more.definition: to finish (to be over, completed); to complete; to finish (to make done); to end up (to eventually do)
more.etymology: Proto-Indo-European *-h₂tiinflu. Inherited from Old Galician-Portuguese acabar, from Vulgar Latin *accapāre. Compare Spanish acabar, French achever and English achieve. By surface analysis, a- + cabo + -ar.

senses.gloss: levar ao seu termo (levar a termo), perfazer, terminar, concluir

examples.text: O garoto foi encontrado no meio da floresta.

translations.de: Der Junge wurde mitten im Wald gefunden.
translations.en: The boy was found in the middle of the forest.
translations.fr: Le garçon a été retrouvé au milieu de la forêt.

examples.text: Ela é a garota mais bonita.

translations.de: Sie ist das schönste Mädchen.
translations.en: She's the most beautiful girl.
translations.fr: Elle est la plus belle fille.

examples.text: Qual destes garotos é Masao?

translations.de: Welcher dieser Jungen ist Masao?
translations.en: Which one of these boys is Masao?
translations.fr: Lequel de ces garçons est Masao ?

examples.text: Tom é o garoto à direita.

translations.de: Tom ist der Junge rechts.
translations.en: Tom is the boy on the right.
translations.fr: Tom est le garçon sur la droite.

more.definition: boy, young man; café au lait, latte (coffee with milk)
more.etymology: Unknown. Maybe related to French gars.

senses.gloss: criança ou adolescente do sexo ou gênero masculino

examples.text: Minha caneta não é tão boa quanto a sua.

translations.de: Mein Kuli ist nicht so gut wie deiner.
translations.en: My pen isn't as good as yours.
translations.fr: Mon stylo n'est pas aussi bon que le tien.

examples.text: Nenhum outro esporte é tão popular quanto futebol no Brasil.

translations.de: Keine andere Sportart ist in Brasilien so populär wie Fußball.
translations.en: No other sport in Brazil is so popular as soccer.
translations.fr: Aucun sport n'est aussi populaire que le foot au Brésil.

examples.text: O pão dormido não é tão saboroso quanto o pão fresco.

translations.de: Altes Brot schmeckt nicht so gut wie frisches Brot.
translations.en: Stale bread isn't as tasty as fresh bread.
translations.fr: Le pain rassis n'est pas aussi savoureux que le pain frais.

examples.text: Quanto custa um quilo de maçã?

translations.de: Wie viel kostet ein Kilogramm Äpfel?
translations.en: How much does a kilogram of apples cost?
translations.fr: Combien coûte un kilo de pommes ?

more.definition: how (to what degree)
more.etymology: Inherited from Old Galician-Portuguese quanto, from Latin quantus (“how much; how many”). Doublet of quantum.

examples.text: É indelicado perguntar a uma mulher quantos anos ela tem.

translations.de: Es ist unhöflich, eine Frau nach ihrem Alter zu fragen.
translations.en: It is impolite to ask a woman how old she is.
translations.fr: Il est impoli de demander à une femme son âge.

examples.text: Quantas bolas são usadas no jogo de bilhar?

translations.de: Wie viele Kugeln werden beim Billardspiel verwendet?
translations.en: How many balls are used in a game of billiards?
translations.fr: Combien de boules sont utilisées dans une partie de billard ?

examples.text: Tanto em vida quanto depois de morto, ele foi desconhecido e ignorado.

translations.de: Sowohl im Leben als auch nach dem Tod war er unbekannt und wurde ignoriert.
translations.en: Both in life and after death, he was unknown and ignored.
translations.fr: De son vivant comme après sa mort, il était inconnu et ignoré.

examples.text: Quantas maçãs pode produzir uma semente de maçã?

translations.de: Wie viele Äpfel kann ein Apfelsamen produzieren?
translations.en: How many apples can an apple seed produce?
translations.fr: Combien de pommes une graine de pomme peut-elle produire ?

more.definition: how much; how many (what number or quantity of); that’s so many (that’s very numerous; that’s a large number of)
more.etymology: Inherited from Old Galician-Portuguese quanto, from Latin quantus (“how much; how many”). Doublet of quantum.

examples.text: Quanto custa uma passagem de ônibus?

translations.de: Wie viel kostet eine Busfahrkarte?
translations.en: How much does a bus ticket cost?
translations.fr: Combien coûte un ticket de bus ?

examples.text: Quanto mais nós temos, mais nós queremos ter.

translations.de: Je mehr wir haben, desto mehr wollen wir.
translations.en: The more we have, the more we want.
translations.fr: Plus nous avons, plus nous voulons.

examples.text: Acredito que o turco seja uma língua tão concisa quanto o latim.

translations.de: Ich glaube, dass das Türkische eine ebenso prägnante Sprache ist wie das Lateinische.
translations.en: I believe Turkish is as concise a language as Latin.
translations.fr: Je crois que le turc est une langue aussi concise que le latin.

examples.text: Quanto mais cedo, melhor, mas nunca é tarde demais.

translations.de: Je früher, desto besser, aber es ist nie zu spät.
translations.en: The sooner the better, but it's never too late.
translations.fr: Le plus tôt sera le mieux, mais il n'est jamais trop tard.

more.definition: as (to the same extent or degree that)
more.etymology: Inherited from Old Galician-Portuguese quanto, from Latin quantus (“how much; how many”). Doublet of quantum.

examples.text: Perguntei em quantas guerras o general tinha lutado.

translations.de: Ich fragte, wie viele Kriege der General geführt habe.
translations.en: I asked how many wars the general had fought.
translations.fr: J'ai demandé combien de guerres le général avait menées.

examples.text: Você sabe quanto isso custa?!

translations.de: Weißt du, wie viel das kostet!
translations.en: Do you know how much it costs?
translations.fr: Savez-vous combien ça coûte ‽

examples.text: De quantos em quantos anos o ano é bissexto?

translations.de: Wie oft kommt ein Schaltjahr vor?
translations.en: How often is it a leap year?
translations.fr: Combien de fois y a-t-il une année bissextile ?

examples.text: O Tom não é tão velho quanto eu sou.

translations.de: Tom ist nicht so alt wie ich.
translations.en: Tom isn't as old as I am.
translations.fr: Tom n'est pas aussi âgé que moi.

more.definition: how much (what price); as much as
more.etymology: Inherited from Old Galician-Portuguese quanto, from Latin quantus (“how much; how many”). Doublet of quantum.

examples.text: Aquela é minha mãe. Ela se chama Beatrice.

translations.de: Das ist meine Mutter. Sie heißt Beatrice.
translations.en: This is my mother. Her name is Beatrice.
translations.fr: C'est ma mère. Elle s'appelle Béatrice.

examples.text: Oi, eu me chamo Ken Saitou.

translations.de: Hallo, ich heiße Ken Saitou.
translations.en: Hi, my name is Ken Saitou.
translations.fr: Bonjour, je m'appelle Ken Saitou.

examples.text: Um dos apóstolos de Jesus chamava-se Paulo.

translations.de: Einer der Apostel Jesu hieß Paulus.
translations.en: One of Jesus' disciples was named Paul.
translations.fr: L'un des apôtres de Jésus s'appelait Paul.

examples.text: Minha filha está com febre. Devo chamar um médico?

translations.de: Meine Tochter hat Fieber. Soll ich einen Arzt rufen?
translations.en: My daughter has fever. Should I call the doctor?
translations.fr: Ma fille a de la fièvre. Dois-je appeler un médecin ?

more.definition: to call; to summon (to ask someone to come); to call, to name (to use as the name of); to call, to label
more.etymology: Inherited from Old Galician-Portuguese chamar, from Latin clāmāre (“to cry out”). Doublet of clamar, a learned borrowing. Cognate with Galician chamar, Catalan clamar, Italian chiamare and Spanish llamar.

senses.gloss: solicitar a atenção ou a aproximação de alguém ou de algum animal (com palavras ou sinais)

examples.text: O outono está aí.

translations.de: Der Herbst ist da.
translations.en: Autumn is just around the corner.
translations.fr: L'automne est là.

examples.text: Minha gata Zizi fugiu de casa. Você a viu por aí?

translations.de: Meine Katze Zizi ist von zu Hause weggelaufen. Haben Sie sie irgendwo gesehen?
translations.en: My cat, Zizi, ran away from home. Have you seen her around?
translations.fr: Ma chatte Zizi s'est enfuie de la maison. L'avez-vous vue dans les environs ?

examples.text: O urso estava aí, mas foi embora.

translations.de: Der Bär war da, aber er ging weg.
translations.en: The bear was there, but it left.
translations.fr: L'ours était là, mais il est parti.

examples.text: Olhei por aí, mas não vi ninguém.

translations.en: I looked around, but saw nobody.
translations.fr: J'ai regardé autour mais n'ai vu personne.

more.definition: there (close to the second person (you)); towards the second person; then (soon afterwards)
more.etymology: From Latin ad (“to, toward, at”) + ibī (“there”). Compare Galician aí, Spanish ahí.

senses.gloss: nesse lugar (em posição próxima à pessoa a quem se fala)

examples.text: O outono está aí.

translations.de: Der Herbst ist da.
translations.en: Autumn is just around the corner.
translations.fr: L'automne est là.

examples.text: Minha gata Zizi fugiu de casa. Você a viu por aí?

translations.de: Meine Katze Zizi ist von zu Hause weggelaufen. Haben Sie sie irgendwo gesehen?
translations.en: My cat, Zizi, ran away from home. Have you seen her around?
translations.fr: Ma chatte Zizi s'est enfuie de la maison. L'avez-vous vue dans les environs ?

examples.text: O urso estava aí, mas foi embora.

translations.de: Der Bär war da, aber er ging weg.
translations.en: The bear was there, but it left.
translations.fr: L'ours était là, mais il est parti.

examples.text: Onde está o Tom? Oh, aí está você!

translations.de: Wo ist denn Tom? – Ach, da bist du!
translations.en: Where's Tom? Oh, there you are!

more.definition: yeah! (expressing joy, celebration, glee, etc.)
more.etymology: From Latin ad (“to, toward, at”) + ibī (“there”). Compare Galician aí, Spanish ahí.

examples.text: Esta escola não aceita crianças que usem óculos.

translations.de: Diese Schule nimmt keine Kinder auf, die eine Brille tragen.
translations.en: This school does not accept children who wear glasses.
translations.fr: Cette école n'accepte pas les enfants qui portent des lunettes.

examples.text: Deveríamos fazer uso da energia atômica.

translations.de: Wir sollten Atomkraft nutzen.
translations.en: We should make use of atomic energy.
translations.fr: Nous devrions faire usage de l'énergie nucléaire.

examples.text: As trigêmeas são muito parecidas e usam sempre vestidos iguais.

translations.de: Die Drillinge sehen sich sehr ähnlich und tragen immer identische Kleider.
translations.en: The triplets look very much alike and always wear identical dresses.
translations.fr: Les triplées se ressemblent beaucoup et portent toujours des robes identiques.

examples.text: É importante acordar cedo e usar o tempo com sabedoria.

translations.de: Es ist wichtig, früh aufzustehen und seine Zeit sinnvoll zu nutzen.
translations.en: It's important to wake up early and use your time wisely.
translations.fr: Il est important de se réveiller tôt et d'utiliser son temps à bon escient.

more.definition: to use; to utilise; to employ; to make use of; to sport (to wear, wield or have as a notable feature); to use (to consume habitually)
more.etymology: Inherited from Old Galician-Portuguese usar, from Early Medieval Latin ūsāre.

senses.gloss: empregar habitualmente; fazer uso de; gastar com o uso; pôr em prática; pôr em uso; servir-se de; trazer ou fazer habitualmente; ter por costume; costumar; cotiar; deteriorar; praticar; trajar; trazer; vestir

examples.text: Você não está feliz? Qual é o problema?

translations.de: Du bist nicht glücklich? Worin besteht das Problem?
translations.en: Aren't you happy? What's the problem?
translations.fr: Tu n'es pas content ? Quel est le problème ?

examples.text: Os computadores nos salvam de perdas de tempo e de problemas.

translations.de: Computer ersparen uns eine Menge Zeit und Ärger.
translations.en: Computers save us a lot of time and trouble.
translations.fr: Les ordinateurs nous épargnent beaucoup de temps et d'ennuis.

examples.text: Qual é o teu problema?

translations.de: Was ist dein Problem?
translations.en: What is your problem?
translations.fr: Quel est ton problème ?

examples.text: Ele tentou resolver o problema.

translations.de: Er versuchte, das Problem zu lösen.
translations.en: He tried solving the problem.
translations.fr: Il essaya de résoudre le problème.

more.definition: problem (difficulty that has to be resolved or dealt with); problem (question to be answered); disorder (physical or psychical malfunction)
more.etymology: Proto-Indo-European *próder. Proto-Indo-European *gʷelH-der. Ancient Greek πρόβλημα (próblēma)bor. Latin problēmalbor. Learned borrowing from Latin problēma, borrowed from Ancient Greek πρόβλημα (próblēma, “obstacle”).

examples.text: Eu me lembro disso.

translations.de: Ich erinnere mich daran.
translations.en: I remember this.
translations.fr: Je m'en souviens.

examples.text: Todo mundo sabe disso.

translations.de: Jeder weiß das.
translations.en: Everybody knows that.
translations.fr: Tout le monde le sait.

examples.text: Ele não se lembra de nada disso.

translations.de: Er kann sich an nichts davon erinnern.
translations.en: He has no memory of it.

examples.text: Se alguém souber disso, vai lidar comigo.

translations.en: If anyone knows that, you're going to deal with me.
translations.fr: Si quelqu'un le sait, vous aurez affaire à moi.

more.definition: contraction of de + isso, literally “of this thing”: neuter of desse

examples.text: Não acredito que me possas esquecer.

translations.de: Ich glaube nicht, dass du mich vergessen könntest.
translations.en: I don't believe you can forget me.
translations.fr: Je ne crois pas que tu puisses m'oublier.

examples.text: Você acredita em todas as notícias que lê no jornal?

translations.de: Glauben Sie alle Nachrichten, die Sie in der Zeitung lesen?
translations.en: Do you believe all the news you read in the newspaper?
translations.fr: Croyez-vous à toutes les informations que vous lisez dans les journaux ?

examples.text: Alguns acreditam que o sete é um número da sorte.

translations.de: Manche sehen die Sieben als Glückszahl.
translations.en: Some believe that seven is a lucky number.
translations.fr: Nombreux sont ceux qui considèrent le sept comme chiffre de chance.

examples.text: Maria disse que me amava, mas eu não acreditei nela.

translations.de: Mary sagte, dass sie mich liebt, aber ich glaubte ihr nicht.
translations.en: Mary said that she loved me, but I didn't believe her.
translations.fr: Marie a dit qu'elle m'aimait, mais je ne l'ai pas crue.

more.definition: to believe (to accept that someone is telling the truth); to believe (to accept that something is true); to believe, to think (to consider likely)
more.etymology: Latin crēditumlbor. Italian creditobor. From a- + crédito + -ar.

examples.text: O rosto é a parte anterior da cabeça.

translations.de: Das Gesicht ist der vordere Teil des Kopfes.
translations.en: The face is the front part of the head.
translations.fr: Le visage est la partie avant de la tête.

examples.text: Desde que ela partiu, meus braços estão vazios.

translations.de: Seit sie gegangen ist, sind meine Arme leer.
translations.en: Since she left, my arms have been empty.
translations.fr: Depuis son départ, mes bras sont vides.

examples.text: Sejam puras as partes mais íntimas do coração.

translations.de: Lass die intimsten Teile des Herzens rein sein.
translations.en: Let the innermost parts of your heart be pure.
translations.fr: Que les parties les plus intimes du cœur soient pures.

examples.text: Ao partires deixaste só saudade em meu coração. Nele nada mais existe.

translations.de: Als du gegangen bist, hast du in meinem Herzen nur Sehnsucht zurückgelassen. Nichts anderes existiert darin.
translations.en: When you left, you left only longing in my heart. Nothing else exists in it.
translations.fr: Quand tu es parti, tu n'as laissé qu'un fort désir dans mon cœur. Rien d'autre n'y existe.

more.definition: to split (divide something, especially in two roughly equal parts); to split; to break apart (become divided, especially in two roughly equal parts); to depart; to leave; to go away
more.etymology: Proto-Indo-European *-yétider. Inherited from Old Galician-Portuguese partir, from Latin partīre.

examples.text: No Palácio das Galáxias mora o Eterno Rei.

translations.de: Der Ewige König wohnt im Palast der Galaxien.
translations.en: The Eternal King lives in the Palace of the Galaxies.
translations.fr: Le Roi Éternel réside au Palais des Galaxies.

examples.text: Nós somos a poeira das estrelas.

translations.de: Wir sind Sternenstaub.
translations.en: We are stardust.
translations.fr: Nous sommes de la poussière d'étoiles.

examples.text: Eu me perdi cruzando o vale das memórias.

translations.de: Ich habe mich beim Durchqueren des Tals der Erinnerungen verlaufen.
translations.en: I got lost in the valley of memories.
translations.fr: Je me suis perdu en traversant la vallée des souvenirs.

examples.text: A alegria das crianças é encantadora.

translations.de: Die Freude der Kinder ist bezaubernd.
translations.en: The children's joy is enchanting.
translations.fr: La joie des enfants est enchanteresse.

more.definition: contraction of de (“of/from”) + as f pl (“the”): feminine plural of do
more.etymology: De de + as.

examples.text: O que você gostaria de fazer hoje?

translations.de: Was möchtest du heute machen?
translations.en: What would you like to do today?
translations.fr: Qu'aimerais-tu faire aujourd'hui ?

examples.text: Acordei pensando no que faria hoje.

translations.de: Ich bin aufgewacht und habe darüber nachgedacht, was ich heute tun würde.
translations.en: I woke up thinking about what I would do today.
translations.fr: Je me suis réveillé en pensant à ce que j'allais faire aujourd'hui.

examples.text: Qual é a previsão do tempo para hoje?

translations.de: Wie ist die Wettervorhersage für heute?
translations.en: What's today's weather forecast?
translations.fr: Quelle est la météo pour aujourd'hui?

examples.text: Eu me levantei muito cedo hoje.

translations.de: Heute Morgen bin ich sehr früh aufgestanden.
translations.en: I got up very early this morning.
translations.fr: Je me suis levée très tôt, ce matin.

more.definition: today (in the current day); nowadays (in the current era)
more.etymology: From Old Galician-Portuguese oge (“today”), from Latin hodiē (“today”), from hōc (“this”) + diē (“day”). Cognate with Galician hoxe, Spanish hoy, Catalan avui, French hui and Italian oggi.

examples.text: As crianças vão à praia hoje.

translations.de: Die Kinder gehen heute an den Strand.
translations.en: The children are going to the beach today.
translations.fr: Les enfants vont à la plage aujourd'hui.

examples.text: Quero assistir a um bom filme hoje à noite.

translations.de: Ich möchte heute Abend einen guten Film sehen.
translations.en: I want to watch a good movie tonight.
translations.fr: J'ai envie de regarder un bon film ce soir.

examples.text: As livrarias estão fechadas hoje.

translations.de: Die Buchhandlungen sind heute geschlossen.
translations.en: Bookstores are closed today.
translations.fr: Les librairies sont fermées aujourd'hui.

examples.text: Quantas frases você acrescentou hoje?

translations.de: Wie viele Sätze hast du heute hinzugefügt?
translations.en: How many sentences did you add today?
translations.fr: Combien de phrases as-tu ajoutées aujourd'hui ?

more.etymology: Do latim hodie⁽ˡᵃ⁾ (neste dia, hoje).

examples.text: Tom pediu nossa ajuda.

translations.de: Tom bat um unsere Hilfe.
translations.en: Tom asked for our help.
translations.fr: Tom a demandé notre aide.

examples.text: Eu sabia que você iria pedir isso.

translations.de: Ich wusste, dass du das fragen würdest.
translations.en: I knew you were going to ask that.
translations.fr: Je savais que tu allais demander ça.

examples.text: De um tecido barato não se faz uma peça de roupa muito boa.

translations.de: Aus billigem Stoff kann man kein besonders gutes Kleidungsstück herstellen.
translations.en: You can't make a very good garment out of cheap fabric.
translations.fr: On ne peut pas faire un très bon vêtement avec un tissu bon marché.

examples.text: Pediste o livro?

translations.de: Hast du das Buch bestellt?
translations.en: Did you order the book?
translations.fr: As-tu commandé le livre ?

more.definition: to ask for; to request (to express the need or desire for something); to order (to request a product or service); to ask for; to invite (to be in obvious need of)
more.etymology: From Old Galician-Portuguese pedir, from Vulgar Latin *petīre, from Latin petere (“ask, request”). Compare Romanian peți, Italian pezzire.

examples.text: Tom não tem medo de ninguém.

translations.de: Tom hat vor niemandem Angst.
translations.en: Tom isn't afraid of anyone.
translations.fr: Tom n'a peur de personne.

examples.text: Eu não conheço ninguém nesta cidade.

translations.de: Ich kenne niemanden in dieser Stadt.
translations.en: I don't know anybody in this town.
translations.fr: Je ne connais personne dans cette ville.

examples.text: A guerra não faz ninguém feliz.

translations.de: Krieg macht niemanden glücklich.
translations.en: War doesn't make anybody happy.
translations.fr: La guerre ne rend personne heureux.

examples.text: Segredo melhor guardado é o que a ninguém é revelado.

translations.de: Das am besten gehütete Geheimnis ist das, das niemandem verraten wird.
translations.en: The best-kept secret is the one that is revealed to no one.
translations.fr: Le secret le mieux gardé est celui qui n’est révélé à personne.

more.definition: nobody (someone who is not important or well-known)
more.etymology: From Latin nec (“not any”) + quem (“whom”).

examples.text: Não viu ninguém.

translations.de: Er hat niemanden gesehen.
translations.en: He didn't see anyone.
translations.fr: Il n'a vu personne.

examples.text: Ninguém é velho demais para aprender.

translations.de: Es ist nie zu spät zum Lernen.
translations.en: Nobody is too old to learn.
translations.fr: Tu n'es pas trop vieux pour apprendre.

examples.text: Ninguém calcula o mal que isso faz à saúde.

translations.de: Niemand ahnt, wie sehr dies der Gesundheit schadet.
translations.en: No one realizes the harm this does to one's health.
translations.fr: Personne ne se rend compte à quel point cela nuit à la santé.

examples.text: Não se deve forçar ninguém a aprender. O aprendizado deve ser incentivado.

translations.de: Niemand sollte zum Lernen gezwungen werden. Lernen sollte gefördert werden.
translations.en: No one should be forced to learn. Learning should be encouraged.
translations.fr: Nul ne devrait être contraint d'apprendre. L'apprentissage devrait être encouragé.

more.definition: no one; nobody (not one person)
more.etymology: From Latin nec (“not any”) + quem (“whom”).

examples.text: Minha mulher chamava-se Marina.

translations.de: Meine Frau hieß Marina.
translations.en: My wife was called Marina.
translations.fr: Ma femme s'appelait Marina.

examples.text: Elas são mulheres independentes.

translations.de: Sie sind unabhängige Frauen.
translations.en: They're independent women.
translations.fr: Ce sont des femmes indépendantes.

examples.text: Eu sou uma mulher casada.

translations.de: Ich bin eine verheiratete Frau.
translations.en: I'm a married woman.
translations.fr: Je suis une femme mariée.

examples.text: A senhora é uma mulher.

translations.de: Sie sind eine Frau.
translations.en: You are a woman.
translations.fr: Vous êtes une femme.

more.definition: pansy; wimpy; effeminate
more.etymology: From Old Galician-Portuguese muller, moller (hence also Galician muller), from Latin mulierem (“woman; wife”), of uncertain origin. Maybe from Proto-Indo-European *h₂melǵ- (milk; to milk). Cognate with Mirandese mulhier, Spanish mujer, Catalan muller, Italian moglie, and Romanian muiere.

examples.text: Minha mulher adora esquiar no inverno.

translations.de: Meine Frau fährt im Winter sehr gerne Ski.
translations.en: My wife loves skiing in the winter.
translations.fr: Ma femme adore skier en hiver.

examples.text: Apagada a luz, todas as mulheres são iguais.

translations.de: Wenn das Licht aus ist, sind alle Frauen gleich.
translations.en: With the light out, all women are equal.
translations.fr: Une fois la lumière éteinte, toutes les femmes sont égales.

examples.text: Ela é a mulher de Alain.

translations.de: Sie ist Alains Ehefrau.
translations.en: She's Alain's wife.
translations.fr: Elle est l'épouse d'Alain.

examples.text: E Deus criou a mulher.

translations.de: Und Gott schuf die Frau.
translations.en: And God created woman.
translations.fr: Et Dieu créa la femme.

more.definition: woman (adult female human); wife; woman (noun sense 4)
more.etymology: From Old Galician-Portuguese muller, moller (hence also Galician muller), from Latin mulierem (“woman; wife”), of uncertain origin. Maybe from Proto-Indo-European *h₂melǵ- (milk; to milk). Cognate with Mirandese mulhier, Spanish mujer, Catalan muller, Italian moglie, and Romanian muiere.

examples.text: Os alunos respondem às perguntas do professor.

translations.de: Die Schüler beantworten die Fragen des Lehrers.
translations.en: Students answer the teacher's questions.
translations.fr: Les élèves répondent aux questions de l'enseignant.

examples.text: Com licença, eu tenho uma pergunta.

translations.de: Entschuldigung, ich habe eine Frage.
translations.en: Excuse me, I have a question.
translations.fr: Excusez-moi, j'ai une question.

examples.text: Eu posso perguntar o porquê?

translations.de: Darf ich fragen, warum?
translations.en: Can I ask why?
translations.fr: Puis-je demander pourquoi ?

examples.text: Mostrei meu desenho aos adultos e perguntei se ele os assustava.

translations.de: Ich zeigte den Erwachsenen meine Zeichnung und fragte, ob sie ihnen Angst mache.
translations.en: I showed my drawing to adults and asked if it scared them.
translations.fr: J'ai montré mon dessin aux adultes et leur ai demandé si cela leur faisait peur.

more.definition: to ask (request an answer); to wonder (query in the mind); to ask oneself (to ponder about something)
more.etymology: Metathesis of preguntar, inherited from Old Galician-Portuguese preguntar, from Vulgar Latin *praecūnctāre, alteration of Latin percontārī.

senses.gloss: fazer uma pergunta a alguém; inquirir, interrogar

examples.text: Quando eu me casar, ela vai morar comigo e com minha esposa.

translations.de: Wenn ich heirate, wird sie bei mir und meiner Frau wohnen.
translations.en: When I get married, she will live with me and my wife.
translations.fr: Quand je me marierai, elle vivra avec ma femme et moi.

examples.text: Por que você está fazendo isso comigo?

translations.de: Warum tust du mir das an?
translations.en: Why are you doing this to me?
translations.fr: Pourquoi me fais-tu ça ?

examples.text: Os meus pais não são estritos comigo.

translations.de: Meine Eltern sind nicht streng zu mir.
translations.en: My parents are not strict with me.
translations.fr: Mes deux parents ne sont pas stricts avec moi.

examples.text: Ou você está comigo, ou está contra mim.

translations.de: Entweder du bist bei mir, oder du bist gegen mich.
translations.en: You're either with me or you're against me.
translations.fr: Soit tu es avec moi, soit tu es contre moi.

more.definition: prepositional form with com of eu: with me
more.etymology: From com (“with”) + Old Galician-Portuguese migo (“with me”), from Latin mēcum (“with me”), from mē (“me”) + cum (“with”). Compare Spanish conmigo.

examples.text: Acho que Tom é nome de gato.

translations.de: Ich glaube, Tom ist ein Katzenname.
translations.en: I think that Tom is a cat's name.
translations.fr: Je pense que Tom est un nom de chat.

examples.text: Meu nome completo é Ricardo Vernaut Junior.

translations.de: Mein voller Name lautet Ricardo Vernaut junior.
translations.en: My full name is Ricardo Vernaut Junior.
translations.fr: Mon nom complet est Ricardo Vernaut Junior.

examples.text: Madeira é o nome de um vinho.

translations.de: „Madeira“ ist ein Weinname.
translations.en: Madeira is the name of a wine.
translations.fr: Madère est le nom d'un vin.

examples.text: Meu nome é Carlos, sou brasileiro.

translations.de: Mein Name ist Carlos, ich bin Brasilianer.
translations.en: My name is Carlos, I'm Brazilian.
translations.fr: Je m'appelle Carlos, je suis brésilien.

more.definition: name (word or phrase which identifies an individual person, place, class, or thing); name (what somebody is known for); noun
more.etymology: From Old Galician-Portuguese nome, from Latin nōmen (“name”), from Proto-Indo-European *h₁nómn̥.

senses.gloss: termo para designar, distinguir ou qualificar pessoa, coisa, lugar, situação ou sentimento

examples.text: Tom se considera um cidadão do mundo.

translations.de: Tom betrachtet sich als Weltbürger.
translations.en: Tom regards himself as a world citizen.
translations.fr: Tom se considère comme un citoyen du monde.

examples.text: O mundo caminha lentamente para a sabedoria.

translations.de: Die Welt wandert langsam zur Weisheit.
translations.en: The world slowly walks towards wisdom.
translations.fr: Le monde avec lenteur marche vers la sagesse.

examples.text: Tudo é loucura neste mundo, exceto o prazer.

translations.de: Alles ist Wahnsinn in dieser Welt, außer dem Vergnügen.
translations.en: Everything is madness in this world, except pleasure.
translations.fr: Tout est folie dans ce monde sauf le plaisir.

examples.text: A computação gráfica mudou o mundo da animação.

translations.de: Computergrafik hat die Welt der Animation verändert.
translations.en: Computer graphics have changed the world of animation.
translations.fr: L'infographie a changé le monde de l'animation.

more.definition: world (the Universe); world (the Earth); world; humanity (human beings collectively)
idioms: o mundo não gira, ele capota
more.etymology: From Old Galician-Portuguese mundo, from Latin mundus (“world”).

senses.gloss: conjunto de espaço, corpos e seres, que a vista humana pode abranger

more.definition: life; way of life, lifestyle
more.etymology: Inherited from Old Galician-Portuguese viver, from Latin vīvere, from Proto-Italic *gʷīwō, from Proto-Indo-European *gʷíh₃weti.

examples.text: Doce é sonhar, amar, cantar – viver!

translations.de: Es ist süß zu träumen, zu lieben, zu singen – zu leben!
translations.en: It is sweet to dream, to love, to sing – to live!
translations.fr: C'est doux de rêver, d'aimer, de chanter – de vivre !

examples.text: A humanidade está vivendo uma crise global de civilidade.

translations.de: Die Menschheit befindet sich in einer globalen Krise der Zivilisation.
translations.en: Humanity is experiencing a global crisis of civility.
translations.fr: L’humanité traverse une crise mondiale de civilité.

examples.text: Quem não vive para servir não serve para viver.

translations.de: Wer nicht lebt, um zu dienen, dient nicht, um zu leben.
translations.en: He who does not live to serve does not serve to live.
translations.fr: Celui qui ne vit pas pour servir ne sert pas pour vivre.

examples.text: Os beduínos vivem no deserto.

translations.de: Die Beduinen leben in der Wüste.
translations.en: Bedouins live in the desert.
translations.fr: Les Bédouins vivent dans le désert.

more.definition: to live; to have life; to live, reside (have permanent residence); to keep, continue for a long period of time
more.etymology: Inherited from Old Galician-Portuguese viver, from Latin vīvere, from Proto-Italic *gʷīwō, from Proto-Indo-European *gʷíh₃weti.

examples.text: A casa tem um jardim grande.

translations.de: Das Haus hat einen großen Garten.
translations.en: The house has a big yard.
translations.fr: La maison a un grand jardin.

examples.text: Há muitas casas antigas nesta rua.

translations.de: In dieser Straße stehen viele alte Häuser.
translations.en: There are many old houses on this street.
translations.fr: Il y a beaucoup de vieilles maisons dans cette rue.

examples.text: Eles estão morando em minha casa.

translations.de: Sie wohnen in meinem Haus.
translations.en: They are living in my house.
translations.fr: Ils vivent chez moi.

examples.text: Como já é noite, retirem-se para suas casas.

translations.de: Da es bereits Nacht ist, zieht euch in eure Häuser zurück.
translations.en: As it is already night, retire to your homes.
translations.fr: Comme il fait déjà nuit, rentrez chez vous.

examples.text: Nossa casa é um submarino amarelo.

translations.de: Unser Haus ist ein gelbes U-Boot.
translations.en: Our house is a yellow submarine.
translations.fr: Notre maison est un sous-marin jaune.

examples.text: Nossa casa era um submarino amarelo.

translations.de: Unser Haus war ein gelbes U-Boot.
translations.en: Our house was a yellow submarine.
translations.fr: Notre maison était un sous-marin jaune.

more.definition: structure serving as an abode of human beings; building or institution serving as something other than residence, such as a shop; noble family
more.etymology: From Old Galician-Portuguese casa, from Latin casa (“cottage”), possibly from Proto-Indo-European *kat- (“to link or weave together; chain, net; hut, shed”).

examples.text: Quem não tem coração jamais aprende a amar.

translations.de: Wer kein Herz hat, wird niemals lieben lernen.
translations.en: Those who have no heart never learn to love.
translations.fr: Ceux qui n'ont pas de cœur n'apprendront jamais à aimer.

examples.text: Não sabia que ela me amava.

translations.de: Ich wusste nicht, dass sie mich liebt.
translations.en: I didn't know she loved me.
translations.fr: Je ne savais pas qu'elle m'aimait.

examples.text: Amai-vos uns aos outros.

translations.de: Liebt einander.
translations.en: Love one another.
translations.fr: Aimez-vous les uns les autres.

examples.text: Eu nasci para te amar.

translations.de: Ich bin dazu geboren, dich zu lieben.
translations.en: I was born to love you.
translations.fr: Je suis né pour t'aimer.

more.definition: to love, to have great affection for; to have the ability to love, to feel love
more.etymology: Proto-Indo-European *h₃emh₃-der. Inherited from Old Galician-Portuguese amar, from Latin amāre (“to love”).

examples.text: Camões perdeu um olho numa batalha.

translations.de: Camões verlor in einer Schlacht ein Auge.
translations.en: Camões lost an eye in a battle.
translations.fr: Camões a perdu un œil au combat.

examples.text: Grande tristeza foi perder tua amizade.

translations.de: Deine Freundschaft zu verlieren machte mich zutiefst traurig.
translations.en: Losing your friendship saddened me deeply.
translations.fr: La perte de votre amitié m'a profondément attristé.

examples.text: O que facilmente se ganha, facilmente se perde.

translations.de: Wie gewonnen, so zerronnen.
translations.en: That which is easily acquired is easily lost.
translations.fr: Ce qui est facilement gagné est facilement perdu.

examples.text: Por que perdes teu tempo? Estás falando ao vento!

translations.de: Warum verschwendest du deine Zeit? Du sprichst mit dem Wind!
translations.en: Why do you waste your time? You're talking to the wind!
translations.fr: Pourquoi perds-tu ton temps ? Tu parles au vent !

more.definition: to lose (an object, a job, interest etc.); to lose (to be defeated in a match, an election etc.); to miss (an opportunity, a train or bus etc.)
more.etymology: From Old Galician-Portuguese perder, from Latin perdere. The first person singular form in the present indicative and all forms of the present subjunctive and commands (except the second person informal affirmative commands) have an analogous change from D to C (expected "perdo" instead of "perco," for example).

senses.gloss: não alcançar um meio de transporte a tempo

examples.text: Maria gasta bastante dinheiro em roupas.

translations.de: Maria gibt viel Geld für Kleidung aus.
translations.en: Mary spends a lot of money on clothes.
translations.fr: Mary dépense beaucoup d'argent en vêtements.

examples.text: O meu irmão não tem dinheiro.

translations.de: Mein Bruder hat kein Geld.
translations.en: My brother has no money.
translations.fr: Mon frère n'a pas d'argent.

examples.text: Ela tem medo de perder dinheiro.

translations.de: Sie hat Angst, Geld zu verlieren.
translations.en: She's afraid of losing money.
translations.fr: Elle a peur de perdre de l'argent.

examples.text: Não tenho dinheiro para comprá-lo.

translations.de: Ich habe nicht das Geld, um es kaufen zu können.
translations.en: I have no money to buy it.
translations.fr: Je n'ai pas d'argent pour l'acheter.

more.definition: money (means of exchange and measure of value); a coin used from the 12th to the 15th century in Portugal
idioms: dinheiro na mão, calcinha no chão
more.etymology: From Old Galician-Portuguese dĩeiro (a coin of little value), from Vulgar Latin *dīnārius, an alteration of Latin dēnārius (“small Roman silver coin”). Doublet of denário and dinar.

senses.gloss: valor simbólico convencional utilizado nas trocas comerciais em substituição às próprias mercadorias

examples.text: Oh, meu Deus!

translations.de: Oh mein Gott!
translations.en: Oh, my God!
translations.fr: Oh, mon Dieu !

examples.text: Oh, pai, pai, o que vamos fazer?

translations.de: O Vater, Vater, was sollen wir tun?
translations.en: Oh, father, father, what shall we do?

examples.text: Oh não! Nosso paciente está morto.

translations.de: O nein! Unser Patient ist tot.
translations.en: Oh no! Our patient is dead.

examples.text: Oh! Hoje é o meu dia.

translations.en: Oh! Today is my day.
translations.fr: Oh ! Aujourd'hui c'est mon jour.

more.etymology: Do latim ô ou oh.

examples.text: Você me ligou ontem à noite?

translations.de: Hast du mich gestern Abend angerufen?
translations.en: Did you call me last night?
translations.fr: M'as-tu appelé hier soir ?

examples.text: Ligue-me se tiver tempo.

translations.de: Ruf mich an, wenn du Zeit hast.
translations.en: Call me if you have time.
translations.fr: Appelle-moi si tu as le temps.

examples.text: Eu não ligo para o que dizem.

translations.de: Ich achte nicht darauf, was sie sagen.
translations.en: I don't care about what they say.
translations.fr: Je ne fais pas attention à ce qu'ils disent.

examples.text: Ken me liga todo dia.

translations.de: Ken ruft mich jeden Tag an.
translations.en: Ken calls me every day.
translations.fr: Ken me téléphone tous les jours.

more.definition: to link; to connect; to join (to put things together so they work together); to connect; to associate (to consider multiples things related); to turn on (to make a device start operating)
more.etymology: Semi-learned borrowing from Latin ligāre, from Proto-Indo-European *leyǵ- (“to bind”). Compare the form liar, which may have (Old) French influence, as well as the inherited Old Portuguese form legar.

senses.gloss: segurar uma coisa a outra; atar; amarrar; pegar; fixar; cimentar

examples.text: Onde se pode jogar futebol de mesa?

translations.de: Wo kann man Tischfußball spielen?
translations.en: Where can you play table football?
translations.fr: Où peut-on jouer au baby-foot ?

examples.text: Ele joga xadrez muito bem.

translations.de: Er spielt sehr gut Schach.
translations.en: He plays chess very well.
translations.fr: Il joue très bien aux échecs.

examples.text: Eu nunca joguei golfe.

translations.de: Ich habe nie Golf gespielt.
translations.en: I've never played golf.
translations.fr: Je n'ai jamais joué au golf.

examples.text: Ou jogamos melhor ou passaremos pela vergonha de mais um rebaixamento.

translations.de: Entweder wir spielen besser, oder wir werden die Schande eines weiteren Abstiegs erleiden.
translations.en: Either we play better or we will suffer the shame of another demotion.
translations.fr: Soit nous jouons mieux, soit nous subirons la honte d'une nouvelle relégation.

more.definition: to play (to participate in a sport or game); to throw; to hurl (to shove an object away); to hand (something) over by throwing
more.etymology: Inherited from Old Galician-Portuguese jogar, from Latin iocārī. Compare Galician xogar, Asturian xugar, Spanish jugar.

examples.text: A qualquer hora.

translations.de: Jederzeit.
translations.en: Any time.
translations.fr: N'importe quand.

examples.text: Estamos ao dispor para qualquer esclarecimento adicional.

translations.de: Wir stehen Ihnen gerne für weitere Auskünfte zur Verfügung.
translations.en: We are at your disposal for any further clarification.
translations.fr: Nous sommes à votre disposition pour toute précision supplémentaire.

examples.text: Este trabalho é qualquer coisa menos fácil.

translations.de: Diese Arbeit ist alles andere als leicht.
translations.en: This work is anything but easy.
translations.fr: Ce travail est tout sauf facile.

examples.text: Não me considero capaz de traduzir, razoavelmente bem, qualquer frase para Toki Pona.

translations.de: Ich halte mich nicht für fähig, irgendeinen Satz halbwegs gut in Toki Pona zu übersetzen.
translations.en: I do not consider myself able to translate, reasonably well, any sentence into Toki Pona.
translations.fr: Je ne me considère pas capable de traduire raisonnablement bien n'importe quelle phrase en toki pona.

more.definition: any; whatever (no matter what kind, which or who); some (in an unspecified time)
more.etymology: Inherited from Old Galician-Portuguese qual quer, from qual + quer. By surface analysis, qual (“which one”) + quer (“wants”). Compare Galician calquera, Spanish cualquiera, and Italian (literary) qualsivoglia.

examples.text: Para continuar, pressione qualquer tecla.

translations.de: Um fortzufahren, drücken Sie eine beliebige Taste.
translations.en: To continue, press any key.
translations.fr: Pour continuer, appuyez sur n'importe quelle touche.

examples.text: Essas formas são essenciais para a comunicação em qualquer idioma.

translations.de: Diese Formen sind für die Kommunikation in jeder Sprache unerlässlich.
translations.en: These forms are essential for communication in any language.
translations.fr: Ces formes sont essentielles à la communication dans toutes les langues.

examples.text: A língua inglesa é mais usada que qualquer outra em Tatoeba.

translations.de: Englisch wird in Tatoeba mehr verwendet als jede andere Sprache.
translations.en: The English language is used more than any other in Tatoeba.
translations.fr: L'anglais est plus utilisé que toute autre langue à Tatoeba.

examples.text: Qualquer criança pode responder a isso.

translations.de: Jedes Kind kann das beantworten.
translations.en: Any child can answer that.
translations.fr: N'importe quel enfant peut répondre à ça.

more.definition: any (no matter what kind, which or who); anyone (no matter who)
more.etymology: Inherited from Old Galician-Portuguese qual quer, from qual + quer. By surface analysis, qual (“which one”) + quer (“wants”). Compare Galician calquera, Spanish cualquiera, and Italian (literary) qualsivoglia.

senses.gloss: pronome indefinido variável singular que significa todo ou toda

examples.text: A mancha de café era difícil de tirar.

translations.de: Der Kaffeefleck war schwer zu entfernen.
translations.en: The coffee stain was difficult to remove.
translations.fr: La tâche de café était difficile à enlever.

examples.text: Eis o Cordeiro de Deus, que tira o pecado do mundo!

translations.de: Seht das Lamm Gottes, das die Sünde der Welt wegnimmt!
translations.en: Behold the Lamb of God, who takes away the sin of the world!
translations.fr: Voici l'Agneau de Dieu, qui ôte le péché du monde !

examples.text: É permitido tirar fotos aqui?

translations.de: Ist es hier erlaubt, zu fotografieren?
translations.en: Are we allowed to take pictures here?
translations.fr: Est-il permis de prendre des photos ici ?

examples.text: Daqui não saio, daqui ninguém me tira.

translations.de: Ich gehe hier nicht weg, niemand kann mich hier rausholen.
translations.en: I'm not leaving here, no one can get me out of here.
translations.fr: Je ne pars pas d'ici, personne ne peut me faire sortir d'ici.

more.definition: to take, take out, take away; to remove, withdraw; to get, obtain (a score or document)
more.etymology: Proto-Indo-European *der-der. Inherited from Old Galician-Portuguese tirar, from Vulgar Latin *tīrāre.

senses.gloss: pôr para fora; retirar facilmente, em geral com as mãos

examples.text: Eu tenho ótima professora de Russo e de Francês.

translations.de: Ich habe eine großartige Russisch- und Französischlehrerin.
translations.en: I have a great Russian and French teacher.
translations.fr: J'ai une excellente professeur de russe et de français.

examples.text: Ele tem um ótimo professor de russo, mas está aprendendo turco sozinho.

translations.de: Er hat zwar einen tollen Russischlehrer, aber Türkisch lernt er selbst.
translations.en: He has a great Russian teacher, but he's learning Turkish on his own.
translations.fr: Il a un excellent professeur de russe, mais il apprend le turc par lui-même.

examples.text: Eu acho que é uma ótima ideia.

translations.en: I think that's a great idea.
translations.fr: Je pense que c'est une excellente idée.

examples.text: A sua sopa de galinha é ótima.

translations.de: Deine Hühnersuppe ist vorzüglich.
translations.en: Your chicken soup is great.

more.definition: great; excellent (very good); optimal (the best possible solution of a problem)
more.etymology: Learned borrowing from Latin optimus (superlative of bonus, literally “best”), from ops (“power to help”), from Proto-Indo-European *h₃ep- (“work”).

examples.text: Ele tem um ótimo professor de russo, mas está aprendendo turco sozinho.

translations.de: Er hat zwar einen tollen Russischlehrer, aber Türkisch lernt er selbst.
translations.en: He has a great Russian teacher, but he's learning Turkish on his own.
translations.fr: Il a un excellent professeur de russe, mais il apprend le turc par lui-même.

examples.text: Envelhecer é ótimo! Posso dizer o que eu quiser e ninguém diz nada.

translations.en: Getting old is great! I can say what I want, and nobody says anything.
translations.fr: Vieillir, c'est génial ! Je peux dire ce que je veux, et personne ne dit rien.

examples.text: É bom que se diga que a Verônica fez um ótimo trabalho aqui.

translations.de: Man muß schon sagen, daß Veronica hier ganze Arbeit geleistet hat.
translations.en: It has to be said that Veronica has done a great job here.

examples.text: Ótimo conselho. Eu o levaria em consideração se não fosse seu.

translations.de: Ein ausgezeichneter Rat. Ich würde ihn beherzigen, wäre er nicht von dir.
translations.en: Very good advice. I would consider it if it weren't yours.

more.definition: great (expression of gladness)
more.etymology: Learned borrowing from Latin optimus (superlative of bonus, literally “best”), from ops (“power to help”), from Proto-Indo-European *h₃ep- (“work”).

examples.text: Seguirei pela vida a esquecer-me de ti.

translations.de: Ich werde durch das Leben gehen und dich vergessen.
translations.en: I'll go on through life forgetting about you.
translations.fr: Je traverserai la vie en t'oubliant.

examples.text: Eu me apaixonei pela língua francesa.

translations.de: Ich habe mich in die französische Sprache verliebt.
translations.en: I fell in love with the French language.
translations.fr: Je suis tombé amoureux de la langue française.

examples.text: Eu orei pela ajuda de Deus.

translations.de: Ich betete um Gottes Hilfe.
translations.en: I prayed for God's help.
translations.fr: J'ai prié pour l'aide de Dieu.

examples.text: Detroit é famosa pela sua indústria de carros.

translations.de: Detroit ist berühmt für seine Automobilindustrie.
translations.en: Detroit is famous for its car industry.
translations.fr: Détroit est célèbre pour son industrie automobile.

more.definition: contraction of per + a, literally “by/through the (feminine singular)”: feminine singular of pelo
more.etymology: Inherited from Old Galician-Portuguese pela, from Vulgar Latin *per (“by; through”) + *la (“the”).

examples.text: A beleza da flor lhe acentua o perfume.

translations.de: Die Schönheit der Blume verstärkt ihren Duft.
translations.en: The beauty of the flower enhances its fragrance.
translations.fr: La beauté de la fleur rehausse son parfum.

examples.text: Você deve ministrar-lhe uma lição!

translations.de: Du musst ihr einmal eine Lektion erteilen!
translations.en: You need to teach her a lesson!
translations.fr: Tu dois lui donner une leçon !

examples.text: O raio feriu uma árvore alta, ateando-lhe fogo.

translations.de: Der Blitz schlug in einen hohen Baum ein und setzte ihn in Brand.
translations.en: The lightning struck a tall tree, setting it on fire.
translations.fr: La foudre a frappé un grand arbre, y mettant le feu.

examples.text: Isso não lhe diz respeito.

translations.de: Das geht dich nichts an.
translations.en: That's none of your business.
translations.fr: Ça ne te regarde pas.

more.definition: equivalent to a third- or second-person possessive pronoun
more.etymology: From Old Galician-Portuguese lle, from earlier Old Galician-Portuguese li, from Latin illī, dative of ille. Cognate with Old Spanish ge, Sicilian ci (dative), and Italian gli (dative).

senses.gloss: pronome pessoal dativo, de dois gêneros, da terceira pessoa do singular (ele, ela, você)

examples.text: Eu não sei o telefone dela.

translations.de: Ich weiß ihre Telefonnummer nicht.
translations.en: I don't know her telephone number.
translations.fr: Je ne connais pas son numéro de téléphone.

examples.text: Naquela noite, ele levou flores para a mãe dela.

translations.de: In dieser Nacht brachte er ihrer Mutter Blumen.
translations.en: That night, he brought flowers to her mother.
translations.fr: Ce soir-là, il apporta des fleurs à sa mère.

examples.text: Ela terminou o trabalho dela.

translations.de: Sie hat ihre Arbeit fertig gestellt.
translations.en: She has finished her work.
translations.fr: Elle a terminé son travail.

examples.text: Minha gatinha é toda branca. O nome dela é Algodão.

translations.de: Mein Kätzchen ist ganz weiß. Sie heißt Baumwolle.
translations.en: My kitten is all white. Her name is Cotton.
translations.fr: Mon chaton est tout blanc. Elle s'appelle Coton.

more.definition: contraction of de + ela: feminine singular of dele

senses.gloss: contração da preposição de e do pronome ela

examples.text: Jura de amor não deve ser levada a sério.

translations.de: Ein Liebesversprechen sollte man nicht ernst nehmen.
translations.en: Vows of love should not be taken seriously.
translations.fr: Il ne faut pas prendre au sérieux une promesse d'amour.

examples.text: Essa troca não é incorreta, mas deve ser evitada.

translations.de: Dieser Austausch ist zwar nicht falsch, sollte aber vermieden werden.
translations.en: This exchange isn't incorrect, but it should be avoided.
translations.fr: Cet échange n'est pas incorrect, mais il doit être évité.

examples.text: Esta frase deve ser verificada por um locutor nativo.

translations.de: Dieser Satz bedarf der Prüfung durch einen Muttersprachler.
translations.en: This sentence needs to be checked by a native speaker.
translations.fr: Cette phrase doit être vérifiée par un locuteur natif.

examples.text: A rainha deve morrer.

translations.de: Die Königin muss sterben.
translations.en: The queen must die.
translations.fr: La reine doit mourir.

more.etymology: Do verbo dever.

examples.text: Oi, me chamo Ken Saitou.

translations.de: Hallo, ich heiße Ken Saitou.
translations.en: Hi, my name is Ken Saitou.
translations.fr: Bonjour, je m'appelle Ken Saitou.

examples.text: Oi! Como vai você?

translations.de: Hallo! Wie geht’s?
translations.en: Hello, how are you?
translations.fr: Salut ! Comment ça va ?

examples.text: Oi, eu me chamo Ken Saitou.

translations.de: Hallo, ich heiße Ken Saitou.
translations.en: Hi, my name is Ken Saitou.
translations.fr: Bonjour, je m'appelle Ken Saitou.

examples.text: Oi, meu nome é Ken Saitou.

translations.en: Hi, my name is Ken Saitou.
translations.fr: Bonjour, je m'appelle Ken Saitou.

more.definition: hey; Oi, Maria!; Hey, Mary!
more.etymology: Possibly from Old Tupi oî. Compare unrelated English oi.

senses.gloss: expressa cumprimento que se faz ao encontrar uma pessoa

examples.text: Não há nenhum leão no zoológico.

translations.de: Es gibt keine Löwen im Zoo.
translations.en: There are no lions in the zoo.
translations.fr: Il n'y a pas de lions dans le zoo.

examples.text: Diferença nenhuma existirá, para mim, entre tírios e troianos.

translations.de: Für mich wird es keinen Unterschied zwischen Tyriern und Trojanern geben.
translations.en: For me, there will be no difference between Tyrians and Trojans.
translations.fr: Pour moi, il n'y aura aucune différence entre les Tyriens et les Troyens.

examples.text: Não recebi nenhuma mensagem ontem.

translations.de: Ich habe gestern keine Nachrichten erhalten.
translations.en: I didn't get any messages yesterday.
translations.fr: Je n'ai reçu aucun message hier.

translations.fr: Il n'y a pas de banque ici ?

translations.en: So much technological progress and no spiritual evolution of human beings!
translations.fr: Tant de progrès technologiques et aucune évolution spirituelle des êtres humains !

examples.text: Não conheço nenhum deles.

translations.fr: Je n'en connais aucun.

examples.text: Não se pode ter certeza de nada neste mundo.

translations.en: Everyone should mind their own business.

translations.en: My sister often looks after the baby.
translations.fr: Ma sœur s'occupe souvent du bébé.

translations.fr: Prenez soin de votre santé. Votre vie est précieuse.

more.etymology: From Old Galician-Portuguese cuidar, from Latin cōgitāre (“to think, to consider”), from co- + agitō (“to agitate”). Doublet of cogitar, a borrowing.

translations.en: A clapperboard marks the beginning of each take.
translations.fr: Un clap marque le début de chaque prise.

translations.en: I have already had my breakfast.
translations.fr: J'ai déjà pris mon petit-déjeuner.

examples.text: O médico me tomou o pulso.

translations.en: The doctor took my pulse.
translations.fr: Le docteur prit mon pouls.

examples.text: É hora de tomar um banho.

translations.de: Es ist Zeit für ein Bad.
translations.en: It's time to take a bath.
translations.fr: C'est l'heure de prendre un bain.

more.definition: to take (to get something into one’s possession or control); to take; to conquer (to seize control of a location); to steal (to take something illegally)
more.etymology: Inherited from Old Galician-Portuguese tomar, of unknown origin. Compare Galician and Spanish tomar.

examples.text: Eu me lembro do meu primeiro dia de aula.

translations.de: Ich erinnere mich an meinen ersten Schultag.
translations.en: I remember my first day of school.
translations.fr: Je me souviens de mon premier jour d'école.

translations.de: Erinnerst du dich an ihren Namen?
translations.en: Do you remember her name?
translations.fr: Tu te souviens de son nom ?

translations.de: Ältere Menschen schätzen es, wenn man an sie denkt.
translations.en: Old people appreciate being remembered.
translations.fr: Les personnes âgées apprécient qu’on se souvienne d’elles.

examples.text: O sangue é vermelho, o preto lembra a escravidão.

translations.en: Blood is red, black reminds us of slavery.
translations.fr: Le sang est rouge, le noir rappelle l'esclavage.

translations.fr: Te souviens-tu de la première fois où je t'ai embrassé ?

translations.de: Ich erinnere mich an die Melodie des Liedes, aber ich habe den Text vergessen.
translations.en: I remember the melody of that song, but I've forgotten the lyrics.
translations.fr: Je me souviens de la mélodie de cette chanson, mais j'ai oublié les paroles.

senses.gloss: trazer da memória um fato passado

examples.text: Gosto de viajar com o meu carro.

translations.de: Ich reise gern mit meinem Auto.
translations.en: I like going on trips in my car.
translations.fr: Je voyage volontiers avec ma voiture.

examples.text: Há sempre muitos carros nesta rua.

translations.de: Auf dieser Straße gibt es immer viele Autos.
translations.en: There are always many cars on this street.
translations.fr: Dans cette rue, il y a toujours beaucoup de voitures.

examples.text: Qual é o carro mais bonito dessa corrida?

translations.de: Welches Auto ist das schönste in diesem Rennen?
translations.en: Which car is the most beautiful in this race?
translations.fr: Quelle est la plus belle voiture de cette course ?

examples.text: Quando acordei, eu estava no carro.

translations.en: When I woke up, I was in the car.
translations.fr: Quand je me réveillai, j'étais dans la voiture.

idioms: colocar o carro na frente dos bois
more.etymology: From Old Galician-Portuguese carro (“cart”), from Latin carrus, from Gaulish *karros, from Proto-Indo-European *ḱr̥sós, from *ḱers- (“to run”).

senses.gloss: veículo com a capacidade de se movimentar guiado por um motorista, geralmente com a finalidade de transportar pessoas

translations.en: What kind of person is she?

translations.de: Ich mag diese Art Haus nicht.
translations.en: I don't like this type of house.
translations.fr: Je n'aime pas ce genre de maison.

translations.en: I can't eat this kind of food.
translations.fr: Je ne peux pas manger ce genre de nourriture.

translations.fr: Sophie mettra les fleurs sur la table du salon.

examples.text: Tom colocou a tigela no micro-ondas.

translations.en: Tom put the bowl into the microwave.

idioms: colocar o carro na frente dos bois
