translations.de: Es ist ihr letzter Film.
translations.en: It is their last movie.
translations.fr: C'est leur dernier film.

translations.fr: J'ai beaucoup travaillé ces derniers jours.

translations.fr: C'est le dernier.

translations.fr: J'aimerais tellement te voir.

translations.en: It's the thought that counts.
translations.fr: Ce qui importe, c'est l'intention.

translations.fr: La vie des Noirs compte.

translations.fr: Le Japon importe une grande quantité de pétrole.

translations.fr: Athènes m'a enchantée, du moins la ville elle-même.

translations.fr: Ce travail est tout sauf facile.

more.definition: behind (at the back); after (looking for); ago (in the past)

translations.fr: Je me couche vers 10 heures.

translations.fr: Le chat est en train de dormir sur la table.

examples.text: Você conhece seu irmão mais velho?

translations.de: Kennst du seinen älteren Bruder?
translations.en: Do you know his older brother?
translations.fr: Connais-tu son frère aîné ?

examples.text: Tenho dois irmãos e uma irmã.

translations.de: Ich habe zwei Brüder und eine Schwester.
translations.en: I have two brothers and a sister.
translations.fr: J'ai deux frères et une sœur.

examples.text: Ele tem irmão ou irmã?

translations.de: Hat er einen Bruder oder eine Schwester?
translations.en: Does he have a brother or a sister?
translations.fr: A-t-il un frère ou une sœur ?

examples.text: Axel é o meu irmão.

translations.de: Axel ist mein Bruder.
translations.en: Axel is my brother.
translations.fr: Axel est mon frère.

more.definition: brother (male sibling); sibling (person having the same parents as another); brother (member of a brotherhood)
more.etymology: Inherited from Old Galician-Portuguese irmão (“brother”), from Latin germānus (“brother”), from the adjective germānus (“of true siblings”), from germen (“sprout, bud”), from Proto-Indo-European *ǵénh₁mn̥ (“offspring, seed”), from *ǵenh₁- (“to beget, to give birth”). Cognates include Galician irmán, Mirandese armano, Asturian hermanu, and Spanish hermano.

senses.gloss: aquele que em relação a outrem, possuí os dois pais (o mesmo pai e a mesma mãe ao mesmo tempo) em comum

examples.text: Ela está curiosa em saber quem foi que mandou as flores.

translations.de: Sie ist neugierig, wer ihr wohl die Blumen schickte.
translations.en: She's curious to find out who sent the flowers.
translations.fr: Elle est curieuse de savoir qui a envoyé les fleurs.

examples.text: Me manda uma foto sua, por favor.

translations.de: Bitte schick mir ein Foto von dir.
translations.en: Please send me a picture of yourself.
translations.fr: S'il vous plaît envoyez-moi une photo de vous.

examples.text: Resta agora saber se ela vai conseguir ouvir a gravação que lhe mandei.

translations.de: Es bleibt nun abzuwarten, ob sie die Aufnahme, die ich ihr geschickt habe, anhören kann.
translations.en: It now remains to be seen whether she can listen to the recording I sent her.
translations.fr: Reste maintenant à voir si elle pourra écouter l’enregistrement que je lui ai envoyé.

examples.text: Por favor, me mande uma foto sua.

translations.en: Please send me a picture of yourself.
translations.fr: S'il vous plaît envoyez-moi une photo de vous.

more.definition: to order, command; to tell to do something (may or may not have a commanding tone); to order, to boss around
more.etymology: Inherited from Old Galician-Portuguese mandar, from Latin mandāre (“to order, to commission”).

examples.text: Um quadrado tem quatro lados iguais.

translations.de: Ein Quadrat hat vier gleiche Seiten.
translations.en: A square has four equal sides.
translations.fr: Un carré a quatre côtés égaux.

examples.text: Um hexágono tem seis lados.

translations.de: Ein Sechseck hat sechs Seiten.
translations.en: A hexagon has six sides.
translations.fr: Un hexagone a six côtés.

examples.text: Em vão acalentei o sonho de viver um amor infinito ao lado teu.

translations.de: Vergeblich hegte ich den Traum, an Deiner Seite eine unendliche Liebe zu erleben.
translations.en: I vainly cherished the dream of living an infinite love by your side.
translations.fr: C'est en vain que j'ai caressé le rêve de vivre auprès de toi un amour infini.

examples.text: É aflitivo viver ao teu lado sem ter o direito de te amar.

translations.de: Es ist quälend, an deiner Seite zu leben, ohne das Recht zu haben, dich zu lieben.
translations.en: It's distressing to live by your side without having the right to love you.
translations.fr: C'est angoissant de vivre à tes côtés sans avoir le droit de t'aimer.

more.definition: side
more.etymology: From Old Galician-Portuguese lado, from Latin lātus. Compare Spanish lado and Italian lato.

senses.gloss: parte direita ou esquerda de qualquer corpo

examples.text: Mais cedo ou mais tarde, pagarás por esta traição.

translations.de: Früher oder später wirst du für diesen Verrat bezahlen.
translations.en: Sooner or later, you will pay for this betrayal.
translations.fr: Tôt ou tard, vous paierez pour cette trahison.

examples.text: Quanto tu pagaste ao eletricista?

translations.de: Wie viel hast du dem Elektriker bezahlt?
translations.en: How much did you pay the electrician?
translations.fr: Combien as-tu payé l'électricien ?

examples.text: Como poderei pagar esta dívida?

translations.de: Wie kann ich diese Schulden bezahlen?
translations.en: How can I pay this debt?
translations.fr: Comment puis-je payer cette dette ?

examples.text: Meu irmão pagou o dobro do preço.

translations.en: My brother paid double the price.
translations.fr: Mon frère a payé le double du prix.

more.definition: to give [someone] money in exchange for a good or service; (to give money in order to discharge [a debt or bill]); to pay for; to buy (to give money in exchange for [a good or service])
idioms: aqui se faz, aqui se paga
more.etymology: From Old Galician-Portuguese pagar, from Latin pacāre (“to pacify”).

examples.text: Este é um momento histórico.

translations.en: This is a historical moment.
translations.fr: C'est un moment historique.

examples.text: Por favor, espera aqui um momento.

translations.de: Bitte warte hier ein wenig.
translations.en: Please wait here for a while.
translations.fr: S'il vous plaît, attendez un peu ici.

examples.text: Neste momento, estou escrevendo uma frase sobre o amor.

translations.de: Ich schreibe gerade einen Satz über die Liebe.
translations.en: Right now, I'm writing a sentence about love.
translations.fr: En ce moment, j'écris une phrase sur l'amour.

examples.text: Acredito que agora seja o momento certo.

translations.de: Ich denke, dass jetzt der richtige Zeitpunkt ist.
translations.en: I think that the right time is right now.
translations.fr: Je pense que le bon moment, c'est maintenant.

more.etymology: De momo + -ento. Do latim momentum⁽ˡᵃ⁾.

translations.en: We both lived those moments of affection and passion without worry.

examples.text: O Tom ganhou peso.

translations.de: Tom hat zugenommen.
translations.en: Tom gained weight.
translations.fr: Tom a pris du poids.

examples.text: Quem está ganhando?

translations.de: Wer gewinnt?
translations.en: Who's winning?
translations.fr: Qui gagne ?

examples.text: Com a má vontade desses árbitros, meu time nunca poderá ganhar uma partida.

translations.de: Aufgrund der Böswilligkeit dieser Schiedsrichter wird meine Mannschaft niemals in der Lage sein, ein Spiel zu gewinnen.
translations.en: With the ill will of these referees, my team can never win a match.
translations.fr: Avec la mauvaise volonté de ces arbitres, mon équipe ne pourra jamais gagner un match.

examples.text: Ele quase ganhou a partida que jogou com Judit, mas acabou empatando.

translations.de: Er hätte fast das Spiel gewonnen, das er mit Judit gespielt hatte, aber das Ergebnis war ein Remis.
translations.en: He almost won the match he played with Judit, but ended up drawing.
translations.fr: Il a presque gagné le match qu'il a joué avec Judit, mais le résultat était une égalité.

more.definition: to win (to achieve victory in a game, a war, etc); to earn (to receive payment for work)
more.etymology: Inherited from Old Galician-Portuguese gãar, gaanhar. Compare Galician gañar.

examples.text: Minha casa fica de frente para a praia.

translations.de: Mein Haus liegt direkt am Meer.
translations.en: My house faces the sea.
translations.fr: Ma maison fait face à la mer.

examples.text: Seria fantástico ter um jardim zen em frente da casa!

translations.de: Das wäre fantastisch, einen Zen-Garten vor dem Haus zu haben!
translations.en: It would be fantastic to have a zen garden in front of the house!
translations.fr: Ce serait super d'avoir un jardin Zen devant la maison !

examples.text: Na frente da minha casa passa um riacho, não um rio.

translations.de: Vor meinem Haus fließt ein Bach, kein Fluss.
translations.en: There's a stream in front of my house, not a river.
translations.fr: Il y a un ruisseau devant chez moi, pas une rivière.

examples.text: Há um banco em frente à estação.

translations.de: Vor dem Bahnhof gibt es eine Bank.
translations.en: There's a bank in front of the station.
translations.fr: Il y a une banque devant la gare.

more.definition: front (facing side); front (main entrance side); front (area or line of conflict)
more.etymology: Borrowed from Spanish frente, from Old Spanish fruente, from Latin frontem. Doublet of fronte and front.

examples.text: Eu não posso abrir arquivos SWF.

translations.de: Ich kann keine SWF-Dateien öffnen.
translations.en: I can't open SWF files.
translations.fr: Je ne peux pas ouvrir de fichiers SWF.

examples.text: Eu abrirei todas as portas, mas vou fechar as janelas.

translations.de: Ich werde alle Türen öffnen, aber die Fenster schließen.
translations.en: I will open all the doors but close the windows.
translations.fr: J'ouvrirai toutes les portes, mais je fermerai les fenêtres.

examples.text: O homem abriu a porta, entrou e acendeu a luz.

translations.de: Der Mann öffnete die Tür, trat ein und schaltete das Licht an.
translations.en: The man opened the door, entered, and turned on the light.
translations.fr: L'homme ouvrit la porte, entra et alluma la lumière.

examples.text: Ele devolveu a carta sem abrir.

translations.de: Er sandte den Brief ungeöffnet zurück.
translations.en: He sent the letter back unopened.
translations.fr: Il renvoya la lettre sans l'ouvrir.

more.definition: to open; to deal (a card)
more.etymology: From Old Galician-Portuguese abrir, from Latin aperīre, from Proto-Indo-European *h₂epo (“off, from”) + *wer-iō (“open”).

senses.gloss: levar de um estado fechado para um aberto, descerrar

examples.text: Foi um prazer conversar com você!

translations.de: Es war schön, mit Ihnen zu sprechen!
translations.en: It was nice talking to you!
translations.fr: C'était un plaisir de vous parler !

examples.text: Conversem uns com os outros.

translations.de: Sprecht miteinander.
translations.en: Talk to one another.
translations.fr: Parlez-vous les uns aux autres.

examples.text: É proibido conversar na biblioteca.

translations.de: Es ist verboten, in der Bücherei zu reden.
translations.en: Talking in the library is not allowed.
translations.fr: Il est interdit de parler dans la bibliothèque.

examples.text: Os dois presidentes trocaram telefones, para poderem conversar sem intermediários.

translations.de: Die beiden Präsidenten tauschten Telefonnummern aus, um ohne Zwischenhändler miteinander sprechen zu können.
translations.en: The two presidents exchanged phone numbers so they could talk without intermediaries.
translations.fr: Les deux présidents ont échangé leurs numéros de téléphone afin de pouvoir parler sans intermédiaire.

more.definition: to talk; to chat (to engage in conversation); to discipline one's child/children, especially through spanking; to receive a beating from one's parent
more.etymology: Learned borrowing from Latin conversāre.

examples.text: De erro em erro, vai-se descobrindo toda a verdade.

translations.de: Von Fehler zu Fehler wird die ganze Wahrheit entdeckt.
translations.en: From mistake to mistake, the whole truth is discovered.
translations.fr: D’erreur en erreur, toute la vérité est découverte.

examples.text: Se tens uma mensagem, tens um público. Basta descobri-lo!

translations.de: Wenn Sie eine Botschaft haben, haben Sie ein Publikum. Entdecken Sie es einfach!
translations.en: If you have a message, you have an audience. Just discover it!
translations.fr: Si vous avez un message, vous avez un public. Découvrez-le !

examples.text: Espero que ninguém descubra o que fizemos.

translations.de: Ich hoffe, es findet niemand heraus, was wir getan haben.
translations.en: I hope that nobody finds out what we did.
translations.fr: J'espère que personne ne découvre ce que nous avons fait.

examples.text: Eu não sei como o Tom descobriu.

translations.de: Ich weiß nicht, wie Tom das herausgefunden hat.
translations.en: I don't know how Tom found out.
translations.fr: Je ne sais pas comment Tom l'a découvert.

more.definition: to discover (to find something for the first time); to find out; to uncover (to remove something’s cover)
more.etymology: From Old Galician-Portuguese descobrir (“to find out”), from Late Latin discoperīre < discooperīre (“to expose”), from Latin dis- + cooperiō (“to cover wholly”). By surface analysis, des- + cobrir.

examples.text: Isso é só uma pilha de merda!

translations.en: This is just a pile of bullshit!

examples.text: A dublagem em espanhol estava uma merda.

translations.en: The Spanish voice-over was complete shit.

examples.text: Pare de xingar, putinha de merda.

translations.en: Stop swearing, you fucking bitch.

examples.text: Você não me deixou merda nenhuma.

translations.en: You didn't leave me shit.

more.definition: shit; shitty
more.etymology: From Old Galician-Portuguese merda, from Latin merda, from Proto-Italic *(s)merdā, from Proto-Indo-European *smerd-h₂- (“stench”).

examples.text: Matemática é uma merda.

translations.en: Math sucks.

examples.text: Vai-me à merda!

translations.fr: Va te faire voir chez les Grecs !

examples.text: Vamos fumar essa merda!

translations.en: Let's smoke this shit!

examples.text: Ele cheirava a merda.

translations.en: He smelled like shit.

more.definition: shit! (expression of worry, failure, shock, etc.); break a leg! (a superstitious expression of encouragement prior to a performance)
more.etymology: From Old Galician-Portuguese merda, from Latin merda, from Proto-Italic *(s)merdā, from Proto-Indo-European *smerd-h₂- (“stench”).

examples.text: Fala sério, quem acreditaria nessa merda?

translations.en: Come on, who would believe that crap?

translations.en: Mennad has a lot of shit.

examples.text: Não me deixaste merda nenhuma.

translations.en: You guys have a shitty task, in a shitty environment.

more.definition: shit; faeces (excretory product evacuated from the bowels); a chunk of shit; shit (rubbish; worthless matter)
more.etymology: From Old Galician-Portuguese merda, from Latin merda, from Proto-Italic *(s)merdā, from Proto-Indo-European *smerd-h₂- (“stench”).

examples.text: A serpente é rápida, mas o caracol é muito lento.

translations.de: Die Schlange ist schnell, aber die Schnecke ist sehr langsam.
translations.en: The snake is fast, but the snail is very slow.
translations.fr: Le serpent est rapide, mais l'escargot est très lent.

examples.text: Tom nada muito rápido.

translations.de: Tom schwimmt sehr schnell.
translations.en: Tom swims very fast.
translations.fr: Tom nage très rapidement.

examples.text: A inteligência artificial aprende rápido e jamais esquece o que aprendeu.

translations.de: Künstliche Intelligenz lernt schnell und vergisst nie, was sie gelernt hat.
translations.en: Artificial intelligence learns quickly and never forgets what it has learned.
translations.fr: L’intelligence artificielle apprend vite et n’oublie jamais ce qu’elle a appris.

examples.text: O computador aprende com seus erros, de maneira rápida e definitiva.

translations.de: Der Computer lernt schnell und sicher aus seinen Fehlern.
translations.en: The computer learns from its mistakes, quickly and definitively.
translations.fr: L'ordinateur apprend de ses erreurs, rapidement et définitivement.

more.definition: fast (occurring or happening within a short time)
more.etymology: Proto-Indo-European *dʰeh₁-der. Latin rapiduslbor. Learned borrowing from Latin rapidus.

examples.text: Como um ano pode passar rápido!

translations.de: Wie schnell kann ein Jahr vorübergehen!
translations.en: How fast can a year go by!
translations.fr: Comme une année peut passer vite !

examples.text: Cebolas cozinham mais rápido que batatas.

translations.de: Zwiebeln kochen schneller als Kartoffeln.
translations.en: Onions cook more quickly than potatoes.
translations.fr: Les oignons cuisent plus vite que les pommes de terre.

examples.text: Cubra a massa para que ela cresça mais rápido.

translations.de: Decken Sie den Teig ab, damit er schneller aufgeht.
translations.en: Cover the dough to make it rise faster.
translations.fr: Couvrez la pâte pour la faire lever plus vite.

examples.text: Quero aprender mais rápido.

translations.de: Ich will schneller lernen.
translations.en: I want to learn faster.
translations.fr: Je veux apprendre plus vite.

more.definition: with speed; rapidly; quickly
more.etymology: Proto-Indo-European *dʰeh₁-der. Latin rapiduslbor. Learned borrowing from Latin rapidus.

examples.text: Ele aprende rápido.

translations.de: Er lernt schnell.
translations.en: He's a fast learner.
translations.fr: Il apprend vite.

examples.text: Venha cá rápido.

translations.de: Komm schnell hierher.
translations.en: Come here quickly.
translations.fr: Viens vite ici.

examples.text: Os cavalos são mais altos e correm mais rápido que os burros.

translations.de: Pferde sind größer und laufen schneller als Esel.
translations.en: Horses are taller and run faster than donkeys.
translations.fr: Les chevaux sont plus grands et courent plus vite que les ânes.

examples.text: Tom não corre tão rápido quanto Bill.

translations.de: Tom läuft nicht so schnell wie Bill.
translations.en: Tom doesn't run as fast as Bill.
translations.fr: Tom ne court pas aussi vite que Bill.

more.etymology: Do latim rapidus⁽ˡᵃ⁾.

translations.de: Wo ist die nächste Pizzeria?
translations.en: Where's the nearest pizzeria?

more.definition: near, close
more.etymology: Latin proximuslbor. Learned borrowing from Latin proximus. Compare Spanish prójimo.

examples.text: Onde fica a galeria de arte mais próxima?

translations.de: Wo ist die nächste Kunstgalerie?
translations.en: Where's the nearest art gallery?
translations.fr: Où est la galerie d'art la plus proche ?

examples.text: Onde é a estação de comboio mais próxima?

translations.de: Wo ist der nächste Bahnhof?

translations.en: Brazil will face Croatia next Tuesday.
translations.fr: Le Brésil affrontera la Croatie mardi prochain.

translations.fr: Hier, il a grêlé dans ma ville.

translations.fr: Il y a beaucoup de belles villes en Turquie. Par exemple, Izmir.

examples.text: Venho da aldeia e vou para a cidade.

translations.de: Ich komme aus dem Dorf und fahre in die Stadt.
translations.en: I come from the village, and I'm going to the city.
translations.fr: Je viens du village et je vais en ville.

translations.de: Paris ist eine absolut spektakuläre Stadt.
translations.en: Paris is an absolutely spectacular city.
translations.fr: Paris est une ville absolument spectaculaire.

more.definition: city, town; city life, urban life
more.etymology: Proto-Indo-European *ḱey-der. Inherited from Old Galician-Portuguese cidade, from Latin cīvitātem.

senses.gloss: aglomeração humana localizada numa área geográfica circunscrita e que tem numerosas casas, próximas entre si, destinadas à moradia e/ou a atividades culturais, mercantis, industriais, financeiras e a outras não relacionadas com a exploração direta do solo; urbe

translations.de: Am Montag arbeite ich nicht.

examples.text: Estou com dor de cabeça. Vou me deitar.

translations.de: Ich habe Kopfschmerzen. Ich werde mich hinlegen.
translations.en: I have a headache. I'm going to lie down.
translations.fr: J'ai mal à la tête. Je vais m'allonger.

examples.text: Medusa tinha cinco cabeças.

translations.de: Medusa hatte fünf Köpfe.
translations.en: Medusa had five heads.
translations.fr: Méduse avait cinq têtes.

examples.text: Você está com dor de cabeça?

translations.de: Hast du Kopfschmerzen?
translations.en: Have you got a headache?
translations.fr: Avez-vous mal à la tête?

examples.text: Tom nos disse que estava com dor de cabeça.

translations.de: Tom sagte uns, dass er Kopfschmerzen hat.
translations.en: Tom told us that he had a headache.
translations.fr: Tom nous a dit qu'il avait un mal de tête.

senses.gloss: parte do corpo humano, onde se localizam o cérebro, protegido pelo crânio, e a face, ligada ao tronco pelo pescoço

examples.text: Ok, vamos começar!

translations.de: Okay, fangen wir an!
translations.en: OK, let's begin!

examples.text: Escuta, você não precisa fazer isso, ok?!

translations.en: Listen, you don't have to do this, all right ?!

examples.text: Se você não quiser fazer isso, está ok.

translations.en: If you don't want to do it, it's OK.

more.definition: alternative letter-case form of OK
more.etymology: Do inglês ok⁽ᵉⁿ⁾.

examples.text: Eu sou cinco anos mais velho que minha irmã.

translations.de: Ich bin fünf Jahre älter als meine Schwester.
translations.en: I am five years older than my sister.
translations.fr: J'ai cinq ans de plus que ma sœur.

examples.text: Eu encontrei uma mulher velha.

translations.de: Ich traf eine alte Frau.
translations.en: I met an old woman.
translations.fr: J'ai rencontré une vieille femme.

examples.text: Um homem velho não aprende facilmente um novo idioma.

translations.de: Ein alter Mann lernt nicht leicht eine neue Sprache.
translations.en: An old man does not easily learn a new language.
translations.fr: Un vieil homme n'apprend pas facilement une nouvelle langue.

examples.text: Eu tenho um carro velho.

translations.de: Ich habe ein altes Auto.
translations.en: I have an old car.
translations.fr: J'ai une vieille voiture.

more.definition: old; ancient (having existed for a long period of time); old; aged (having lived for most of the expected years); old (that has been used for a considerable period of time)
more.etymology: From Old Galician-Portuguese velho, from Late Latin veclus, from Latin vetulus.

examples.text: Eu sou um homem velho.

translations.de: Ich bin ein alter Mann.
translations.en: I'm an old man.
translations.fr: Je suis un vieil homme.

examples.text: Meu piano é velho.

translations.de: Mein Klavier ist alt.
translations.en: My piano is old.
translations.fr: Mon piano est vieux.

translations.de: Ein alter Schauspieler trägt Millionen von Seelen in sich.
translations.en: An old actor carries millions of souls within him.
translations.fr: Un vieil acteur porte en lui des millions d’âmes.

examples.text: Eu cantarei enquanto o coração neste meu velho peito palpitar.

translations.de: Ich werde singen, solange das Herz in meiner alten Brust schlägt.
translations.en: I'll sing as long as the heart in my old breast beats.
translations.fr: Je chanterai tant que le cœur dans ma vieille poitrine battra.

more.definition: man!, dude! (emphatic interjection)
more.etymology: From Old Galician-Portuguese velho, from Late Latin veclus, from Latin vetulus.

examples.text: Eu sou o aluno mais velho da escola.

translations.de: Ich bin der älteste Schüler der Schule.
translations.en: I am the oldest student at school.
translations.fr: Je suis l'élève le plus âgé de l'école.

translations.de: Interlingua hat fünf ältere Schwestern.
translations.en: Interlingua has five older sisters.
translations.fr: Interlingua a cinq sœurs plus âgées.

examples.text: Eu moro em uma casa velha.

translations.de: Ich wohne in einem alten Haus.
translations.en: I live in an old house.
translations.fr: J'habite dans une vieille maison.

examples.text: Eu sou mais velho do que você pensa.

translations.de: Ich bin älter, als du denkst.
translations.en: I'm older than you think I am.
translations.fr: Je suis plus vieux que tu le penses.

more.definition: an old person; father; husband, especially a middle-aged or elderly one
more.etymology: From Old Galician-Portuguese velho, from Late Latin veclus, from Latin vetulus.

more.definition: wakening (act of awaking)
more.etymology: From Old Galician-Portuguese acordar, from Vulgar Latin *accordāre. Sense of "to wake up" was possibly influenced by Latin cordatus (“wise, prudent”), which would yield *cordado if inherited.

examples.text: Ontem o despertador não tocou e Kurt não acordou.

translations.de: Gestern hat der Wecker nicht geklingelt und Kurt ist nicht aufgewacht.
translations.en: Yesterday the alarm clock didn't go off and Kurt didn't wake up.
translations.fr: Hier le réveil n'a pas sonné et Kurt ne s'est pas réveillé.

examples.text: Depois de acordar, eu geralmente tomo banho...

translations.de: Nach dem Aufwachen dusche ich normalerweise...
translations.en: After waking up, I usually take a shower...
translations.fr: Après m'être réveillé, je prends généralement une douche...

examples.text: Quando acordei, eu estava no carro.

translations.de: Als ich aufwachte, war ich im Auto.
translations.en: When I woke up, I was in the car.
translations.fr: Quand je me réveillai, j'étais dans la voiture.

examples.text: Estou parcialmente de acordo com você.

translations.de: Ich stimme dir teilweise zu.
translations.en: I'm in partial agreement with you.
translations.fr: Je suis en partie d'accord avec vous.

more.definition: to awake; to wake up (to stop sleeping); to wake; to wake up; to awaken (to cause someone to stop sleeping); to wake up (to), to become aware (of) (to become aware of a serious issue)
more.etymology: From Old Galician-Portuguese acordar, from Vulgar Latin *accordāre. Sense of "to wake up" was possibly influenced by Latin cordatus (“wise, prudent”), which would yield *cordado if inherited.

examples.text: A Wikipédia é uma enciclopédia livre.

translations.de: Wikipedia ist eine freie Enzyklopädie.
translations.en: Wikipedia is a free encyclopedia.
translations.fr: Wikipédia est une encyclopédie libre.

examples.text: A livraria está aberta.

translations.de: Der Buchladen ist geöffnet.
translations.en: The bookstore is open.
translations.fr: La librairie est ouverte.

examples.text: Não tenho tempo livre para estudar.

translations.de: Ich habe keine Zeit, um zu studieren.
translations.en: I have no leisure to study.
translations.fr: Je n'ai pas de temps libre pour étudier.

examples.text: Eu sou um homem livre.

translations.de: Ich bin ein freier Mann.
translations.en: I'm a free man.
translations.fr: Je suis un homme libre.

more.definition: to save; to free; to release; to exempt
more.etymology: Inherited from Old Galician-Portuguese livrar, from Latin līberāre (“to acquit”). Doublet of liberar, which was borrowed.

examples.text: A magia tem um papel importante nas sociedades primitivas.

translations.de: Zauberei spielt in primitiven Gesellschaften eine wichtige Rolle.
translations.en: Magic plays an important part in primitive society.
translations.fr: La magie joue un rôle important dans les sociétés primitives.

examples.text: Até alguma poesia pode ser encontrada nas páginas de Tatoeba.

translations.de: Sogar einige Gedichte finden sich in den Seiten von Tatoeba.
translations.en: Even some poetry can be found on the pages of Tatoeba.
translations.fr: On trouve même de la poésie dans les pages de Tatoeba.

examples.text: Dos seus versos a música é gerada nas esferas sutis do coração.

translations.de: Die Musik seiner Verse entsteht in den subtilen Sphären des Herzens.
translations.en: The music of his verses is generated in the subtle spheres of the heart.
translations.fr: La musique de ses vers est générée dans les sphères subtiles du cœur.

examples.text: O velho aluno ainda comete erros nas frases que traduz para o Latim.

translations.de: Der alte Schüler macht immer noch Fehler in den Sätzen, die er ins Lateinische übersetzt.
translations.en: The old student still makes mistakes in the sentences he translates into Latin.
translations.fr: L'ancien étudiant fait encore des fautes dans les phrases qu'il traduit en latin.

more.definition: contraction of em + as, literally “in the”: feminine plural of no

examples.text: Ele comprou um terno azul-marinho muito bonito.

translations.de: Er kaufte sich einen sehr schönen marineblauen Anzug.
translations.en: He bought a very nice navy blue suit.
translations.fr: Il a acheté un très beau costume bleu marine.

examples.text: Eu preciso comprar um mouse pad.

translations.de: Ich brauche ein Mauspad.
translations.en: I need a mouse pad.
translations.fr: J'ai besoin d'un tapis de souris.

examples.text: Já compramos selos na segunda-feira.

translations.de: Wir haben schon am Montag Briefmarken gekauft.
translations.en: We already bought stamps on Monday.
translations.fr: Nous avons déjà acheté des timbres lundi.

examples.text: Ele perdeu o relógio que comprara na véspera.

translations.de: Er verlor die Uhr, welche er am Tage zuvor gekauft hatte.
translations.en: He lost the watch which he had bought the day before.
translations.fr: Il a perdu la montre qu'il avait achetée la veille.

more.definition: to buy
more.etymology: From Old Galician-Portuguese comprar, conprar, from Vulgar Latin *comperāre, from Latin comparāre (“to prepare, to procure, to get, to purchase, to obtain”). Doublet of comparar.

senses.gloss: obter algo em troca de dinheiro

examples.text: Honestamente, eu preferia estar errado.

translations.de: Ehrlich gesagt hätte ich lieber unrecht.
translations.en: Honestly, I would rather be wrong.
translations.fr: Honnêtement, je préfèrerais me tromper.

examples.text: A primeira resposta está certa, a segunda está errada.

translations.de: Die erste Antwort ist richtig, die zweite ist falsch.
translations.en: The first answer is correct; the second is wrong.
translations.fr: La première réponse est correcte, la seconde est fausse.

examples.text: Não há nada de errado em envelhecer.

translations.de: Es ist nichts Falsches daran, alt zu werden.
translations.en: There's nothing wrong with growing old.
translations.fr: Il n'y a pas de mal à vieillir.

examples.text: Que fizemos de errado para merecer esta penalidade?

translations.de: Was haben wir falsch gemacht, dass wir diese Sanktion verdienen?
translations.en: What did we do wrong to deserve this sanction?
translations.fr: Qu’avons-nous fait de mal pour mériter cette pénalité ?

more.definition: not correct; wrong; incorrect
more.etymology: Past participle of errar.

examples.text: Nunca é demasiado tarde para se aprender.

translations.de: Es ist nie zu spät zum Lernen.
translations.en: It is never too late to learn.
translations.fr: Personne n'est trop vieux pour apprendre.

examples.text: O que você faz à tarde?

translations.de: Was machst du am Nachmittag?
translations.en: What do you do in the afternoon?
translations.fr: Que fais-tu l'après-midi ?

examples.text: Nunca é tarde demais para aprender.

translations.de: Es ist nie zu spät zum Lernen.
translations.en: It is never too late to learn.
translations.fr: Tu n'es pas trop vieux pour apprendre.

examples.text: Minha filha passeia com o cachorro de manhã e à tarde.

translations.de: Meine Tochter geht morgens und nachmittags mit dem Hund spazieren.
translations.en: My daughter walks the dog in the morning and in the afternoon.
translations.fr: Ma fille promène le chien le matin et l'après-midi.

more.definition: late (near the end of a period of time); late (specifically, near the end of the day); late (not arriving until after an expected time)

translations.de: Um fünf Uhr nachmittags in Paris, wie spät ist es in Moskau?
translations.en: At five o'clock in the afternoon in Paris, what time is it in Moscow?
translations.fr: À cinq heures de l'après-midi à Paris, quelle heure est-il à Moscou ?

examples.text: As manhãs são mais claras do que as tardes.

translations.de: Die Morgenstunden sind heller als die Nachmittage.
translations.en: The mornings are brighter than the afternoons.
translations.fr: Les matins sont plus lumineux que les après-midis.

examples.text: Peguei um táxi, para não chegar tarde.

translations.de: Ich habe ein Taxi genommen, damit ich nicht zu spät ankomme.
translations.en: I took a taxi so I wouldn't arrive late.
translations.fr: 38 J'ai pris un taxi pour ne pas arriver en retard.

examples.text: Não tenho nada que fazer esta tarde.

translations.de: Ich habe heute Nachmittag nichts zu tun.
translations.en: I have nothing to do this afternoon.
translations.fr: Je n'ai rien à faire cet après-midi.

more.definition: afternoon
more.etymology: From Old Galician-Portuguese tarde, from Latin tardē (“tardily; late”, adverb), from tardus (“late”, adjective). Compare French tard, Spanish tarde and related to English tardy.

senses.gloss: período do dia entre o meio-dia e o pôr-do-sol

examples.text: O gato está dentro da caixa.

translations.en: The cat is inside the box.
translations.fr: Le chat est à l'intérieur de la boîte.

translations.de: Tom stieß das Floß ins Wasser.
translations.en: Tom pushed the raft into the water.
translations.fr: Tom poussa le radeau dans l'eau.

translations.de: Wer nach außen schaut, träumt; wer nach innen schaut, erwacht.
translations.en: Those who look outward dream; those who look inward awaken.
translations.fr: Ceux qui regardent à l'extérieur rêvent ; ceux qui regardent à l'intérieur s'éveillent.

examples.text: Dentro da colmeia, cheirava a mel.

translations.fr: À l'intérieur de la ruche, ça sentait le miel.

more.definition: inside (within or into something’s interior); indoors (in a building)

examples.text: Eu vou te mostrar a cidade.

examples.text: Qual é o significado dessa história?

translations.fr: Cette épée a une étrange histoire.

translations.en: This is such a sad story.
translations.fr: C’est une histoire tellement triste.

more.etymology: Learned borrowing from Latin historia (“history”), from Ancient Greek ἱστορία (historía, “learning through research, narration of what is learned”), from ἱστορέω (historéō, “to learn through research, to inquire”), from ἵστωρ (hístōr, “the one who knows, the expert, the judge”). examples.text: Lembrar-me-ei disso.

examples.text: O Tom sabe que ele não tem escolha.

translations.fr: Tom sait qu'il n'a pas le choix.

translations.en: A lot is at stake when a country chooses its destiny.
translations.fr: Beaucoup de choses sont en jeu lorsqu'un pays choisit son destin.

examples.text: Na ilha estávamos sozinhos e era noite de luar.

translations.fr: Elles ne sont pas seules.

translations.de: Sie lebt allein.

examples.text: A buganvília cresce enquanto espera em flores converter as cinzas do meu corpo.

translations.fr: La vie est espoir.

translations.fr: Les cinémas sont pleins, tandis que les théâtres sont vides.

translations.fr: Terminer, c'est facile. Commencer, c'est difficile.

translations.fr: Le turc est une langue difficile.

translations.fr: J'ai toujours tenu mes promesses.

translations.fr: Je suis fatigué de tous leurs mensonges.

examples.text: Vi um rato correndo na cozinha.

translations.de: Ich sah eine Ratte in der Küche herumlaufen.
translations.en: I saw a mouse running through the kitchen.
translations.fr: J'ai vu un rat courir dans la cuisine.

examples.text: Uma besta grande correu, matou e comeu uma besta pequena.

translations.de: Ein großes Tier rannte, tötete und fraß ein kleines Tier.
translations.en: A big beast ran, killed and ate a small beast.
translations.fr: Une grosse bête a couru, tué et mangé une petite bête.

examples.text: Eu gosto de correr.

translations.de: Ich gehe gerne Joggen.
translations.en: I like jogging.
translations.fr: J'aime courir.

examples.text: O cavalo é um animal que corre com muita graça e beleza.

translations.de: Das Pferd ist ein Tier, das mit großer Anmut und Schönheit läuft.
translations.en: The horse is an animal that runs with great grace and beauty.
translations.fr: Le cheval est un animal qui court avec une grande grâce et une grande beauté.

examples.text: Quem te bateu?

translations.de: Wer hat dich geschlagen?
translations.en: Who hit you?
translations.fr: Qui t'a battu ?

translations.de: Er klopft immer an die Tür, bevor er eintritt.
translations.en: He always knocks on the door before entering.
translations.fr: Il frappe toujours à la porte avant d'entrer.

examples.text: Você precisa pagar a mais pelas baterias.

translations.de: Die Batterien muss man extra bezahlen.
translations.en: You need to pay extra for the batteries.

examples.text: Sofia vai bater à porta de Cláudia.

translations.en: Sophie is going to knock on Claudia's door.
translations.fr: Sophie va frapper à la porte de Claudia.

more.definition: to beat; to beat up (to attack someone violently); to hit; to strike (to collide with violently); to crash (to cause something to collide)
more.etymology: Inherited from Old Galician-Portuguese bater, from Latin battere, from earlier battuere. Compare Galician bater.

senses.gloss: dar pancada, com objeto, com a mão ou com o pé, em; golpear

examples.text: Não existe pecado. Há somente ignorância.

translations.de: Es gibt keine Sünde. Es gibt nur Unwissenheit.
translations.en: There is no sin. There is only ignorance.
translations.fr: Il n'y a pas de péché. Il n'y a que l'ignorance.

examples.text: Será que existem lobos bons e lobos maus?

translations.de: Gibt es gute und böse Wölfe?
translations.en: Are there good wolves and bad wolves?
translations.fr: Y a-t-il de bons loups et de mauvais loups ?

examples.text: A alma pode existir sem o corpo.

translations.de: Die Seele kann ohne den Körper existieren.
translations.en: The soul can exist without the body.
translations.fr: L'âme peut exister sans le corps.

examples.text: Se não estás no Facebook, não existes!

translations.de: Wenn du nicht auf Facebook bist, existierst du nicht!
translations.en: If you're not on Facebook, you don't exist!
translations.fr: Si tu n'es pas sur Facebook, tu n'existes pas !

more.definition: to exist (to be)
more.etymology: Borrowed from Latin existere, variant of exsistō (“to step forth, to emerge”).

examples.text: Acho que a prova vai ser fácil.

translations.de: Ich glaube, der Test wird einfach sein.
translations.en: I think the test will be easy.
translations.fr: Je pense que le test sera facile.

translations.de: Ich habe dir alle Liebesbeweise gegeben, die du von mir erwarten konntest.
translations.en: I've given you all the tokens of love you could expect from me.
translations.fr: Je t'ai donné tous les signes d'amour que tu pouvais attendre de moi.

examples.text: Eu posso provar que tenho razão.

translations.de: Ich kann beweisen, dass ich recht habe.
translations.en: I can prove that I am right.
translations.fr: Je peux prouver que j'ai raison.

examples.text: O Latim prova que a morte não existe.

translations.de: Latein beweist, dass es den Tod nicht gibt.
translations.en: Latin proves that death does not exist.
translations.fr: Le latin prouve que la mort n'existe pas.

examples.text: O catolicismo renega a ideia de reencarnação.

translations.de: Der Katholizismus verleugnet die Idee der Reinkarnation.
translations.en: Catholicism repudiates the idea of reincarnation.
translations.fr: Le catholicisme renie l'idée de réincarnation.

examples.text: Não é fácil entender as suas ideias.

translations.de: Es ist nicht leicht, seine Gedanken zu verstehen.
translations.en: It isn't easy to understand his ideas.
translations.fr: Il n'est pas facile de comprendre ses idées.

examples.text: Essa é a minha ideia.

translations.de: Das ist meine Idee.
translations.en: That's my idea.
translations.fr: C'est mon idée.

examples.text: Você tem alguma ideia melhor?

translations.de: Hast du eine bessere Idee?
translations.en: Do you have any better ideas?
translations.fr: As-tu une meilleure idée ?

examples.text: Ponha as maçãs vermelhas aqui e as verdes ali.

translations.fr: Mettez les pommes rouges ici et les vertes là.

translations.en: Set sail immediately to Italy and found a new Troy there.
translations.fr: Naviguez immédiatement vers l'Italie et fondez-y une nouvelle Troie.

translations.fr: Le petit garçon debout là-bas est mon fils.

examples.text: No coração cultiva a planta da saudade.

translations.de: Im Herzen kultiviert sich die Pflanze der Sehnsucht.
translations.en: In his heart he grows the plant of longing.
translations.fr: Dans le cœur il cultive la plante de la nostalgie.

translations.fr: Elle a un cœur de pierre !

translations.en: My heart is green and yellow.
translations.fr: Mon cœur est vert et jaune.

examples.text: Ele viverá para sempre em nossos corações.

translations.de: Er wird in unseren Herzen immer weiterleben.
translations.en: He will live forever in our hearts.
translations.fr: Il survivra à jamais dans nos cœurs.

senses.gloss: órgão muscular que bombeia o sangue de certos animais

examples.text: Eu quero me tornar professor de japonês.

translations.de: Ich möchte Japanischlehrer werden.
translations.en: I want to become a teacher of Japanese.
translations.fr: Je veux devenir un professeur de japonais.

examples.text: O inglês se tornou uma língua internacional.

translations.de: Englisch ist eine internationale Sprache geworden.
translations.en: English has become an international language.
translations.fr: L'anglais est devenu une langue internationale.

examples.text: Que ela se torne amiga de minha esposa.

translations.en: Let her become friends with my wife.
translations.fr: Laissez-la devenir amie avec ma femme.

translations.en: Her goal is to become a teacher.
translations.fr: Son but est de devenir enseignante.

more.definition: to make (to cause to be); to become; to turn into; to return; to come back
more.etymology: Ancient Greek τόρνος (tórnos)bor. Proto-Indo-European *-h₂tiinflu. Inherited from Old Galician-Portuguese tornar, from Latin tornāre.

examples.text: Isso tem de ser bom, jamais há de ser mau.

translations.de: Das muss gut sein, es darf niemals schlecht sein.
translations.en: This must be good, it can never be bad.

translations.fr: Il y a deux assiettes sur la table.

translations.fr: Ça ne fonctionnera pas.

translations.fr: Aujourd'hui, mon fils a fait du poney.

translations.de: Ich will nicht anders sein.

translations.fr: Je ne veux pas être différent.

translations.en: I'm afraid of my boss.
translations.fr: J'ai peur de mon patron.

examples.text: Meu chefe sempre usa terno e gravata.

translations.en: My boss always wears a suit and tie.
translations.fr: Mon patron porte toujours un costume et une cravate.

examples.text: Ela sempre sabe mais que o chefe.

translations.en: She always knows better than the boss.
translations.fr: Elle sait toujours tout mieux que le chef.

more.definition: chief, head, head man, boss; chieftain; chef (the head cook of an establishment such as a restaurant)
more.etymology: Borrowed from French chef; cognates include Spanish jefe and English chief. Doublet of chef, cabo, and caput.

senses.gloss: pessoa que se destaca pelas qualidades de autoridade, competência, poder de decisão etc

examples.text: Maria é a esposa de Tom.

translations.de: Marie ist Toms Frau.
translations.en: Mary is Tom's wife.
translations.fr: Marie est la femme de Tom.

examples.text: Ela é a esposa de Alain.

translations.de: Sie ist Alains Ehefrau.
translations.en: She's Alain's wife.
translations.fr: Elle est l'épouse d'Alain.

examples.text: A minha esposa é polonesa.

translations.de: Meine Frau ist Polin.
translations.en: My wife is Polish.
translations.fr: Mon épouse est polonaise.

examples.text: Eu amo a minha esposa.

translations.de: Ich liebe meine Frau.
translations.en: I love my wife.
translations.fr: J'aime mon épouse.

more.etymology: Latin spōnsusnom. Inherited from Old Galician-Portuguese esposa, from Latin spōnsa.

examples.text: Ela está com alguma coisa no olho.

translations.de: Sie hat etwas im Auge.
translations.en: She has something in her eye.
translations.fr: Elle a quelque chose dans l'œil.

examples.text: Ele tem olhos azuis.

translations.de: Er hat blaue Augen.
translations.en: He has blue eyes.
translations.fr: Il a les yeux bleus.

examples.text: Ambas as meninas têm olhos azuis.

translations.de: Beide Mädchen haben blaue Augen.
translations.en: Both girls have blue eyes.
translations.fr: Les deux filles ont les yeux bleus.

examples.text: Seus olhos estavam cheios de lágrimas.

translations.de: Ihre Augen waren voller Tränen.
translations.en: Her eyes were filled with tears.
translations.fr: Ses yeux étaient remplis de larmes.

examples.text: Fechei meus olhos para descansar.

translations.de: Ich schloss meine Augen, um mich auszuruhen.
translations.en: I closed my eyes to rest.
translations.fr: J'ai fermé les yeux pour me reposer.

examples.text: Em teus olhos, eu encontro um pedaço do paraíso.

translations.de: In deinen Augen finde ich ein Stück Paradies.
translations.en: In your eyes I find a piece of paradise.
translations.fr: Dans tes yeux je trouve un coin de paradis.

more.definition: eye; eye, center (of a storm, etc.); a hole in cheese, bread or similar items
collocations: de olho em — keeping an eye on
idioms: a beleza está nos olhos de quem vê
more.etymology: Proto-Indo-European *h₃ekʷ-der. Inherited from Old Galician-Portuguese olho, from Vulgar Latin oclum, from Latin oculum (“eye”), ultimately from Proto-Indo-European *h₃ekʷ- (“eye; to see”). Doublet of óculo, a borrowing. Compare Galician ollo, Spanish ojo, French œil and Italian occhio.

senses.gloss: órgão, geralmente aos pares, de vários animais responsável pela visão

examples.text: A velhice chegou. O fim já se aproxima.

translations.de: Das Alter ist angekommen. Das Ende naht bereits.
translations.en: Old age has arrived. The end is approaching.
translations.fr: La vieillesse est arrivée. La fin approche déjà.

examples.text: A guerra estúpida e sangrenta chega ao fim.

translations.de: Der dumme und blutige Krieg geht zu Ende.
translations.en: The stupid and bloody war comes to an end.
translations.fr: La guerre stupide et sanglante touche à sa fin.

examples.text: Quero poder cantar até o fim da minha vida.

translations.de: Ich möchte bis an mein Lebensende singen können.
translations.en: I want to be able to sing until the end of my life.
translations.fr: Je veux pouvoir chanter jusqu'à la fin de ma vie.

examples.text: O médico recomendou repouso absoluto até o fim da gravidez.

translations.de: Der Arzt empfahl absolute Bettruhe bis zum Ende der Schwangerschaft.
translations.en: The doctor recommended complete bed rest until the end of the pregnancy.
translations.fr: Le médecin a recommandé un repos complet au lit jusqu'à la fin de la grossesse.

more.definition: end, conclusion, closure
more.etymology: From Old Galician-Portuguese fim, fin, from Latin finis, of disputed origin. Perhaps ultimately from Proto-Indo-European *dʰeygʷ- or Proto-Indo-European *bʰeyd-.

senses.gloss: lugar ou tempo em que algo termina, final, antônimo de início

examples.text: Os mamíferos têm mamas, os ovíparos põem ovos.

translations.de: Säugetiere haben Zitzen, Ovipare legen Eier.
translations.en: Mammals have breasts, oviparous lay eggs.
translations.fr: Les mammifères ont des mamelles, les ovipares pondent des œufs.

examples.text: Põe-te em meu lugar.

translations.de: Versetz dich in meine Lage.
translations.en: Put yourself in my place.
translations.fr: Mets-toi à ma place.

examples.text: Ponha-se em meu lugar.

translations.de: Versetz dich in meine Lage.
translations.en: Put yourself in my place.
translations.fr: Mets-toi à ma place.

examples.text: Os pássaros põem ovos.

translations.de: Die Vögel legen Eier.
translations.en: Birds lay eggs.
translations.fr: Les oiseaux pondent des œufs.

more.definition: to put; to place; to get (to position oneself into a given state); to go
more.etymology: From Old Galician-Portuguese põer (“to put”), from Latin pōnere, from Proto-Italic *pozinō. Cognate of Spanish poner, French pondre, Italian porre, Sicilian pùniri.

senses.gloss: fazer com que algo se estabeleça num lugar

examples.text: Tatoeba não é uma escola — é uma universidade!

translations.de: Tatoeba ist keine Schule — es ist eine Universität!
translations.en: Tatoeba is not a school — it is a university!
translations.fr: Tatoeba n'est pas une école — c'est une université!

examples.text: Nas escolas russas, o inglês é a língua estrangeira mais estudada.

translations.de: In russischen Schulen ist Englisch die am häufigsten gelernte Fremdsprache.
translations.en: In Russian schools, English is the most studied foreign language.
translations.fr: Dans les écoles russes, l'anglais est la langue étrangère la plus étudiée.

examples.text: Ele vai à escola de ônibus.

translations.de: Er fährt mit dem Bus zur Schule.
translations.en: He goes to school by bus.
translations.fr: Il va à l'école en bus.

examples.text: Eu vou à escola de segunda a sexta-feira.

translations.de: Ich gehe von Montag bis Freitag zur Schule.
translations.en: I go to school from Monday to Friday.
translations.fr: Je vais à l'école du lundi au vendredi.

more.definition: school (institution dedicated to teaching and learning); school (an art movement); school (the followers of a particular doctrine)
more.etymology: From Old Galician-Portuguese escola, from Latin schola, from Ancient Greek σχολή (skholḗ, “spare time, leisure”). The Portuguese form may indicate a semi-learned influence on the phonetic aspects of the word.

senses.gloss: instituição social que tem a missão de educar

examples.text: Não consigo imaginar minha vida sem Tatoeba.

translations.de: Ich kann mir mein Leben ohne Tatoeba nicht vorstellen.
translations.en: I can't imagine my life without Tatoeba.
translations.fr: Je ne peux pas imaginer ma vie sans Tatoeba.

examples.text: Que situação você imaginou, na qual alguém diria isso?

translations.de: Was für eine Situation, in der das gesagt wird, hast du dir vorgestellt?
translations.en: What situation did you imagine, in which someone would say that?
translations.fr: Quelle situation avez-vous imaginée, dans laquelle quelqu'un dirait cela ?

examples.text: Que imagina o senhor que eu andaria fazendo?

translations.en: What do you think I've been doing?
translations.fr: Que pensez-vous que je ferais?

examples.text: Foi o que eu imaginei.

translations.en: That's what I figured.
translations.fr: C'est ce que je me suis imaginé.

more.definition: to imagine (all senses)
more.etymology: Borrowed from Latin imāginārī, from imāginem, the accusative singular of imāgō (“a copy, likeness, image”).

senses.gloss: criar na imaginação, criar imagem na mente

examples.text: Jesus se vestia qual um pobre. Entretanto, falava qual um rei.

translations.de: Jesus kleidete sich wie ein armer Mann. Doch er sprach wie ein König.
translations.en: Jesus dressed like a poor man. However, he spoke like a king.
translations.fr: Jésus s'habillait comme un pauvre. Pourtant, il parlait comme un roi.

examples.text: Tom vestiu-se.

translations.de: Tom zog sich an.
translations.en: Tom put on some clothes.
translations.fr: Tom s'est habillé.

examples.text: Nós nos vestimos.

translations.de: Wir zogen uns an.
translations.en: We got dressed.
translations.fr: Nous nous sommes habillés.

examples.text: Tom se vestiu.

translations.de: Tom zog sich an.
translations.en: Tom got dressed.
translations.fr: Tom s'est habillé.

more.definition: to wear; to don (to have an item of clothing on oneself); to put on (to put an item of clothing on oneself); to get dressed (to put clothes on oneself)
more.etymology: Proto-Indo-European *-yétider. Inherited from Old Galician-Portuguese vestir, from Latin vestiō.

examples.text: Eu preciso de mais vitamina D.

translations.de: Ich brauche mehr Vitamin D.
translations.en: I need more vitamin D.
translations.fr: J'ai besoin de plus de vitamine D.

examples.text: O mundo não precisa de mim.

translations.de: Die Welt braucht mich nicht.
translations.en: The world has no need for me.
translations.fr: Le monde n'a pas besoin de moi.

examples.text: Estás doente, tu precisas repousar.

translations.de: Du bist krank, du musst dich ausruhen.
translations.en: You're sick. You have to rest.
translations.fr: Tu es malade, tu dois te reposer.

examples.text: Você precisa aceitar o seu papel.

translations.de: Du musst deine Rolle akzeptieren.
translations.en: You need to accept your role.
translations.fr: Tu dois accepter ton rôle.

more.definition: precise; accurate (in exact or careful conformity with the truth); accurate (which hits the target); necessary
more.etymology: From Latin praecīsus (“shortened”), from praecīdō (“to shorten”).

examples.text: Alguém atacou o Tom.

translations.de: Jemand griff Tom an.
translations.en: Someone attacked Tom.
translations.fr: Quelqu'un attaqua Tom.

examples.text: Durante a partida, aquele treinador ficava à beira de um ataque de nervos.

translations.de: Während des Spiels stand der Trainer kurz vor einem Nervenzusammenbruch.
translations.en: That coach was on the verge of having a nervous breakdown during the match.
translations.fr: Durant le match, cet entraîneur était au bord de la crise de nerfs.

examples.text: O xadrez, alegoria de uma guerra, é um jogo de ataque e defesa.

translations.de: Schach, Allegorie eines Krieges, ist ein Angriffs- und Verteidigungsspiel.
translations.en: Chess, allegory of a war, is a game of attack and defense.
translations.fr: Les échecs, allégorie d'une guerre, sont un jeu d'attaque et de défense.

examples.text: Uma abelha só pica se for atacada.

translations.de: Eine Biene sticht nur, wenn sie angegriffen wird.
translations.en: A bee only stings if it is attacked.
translations.fr: Une abeille ne pique que si elle est attaquée.

more.definition: to attack (to apply violent force); to attack (to aggressively challenge a person or idea); to attack (to deal with something in a direct way)
more.etymology: Proto-Indo-European *trísinflu. Middle French destacherbor. Italian attaccarebor. Borrowed from Italian attaccare (“to join; to attack”).

examples.text: Jim não é advogado. É médico.

translations.de: Jim ist nicht Anwalt, sondern Arzt.
translations.en: Jim is not a lawyer but a doctor.
translations.fr: Jim n'est pas avocat mais médecin.

examples.text: A médica examinou o bebê.

translations.de: Die Ärztin untersuchte das Baby.
translations.en: The doctor examined the baby.
translations.fr: Le médecin examina le bébé.

examples.text: Seu tio é um médico famoso.

translations.de: Sein Onkel ist ein berühmter Arzt.
translations.en: His uncle is a famous doctor.
translations.fr: Son oncle est un célèbre médecin.

examples.text: O médico o aconselhou a diminuir a bebida.

translations.de: Der Arzt riet ihm, weniger zu trinken.
translations.en: The doctor advised him to cut down on drinking.
translations.fr: Le docteur lui a conseillé de diminuer la boisson.

more.definition: medical
more.etymology: Latin medicuslbor. Learned borrowing from Latin medicus.

senses.gloss: que é relativo à medicina ou a quem a exerce

examples.text: Eu conheço um médico muito habilidoso.

translations.de: Ich kenne einen sehr erfahrenen Arzt.
translations.en: I know a doctor who is very good at what he does.
translations.fr: Je connais un médecin très compétent.

examples.text: A minha esposa é médica.

translations.de: Meine Frau ist Ärztin.
translations.en: My wife is a doctor.
translations.fr: Ma femme est médecin.

examples.text: Nós somos médicos.

translations.de: Wir sind Ärzte.
translations.en: We are doctors.
translations.fr: Nous sommes médecins.

examples.text: O que o médico está fazendo?

translations.de: Was macht der Arzt?
translations.en: What is the doctor doing?
translations.fr: Qu'est-ce que le médecin fait ?

more.definition: consulting room, clinic; remedy
more.etymology: Latin medicuslbor. Learned borrowing from Latin medicus.

senses.gloss: pessoa diplomada em medicina, qualificada para tratar doentes

examples.text: Esta pedra tem forma de um animal.

translations.de: Dieser Stein hat die Form eines Tiers.
translations.en: This rock has the shape of an animal.
translations.fr: Cette pierre a la forme d'un animal.

examples.text: Precisamos de novas formas de apoiar os artistas.

translations.de: Wir brauchen neue Wege, um Künstler zu unterstützen.
translations.en: We need new ways to support artists.
translations.fr: Nous avons besoin de nouvelles façons de soutenir les artistes.

examples.text: De que forma o erro se manifestou?

translations.de: Wie äußert sich der Fehler?
translations.en: How is the error observed?
translations.fr: Comment se manifeste le défaut ?

examples.text: Soneto é poesia emoldurada. Tem beleza na forma e na expressão.

translations.de: Das Sonett ist gerahmte Poesie. Es hat Schönheit in Form und Ausdruck.
translations.en: A sonnet is framed poetry. It has beauty in form and expression.
translations.fr: Le sonnet est une poésie encadrée. Il a de la beauté dans la forme et l’expression.

more.definition: form; shape (the visible structure of a thing); shape; figure (a geometric object); form (a conventional method way of doing something)
more.etymology: Learned borrowing from Latin fōrma. Doublet of etymology 2, which was inherited.

examples.text: A mamãe pode fazer este bolo sozinha.

translations.en: Mom alone can make this cake.
translations.fr: Maman peut faire ce gâteau seule.

examples.text: Papai é mais velho que mamãe.

translations.de: Papa ist älter als Mama.
translations.en: Dad is older than mom.

examples.text: Mamãe, cadê o vaso onde eu plantei a flor?

translations.en: Mom, where's the pot where I planted the flower?
translations.fr: Maman, où est le pot dans lequel j'ai planté la fleur ?

examples.text: Mamãe, onde está o papai?

translations.en: Mum, where's Dad?
translations.fr: Maman, où est papa ?

more.definition: mum, mom, mummy
more.etymology: From mãe.

examples.text: O gato está brincando com a bola.

translations.de: Die Katze spielt mit dem Ball.
translations.en: The cat is playing with the ball.
translations.fr: Le chat joue avec le ballon.

examples.text: Nós brincamos nesta praia.

translations.de: Wir haben an diesem Strand gespielt.
translations.en: We have played at this beach.
translations.fr: Nous avons joué sur cette plage.

examples.text: As crianças brincavam no quintal com os coelhos e as galinhas.

translations.de: Die Kinder spielten im Hof mit den Kaninchen und Hühnern.
translations.en: The children were playing in the backyard with the rabbits and the chickens.
translations.fr: Les enfants jouaient dans la cour avec les lapins et les poules.

examples.text: Três crianças estavam brincando no parque.

translations.de: Drei Kinder spielten im Park.
translations.en: Three children were playing in the park.
translations.fr: Trois enfants jouaient dans le parc.

more.definition: to play, as in child's play or "playing around"; to act with levity or thoughtlessness; to joke, to kid
more.etymology: Probably from brinco (“merriment”) + -ar or less likely from Proto-Germanic *blinkaną (“to gleam, glitter, flash”).

examples.text: Eles pensam que podem controlar a situação, mas estão muito enganados.

translations.de: Sie glauben, sie könnten die Situation unter Kontrolle halten, aber da irren sie sich gewaltig.
translations.en: They think they can control the situation, but they're very much mistaken.
translations.fr: Ils pensent pouvoir maîtriser la situation, mais ils se trompent lourdement.

examples.text: Há um controle remoto debaixo do sofá.

translations.en: There is a TV remote control under the couch.
translations.fr: Il y a une télécommande sous le canapé.

examples.text: Ninguém tem o direito de nos controlar.

translations.en: Nobody has the right to control us.
translations.fr: Personne n'a le droit de nous contrôler.

examples.text: Ele não podia controlar a sua cólera.

translations.en: He couldn't control his anger.
translations.fr: Il ne pouvait contenir sa colère.

more.definition: to control (to determine the behavior of); to keep under control; to govern (to exercise sovereign authority)
more.etymology: Borrowed from French contrôler.

examples.text: Essa frase em galego é exatamente igual à sua tradução em português.

translations.de: Dieser Satz auf Galicisch ist genau derselbe wie seine Übersetzung auf Portugiesisch.
translations.en: That sentence in Galician is exactly the same as its translation in Portuguese.
translations.fr: Cette phrase en galicien est exactement la même que sa traduction en portugais.

examples.text: É exatamente isso que eu queria dizer.

translations.de: Das ist genau das, was ich sagen wollte.
translations.en: That is exactly what I wanted to say.
translations.fr: C'est exactement ce que je voulais dire.

examples.text: Esta frase contém exatamente seis palavras.

translations.de: Dieser Satz enthält genau sechs Wörter.
translations.en: This sentence contains exactly six words.
translations.fr: Cette phrase contient exactement six mots.

examples.text: Você pode me explicar exatamente como isso aconteceu?

translations.en: Can you explain to me exactly how that happened?
translations.fr: Pouvez-vous m'expliquer exactement comment cela s'est passé ?

more.definition: exactly
more.etymology: From exata + -mente.

examples.text: Cinco é o número entre quatro e seis.

translations.de: Fünf ist die Zahl zwischen vier und sechs.
translations.en: Five is the number between four and six.
translations.fr: Cinq est le nombre entre quatre et six.

examples.text: O número de estrelas no céu é infinito.

translations.de: Die Zahl der Sterne am Himmel ist unendlich.
translations.en: The number of stars in the sky is infinite.
translations.fr: Le nombre d'étoiles dans le ciel est infini.

examples.text: Um, três e cinco são números ímpares.

translations.de: 1, 3 und 5 sind ungerade Zahlen.
translations.en: One, three, and five are odd numbers.
translations.fr: 1, 3 et 5 sont des nombres impairs.

examples.text: Qual é o número?

translations.de: Wie lautet die Telefonnummer?
translations.en: What's the number?
translations.fr: Quel est le numéro ?

more.definition: number (quantity); number (entity used to describe quantity); number (element of mathematical set)
idioms: concordar em gênero, número e grau
more.etymology: Inherited from Old Galician-Portuguese número, from Latin numerus.

examples.text: É muito longe pra ir caminhando?

translations.de: Ist es zu weit, um zu laufen?
translations.en: Is it too far to walk?
translations.fr: Est-ce trop loin pour marcher ?

examples.text: Avistava-se ao longe algo parecido com uma choça.

translations.de: In der Ferne war so etwas wie eine Hütte zu sehen.
translations.en: Something like a hut could be seen in the distance.
translations.fr: On apercevait au loin quelque chose qui ressemblait à une cabane.

examples.text: Minha casa fica perto do banco, porém longe da estação.

translations.de: Mein Haus liegt in der Nähe der Bank, aber weit vom Bahnhof entfernt.
translations.en: My house is near the bank, but far from the station.
translations.fr: Ma maison est près de la banque, mais loin de la gare.

examples.text: O supermercado fica perto de nossa casa, mas a igreja fica muito longe.

translations.de: Der Supermarkt ist in der Nähe unseres Hauses, aber die Kirche ist sehr weit entfernt.
translations.en: The supermarket is close to our house, but the church is very far away.
translations.fr: Le supermarché est près de chez nous, mais l'église est très loin.

more.definition: distant, faraway
more.etymology: Inherited from Old Galician-Portuguese longe, from Latin longe.

translations.de: Ist es zu weit, um zu laufen?

translations.de: Ich bin gestern Abend nicht zur Party gegangen, weil ich sehr müde war.
translations.en: I didn't go to the party last night because I was too tired.
translations.fr: Je ne suis pas allé à la fête hier soir parce que j'étais très fatigué.

examples.text: Se o poeta sair, a festa acaba.

translations.de: Wenn der Dichter geht, ist die Party vorbei.
translations.en: If the poet leaves, the party's over.
translations.fr: Si le poète s'en va, la fête est finie.

examples.text: A Páscoa é a festa anual dos cristãos, comemorativa da ressurreição de Cristo.

translations.de: Ostern ist das jährliche Fest der Christen, das an die Auferstehung Christi erinnert.
translations.en: Easter is the annual feast of Christians, commemorating the resurrection of Christ.
translations.fr: Pâques est la fête annuelle des chrétiens, commémorant la résurrection du Christ.

examples.text: O vizinho do outro lado da rua sempre dá festas.

translations.de: Der Nachbar gegenüber macht immer Partys.
translations.en: The neighbor across the street always throws parties.

more.etymology: From Old Galician-Portuguese festa, from Late Latin fēsta, from the plural of Latin fēstum.

senses.gloss: reunião de pessoas para comemorar algum evento

examples.text: As mudanças climáticas são naturais ou causadas pela ação humana?

translations.de: Ist der Klimawandel natürlich oder durch menschliches Handeln verursacht?
translations.en: Is climate change natural or caused by human action?
translations.fr: Le changement climatique est-il naturel ou causé par l’action humaine ?

examples.text: O brilho dos faróis a cegou e isso causou o acidente.

translations.de: Sie wurde durch das grelle Licht der Scheinwerfer geblendet, was den Unfall verursachte.
translations.en: The glare from the headlights blinded her and this caused the accident.
translations.fr: L'éblouissement des phares l'a aveuglée et c'est ce qui a provoqué l'accident.

examples.text: A causa mortis não foi revelada.

translations.en: DNA is extracted from a blood sample.
translations.fr: L'ADN est extrait à partir d'un échantillon de sang.

more.definition: blood (vital liquid flowing in human and animal bodies); blood (family relationship due to birth, e.g. between siblings)
more.etymology: From Old Galician-Portuguese sangue, sangui, from Latin sanguinem m, from older sanguen, from *san-, from Proto-Indo-European *h₁sh₂-én-, oblique stem of *h₁ésh₂r̥ (“blood”). Compare Galician sangue m, Spanish sangre f, Italian sangue m, French sang m.

senses.gloss: líquido vermelho que circula pelos vasos sanguíneos; é constituído de plasma e células (hemácias, leucócitos e plaquetas); suas principais funções são transportar o oxigênio dos pulmões para as células do organismo e remover o dióxido de carbono dos tecidos de volta para os pulmões

examples.text: Ele mora numa maçã.

translations.de: Er lebt in einem Apfel.
translations.en: He lives inside an apple.
translations.fr: Il vit dans une pomme.

examples.text: Ela nasceu numa terça-feira de março e se chama Márcia.

translations.de: Sie wurde an einem Dienstag im März geboren und heißt Marcia.
translations.en: She was born on a Tuesday in March, and her name is Marcia.
translations.fr: Elle est née un mardi de mars et elle s'appelle Marcia.

examples.text: A ideia numa me passou pela cabeça.

translations.de: Die Idee ist mir nie in den Sinn gekommen.
translations.en: The idea never came into my head.
translations.fr: Cette idée ne m'est jamais passée par la tête.

examples.text: Meu sonho era morar, depois de aposentado, numa casinha pequenina à beira-mar.

translations.de: Mein Traum war es, nach meiner Pensionierung in einem winzigen Häuschen am Meer zu leben.
translations.en: My dream was to live, after retiring, in a tiny little house by the sea.
translations.fr: Mon rêve était de vivre, après ma retraite, dans une toute petite maison au bord de la mer.

more.definition: contraction of em + uma, literally “in a (feminine)”: feminine singular of num

examples.text: Ele não faz idéia do que está acontecendo.

translations.en: He has no idea what is going on.
translations.fr: Il n'a aucune idée de ce qui se passe.

examples.text: Essa foi minha idéia.

translations.de: Das ist auf meinem Mist gewachsen.
translations.en: This was my idea.

examples.text: Ela está interessada em aprender novas idéias.

translations.en: She is interested in learning new ideas.

examples.text: Tom voltou com algumas idéias boas.

translations.en: Tom came up with a few good ideas.

more.definition: pre-reform spelling (used until 1990) of ideia; may still occur as a sporadic misspelling

examples.text: Tu podes confiar nele.

translations.de: Du kannst ihm vertrauen.
translations.en: You can trust him.
translations.fr: Tu peux lui faire confiance.

examples.text: Tenho um amigo em que todos confiam.

translations.de: Ich habe einen Freund, dem jeder vertraut.
translations.en: I have a friend everybody trusts.
translations.fr: J'ai un ami en qui tout le monde à confiance.

examples.text: Não podemos confiar no que ela diz.

translations.de: Wir können uns nicht darauf verlassen, was sie sagt.
translations.en: We can't trust what she says.
translations.fr: Nous ne pouvons nous fier à ce qu'elle dit.

examples.text: Não confies demais em teu amigo.

translations.de: Vertraue deinem Freund nicht zu sehr.
translations.en: Don't trust your friend too much.
translations.fr: Ne fais pas trop confiance à ton ami.

more.definition: to confide, entrust; to rely on, trust
more.etymology: Inherited from Old Galician-Portuguese confiar, from Vulgar Latin *cōnfīdāre, from cōnfīdere.

examples.text: Mary é a irmã gêmea do Tom.

translations.de: Maria ist Toms Zwillingsschwester.
translations.en: Mary is Tom's twin sister.
translations.fr: Mary est la jumelle de Tom.

examples.text: As irmãs são bem parecidas.

translations.de: Schwestern sind sich sehr ähnlich.
translations.en: The sisters are quite alike.
translations.fr: Les sœurs se ressemblent bien.

examples.text: Este dicionário pertence à minha irmã.

translations.de: Dieses Wörterbuch gehört meiner Schwester.
translations.en: This dictionary is my sister's.
translations.fr: Ce dictionnaire appartient à ma sœur.

examples.text: Minha irmã é menor que você.

translations.de: Meine Schwester ist kleiner als du.
translations.en: My sister is shorter than you.
translations.fr: Ma sœur est plus petite que toi.

more.definition: sister
more.etymology: Inherited from Old Galician-Portuguese irmãa, yrmãa, from Latin germāna (“sister”), from the adjective germānus (“of siblings”); more at irmão. By surface analysis, irmão + -a (forms feminine equivalents).

senses.gloss: aquela que em relação a outrem, possui os dois pais (o mesmo pai e a mesma mãe ao mesmo tempo) em comum

examples.text: O caçador atira em veados e lebres.

translations.de: Der Jäger schießt Hirsche und Hasen.
translations.en: The hunter shoots stags and hares.

examples.text: Não atire antes que eu mande!

translations.en: Don't shoot before my order!
translations.fr: Ne tirez pas avant mon ordre !

examples.text: Ele atirou em seu joelho.

translations.en: He shot him in the knee.
translations.fr: Il lui a tiré dans le genou.

examples.text: O homem de repente começou a atirar com sua arma.

translations.en: The man suddenly started shooting his gun.
translations.fr: Tout à coup, l'homme a commencé à tirer avec son arme.

more.definition: to throw; to fire (shoot a gun)
more.etymology: From a- + tiro + -ar.

senses.gloss: lançar um projétil contra um alvo ou pessoa

examples.text: Você encontrou a diferença entre estas duas fotos?

translations.de: Hast du den Unterschied zwischen diesen zwei Fotos entdeckt?

translations.fr: Tu as découvert la différence entre ces deux photos ?

translations.de: Auf diesem Foto, ich erinnere mich, war mein Enkelsohn gerade einmal fünf Jahre alt.
translations.en: In this photo, I remember my grandson was only five years old.
translations.fr: Sur cette photo, je me souviens que mon petit-fils n'avait que cinq ans.

examples.text: Vou te mostrar algumas fotos.

translations.de: Ich werde euch ein paar Bilder zeigen.
translations.en: I will show you some pictures.
translations.fr: Je vous montrerai quelques photos.

examples.text: É permitido tirar fotos aqui?

translations.de: Ist es hier erlaubt, zu fotografieren?
translations.en: Are we allowed to take pictures here?
translations.fr: Est-il permis de prendre des photos ici ?

more.definition: photo; photograph
more.etymology: French photographiebor. Portuguese fotografiaclip. Clipping of fotografia.

examples.text: Este navio precisa de um novo capitão.

translations.de: Dieses Schiff braucht einen neuen Kapitän.
translations.en: This ship needs a new captain.

examples.text: Escolheram Pierre como capitão.

translations.en: They chose Peter as captain.
translations.fr: Ils ont choisi Pierre comme capitaine.

examples.text: Eu sou a capitã deste navio.

translations.en: I'm the captain of this ship.

examples.text: Do nada, o capitão abandonou o navio.

translations.en: Suddenly, the captain abandoned the ship.

more.definition: captain (army officer rank); captain; A term of address for someone
more.etymology: From Old Galician-Portuguese capitan, capitam, from Genoese Ligurian capitan, from Late Latin capitānus, from capitāneus, or from Latin capitālis.

examples.text: Meu francês é muito ruim.

translations.de: Mein Französisch ist Mist.
translations.en: My French is really bad.
translations.fr: Mon français est merdique.

examples.text: Com ferramentas ruins o operário trabalha pior.

translations.de: Mit schlechtem Werkzeug leistet der Arbeiter schlechtere Arbeit.
translations.en: With poor tools, workers perform worse.
translations.fr: Avec de mauvais outils, le travailleur est moins performant.

examples.text: A ideia de ir ao cinema era maravilhosa, mas o filme foi péssimo.

translations.de: Die Idee, ins Kino zu gehen, war wunderbar, aber der Film war miserabel.
translations.en: The idea of going to the movies was wonderful, but the movie was terrible.
translations.fr: L'idée d'aller au cinéma était géniale, mais le film, lui, était nul.

examples.text: Este lugar não é tão ruim.

translations.en: This place isn't so bad.
translations.fr: Cette place n'est pas si mal.

more.definition: bad; unpleasant; evil
more.etymology: Proto-Indo-European *h₃rew-der. Inherited from Old Galician-Portuguese roin, ultimately from Latin ruīna or a word from the same root. Compare Galician ruín, Spanish ruin, Catalan roí, French ruine.

examples.text: Não tenho dinheiro suficiente para viajar.

translations.de: Ich habe nicht genügend Geld für eine Reise.
translations.en: I don't have enough money to travel.
translations.fr: Je n'ai pas assez d'argent pour voyager.

translations.fr: Tom n'avait pas assez d'argent.

translations.de: Ein Bein genügt nicht zum Laufen.
translations.en: One leg is not enough for running.

more.definition: sufficient; enough
more.etymology: Learned borrowing from Latin sufficientem, present participle of sufficiō.

examples.text: Muitos consideram o Latim uma língua morta.

translations.de: Viele halten Latein für eine tote Sprache.
translations.en: Many consider Latin a dead language.
translations.fr: Beaucoup considèrent le latin comme une langue morte.

examples.text: Eu o vi enterrando o gato morto no quintal.

translations.de: Ich sah, wie er die tote Katze im Hof vergrub.
translations.en: I saw him burying the dead cat in the yard.
translations.fr: Je l'ai vu enterrer le chat mort dans le jardin.

examples.text: O cachorro está morto.

translations.de: Der Hund ist tot.
translations.en: The dog is dead.
translations.fr: Le chien est mort.

examples.text: Este homem está morto.

translations.de: Dieser Mensch ist tot.
translations.en: That man is dead.
translations.fr: Cet homme est mort.

more.definition: dead (no longer living); dead (completely inactive); exhausted (extremely tired)
more.etymology: From Old Galician-Portuguese morto, from Vulgar Latin *mortu(s), from Latin mortuus, perfect active participle of morior (“to die”). Corresponds to Proto-Indo-European *mr̥twós, *mr̥tós (“dead, mortal”), *mr̥tó-, ultimately from *mer- (“to die”). Compare Galician morto and Spanish muerto.

examples.text: Ela está morta.

translations.de: Sie ist tot.
translations.en: She is dead.
translations.fr: Elle est morte.

examples.text: Se arrependimento matasse, eu estaria morto.

translations.de: Wenn Reue töten würde, wäre ich tot.
translations.en: If regret killed, I would be dead.
translations.fr: Si le regret tuait, je serais mort.

examples.text: Muitos consideram o Latim uma língua morta.

translations.de: Viele halten Latein für eine tote Sprache.
translations.en: Many consider Latin a dead language.
translations.fr: Beaucoup considèrent le latin comme une langue morte.

examples.text: Como é que a língua latina está morta se eu a estou falando?

translations.de: Wie kann Latein eine tote Sprache sein, wenn ich es doch spreche?
translations.en: How can Latin be dead if I'm speaking it?
translations.fr: Comment le latin peut-il être une langue morte si je le parle ?

more.definition: deceased; corpse (the body of a dead person); a number of cards set apart that can be picked up by the first player to play all his cards
more.etymology: From Old Galician-Portuguese morto, from Vulgar Latin *mortu(s), from Latin mortuus, perfect active participle of morior (“to die”). Corresponds to Proto-Indo-European *mr̥twós, *mr̥tós (“dead, mortal”), *mr̥tó-, ultimately from *mer- (“to die”). Compare Galician morto and Spanish muerto.

senses.gloss: diz-se do que não é nem duro nem difícil de se realizar, daquilo que não exige muito trabalho ou esforço

examples.text: O leite nos deixa fortes.

translations.en: How many wishes did the genie promise to fulfill?

translations.fr: Les gens ne tiennent pas toujours leurs promesses.
