translations.de: Er ist nicht so dumm, diese Geschichte zu glauben.
translations.en: He is not such a fool as to believe that story.
translations.fr: Il n'est pas stupide au point de croire à cette histoire.

examples.text: Eu compartilho de seu ponto de vista.

translations.de: Ich teile Ihren Standpunkt.
translations.en: We think alike.
translations.fr: Je partage votre point de vue.

more.definition: point, a specific spot, location, or place; point, a unit of scoring; point, a topic of discussion
idioms: aí é que bate o ponto
more.etymology: From Old Galician-Portuguese ponto, from Latin punctum (“point”), from pungō (“to prick, to puncture, to punch”). Cognate with Spanish punto. Doublet of point.

senses.gloss: entidade geométrica cuja característica é a adimensionalidade; sua única propriedade é a posição

examples.text: Fugindo do inverno, as andorinhas vão em busca da primavera.

translations.de: Schwalben entfliehen dem Winter und machen sich auf die Suche nach dem Frühling.
translations.en: Fleeing winter, the swallows go in search of spring.
translations.fr: Fuyant l’hiver, les hirondelles partent à la recherche du printemps.

examples.text: O criminoso tentou fugir correndo, mas foi preso pela polícia.

translations.de: Der Täter versuchte, zu Fuß zu fliehen, wurde jedoch von der Polizei festgenommen.
translations.en: The criminal tried to run away, but was arrested by the police.
translations.fr: Le malfaiteur a tenté de s'enfuir en courant, mais il a été arrêté par la police.

examples.text: Minha gata Zizi fugiu de casa. Você a viu por aí?

translations.de: Meine Katze Zizi ist von zu Hause weggelaufen. Haben Sie sie irgendwo gesehen?
translations.en: My cat, Zizi, ran away from home. Have you seen her around?
translations.fr: Ma chatte Zizi s'est enfuie de la maison. L'avez-vous vue dans les environs ?

examples.text: Os tigres fugiram do zoológico.

translations.en: The tigers escaped from the zoo.
translations.fr: Les tigres se sont enfuis du zoo.

more.definition: to run away; to flee (to move away from something unpleasant quickly or suddenly); to be forgotten, to escape
idioms: fugir com o rabo à seringa
more.etymology: From Old Galician-Portuguese fugir, from Vulgar Latin *fugīre, from Latin fugere, from Proto-Italic *fugiō, ultimately from Proto-Indo-European *bʰewg-. Cognate with Galician fuxir, Asturian afuxir, Catalan fugir, Italian fuggire, French fuir, Spanish huir.

examples.text: Eu decidi sair do Japão.

translations.de: Ich habe mich dazu entschlossen Japan zu verlassen.
translations.en: I have made up my mind to leave Japan.
translations.fr: Je me suis décidé à quitter le Japon.

examples.text: Você decidiu ir ao Japão?

translations.de: Hast du beschlossen, nach Japan zu gehen?
translations.en: Did you decide to go to Japan?
translations.fr: As-tu décidé d'aller au Japon ?

examples.text: Eu decidi aprender Turco.

translations.de: Ich beschloss, Türkisch zu lernen.
translations.en: I decided to learn Turkish.
translations.fr: J'ai décidé d'apprendre le turc.

examples.text: Nada foi decidido ainda.

translations.de: Noch ist nichts entschieden.
translations.en: Nothing has been decided yet.
translations.fr: Rien n'est encore décidé.

more.definition: to decide; to determine; to resolve
more.etymology: Borrowed from Latin dēcīdere, with change of conjugation.

examples.text: Ele está com as pernas e os pés muito inchados.

translations.de: Seine Beine und Füße sind stark geschwollen.
translations.en: His legs and feet are very swollen.
translations.fr: Ses jambes et ses pieds sont très enflés.

examples.text: Fui a pé.

translations.de: Ich ging zu Fuß.
translations.en: I walked.
translations.fr: J'ai marché.

examples.text: O medo dá asas aos pés.

translations.de: Angst verleiht den Füßen Flügel.
translations.en: Fear gives wings to the feet.
translations.fr: La peur donne des ailes aux pieds.

examples.text: O que tem pés, mas não anda?

translations.en: What has a foot, but cannot walk?
translations.fr: Qu'est-ce qui a des pieds, mais qui ne marche pas ?

more.definition: foot, part of the human body; foot, part of the body of some terrestrial animals; foot (lower part of a slope)
more.etymology: Inherited from Old Galician-Portuguese pee, from Latin pedem. Cognate with Galician pé, Asturian and Spanish pie, and Catalan peu

senses.gloss: extremidade dos membros inferiores do corpo humano, responsável pelo equilíbrio

examples.text: O homem vendeu sua alma ao diabo.

translations.de: Der Mann verkaufte dem Teufel seine Seele.
translations.en: The man sold his soul to the devil.

examples.text: Cabeça vazia é oficina do diabo.

translations.de: Ein leerer Kopf ist eine Werkstatt des Teufels.
translations.en: An empty head is the devil's workshop.

examples.text: Onde diabo você exatamente esteve, Maria?

translations.en: Just where the hell have you been, Mary?
translations.fr: Où diable étiez-vous exactement, Marie?

examples.text: Quanto mais o diabo tem, mais ele quer.

translations.de: Je mehr der Teufel hat, je mehr will er haben.
translations.en: The more the devil has, the more he wants.

more.definition: Expresses anger, irritation or disappointment; damn!
more.etymology: Inherited from Old Galician-Portuguese diaboo, displacing the collateral forms diabre, diabro and diablo, from Ecclesiastical Latin, Late Latin diabolus (“devil”) (probably borrowed as a semi-learned term), itself from Ancient Greek διάβολος (diábolos, “slanderer”). Doublet of diabolô and diábolo.

examples.text: Uma mente vazia, é oficina do diabo.

translations.en: An empty mind is the devil's workshop.
translations.fr: Un esprit vide est l'atelier du diable.

examples.text: Que diabos isso tem a ver comigo?

translations.en: What on earth does this have to do with me?
translations.fr: Qu'est-ce que ça a à faire avec moi le moins du monde ?

examples.text: Ele venderia a sua alma ao diabo.

translations.en: He would sell his soul to the devil.
translations.fr: Il vendrait son âme au diable.

examples.text: Esse homem vendeu sua alma ao diabo.

translations.en: That man sold his soul to the devil.
translations.fr: Cet homme a vendu son âme au diable.

more.definition: devil; demon; fiend (creature from Hell); used to emphasise the extent of an action, usually one of a negative nature; evil or perverse person
idioms: comer o pão que o diabo amassou
estar com o diabo no corpo
more.etymology: Inherited from Old Galician-Portuguese diaboo, displacing the collateral forms diabre, diabro and diablo, from Ecclesiastical Latin, Late Latin diabolus (“devil”) (probably borrowed as a semi-learned term), itself from Ancient Greek διάβολος (diábolos, “slanderer”). Doublet of diabolô and diábolo.

senses.gloss: espírito maligno; representação mental, normalmente de uma figura grotesca semelhante a um humano mas com cornos e cauda que representa o espírito do mal, portanto tudo o que se oponha ao bem

more.definition: singing; song (the act of using the voice to produce musical sounds; vocalizing)
more.etymology: Proto-Indo-European *-h₂tiinflu. Inherited from Old Galician-Portuguese cantar, from Latin cantāre.

examples.text: Eles estavam cantando na chuva.

translations.de: Sie sangen im Regen.
translations.en: They were singing in the rain.
translations.fr: Ils chantaient sous la pluie.

examples.text: Duas mulheres cantam.

translations.de: Zwei Frauen singen.
translations.en: Two women are singing.
translations.fr: Deux femmes chantent.

examples.text: Que desumanidade! Furaram os olhos do passarinho para que ele cantasse melhor!

translations.de: Wie unmenschlich! Sie haben dem Vogel die Augen ausgestochen, damit er besser singt!
translations.en: How inhumane! They gouged out the bird's eyes so it would sing better!
translations.fr: Quelle cruauté ! Ils ont crevé les yeux de l'oiseau pour qu'il chante mieux !

examples.text: Novos sonhos fizeste-me sonhar. Minha alma canta o gosto de viver.

translations.de: Neue Träume hast du mich träumen lassen. Meine Seele singt den Geschmack des Lebens.
translations.en: New dreams you made me dream. My soul sings the taste of living.
translations.fr: De nouveaux rêves tu m'as fait rêver. Mon âme chante le goût de vivre.

more.definition: to sing (express sounds musically through the voice); to sing, to say musically; to say with rhythm, chant
more.etymology: Proto-Indo-European *-h₂tiinflu. Inherited from Old Galician-Portuguese cantar, from Latin cantāre.

senses.gloss: emitir sons vocálicos formando uma sequência melodiosa

examples.text: Ela é a menina mais bonita.

translations.de: Sie ist das schönste Mädchen.
translations.en: She's the most beautiful girl.
translations.fr: Elle est la plus belle fille.

examples.text: O menino beijou a menina.

translations.de: Der Junge küsste das Mädchen.
translations.en: The boy kissed the girl.
translations.fr: Le garçon embrassa la fille.

examples.text: Ambas as meninas têm olhos azuis.

translations.de: Beide Mädchen haben blaue Augen.
translations.en: Both girls have blue eyes.
translations.fr: Les deux filles ont les yeux bleus.

examples.text: A menina é bonita.

translations.de: Das Mädchen ist schön.
translations.en: The girl is pretty.
translations.fr: La fille est jolie.

more.definition: girl (female child); young lady, miss (a title of respect for an unmarried young woman); an effeminate boy
more.etymology: From Old Galician-Portuguese meninha, from meninho.

examples.text: Caminhamos depois do jantar.

translations.de: Wir gehen nach dem Abendessen.
translations.en: We walk after dinner.
translations.fr: Nous marchons après le dîner.

examples.text: No café da manhã, no almoço e no jantar ele sempre come pão.

translations.de: Er isst immer Brot zum Frühstück, Mittag- und Abendessen.
translations.en: He always eats bread for breakfast, lunch, and dinner.
translations.fr: Il mange toujours du pain au petit-déjeuner, au déjeuner et au dîner.

examples.text: O jantar estará pronto em breve.

translations.de: Das Abendessen ist bald fertig.
translations.en: Dinner will be ready soon.
translations.fr: Le dîner sera bientôt prêt.

more.definition: dinner (evening meal)
more.etymology: From Old Galician-Portuguese jantar, jentar (“lunch, to have lunch”), from Vulgar Latin to eat lunch, from Latin ientāre (“to breakfast”). See iēntāculum (“the first meal of the day”).

senses.gloss: refeição que se come no final do dia ou início da noite

examples.text: Eu gostaria de convidar você para jantar.

translations.de: Ich möchte dich zum Abendessen einladen.
translations.en: I would like to invite you to dinner.
translations.fr: J'aimerais t'inviter à dîner.

more.definition: to dine
more.etymology: From Old Galician-Portuguese jantar, jentar (“lunch, to have lunch”), from Vulgar Latin to eat lunch, from Latin ientāre (“to breakfast”). See iēntāculum (“the first meal of the day”).

examples.text: Com licença, que horas são?

translations.de: Entschuldigung, wie viel Uhr ist es?
translations.en: Excuse me, what time is it?
translations.fr: Excusez-moi, quelle heure est-il ?

examples.text: Com licença, fala português?

translations.de: Entschuldigen Sie, sprechen Sie Portugiesisch?
translations.en: Excuse me, do you speak Portuguese?
translations.fr: Excusez-moi, parlez-vous portugais ?

examples.text: Com licença, o que isso significa?

translations.de: Entschuldigung, was bedeutet das?
translations.en: Sorry, what does that mean?
translations.fr: Excusez-moi, qu'est-ce que cela signifie ?

examples.text: Com licença, eu tenho uma pergunta.

translations.de: Entschuldigung, ich habe eine Frage.
translations.en: Excuse me, I have a question.
translations.fr: Excusez-moi, j'ai une question.

more.definition: clipping of com licença
more.etymology: From Old Galician-Portuguese lecença, from Latin licentia (“license; freedom; liberty”), from licēns (“allowing, permitting”), present participle of licet (“allow”).

examples.text: Com licença, que horas são?

translations.de: Entschuldigung, wie viel Uhr ist es?
translations.en: Excuse me, what time is it?
translations.fr: Excusez-moi, quelle heure est-il ?

examples.text: Com licença, fala português?

translations.de: Entschuldigen Sie, sprechen Sie Portugiesisch?
translations.en: Excuse me, do you speak Portuguese?
translations.fr: Excusez-moi, parlez-vous portugais ?

examples.text: Com licença, o que isso significa?

translations.de: Entschuldigung, was bedeutet das?
translations.en: Sorry, what does that mean?
translations.fr: Excusez-moi, qu'est-ce que cela signifie ?

examples.text: Com licença, eu tenho uma pergunta.

translations.de: Entschuldigung, ich habe eine Frage.
translations.en: Excuse me, I have a question.
translations.fr: Excusez-moi, j'ai une question.

more.definition: license; permit (legal document giving official permission to do something); authorization; permission; permission given to an employee to miss work for some time (due to ill health, for example); leave
more.etymology: From Old Galician-Portuguese lecença, from Latin licentia (“license; freedom; liberty”), from licēns (“allowing, permitting”), present participle of licet (“allow”).

examples.text: Eu fico de guarda.

translations.de: Ich halte Wache.
translations.en: I'm standing guard.
translations.fr: Je monte la garde.

examples.text: Imprima este texto e guarde-o na sua bagagem de mão.

translations.de: Drucken Sie diesen Text aus und bewahren Sie ihn in Ihrem Handgepäck auf.
translations.en: Print out this text and keep it in your carry-on luggage.
translations.fr: Imprimez ce texte et conservez-le dans votre bagage à main.

examples.text: A verdade é um segredo bem guardado.

translations.de: Die Wahrheit ist ein gut gehütetes Geheimnis.
translations.en: The truth is a well-kept secret.
translations.fr: La vérité est un secret bien gardé.

examples.text: Fico de guarda.

translations.de: Ich halte Wache.
translations.en: I stand guard.
translations.fr: Je monte la garde.

more.definition: to save, keep, retain, preserve; to protect, defend; to put away (to put something in its usual storage place)
more.etymology: Frankish *wardēnbor. Inherited from Old Galician-Portuguese guardar, from Early Medieval Latin wardāre.

examples.text: Ao comparar as traduções, aprendo as línguas.

translations.de: Durch den Vergleich von Übersetzungen lerne ich Sprachen.
translations.en: By comparing translations, I learn languages.
translations.fr: En comparant les traductions, j'apprends les langues.

examples.text: O cérebro humano foi programado biologicamente para aprender idiomas.

translations.de: Das menschliche Gehirn ist biologisch darauf programmiert, Sprachen zu lernen.
translations.en: The human brain is biologically programmed to learn languages.
translations.fr: Le cerveau humain a été biologiquement programmé pour apprendre des langues.

examples.text: Estou aprendendo uma nova língua.

translations.de: Ich lerne eine neue Sprache.
translations.en: I am learning a new language.
translations.fr: J'apprends une nouvelle langue.

examples.text: Eu aprendi francês em Paris.

translations.de: Ich habe in Paris Französisch gelernt.
translations.en: I learned French in Paris.
translations.fr: J'ai appris le français à Paris.

more.definition: to learn, to acquire knowledge; to be able to learn
more.etymology: Inherited from Old Galician-Portuguese aprender, from Latin apprendere, alternative form of apprehendere. Doublet of apreender, a borrowing. Compare Galician aprender.

examples.text: Bem cedo ele deixou-se fascinar. Mais tarde percebeu quão fingida era ela.

translations.de: Schon früh war er fasziniert. Später wurde ihm klar, wie falsch sie war.
translations.en: Very early on he became fascinated. Later he realized how fake she was.
translations.fr: Très tôt, il est fasciné. Plus tard, il réalisa à quel point elle était fausse.

examples.text: Percebo agora que aquele livro, que me parecia tão bom, provavelmente contém erros.

translations.de: Ich weiß jetzt, dass das Buch, das mir so gut erschien, wahrscheinlich Fehler enthält.
translations.en: I realize now that that book, which seemed so good to me, probably contains errors.
translations.fr: Je réalise maintenant que ce livre, qui me semblait si bon, contient probablement des erreurs.

examples.text: Então, percebi que havia algo mais no horizonte.

translations.de: Dann wurde mir klar, dass da noch etwas anderes am Horizont lauerte.
translations.en: Now I felt there was more in the offing.
translations.fr: Je sentais maintenant qu'il y avait autre chose en perspective.

examples.text: De repente, percebo que ainda tenho tanto que aprender!

translations.de: Plötzlich wird mir klar, dass ich noch so viel zu lernen habe!
translations.en: Suddenly, I realize that I still have so much to learn!
translations.fr: Soudain, je réalise que j’ai encore tant à apprendre !

more.definition: to understand; to realize, to notice; to perceive
more.etymology: Proto-Indo-European *per-der. Inherited from Old Galician-Portuguese perceber, from Latin percipere.

examples.text: É prazeroso estudar interlíngua novamente.

translations.de: Es ist mir ein Vergnügen, Interlingua wieder zu studieren.
translations.en: It's a pleasure to study Interlingua again.
translations.fr: C'est un plaisir d'étudier à nouveau l'Interlingua.

examples.text: Isso não é novo. Está acontecendo novamente.

translations.de: Das ist nichts Neues. Es passiert schon wieder.
translations.en: This is nothing new. It's happening again.
translations.fr: Ce n'est pas nouveau. Cela se reproduit.

examples.text: Liguei hoje várias vezes para você, mas você não atendeu. Ligarei novamente amanhã.

translations.de: Ich habe dich heute mehrmals angerufen, aber du hast nicht abgenommen. Ich rufe morgen noch einmal an.
translations.en: I called you several times today, but you didn’t answer. I’ll call again tomorrow.
translations.fr: Je t'ai appelé plusieurs fois aujourd'hui, mais tu n'as pas répondu. Je rappellerai demain.

examples.text: Por Interlíngua novamente apaixonado, prometo nunca mais abandoná-la.

translations.de: Da ich mich wieder in Interlingua verliebt habe, verspreche ich, sie nie wieder zu verlassen.
translations.en: Having fallen in love with Interlingua again, I promise I'll never abandon it.
translations.fr: Étant retombé amoureux d'Interlingua, je promets de ne jamais l'abandonner.

more.definition: again (having already happened before)
more.etymology: From nova + -mente.

senses.gloss: indica repetição de um ato ocorrido anteriormente

examples.text: Deixarei filhos, netos e bisnetos, além das pobres frases que escrevi.

translations.de: Ich werde Kinder, Enkel und Urenkel hinterlassen, zusätzlich zu den armseligen Sätzen, die ich geschrieben habe.
translations.en: I will leave children, grandchildren, and great-grandchildren, besides the poor sentences I have written.
translations.fr: Je laisserai des enfants, petits-enfants et arrière-petits-enfants, en plus des pauvres phrases que j'ai écrites.

examples.text: Ele é um espírito de luz e há de brilhar no Além.

translations.de: Er ist ein Lichtgeist und wird im Jenseits leuchten.
translations.en: He is a spirit of light and will shine in the afterlife.
translations.fr: Il est un esprit de lumière et brillera dans l'au-delà.

examples.text: Quem quer passar além do Bojador tem que passar além da dor.

translations.de: Wer über Bojador hinaus will, muss über den Schmerz hinausgehen.
translations.en: Whoever wants to go beyond Bojador has to go beyond pain.
translations.fr: Celui qui veut aller au-delà de Bojador doit aller au-delà de la douleur.

examples.text: Ele não come nada além de frutas.

translations.en: He eats nothing other than fruit.
translations.fr: Il ne mange rien que des fruits.

more.definition: there, over there; beyond (farther along or away)
more.etymology: Inherited from Old Galician-Portuguese alen, from Latin ad + illinc (“thence, there”).

examples.text: Deixarei filhos, netos e bisnetos, além das pobres frases que escrevi.

translations.de: Ich werde Kinder, Enkel und Urenkel hinterlassen, zusätzlich zu den armseligen Sätzen, die ich geschrieben habe.
translations.en: I will leave children, grandchildren, and great-grandchildren, besides the poor sentences I have written.
translations.fr: Je laisserai des enfants, petits-enfants et arrière-petits-enfants, en plus des pauvres phrases que j'ai écrites.

examples.text: Ele é um espírito de luz e há de brilhar no Além.

translations.de: Er ist ein Lichtgeist und wird im Jenseits leuchten.
translations.en: He is a spirit of light and will shine in the afterlife.
translations.fr: Il est un esprit de lumière et brillera dans l'au-delà.

examples.text: Quem quer passar além do Bojador tem que passar além da dor.

translations.de: Wer über Bojador hinaus will, muss über den Schmerz hinausgehen.
translations.en: Whoever wants to go beyond Bojador has to go beyond pain.
translations.fr: Celui qui veut aller au-delà de Bojador doit aller au-delà de la douleur.

examples.text: Estava frio e, além disso, estava ventando.

translations.en: It was cold, and in addition, it was windy.
translations.fr: Il faisait froid, et en plus, il y avait du vent.

more.definition: the afterlife, the beyond (supposed world or state of existence that is entered after death)
more.etymology: Inherited from Old Galician-Portuguese alen, from Latin ad + illinc (“thence, there”).

examples.text: De dia, eu trabalho. À noite, divirto-me e descanso.

translations.de: Tagsüber arbeite ich. Nachts habe ich Spaß und ruhe mich aus.
translations.en: During the day, I work. At night, I have fun and rest.
translations.fr: La journée, je travaille. La nuit, je m'amuse et je me repose.

examples.text: Aprender é divertido.

translations.de: Lernen macht Spaß.
translations.en: Learning is fun.
translations.fr: Apprendre, c'est amusant.

examples.text: Eu estou me divertindo muito no Canadá.

translations.en: I'm having a great time in Canada.
translations.fr: Je m'amuse bien au Canada.

examples.text: Você se divertiu ontem à noite?

translations.en: Did you have fun last night?
translations.fr: Est-ce que tu t'es amusé hier soir ?

more.definition: to distract (divert the attention of); to entertain, amuse; to dissuade (convince not to try or do)
more.etymology: Borrowed from Latin dīvertere (“to divert”), with change of conjugation.

examples.text: A música é um dom de Deus.

translations.de: Die Musik ist eine Gabe Gottes.
translations.en: Music is a gift from God.
translations.fr: La musique est un don de Dieu.

examples.text: Eu gosto da música dele.

translations.de: Ich mag seine Musik.
translations.en: I like his music.
translations.fr: J'aime sa musique.

examples.text: Betty gosta de música clássica.

translations.de: Betty mag klassische Musik.
translations.en: Betty likes classical music.
translations.fr: Betty aime la musique classique.

examples.text: A chuva é a música de um poema de Verlaine.

translations.de: Der Regen ist die Musik eines Gedichts von Verlaine.
translations.en: Rain is the music of a poem by Verlaine.
translations.fr: La pluie est la musique d'un poème de Verlaine.

more.definition: music (melodic and rhythmic sounds made as art); song (any musical composition); music; musicology (the study of music)
more.etymology: Ancient Greek μουσική (mousikḗ)bor. Latin mūsicalbor. Learned borrowing from Latin mūsica, borrowed from Ancient Greek μουσική (mousikḗ, “of a Muse”), derived from Μοῦσα (Moûsa, “Muse”). By surface analysis, musa + -ica.

senses.gloss: arte que consiste em combinar sons de forma harmoniosa

examples.text: Eu sou a luz, o caminho e a vida.

translations.de: Ich bin das Licht, der Weg und das Leben.
translations.en: I am the light, the way, and the life.
translations.fr: Je suis la lumière, le chemin et la vie.

examples.text: Há muitas maneiras de conseguir isso. Todos os caminhos levam a Roma.

translations.de: Es gibt viele Möglichkeiten, dies zu erreichen. Alle Wege führen nach Rom.
translations.en: There are many ways to achieve this. All roads lead to Rome.
translations.fr: Il existe de nombreuses façons d'y parvenir. Tous les chemins mènent à Rome.

examples.text: Não existe um caminho para a felicidade, a felicidade é o caminho.

translations.de: Kein Weg führt zum Glück, denn Glücklichsein ist der Weg.
translations.en: A path to happiness doesn't exist. Happiness is the path.
translations.fr: Il n'existe pas de chemin vers le bonheur. Le bonheur est le chemin.

examples.text: Para ser justo, vai pelo caminho reto.

translations.de: Um fair zu sein, nehmen Sie den geraden Weg.
translations.en: To be fair, take the straight path.
translations.fr: Pour être juste, prenez le droit chemin.

more.definition: path; way, route; means

examples.text: A guerra é o inferno.

examples.text: Eu sei perfeitamente que isso não foi culpa sua.

translations.fr: Ce n'est pas ma faute !

examples.text: Um outro mundo é possível.

translations.en: I will open all the doors but close the windows.
translations.fr: J'ouvrirai toutes les portes, mais je fermerai les fenêtres.

more.definition: to close; to conclude (an agreement); to complete (all levels of a video game)
more.etymology: Inherited from Old Galician-Portuguese fechar (13th century, Cantigas de Santa Maria), from Vulgar Latin pesclum, from Latin pessulus (“bolt”). Probably a southern Portuguese variant, with the change of /p/ to /f/ reflecting Arabic influence. By surface analysis, fecho + -ar.

senses.gloss: cerrar com chave, aldraba, tranca ou outro meio; encerrar; rematar

examples.text: Percebo agora que aquele livro, que me parecia tão bom, provavelmente contém erros.

translations.de: Ich weiß jetzt, dass das Buch, das mir so gut erschien, wahrscheinlich Fehler enthält.
translations.en: I realize now that that book, which seemed so good to me, probably contains errors.
translations.fr: Je réalise maintenant que ce livre, qui me semblait si bon, contient probablement des erreurs.

examples.text: Eu provavelmente não lerei o relatório de Tom.

translations.en: I probably won't read Tom's report.
translations.fr: Je ne lirai probablement pas le rapport de Tom.

examples.text: Vocês provavelmente nunca mais serão capazes de andar novamente.

translations.en: You may never be able to walk again.
translations.fr: Vous ne serez peut-être plus jamais en mesure de marcher à nouveau.

examples.text: Tom provavelmente pegou um táxi.

translations.de: Tom hat wahrscheinlich ein Taxi genommen.
translations.en: Tom probably took a taxi.

more.definition: probably
more.etymology: From provável + -mente.

senses.gloss: quase certo; com grande probabilidade de acontecer

examples.text: Para alguém de oitenta anos, o sexo é sem prazer?

translations.de: Ist Sex für eine achtzigjährige Person ohne Vergnügen?
translations.en: For someone who is eighty years old, is sex without pleasure?
translations.fr: Pour une personne de quatre-vingts ans, le sexe est-il sans plaisir ?

examples.text: Prazer em conhecê-la.

translations.de: Nett dich kennenzulernen.
translations.en: Pleased to meet you.
translations.fr: Ravi de faire ta connaissance.

examples.text: Prazer em te conhecer.

translations.de: Schön, dich kennenzulernen!
translations.en: Pleased to meet you.
translations.fr: Ravi d'apprendre à te connaître.

examples.text: Foi um prazer conversar com você!

translations.de: Es war schön, mit Ihnen zu sprechen!
translations.en: It was nice talking to you!
translations.fr: C'était un plaisir de vous parler !

more.definition: pleased to meet you!
more.etymology: Inherited from Old Galician-Portuguese prazer, a semi-learned borrowing from Latin placēre. Compare Spanish placer and Galician pracer. (interjection): Ellipsis of phrases such as é um prazer conhecê-lo/la (“it’s a pleasure to meet you”).

examples.text: Prazer em conhecê-la.

translations.de: Nett dich kennenzulernen.
translations.en: Pleased to meet you.
translations.fr: Ravi de faire ta connaissance.

examples.text: Prazer em te conhecer.

translations.de: Schön, dich kennenzulernen!
translations.en: Pleased to meet you.
translations.fr: Ravi d'apprendre à te connaître.

examples.text: Foi um prazer conversar com você!

translations.de: Es war schön, mit Ihnen zu sprechen!
translations.en: It was nice talking to you!
translations.fr: C'était un plaisir de vous parler !

examples.text: Tudo é loucura neste mundo, exceto o prazer.

translations.de: Alles ist Wahnsinn in dieser Welt, außer dem Vergnügen.
translations.en: Everything is madness in this world, except pleasure.
translations.fr: Tout est folie dans ce monde sauf le plaisir.

more.definition: pleasure
more.etymology: Inherited from Old Galician-Portuguese prazer, a semi-learned borrowing from Latin placēre. Compare Spanish placer and Galician pracer. (interjection): Ellipsis of phrases such as é um prazer conhecê-lo/la (“it’s a pleasure to meet you”).

examples.text: No princípio Deus criou os céus e a terra.

translations.de: Im Anfang schuf Gott Himmel und Erde.
translations.en: In the beginning God created Heaven and Earth.
translations.fr: Au commencement, Dieu créa le ciel et la terre.

examples.text: Deus criou a mulher para infernizar a vida do homem.

translations.de: Gott schuf die Frau, um dem Mann das Leben zur Hölle zu machen.
translations.en: God created woman to turn man's life into a living hell.
translations.fr: Dieu a créé la femme pour rendre la vie de l'homme misérable.

examples.text: O homem inteligente criou e está aperfeiçoando a Inteligência Artificial.

translations.de: Der intelligente Mensch hat die künstliche Intelligenz geschaffen und perfektioniert sie.
translations.en: Intelligent man has created and is perfecting Artificial Intelligence.
translations.fr: L’homme intelligent a créé et perfectionne l’intelligence artificielle.

examples.text: A juventude indolente cria uma velhice mendicante.

translations.de: Träge Jugend schafft ein bettelndes Alter.
translations.en: Indolent youth creates a begging old age.
translations.fr: La jeunesse indolente crée une vieillesse mendiante.

more.definition: to create, to put into existence; to invent; to raise (a child)
more.etymology: Inherited from Old Galician-Portuguese criar, from Latin creāre. False friend to Spanish criar.

examples.text: O sofá é para a sala.

translations.de: Das Sofa ist für das Wohnzimmer.
translations.en: The sofa is for the living room.
translations.fr: Le canapé est pour le salon.

examples.text: Quando ela abriu a janela, o ar frio penetrou na sala.

translations.de: Als sie das Fenster öffnete, strömte kalte Luft in den Raum.
translations.en: When she opened the window, the cold air entered the room.
translations.fr: Lorsqu'elle ouvrit la fenêtre, l'air froid entra dans la pièce.

examples.text: Sophie vai colocar as flores na mesa da sala.

translations.de: Sophie wird die Blumen auf den Wohnzimmertisch stellen.
translations.en: Sophie will put the flowers on the living room table.
translations.fr: Sophie mettra les fleurs sur la table du salon.

examples.text: A sala de estar é clara, mas achei a cozinha muito escura.

translations.de: Das Wohnzimmer ist hell, aber die Küche fand ich zu dunkel.
translations.en: The living room is bright, but I found the kitchen very dark.
translations.fr: Le salon est lumineux, mais j'ai trouvé la cuisine trop sombre.

more.definition: room (division in a building); ellipsis of sala de estar (“living room”); ellipsis of sala de aula (“classroom”)
more.etymology: Inherited from Old Galician-Portuguese sala, from a Germanic language, from Proto-Germanic *salą. Doublet of Sá.

examples.text: A astronomia trata de estrelas e planetas.

translations.de: Astronomie handelt von Sternen und Planeten.
translations.en: Astronomy deals with the stars and planets.
translations.fr: L'astronomie traite des étoiles et des planètes.

examples.text: Essa obra trata de um assunto explosivo e muitas vezes também doloroso.

translations.de: Dieses Werk behandelt ein brisantes und oft schmerzhaftes Thema.
translations.en: This work deals with an explosive and often painful subject.
translations.fr: Cet ouvrage traite d’un sujet explosif et souvent douloureux.

examples.text: Continuo sem saber do que se trata.

translations.de: Ich weiß noch immer nicht, worum es geht.
translations.en: I still don't know what it's about.
translations.fr: Je ne sais toujours pas de quoi il s'agit.

examples.text: A máscara dele caiu. Agora sabemos, realmente, de quem se trata.

translations.de: Seine Maske ist gefallen. Jetzt wissen wir wirklich, wer er ist.
translations.en: His mask has fallen. Now we really know who he is.
translations.fr: Son masque est tombé. Maintenant, nous savons vraiment qui il est.

more.definition: to treat (to handle, deal with or behave towards in a specific way); to deal with, to handle, to take care of; to treat (to apply medical care to a person)
more.etymology: Semi-learned form modified from older tractar, borrowed from Latin tractāre (“to drag; to handle; to practice”), from tractus (“dragged”), perfect passive participle of trahō (“to drag; to extract”).

senses.gloss: ocupar-se de; dedicar cuidados a; dar tratamento a; ter relações com; discorrer acerca de; ocupar-se de; manusear; alimentar; executar; combinar; obsequiar; estabelecer; pactuar; combinar; cultivar

examples.text: Atingi o total de sessenta mil frases, na língua portuguesa em Tatoeba.

translations.de: Ich habe auf Tatoeba insgesamt sechzigtausend Sätze in portugiesischer Sprache erreicht.
translations.en: I've reached a total of sixty thousand sentences in Portuguese on Tatoeba.
translations.fr: J'ai atteint un total de soixante mille phrases en langue portugaise sur Tatoeba.

examples.text: Em Elefen ele escreveu quinze mil frases.

translations.de: In Elefen schrieb er fünfzehntausend Sätze.
translations.en: In Elefen, he wrote fifteen thousand sentences.
translations.fr: En elefen, il a écrit quinze mille phrases.

examples.text: Tenho vontade de lhe dar mil beijos.

translations.de: Ich möchte ihm tausend Küsse geben.
translations.en: I want to give you a thousand kisses.
translations.fr: J'ai envie de lui faire 1000 bisous.

examples.text: Uma imagem vale mais que mil palavras.

translations.de: Ein Bild sagt mehr als tausend Worte.
translations.en: A picture is worth a thousand words.
translations.fr: Une image vaut mille mots.

more.definition: one thousand; a thousand; 1000; thousands of (very many)
more.etymology: Inherited from Old Galician-Portuguese mil, from Latin mīlle, from Proto-Italic *smīɣeslī, from Proto-Indo-European *smih₂ǵʰéslih₂ (“one thousand”).

examples.text: Ele me deu dez mil ienes.

translations.de: Er gab mir zehntausend Yen.
translations.en: He gave me 10,000 yen.
translations.fr: Il m'a donné dix mille yen.

examples.text: Dá-me mil beijos.

translations.de: Gib mir tausend Küsse.
translations.en: Give me a thousand kisses.
translations.fr: Donne-moi mille baisers.

examples.text: Ainda que escrevesse mil poemas, não faria justiça ao teu amor.

translations.de: Selbst wenn ich tausend Gedichte schreiben würde, könnte ich deiner Liebe nicht gerecht werden.
translations.en: Even if I wrote a thousand poems, it wouldn't do justice to your love.
translations.fr: Même si j'écrivais mille poèmes, cela ne rendrait pas justice à ton amour.

examples.text: O copo caiu da mesa e partiu-se em mil pedaços.

translations.de: Das Glas fiel vom Tisch und zersprang in tausend Stücke.
translations.en: The glass fell from the table and shattered into a thousand pieces.
translations.fr: Le verre est tombé de la table et s'est brisé en mille morceaux.

more.etymology: Do latim mille⁽ˡᵃ⁾.

examples.text: Não, ele não está usando tua roupa.

translations.de: Nein, er trägt nicht Ihre Kleidung.
translations.en: No, he's not wearing your clothes.
translations.fr: Non, il ne porte pas tes vêtements.

examples.text: Viajar é mudar a roupa da alma.

translations.de: Reisen bedeutet, die Kleider der Seele zu wechseln.
translations.en: Traveling is changing the clothes of the soul.
translations.fr: Voyager, c'est changer les vêtements de l'âme.

examples.text: De um tecido barato não se faz uma peça de roupa muito boa.

translations.de: Aus billigem Stoff kann man kein besonders gutes Kleidungsstück herstellen.
translations.en: You can't make a very good garment out of cheap fabric.
translations.fr: On ne peut pas faire un très bon vêtement avec un tissu bon marché.

examples.text: Ela veste-se com o mesmo tipo de roupa que a irmã dela.

translations.de: Sie trägt die gleiche Art von Kleidung wie ihre Schwester.
translations.en: She wears the same kinds of clothes as her sister.
translations.fr: Elle porte le même type de vêtement que sa sœur.

more.definition: clothing, clothes
more.etymology: Inherited from Old Galician-Portuguese roupa, from Gothic *𐍂𐌰𐌿𐍀𐌰 (*raupa), from 𐍂𐌰𐌿𐍀𐌾𐌰𐌽 (raupjan). Cognate with Spanish ropa. See also Portuguese roubar.

senses.gloss: peça de tecido usada para cobrir partes do corpo

examples.text: Em Toki Pona, a ordem dos fatores altera o produto.

translations.de: Bei Toki Pona verändert die Reihenfolge der Faktoren das Produkt.
translations.en: In Toki Pona, the order of factors changes the product.
translations.fr: Dans toki pona, l'ordre des facteurs change le produit.

examples.text: Está tudo em ordem.

translations.de: Es ist alles in Ordnung.
translations.en: Everything is OK.
translations.fr: Tout est en ordre.

examples.text: Antes de dar ordens, você deve aprender a obedecer.

translations.de: Vor dem Befehlen musst du Gehorchen lernen.
translations.en: Before you give orders, you must learn to obey.

examples.text: Seu desejo é uma ordem para mim.

translations.en: Your wish is a command for me.
translations.fr: Son désir est pour moi un ordre.

more.definition: order (arrangement, disposition); order (the state of being well arranged); order; command
more.etymology: Inherited from Old Galician-Portuguese ordin, orden, from Latin ōrdinem m.

examples.text: O calor do abraço traz conforto e segurança.

translations.de: Die Wärme einer Umarmung spendet Trost und Geborgenheit.
translations.en: The warmth of a hug brings comfort and security.
translations.fr: La chaleur d'une étreinte apporte du réconfort et de la sécurité.

examples.text: Os órgãos de segurança foram criminosamente omissos.

translations.en: The security agencies were criminously omissive.
translations.fr: Les agences de sécurité ont été criminellement négligentes.

examples.text: Eu prometo que te manterei em segurança.

translations.en: I promise you I'll keep you safe.
translations.fr: Je te promets que je te maintiendrai en sécurité.

examples.text: Eu temo pela segurança do Tom.

translations.de: Ich fürchte um Toms Sicherheit.
translations.en: I fear for Tom's safety.

more.definition: security; safety (condition of not being threatened); any object related to the safety of something or some place; a set of devices designed to help avoid surprise attacks
more.etymology: Inherited from Old Galician-Portuguese segurança. By surface analysis, segurar (“to hold; to secure”) + -ança.

examples.text: Eles apostam uma garrafa de uísque.

translations.en: They bet a bottle of whiskey.
translations.fr: Ils ont parié une bouteille de whisky.

examples.text: Aposto que ele ficou surpreso.

translations.en: I bet he was surprised.
translations.fr: Je parie qu'il a été surpris.

examples.text: Se importa em fazer uma aposta?

translations.en: Care to make a wager?

examples.text: Eu apostei tudo que eu tinha.

translations.en: I've wagered everything I own.

more.definition: to bet (to make a guess about the outcome of an event); to bet (to be quite certain of something); to invest
more.etymology: From aposta (“bet”) + -ar or from Vulgar Latin *appositāre, from Latin appositus.

examples.text: Eu quero passar tempo junto contigo.

translations.de: Ich will Zeit mit dir verbringen.
translations.en: I want to spend time with you.
translations.fr: Je veux passer du temps avec toi.

examples.text: Muitos cidadãos se juntaram ao exército.

translations.de: Viele Bürger traten der Armee bei.
translations.en: Many citizens joined the army.

examples.text: Inscreva-se para nos juntar ao Grupo de WhatsApp.

translations.en: Sign up to join us in the WhatsApp Group.
translations.fr: Inscrivez-vous pour rejoindre le groupe WhatsApp.

examples.text: Inscreva-se para se juntar ao Grupo de WhatsApp.

translations.en: Sign up to join us in the WhatsApp Group.
translations.fr: Inscrivez-vous pour rejoindre le groupe WhatsApp.

more.definition: to combine; to unite; to gather; to collect; to assemble (to gather as a group)
more.etymology: From Old Galician-Portuguese juntar, from junto (“joined, together”), from Latin iūnctus (“joined”), present passive participle of iungō, from Proto-Indo-European *yewg-.

senses.gloss: alisar com a junteira as tábuas a sobrepor

examples.text: Ela quebrou meu violão de estimação.

translations.de: Sie hat meine Lieblingsgitarre kaputt gemacht.
translations.en: She broke my favorite guitar.
translations.fr: Elle a cassé ma guitare préférée.

examples.text: Nosso vizinho quebrou uma costela.

translations.de: Unser Nachbar hat sich eine Rippe gebrochen.
translations.en: Our neighbor has broken a rib.
translations.fr: Notre voisin s'est cassé une côte.

examples.text: O rádio do Tom está quebrado.

translations.de: Toms Radio ist kaputt.
translations.en: Tom's radio is broken.
translations.fr: La radio de Tom est cassée.

examples.text: Foi o espelho que se quebrou ou foste tu que o partiste?

translations.de: Ist der Spiegel von selbst zerbrochen oder hast du ihn zerbrochen?
translations.en: Was it the mirror that broke or did you break it?
translations.fr: C'est le miroir qui s'est cassé ou c'est toi qui l'as cassé ?

more.definition: to break (end up or cause to end up in two or more pieces that cannot easily be reassembled); to fracture a bone; to break down (stop, or to cause to stop, functioning properly or altogether)
more.etymology: From Old Galician-Portuguese quebrar, itself, through metathesis, from Latin crepāre (“to crack, to creak”), from Proto-Indo-European *ḱorh₂-.

examples.text: Não há nada objetivo que possa explicar a subjetividade.

translations.de: Es gibt nichts Objektives, das Subjektivität erklären kann.
translations.en: There is nothing objective that can explain subjectivity.
translations.fr: Il n'y a rien d'objectif qui puisse expliquer la subjectivité.

examples.text: Ele me explicou a regra.

translations.de: Er erklärte mir die Regel.
translations.en: He explained the rule to me.
translations.fr: Il m'expliqua la règle.

examples.text: Resolvam o problema e expliquem como encontraram a solução.

translations.de: Löst das Problem und erklärt, wie ihr die Lösung gefunden habt.
translations.en: Solve the problem and explain how you found the solution.
translations.fr: Résolvez le problème et expliquez comment vous avez trouvé la solution.

examples.text: Eu levaria uma eternidade para explicar tudo.

translations.de: Um alles zu erklären würde ich ewig brauchen.
translations.en: It would take forever for me to explain everything.
translations.fr: Ça me prendrait l'éternité pour tout expliquer.

more.definition: to explain
more.etymology: Proto-Indo-European *pleḱ-der. Latin explicārelbor. Learned borrowing from Latin explicāre.

examples.text: Por que vocês não estão respondendo?

translations.de: Warum antworten Sie nicht?
translations.en: Why aren't you answering?
translations.fr: Pourquoi ne répondez-vous pas ?

examples.text: Não respondeu à minha pergunta.

translations.de: Er hat nicht auf meine Frage geantwortet.
translations.en: He didn't answer my question.
translations.fr: Il n'a pas répondu à ma question.

examples.text: Você me entristeceu muito ao não responder à minha mensagem.

translations.de: Du hast mich sehr traurig gemacht, indem du nicht auf meine Nachricht geantwortet hast.
translations.en: You made me very sad by not replying to my message.
translations.fr: Tu m'as beaucoup attristé en ne répondant pas à mon message.

examples.text: Por favor me perdoe por não ter respondido à sua carta.

translations.de: Verzeihen Sie mir, dass ich Ihren Brief nicht beantwortet habe.
translations.en: Please forgive me for not answering your letter.
translations.fr: Pardonnez-moi de ne pas avoir répondu à votre lettre.

more.definition: to answer; to reply (to give a written or spoken response); to retort frequently; to correspond to (to be equivalent to)
more.etymology: Inherited from Old Galician-Portuguese responder, from Latin respondēre (“answer”) (likely via Late Latin respondere), from re- & spondeō (“promise”).

examples.text: Se a tua cama falasse, o que ela diria?

translations.de: Wenn dein Bett sprechen würde, was würde es sagen?
translations.en: If your bed spoke, what would it say?
translations.fr: Si ton lit parlait, que dirait-il ?

examples.text: Você deveria ficar na cama.

translations.de: Du solltest im Bett bleiben.
translations.en: You should stay in bed.
translations.fr: Tu devrais rester au lit.

examples.text: É cedo demais para ir para a cama.

translations.de: Es ist zu früh, um ins Bett zu gehen.
translations.en: It is too early to go to bed.
translations.fr: Il est trop tôt pour aller au lit.

examples.text: Eles dormem em camas separadas.

translations.de: Sie schlafen in getrennten Betten.
translations.en: They sleep in separate beds.

more.definition: bed (furniture for sleeping on)
more.etymology: Inherited from Old Galician-Portuguese cama, from Late Latin cama, first attested in Isidore. Likely a borrowing from an Iberian substrate.

senses.gloss: móvel, normalmente plano e macio, usado para dormir

examples.text: Eu não gosto desta frase.

translations.de: Dieser Satz gefällt mir nicht.
translations.en: I don't like that sentence.
translations.fr: Je n'aime pas cette phrase.

examples.text: Eu sou o aluno mais velho desta escola de idiomas.

translations.de: Ich bin der älteste Schüler dieser Sprachschule.
translations.en: I am the oldest student at this language school.
translations.fr: Je suis l'élève le plus âgé de cette école de langues.

examples.text: Os figos desta figueira são muito doces.

translations.de: Die Feigen dieses Feigenbaums sind sehr süß.
translations.en: The figs from this fig tree are very sweet.
translations.fr: Les figues de ce figuier sont très sucrées.

examples.text: Qual é o significado desta palavra?

translations.de: Was ist die Bedeutung dieses Wortes?
translations.en: What is the meaning of this word?
translations.fr: Quelle est la signification de ce mot ?

more.definition: contraction of de + esta, literally “of/from this (feminine)”: feminine singular of deste

examples.text: Tudo está calmo.

translations.de: Alles ist ruhig.
translations.en: All is quiet.
translations.fr: Tout est calme.

examples.text: O mar, quando está calmo, espelha o céu.

translations.de: Wenn es ruhig ist, spiegelt das Meer den Himmel.
translations.en: The sea, when it is calm, mirrors the sky.
translations.fr: La mer, quand elle est calme, reflète le ciel.

examples.text: Aconteça o que aconteça, você deve permanecer calma.

translations.en: Whatever happens, you must keep calm.
translations.fr: Quoi qu'il arrive, tu dois rester calme.

examples.text: Vá com calma e melhore logo.

translations.en: Take it easy and get well.
translations.fr: Vas-y doucement et ça ira tout de suite mieux.

more.definition: calm; serene
more.etymology: From calma.

examples.text: Esperarei por tua decisão.

translations.de: Ich werde auf deine Entscheidung warten.
translations.en: I'll wait for your decision.
translations.fr: J'attendrai ta décision.

examples.text: Sou teu pai, Adolf.

translations.de: Ich bin dein Vater, Adolf.
translations.en: I'm your father, Adolf.
translations.fr: Je suis ton père, Adolf.

examples.text: Os teus beijos são qual néctar que alivia o meu penar.

translations.de: Deine Küsse sind wie Nektar, der mein Leid lindert.
translations.en: Your kisses are like nectar that soothes my suffering.
translations.fr: Tes baisers sont comme un nectar qui apaise ma souffrance.

examples.text: Sou tua mãe, Luke.

translations.de: Ich bin deine Mutter, Luke.
translations.en: I'm your mother, Luke.
translations.fr: Je suis ta mère, Luc.

more.definition: your (singular) (belonging to, associated with, related to, or in the possession of you)
more.etymology: Proto-Italic *towosder. Inherited from Old Galician-Portuguese tou, from Latin tuus, from Proto-Italic *towos.

examples.text: Este lápis vermelho é teu?

translations.de: Ist dieser rote Stift deiner?
translations.en: Is this red pencil yours?
translations.fr: Ce crayon rouge est à toi ?

examples.text: Se ele fosse teu amigo, não teria feito isso.

translations.de: Wenn er dein Freund wäre, hätte er es nicht getan.
translations.en: If he were your friend, he wouldn't have done it.
translations.fr: S'il était ton ami, il ne l'aurait pas fait.

examples.text: Qual é o teu apelido?

translations.de: Was ist dein Spitzname?
translations.en: What's your nickname?
translations.fr: Quel est ton pseudonyme ?

examples.text: Aonde quer que vás, vai com todo o teu coração.

translations.de: Wo auch immer du hingehst, geh mit ganzem Herzen.
translations.en: Wherever you go, go with all your heart.
translations.fr: Où que tu ailles, vas-y de tout ton cœur.

more.definition: hey; oi (used vocatively to draw someone’s attention); dude, mate
more.etymology: From meu (“hey, dude”), in analogy with the eu/meu and tu/teu pronominal pairs.

senses.gloss: modo, jeito como algo é feito

examples.text: Se o nível do mar continuar subindo, o que os países farão?

translations.en: Children like climbing trees.
translations.fr: Les enfants aiment grimper aux arbres.

examples.text: Socorram-me, subi no ônibus em Marrocos!

translations.en: Help me. I took the bus in Morocco.
translations.fr: À l'aide, je suis monté dans le bus au Maroc !

examples.text: Todos na classe subiram a colina.

translations.fr: Tout le monde dans la classe a grimpé la colline.

more.definition: to ascend, to go up; to climb; to upload

examples.text: Minha professora de Alemão é muito paciente.

translations.fr: Ma professeur d'allemand est très patiente.

examples.text: Meu professor está me ensinando matemática.

translations.fr: Mon professeur m'enseigne les maths.

examples.text: Será que existem professores dotados de inteligência artificial?

translations.de: Gibt es Lehrer mit künstlicher Intelligenz?
translations.en: Are there teachers endowed with artificial intelligence?
translations.fr: Existe-t-il des enseignants dotés d'intelligence artificielle ?

examples.text: A dona Smith é professora de inglês?

translations.de: Ist Frau Smith Englischlehrerin?
translations.en: Is Miss Smith an English teacher?
translations.fr: Est-ce que madame Smith est professeur d'anglais ?

more.definition: teacher (a person who teaches professionally); coach; referee
more.etymology: Proto-Indo-European *bʰeh₂-der. Latin professorlbor. Inherited from Old Galician-Portuguese professor, a learned borrowing from Latin professor, from professus + -tor.

senses.gloss: pessoa que tem por profissão ensinar

examples.text: Meu gatinho me dá muitos presentes. Que animal gracioso e inteligente!

translations.de: Mein Kätzchen macht mir so viele Geschenke. Was für ein anmutiges und intelligentes Tier!
translations.en: My kitten gives me so many gifts. What a graceful and intelligent animal!
translations.fr: Mon chaton me fait tant de cadeaux. Quel animal gracieux et intelligent !

examples.text: O presente de que ela mais gostou foi um bolo de chocolate.

translations.de: Das Geschenk, das ihr am besten gefiel, war ein Schokoladenkuchen.
translations.en: The gift she liked most was a chocolate cake.
translations.fr: Le cadeau qu'elle aimait le plus était un gâteau au chocolat.

examples.text: Todos os alunos da classe estão presentes.

translations.de: Alle Schüler der Klasse sind anwesend.

translations.fr: Tous les élèves de la classe sont présents.

translations.de: Alle Mitglieder des Kabinetts waren anwesend.
translations.en: Every member of the cabinet was present.
translations.fr: Tous les membres du cabinet étaient présents.

more.etymology: Inherited from Old Galician-Portuguese presente, from Latin praesentem.

senses.gloss: que se encontra em determinado lugar ou situação

translations.de: Ich habe vergessen, ein Geschenk zu kaufen.

translations.fr: J'ai oublié d'acheter un cadeau.

translations.de: Sie schenkte mir ein Buch zu Weihnachten.
translations.en: She gave me a book for Christmas.
translations.fr: Elle m'a offert un livre pour Noël.

translations.de: Dieses Buch, das ich zweimal gelesen habe, war ein Geschenk von Peter.
translations.en: This book, which I've read twice, was a gift from Peter.
translations.fr: Ce livre, que j'ai lu deux fois, a été un cadeau de Peter.

examples.text: O passado é lembrança, o futuro é esperança, o presente é ilusão.

more.etymology: Do latim praesens⁽ˡᵃ⁾, -entis.

examples.text: O presente que você me deu é excelente.

translations.de: Das Geschenk, das du mir gegeben hast, ist ausgezeichnet.

translations.fr: Le cadeau que tu m'as offert est génial.

more.etymology: Inherited from Old Galician-Portuguese presente, from Latin praesentem.

examples.text: Um agente disfarçado se infiltrou na organização.

translations.en: An undercover operative infiltrated the organization.

examples.text: Os agentes da polícia concluíram a inspeção.

translations.en: The police officers completed their inspection.

examples.text: O Tom é um agente imobiliário licenciado.

translations.en: Tom is a licensed real estate agent.

examples.text: Dan falhou como agente de viagens.

translations.en: Dan failed as a travel agent.

more.definition: agent (one who exerts power)
more.etymology: Learned borrowing from Latin agente. By surface analysis, agir + -ente.

examples.text: O espetáculo durou duas horas.

translations.de: Die Show dauerte zwei Stunden.
translations.en: The show lasted two hours.
translations.fr: Le spectacle a duré deux heures.

examples.text: As alegrias duram pouco.

translations.de: Die Freuden sind von kurzer Dauer.
translations.en: The joys are short-lived.
translations.fr: Les joies sont éphémères.

examples.text: Nada dura para sempre.

translations.de: Nichts währt ewig.
translations.en: Nothing lasts forever.
translations.fr: Rien ne dure pour toujours.

examples.text: O ferro é duro.

translations.de: Eisen ist hart.
translations.en: Iron is hard.
translations.fr: Le fer est dur.

more.definition: to last, endure
more.etymology: Proto-Indo-European *-h₂tiinflu. Inherited from Old Galician-Portuguese, from Latin dūrāre.

examples.text: Os campeonatos de futebol são longos.

translations.de: Die Fußballmeisterschaften sind lang.
translations.en: The soccer championships are long.
translations.fr: Les championnats de football sont longs.

translations.de: Fred schrieb seiner Mutter einen langen Brief.
translations.en: Fred wrote his mother a long letter.
translations.fr: Fred écrivit une longue lettre à sa mère.

examples.text: Maria tem os cabelos longos.

translations.de: Maria hat lange Haare.
translations.en: Maria has long hair.
translations.fr: Maria a les cheveux longs.

examples.text: A estrada é longa, mas será percorrida passo a passo.

translations.de: Der Weg ist lang, aber er wird Schritt für Schritt zurückgelegt.
translations.en: The road is long, but it will be covered step by step.
translations.fr: La route est longue, mais elle sera parcourue pas à pas.

more.definition: long
more.etymology: From Old Galician-Portuguese longo, from Latin longus, from Proto-Indo-European *dl̥h₁gʰós (“long”).

examples.text: A coroa do rei é alaranjada.

translations.de: Die Krone des Königs ist orange.
translations.en: The king's crown is orange.
translations.fr: La couronne du roi est orange.

examples.text: O rei não deveria dizer isso.

translations.de: Der König rede nicht also.
translations.en: Let not the king say so!
translations.fr: Que le roi ne parle pas ainsi !

examples.text: A coroa é o símbolo dos reis.

translations.de: Die Krone ist das Symbol der Könige.
translations.en: The crown is the symbol of kings.
translations.fr: La couronne est le symbole des rois.

examples.text: O rei é um tolo.

translations.de: Der König ist ein Narr.
translations.en: The king is a fool.
translations.fr: Le roi est un imbécile.

more.definition: king (male monarch); king (chess piece); king (playing card)
more.etymology: Inherited from Old Galician-Portuguese rei, from Latin rēgem (“king”), from Proto-Indo-European *h₃rḗǵs (“rules”). Compare Galician and Fala rei.

examples.text: Isso não é engraçado!

translations.de: Das ist nicht lustig!
translations.en: This is not funny!
translations.fr: C'est pas drôle !

examples.text: Aprecio teu bom humor. Achas tudo engraçado.

translations.de: Ich schätze deinen guten Humor. Du findest alles lustig.
translations.en: I appreciate your good humor. You find everything funny.
translations.fr: J'apprécie ta bonne humeur. Tu trouves tout drôle.

examples.text: Eu gosto mais de filmes engraçados.

translations.de: Ich mag lustige Filme lieber.
translations.en: I like funny movies better.

examples.text: Tom faz algumas coisas engraçadas de vez em quando.

translations.en: Tom does some funny things every once in a while.
translations.fr: Tom fait de drôles de choses de temps en temps.

more.etymology: Latin grātialbor. From en- + graça (“joke”) + -ado. Compare Spanish gracioso.

senses.gloss: que tem graça; aquele que é divertido, cômico

examples.text: A tartaruga está nadando no lago.

translations.de: Die Schildkröte schwimmt im See.

translations.fr: La tortue nage dans le lac.

translations.de: Heute kannst du nicht schwimmen gehen.
translations.en: You can't go swimming today.
translations.fr: Tu ne peux pas aller nager aujourd'hui.

examples.text: Eu fui nadar no mar.

translations.de: Ich bin im Meer schwimmen gegangen.
translations.en: I went swimming in the sea.
translations.fr: Je suis allé nager dans la mer.

examples.text: Ele propôs que fôssemos nadar.

translations.de: Er schlug vor, eine Runde schwimmen zu gehen.
translations.en: He suggested that we go for a swim.
translations.fr: Il proposa que nous allions nager.

more.etymology: Proto-Indo-European *-h₂tiinflu. Inherited from Old Galician-Portuguese, from Latin natāre.

senses.gloss: deslocar-se na água ou sustentar-se sobre ela usando recursos do próprio corpo (pés, mãos, braços, pernas, nadadeiras, cauda etc.)

translations.en: I've never worn boots either. In fact, I never served in the army.
translations.fr: Je n'ai jamais porté de bottes non plus. En fait, je n'ai jamais fait mon service militaire.

examples.text: Tomates podem ser servidos quentes ou frios, como entrada ou acompanhamento.

translations.de: Tomaten können warm oder kalt serviert werden, als Vorspeise oder als Beilage.
translations.en: Tomatoes may be served hot or cold, as a starter or as a side dish.
translations.fr: Les tomates peuvent être servies chaudes ou froides, comme entrée ou comme accompagnement.

examples.text: Quem não vive para servir não serve para viver.

translations.de: Wer nicht lebt, um zu dienen, dient nicht, um zu leben.
translations.en: He who does not live to serve does not serve to live.
translations.fr: Celui qui ne vit pas pour servir ne sert pas pour vivre.

examples.text: Que hora será servido o jantar?

translations.en: What time will dinner be served?
translations.fr: À quelle heure le diner sera-t-il servi ?

more.etymology: From Old Galician-Portuguese maldito, a semi-learned borrowing from Latin maledictus.

examples.text: Eu vou te ensinar a dirigir um carro.

translations.en: I'll teach you how to drive a car.
translations.fr: Je t'apprendrai comment conduire une voiture.

translations.de: Mein Vater hat früher einen Käfer gefahren.
translations.en: My dad used to drive a Beetle.
translations.fr: Mon père conduisait auparavant une Coccinelle.

translations.fr: Sais-tu conduire ?

translations.en: Is the cat on the chair or under the chair?
translations.fr: Est-ce que le chat est sur la chaise ou sous la chaise ?

translations.de: Nichts Neues unter der Sonne.
translations.en: Nothing new under the sun.
translations.fr: Rien de neuf sous le soleil.

translations.de: Es gibt nichts Neues unter der Sonne.
translations.en: There is nothing new under the sun.
translations.fr: Il n'y a rien de nouveau sous le soleil.

translations.de: Unter den Trümmern der zerstörten Häuser könnten Tausende von Leichen liegen.

translations.fr: Le contenu de la lettre était secret.

translations.de: Nur er hat diesen Brief gelesen.

translations.fr: Seul lui a lu cette lettre.

translations.de: Wer hat diesen Brief geschrieben?
translations.en: Who wrote this letter?
translations.fr: Qui a écrit cette lettre ?

translations.fr: J'ai reçu ta lettre.

translations.fr: S'allonger, c'est le contraire de se lever.

translations.fr: Lève-toi immédiatement et prépare-toi.

translations.de: Du brauchst nicht aufzustehen.

translations.fr: Vous n'avez pas besoin de vous lever.

translations.fr: Je me suis levée très tôt, ce matin.

examples.text: As paredes do apartamento são brancas.

translations.fr: Les murs de l'appartement sont blancs.

translations.de: Tom hat einen weißen Hund.
translations.en: Tom has a white dog.
translations.fr: Tom a un chien blanc.

translations.de: Warum ist Schnee weiß?
translations.en: Why is snow white?
translations.fr: Pourquoi la neige est-elle blanche ?

translations.de: Die Haare und der Bart des Vaters meiner Mutter sind weiß.

translations.en: I play white.

examples.text: Tom tem um cachorro branco.

translations.de: Tom hat einen weißen Hund.
translations.en: Tom has a white dog.
translations.fr: Tom a un chien blanc.

translations.de: Diese Kerze ist nicht weiß.
translations.en: This candle isn't white.
translations.fr: Cette bougie n'est pas blanche.

examples.text: O meu gato é branco.

translations.de: Meine Katze ist weiß.
translations.en: My cat is white.
translations.fr: Mon chat est blanc.

more.definition: argent; white clothing; blackout (failure in recalling something)
idioms: dar uma procuração assinada em branco
more.etymology: Proto-Indo-European *bʰleyǵ-der. Frankish *blankbor. Inherited from Old Galician-Portuguese branco, from Early Medieval Latin blancus, borrowed from Frankish *blank. Cognate with Galician branco, Spanish blanco. Doublet of Blanco and Bianca.

examples.text: Minha mãe está no hospital agora.

translations.de: Meine Mutter ist jetzt im Krankenhaus.
translations.en: My mother is in the hospital now.
translations.fr: Ma mère est à l'hôpital, en ce moment.

translations.de: Mein Vater ist jetzt im Krankenhaus.
translations.en: My father is in the hospital now.
translations.fr: Mon père est maintenant à l'hôpital.

examples.text: Minha filha nasceu neste hospital.

translations.de: Meine Tochter wurde in diesem Krankenhaus geboren.
translations.en: My daughter was born in this hospital.
translations.fr: Ma fille est née dans cet hôpital.

translations.fr: Elle est à l'hôpital depuis un mois.

senses.gloss: local onde se recebem e se tratam doentes

examples.text: Ele está aqui para te proteger.

translations.fr: Il est ici pour te protéger.

translations.en: You are protected here. This place is safe.
translations.fr: Ici, vous êtes protégée. Cet endroit est sûr.

translations.en: The soldiers guarded the bridge.
translations.fr: Les soldats gardaient le pont.

translations.de: Ich werde Sie beschützen!
translations.fr: Je vous protègerai !

translations.fr: Je veux trouver l'amour véritable.

translations.fr: Où pouvez-vous trouver un véritable ami ?

more.etymology: Inherited from Old Galician-Portuguese verdadeiro. By surface analysis, verdade + -eiro. Compare Spanish verdadero.

translations.en: What he said turned out to be true.

translations.de: Wir machen uns Sorgen um eure Zukunft.
translations.en: We worry about your future.
translations.fr: Nous nous inquiétons de votre avenir.

examples.text: O passado é lembrança, o futuro é esperança, o presente é ilusão.

translations.de: Die Vergangenheit ist Erinnerung, die Zukunft ist Hoffnung, die Gegenwart ist Illusion.
translations.en: The past is memory, the future is hope, and the present is an illusion.
translations.fr: Le passé est souvenir, le futur est espoir, le présent est illusion.

examples.text: Tenho muitos planos para o futuro.

translations.en: I have a lot of plans for the future.
translations.fr: J'ai beaucoup de projets pour l'avenir.

examples.text: Eles me perguntaram o que farei no futuro.

translations.en: They asked me what I will do in the future.
translations.fr: Ils m'ont demandé ce que je ferais à l'avenir.

more.definition: future (the time ahead); future tense
more.etymology: Learned borrowing from Latin futūrus (“about to be”).

senses.gloss: intervalo de tempo que inicia após o presente e tem fim indeterminado

examples.text: O silêncio será minha resposta.

translations.de: Meine Antwort wird Schweigen sein.
translations.en: Silence will be my answer.
translations.fr: Le silence sera ma réponse.

examples.text: Compare suas respostas com as do professor.

translations.de: Vergleiche deine Antworten mit denen des Lehrers.
translations.en: Compare your answers with the teacher's.
translations.fr: Compare tes réponses avec celles du professeur.

examples.text: A falta de resposta já é uma resposta, cheia de significado.

translations.de: Das Ausbleiben einer Antwort ist bereits eine bedeutungsvolle Antwort.
translations.en: The lack of response is already a response, full of meaning.
translations.fr: L’absence de réponse est déjà une réponse, pleine de sens.

examples.text: A primeira resposta está certa, a segunda está errada.

translations.de: Die erste Antwort ist richtig, die zweite ist falsch.
translations.en: The first answer is correct; the second is wrong.
translations.fr: La première réponse est correcte, la seconde est fausse.

more.definition: answer, response
more.etymology: From Old Galician-Portuguese resposta, reposta, from responder, corrupted by posta, feminine past participle of põer (Portuguese pôr). Compare Asturian and Spanish respuesta, Catalan and Galician resposta and Italian risposta.

senses.gloss: enunciado que se faz como réplica a uma pergunta

examples.text: Aonde você quer ir?

translations.de: Wohin möchten Sie gehen?
translations.en: Where do you want to go?
translations.fr: Où veux-tu aller ?

examples.text: Aonde quer que vás, vai com todo o teu coração.

translations.de: Wo auch immer du hingehst, geh mit ganzem Herzen.
translations.en: Wherever you go, go with all your heart.
translations.fr: Où que tu ailles, vas-y de tout ton cœur.

examples.text: Eu não sei aonde você deve ir.

translations.en: I don't know where you have to go.
translations.fr: Je ne sais pas où tu dois aller.

examples.text: Não sei aonde você deve ir.

translations.en: I don't know where you have to go.
translations.fr: Je ne sais pas où tu dois aller.

more.definition: Contraction of a + onde ("to where, whereto, whither"), used with verbs denoting movement
more.etymology: Egyptian 𓃾 (kꜣ)der. Phoenician 𐤀 (ʾ)bor. Ancient Greek Α (A)bor. Etruscan 𐌀 (a)influ. Latin *cundeder. From a (“to”) + onde (“where”).

examples.text: Com a chuva, os rios crescem.

translations.de: Mit dem Regen wachsen die Flüsse.
translations.en: With the rain, the rivers grow.
translations.fr: Avec la pluie, les rivières grossissent.

examples.text: Tom cresceu na Alemanha mas agora ele mora nos Estados Unidos.

translations.de: Tom ist in Deutschland aufgewachsen, aber jetzt lebt er in den Vereinigten Staaten.
translations.en: Tom grew up in Germany, but now he lives in the USA.
translations.fr: Tom a grandi en Allemagne, mais maintenant il vit aux États-Unis.

examples.text: Eu podia sentir a emoção crescendo no ar.

translations.de: Ich konnte die wachsende Aufregung in der Luft spüren.
translations.en: I could feel the excitement building in the air.
translations.fr: Je sentais l'excitation monter dans l'air.

examples.text: A desconfiança crescia entre as pessoas.

translations.de: Das Misstrauen im Volk wuchs.
translations.en: Distrust was growing among the people.
translations.fr: La méfiance grandissait parmi la population.

more.definition: to grow (become bigger or taller); to grow up (to become older); to grow in number or extent
more.etymology: Inherited from Old Galician-Portuguese crecer, from Latin crēscere (“to grow”), from Proto-Italic *krēskō, from Proto-Indo-European *ḱreh₁- (“to grow, become bigger”).

examples.text: O supremo tribunal condenou o réu à prisão.

translations.de: Das Oberste Gericht verurteilte den Angeklagten zu einer Freiheitsstrafe.
translations.en: The Supreme Court sentenced the defendant to prison.
translations.fr: La Cour suprême a condamné l'accusé à une peine d'emprisonnement.

examples.text: Não há prisão que nos encarcere o pensamento.

translations.de: Es gibt kein Gefängnis, das unsere Gedanken einsperren könnte.
translations.en: There is no prison to imprison our thoughts.
translations.fr: Il n'y a pas de prison pour emprisonner nos pensées.

examples.text: A alma é a prisão do corpo.

translations.de: Die Seele ist das Gefängnis des Körpers.
translations.en: The soul is the prison of the body.
translations.fr: L'âme est la prison du corps.

examples.text: Sua fuga da prisão foi bem planejada.

translations.de: Seine Flucht aus dem Gefängnis war gut geplant.
translations.en: His escape from prison was well planned.

more.definition: prison; arrest; captivity
more.etymology: Inherited from Old Galician-Portuguese prison, borrowed from Old French prison, from Latin prehēnsiō, from prehendō (“to seize”) + -tiō. Doublet of preensão.

examples.text: Um terremoto destruiu o edifício.

translations.de: Ein Erdbeben zerstörte das Gebäude.
translations.en: An earthquake destroyed the building.
translations.fr: Un tremblement de terre détruisit le bâtiment.

examples.text: A verdade destrói todos os grilhões.

translations.de: Die Wahrheit zerstört alle Fesseln.
translations.en: Truth destroys all shackles.
translations.fr: La vérité détruit toutes les chaînes.

examples.text: A bomba atômica destruiu por completo a cidade de Hiroxima.

translations.de: Die Atombombe hat Hiroshima vollkommen zerstört.
translations.en: The atomic bomb destroyed the entire city of Hiroshima.
translations.fr: La bombe atomique a entièrement détruit la ville d'Hiroshima.

examples.text: O mal por si se destrói.

translations.de: Das Böse zerstört sich selbst.
translations.en: Evil destroys itself.
translations.fr: Le mal se détruit lui-même.

more.definition: to ruin, devastate (proceed with the destruction of, cause the destruction of); to undo; to break down
more.etymology: Inherited from Old Galician-Portuguese destruir, destroir, from Latin dēstruere (“to destroy”) (probably an early borrowing), from dē + struō (“to put together”).

senses.gloss: desfazer, tornar em nada algo que existia

examples.text: O assassino foi identificado graças às pegadas deixadas no local do crime.

translations.de: Der Mörder konnte dank der am Tatort hinterlassenen Fußspuren identifiziert werden.
translations.en: The killer was identified thanks to footprints left at the scene.
translations.fr: Le meurtrier a été identifié grâce aux empreintes de pas laissées sur les lieux du crime.

examples.text: Aquele é um local onde várias colônias de pássaros nidificam.

translations.de: Dort ist eine Stelle, wo mehrere Vogelkolonien nisten.
translations.en: Over there is a place where several colonies of birds nest.

examples.text: O local está vazio.

translations.en: The premises are empty.
translations.fr: Le local est vide.

examples.text: É claro que deve haver hospitais locais.

translations.en: Of course there should be local hospitals.

more.definition: local
more.etymology: Borrowed from Late Latin locālis, from Latin locus. Cognate with the inherited lugar.

examples.text: O rosto dele ficou branco como papel.

translations.de: Sein Gesicht wurde kreidebleich.
translations.en: His face turned as white as a sheet.
translations.fr: Son visage devint blanc comme du papier.

examples.text: Ele tem uma grande cicatriz no rosto.

translations.de: Er hat eine große Narbe im Gesicht.
translations.en: He has a large scar on his face.
translations.fr: Il a une grande cicatrice sur le visage.

examples.text: O rosto é a parte anterior da cabeça.

translations.de: Das Gesicht ist der vordere Teil des Kopfes.
translations.en: The face is the front part of the head.
translations.fr: Le visage est la partie avant de la tête.

examples.text: Maria escondeu o rosto entre as mãos.

translations.de: Maria verbarg das Gesicht in den Händen.
translations.en: Maria covered her face with her hands.

more.definition: face (part of head)
more.etymology: Inherited from Old Galician-Portuguese rosto, rostro, from Latin rōstrum. Doublet of rostro, a learned borrowing.

examples.text: A neve desapareceu.

translations.de: Der Schnee ist verschwunden.
translations.en: The snow has disappeared.
translations.fr: La neige a disparu.

examples.text: Nós desapareceremos antes que essas velhas oliveiras desapareçam.

translations.de: Wir werden verschwinden, bevor diese alten Olivenbäume verschwinden.
translations.en: We will disappear before these old olive trees disappear.
translations.fr: Nous disparaîtrons avant que ces vieux oliviers ne disparaissent.

examples.text: O gato de Tom desapareceu por alguns dias.

translations.en: Tom's cat disappeared for a few days.
translations.fr: Le chat de Tom a disparu pendant quelques jours.

examples.text: O meu querido gatinho desapareceu há uma semana.

translations.en: My dear little cat disappeared a week ago.
translations.fr: Mon cher petit chat a disparu depuis une semaine.

more.definition: to disappear; to vanish (to become lost, unseen or stop existing); to make something disappear; to get rid of
more.etymology: Proto-Indo-European *trísinflu. From des- + aparecer (“to appear”).

senses.gloss: deixar de ser visto; sair do campo de visão

examples.text: Eu sou a voz do que clama no deserto.

translations.de: Ich bin die Stimme dessen, der in der Wüste weint.
translations.en: I am the voice of one calling in the desert.
translations.fr: Je suis la voix de celui qui crie dans le désert.

examples.text: Que voz encantadora! Inesquecível!

translations.de: Was für eine bezaubernde Stimme! Unvergesslich!
translations.en: What a charming voice! Unforgettable!
translations.fr: Quelle voix charmante ! Inoubliable !

examples.text: Eu adoro as cores e as vozes da primavera.

translations.de: Ich liebe die Farben und Klänge des Frühlings.
translations.en: I love the colors and voices of spring.
translations.fr: J'adore les couleurs et les sons du printemps.

examples.text: O tio dele tinha uma voz linda.

translations.de: Sein Onkel hatte eine wunderschöne Stimme.
translations.en: His uncle had a beautiful voice.
translations.fr: Son oncle avait une voix magnifique.

more.definition: voice (all senses); speech
more.etymology: Proto-Indo-European *wekʷ-der. Inherited from Old Galician-Portuguese voz, from Latin vōcem, from Proto-Italic *wōks, from Proto-Indo-European *wṓkʷs.

examples.text: A guerra haverá sempre de existir, até que o homem finalmente se conheça.

translations.de: Der Krieg wird es immer geben, bis der Mensch sich endlich selbst kennt.
translations.en: War will always exist, until man finally knows himself.
translations.fr: La guerre existera toujours, jusqu'à ce que l'homme se connaisse enfin.

examples.text: Os exploradores finalmente atingiram o seu objetivo.

translations.en: The explorers finally reached their goal.
translations.fr: Les explorateurs ont finalement atteint leur but.

examples.text: Segundo os jornais o indivíduo finalmente confessou.

translations.en: According to the papers, the man has finally confessed.
translations.fr: Selon les journaux, l'homme a finalement avoué.

examples.text: Ele chegou ao seu objetivo, finalmente.

translations.de: Schließlich erreichte er sein Ziel.
translations.en: He achieved his aim at last.

more.definition: eventually; at last, finally (after a long time); lastly; finally; in the end (at the conclusion)
more.etymology: From final + -mente.

senses.gloss: por fim, por último, de forma conclusiva, para terminar:

examples.text: O tempo é uma relação entre eventos. Não existe por si só.

translations.de: Zeit ist eine Beziehung zwischen Ereignissen. Sie existiert nicht für sich allein.
translations.en: Time is a relationship between events. It does not exist on its own.
translations.fr: Le temps est une relation entre des événements. Il n'existe pas en soi.

examples.text: Califórnia e Nevada fazem fronteira entre si.

translations.de: Kalifornien und Nevada grenzen aneinander.
translations.en: California and Nevada border on each other.
translations.fr: La Californie et le Nevada se jouxtent.

examples.text: Nós somos, literalmente, o universo olhando-se a si mesmo.

translations.de: Wir sind buchstäblich das Universum, das sich selbst betrachtet.
translations.en: We are, quite literally, the universe looking at itself.
translations.fr: Nous sommes, littéralement, l'univers qui se contemple lui-même.

examples.text: Ele é um caçador que só caça a si mesmo.

translations.de: Er ist ein Jäger, der nur sich selbst jagt.
translations.en: He is a hunter who only hunts himself.
translations.fr: C'est un chasseur qui ne chasse que lui-même.

translations.fr: La clé d'un problème se situe souvent dans la porte du voisin.

translations.de: Kein Zahlensystem kann mit Toki Pona kompatibel sein.

translations.fr: Aucun système de numération ne peut être compatible avec le toki pona.

translations.de: Die Beherrschung des agglutinierenden Systems der türkischen Sprache ist eine spannende Herausforderung.

translations.fr: Maîtriser le système agglutinatif de la langue turque est un défi passionnant.

examples.text: Tom leu um artigo sobre o sistema solar.

translations.fr: Tom a lu un article à propos du système solaire.

more.etymology: Ancient Greek σύστημα (sústēma)bor. Latin systēmader. Derived from Latin systēma, borrowed from Ancient Greek σύστημα (sústēma). Compare French système.

examples.text: Entre o amarelo e o vermelho há vários tons de laranja.

translations.en: Between yellow and red, there are various shades of orange.
translations.fr: Entre le jaune et le rouge, il y a plusieurs nuances d'orange.

examples.text: Tenho várias perguntas.

translations.en: I've got lots of questions.
translations.fr: J'ai de nombreuses questions.

translations.fr: Divers efforts ont été faits pour ressusciter le latin.

examples.text: De várias maneiras algo pode ser dito em Toki Pona.

translations.en: In many ways, something can be said in Toki Pona.
translations.fr: De bien des façons, on peut dire la même chose à toki pona.

more.etymology: Proto-Indo-European *h₁weh₂-der. Proto-Italic *-jōsinflu. Latin variuslbor. Learned borrowing from Latin varius. Doublet of veiro.

translations.en: She was kissed by him.
translations.fr: Elle fut embrassée par lui.

examples.text: Quero muito te beijar.

translations.fr: Je veux vraiment t'embrasser.

examples.text: Ele a beijou.

translations.de: Er küsste sie.
translations.en: He kissed her.
translations.fr: Il l'a embrassée.

translations.fr: Ceux qui vivent tristes ne peuvent pas soulager la douleur des autres.

translations.fr: Nul plaisir sans peine.

translations.fr: Le latin mérite de redevenir la langue de l'Europe.

translations.fr: Tatoeba mérite le meilleur de chaque langue.

translations.fr: Il n'aime pas jouer au football sur du gazon synthétique.
