translations.en: Superconducting magnets can produce intense magnetic fields.

translations.de: Neptun hat ein sehr starkes Magnetfeld.
translations.en: Neptune has a very strong magnetic field.

examples.text: O Tom disse-nos o segredo.

translations.fr: Je ne révélerai jamais mon secret.

translations.de: Die türkische Sprache beginnt mir ihre Geheimnisse zu offenbaren.
translations.en: The Turkish language is beginning to reveal its secrets to me.
translations.fr: La langue turque commence à me dévoiler ses secrets.

translations.de: Das Geheimnis des Sieges ist es, nicht aufzugeben.
translations.en: The secret to victory is not to give up.
translations.fr: Le secret de la victoire réside dans le refus d'abandonner.

translations.de: Tagsüber lernt er Türkisch. Abends sieht er Fernsehserien.
translations.en: During the day, he studies Turkish. At night, he watches TV series.
translations.fr: Durant la journée, il étudie le turc. Le soir, il regarde des séries télévisées.

examples.text: Hoje à noite assistiremos a um bom filme.

translations.de: Heute Abend schauen wir uns einen guten Film an.
translations.en: Tonight we'll watch a good movie.
translations.fr: Ce soir, nous regarderons un bon film.

examples.text: Eu quero assistir a filmes gregos.

translations.de: Ich möchte griechische Filme sehen.
translations.en: I want to watch Greek movies.
translations.fr: Je veux regarder des films grecs.

translations.fr: Elle aime cuisiner pour sa famille.

translations.fr: Les oignons cuisent plus vite que les pommes de terre.

examples.text: É permitido aqui falar de amor?

translations.de: Darf man hier von Liebe sprechen?
translations.en: Is it allowed here to talk about love?
translations.fr: Peut-on parler d'amour ici ?

translations.en: What a cold little hand! Allow me to warm it up.
translations.fr: Quelle petite main froide ! Permettez-moi de la réchauffer.

translations.de: Wenn etwas nicht verboten ist, ist es dann erlaubt?
translations.en: If something is not forbidden, then is it allowed?
translations.fr: Si une chose n'est pas interdite, alors est-elle permise ?

translations.de: Ist es hier erlaubt, zu fotografieren?
translations.en: Are we allowed to take pictures here?
translations.fr: Est-il permis de prendre des photos ici ?

more.etymology: Learned borrowing from Latin permittere, with change of conjugation.

examples.text: O céu está cheio de estrelas.

translations.de: Der Himmel ist voller Sterne.
translations.en: The sky is full of stars.
translations.fr: Le ciel est rempli d'étoiles.

translations.de: In meinem Land leuchten die Sterne am Himmel am hellsten.
translations.en: The stars shine brighter in the skies of my homeland.
translations.fr: Les étoiles brillent plus fort dans le ciel de mon pays.

examples.text: Vi o Espírito descer do céu como pomba e pousar sobre ele.

translations.de: Ich sah den Geist wie eine Taube vom Himmel herabsteigen und auf ihm ruhen.
translations.en: I saw the Spirit come down from heaven as a dove and remain on him.
translations.fr: J'ai vu l'Esprit descendre du ciel comme une colombe et se poser sur lui.

translations.de: Himmel und Hölle sind Schöpfungen des Geistes.
translations.en: Hell and heaven are mental creations.
translations.fr: L’enfer et le paradis sont des impressions mentales.

Cognate with Galician ceo, Spanish cielo, Catalan cel, Occitan cèl, French ciel, Italian cielo and Romanian cer.

senses.gloss: parte do espaço que parece formar uma abóbada em cima de nossas cabeças; abóbada celeste

translations.fr: Quand l'air est plus chaud, il pleut davantage.

translations.de: Ich will einfach nur etwas frische Luft schnappen.

translations.fr: Je veux simplement prendre un peu d'air frais.

examples.text: Eu só quero pegar um pouco de ar fresco.

translations.fr: La balle vola dans les airs.

translations.fr: Tu me fais rêver.

translations.fr: Pourquoi rêvons-nous ?

translations.fr: Mon copain est journaliste.

translations.fr: Je n'ai pas de petite amie.

examples.text: Eu não tenho a intenção de namorar com ela.

examples.text: Ela é minha namorada.

translations.de: Sie ist meine Freundin.
translations.en: She is my girlfriend.
translations.fr: C'est ma petite amie.

examples.text: Meu melhor amigo tem duas namoradas.

translations.de: Mein bester Freund hat zwei Freundinnen.
translations.en: My best friend has two girlfriends.
translations.fr: Mon meilleur ami a deux copines.

examples.text: Tenho uma namorada.

translations.de: Ich habe eine Freundin.

translations.fr: J'ai une petite amie.

more.definition: to endeavor to gain (someone's) affection; to woo; to court; to be in a romantic relationship (with); to be dating; to treat (someone) as expected between lovers: to kiss him or her, to hug him or her, and so on
more.etymology: Apheretic form of enamorar.

examples.text: Isso está quente, não frio.

translations.de: Das ist heiß, nicht kalt.
translations.en: This is hot, not cold.
translations.fr: Ceci est chaud, pas froid.

translations.de: Die Suppe ist kalt.
translations.en: The soup is cold.
translations.fr: La soupe est froide.

examples.text: Está muito frio.

translations.en: We didn't go out yesterday because it was too cold.
translations.fr: Nous ne sommes pas sortis hier car il faisait trop froid.

more.definition: having low temperatures; cool; insensitive

Compare Galician and Spanish frío, Asturian fríu, Catalan fred, Italian freddo. Doublet of frígido.

examples.text: Estou com frio apesar de estar bem agasalhado.

translations.fr: J'ai froid même si je suis bien habillé.

translations.en: This country's climate is cold and dry.
translations.fr: Le climat de ce pays est froid et sec.

examples.text: O café está quente, mas o chá está frio.

translations.de: Der Kaffee ist heiß, aber der Tee ist kalt.
translations.en: The coffee is hot, but the tea is cold.
translations.fr: Le café est chaud, mais le thé est froid.

examples.text: Isso está quente, não frio.

translations.de: Das ist heiß, nicht kalt.
translations.en: This is hot, not cold.
translations.fr: Ceci est chaud, pas froid.

more.definition: cold; coldness
more.etymology: Inherited from Old Galician-Portuguese frio, from Latin frīgidus (“cold”), from frīgeō (“to be cold”), from frigus (“cold, coldness”), from Proto-Indo-European *sriHgos-, *sriges-, *sriHges-. Compare Galician and Spanish frío, Asturian fríu, Catalan fred, Italian freddo. Doublet of frígido.

examples.text: Ela nasceu pra me fazer feliz.

translations.en: She was born to make me happy.
translations.fr: Elle est née pour me rendre heureux.

examples.text: Isso é pra mim?

translations.de: Ist das für mich?
translations.en: Is that for me?
translations.fr: Est-ce pour moi ?

examples.text: É muito longe pra ir caminhando?

translations.de: Ist es zu weit, um zu laufen?
translations.en: Is it too far to walk?
translations.fr: Est-ce trop loin pour marcher ?

examples.text: Ele pediu pra ela pagar suas contas.

translations.en: He asked her to pay her bills.
translations.fr: Il lui a demandé de payer ses factures.

more.definition: contraction of pra + o, literally “for/to the (masculine singular)”
more.etymology: Contraction of pra + o.

examples.text: A impressora precisa de papel.

translations.de: Der Drucker braucht Papier.
translations.en: The printer needs paper.
translations.fr: L'imprimeur a besoin de papier.

examples.text: Você precisa aceitar o seu papel.

translations.de: Du musst deine Rolle akzeptieren.
translations.en: You need to accept your role.
translations.fr: Tu dois accepter ton rôle.

examples.text: As conjunções desempenham importante papel na construção das frases.

translations.de: Konjunktionen spielen eine wichtige Rolle beim Satzbau.
translations.en: Conjunctions play an important role in sentence construction.
translations.fr: Les conjonctions jouent un rôle important dans la construction des phrases.

examples.text: A magia tem um papel importante nas sociedades primitivas.

translations.de: Zauberei spielt in primitiven Gesellschaften eine wichtige Rolle.
translations.en: Magic plays an important part in primitive society.
translations.fr: La magie joue un rôle important dans les sociétés primitives.

more.definition: paper (sheet material typically used for writing on or printing); (written) document; paper (an open hand in rock paper scissors)

senses.gloss: folha ou lâmina delgada feita de substâncias de origem vegetal que serve para escrever, imprimir, embrulhar, etc.

examples.text: O quanto você gosta do teu emprego?

translations.de: Wie sehr magst du deine Arbeit?
translations.en: How much do you like your job?

examples.text: Acho que você gosta de seu emprego.

translations.en: I think you like your job.
translations.fr: Je pense que vous aimez votre travail.

examples.text: Vou para uma entrevista de emprego.

translations.en: I'm going for a job interview.
translations.fr: Je vais pour un entretien d'embauche.

examples.text: O Tom perdeu o emprego há três meses.

translations.en: Tom lost his job three months ago.
translations.fr: Tom a perdu son emploi il y a trois mois.

more.definition: job (economic role for which a person is paid); use; usage (the act of using something or the way something is used); employment (the state of being employed)
more.etymology: Deverbal from empregar (“to employ”).

examples.text: Boa noite e bons sonhos.

translations.de: Gute Nacht und schöne Träume.
translations.en: Good night and sweet dreams.
translations.fr: Bonne nuit et fais de beaux rêves.

examples.text: Não há mais nada, foi um sonho que findou.

translations.de: Es gibt nichts mehr, es war ein Traum, der endete.
translations.en: There is nothing left, it was a dream that ended.
translations.fr: Il n'y a plus rien, c'était un rêve qui s'est terminé.

examples.text: Que todos os seus sonhos se realizem!

translations.de: Mögen alle deine Träume wahr werden!
translations.en: May all your dreams come true!
translations.fr: Que tous tes rêves deviennent réalité !

examples.text: Da matéria dos sonhos faz a mente os egos, frágeis e ilusórias construções.

translations.de: Aus dem Stoff der Träume macht der Geist das Ego, zerbrechliche und illusorische Konstruktionen.
translations.en: From the stuff of dreams, the mind makes egos, fragile and illusory constructions.
translations.fr: De l'étoffe des rêves l'esprit fait les egos, des constructions fragiles et illusoires.

more.definition: dream (imaginary events seen while sleeping); dream (a deep hope or desire); a traditional Christmas treat prepared with eggs and flour, fried in olive oil; beignet, fritter
more.etymology: Proto-Indo-European *swep-der. Inherited from Old Galician-Portuguese sonho, from Latin somnium. Compare Galician soño, Spanish sueño, Italian sogno, and French songe.

senses.gloss: ideias e imagens que perpassam na mente de quem dorme

examples.text: O elevador está fora de serviço.

translations.en: The elevator isn't running.
translations.fr: L'ascenseur est hors service.

examples.text: Não fume quando estiver em serviço.

translations.en: Don't smoke while you are on duty.
translations.fr: Ne fume pas quand tu es en service.

examples.text: Por favor, tire da mesa o serviço de chá.

translations.de: Bitte räume das Teeservice ab!
translations.en: Please clear away the tea things.

examples.text: Eu lamento dizer isto, mas o serviço não é bom aqui.

translations.en: I'm sorry to say this, but the service is not good here.
translations.fr: Je regrette de devoir dire cela, mais le service n'est juste pas bon ici.

more.definition: service (work that is produced, traded, sold, then consumed); work; labour; job; a task
more.etymology: From Old Galician-Portuguese serviço, a semi-learned borrowing from Latin servitium (“slavery; servitude”) (compare Italian servizio, French service, Norman sèrvice, Spanish servicio), from servus (“serf”). By surface analysis, servo + -iço.

examples.text: É difícil negociar com quem quer brigar.

translations.de: Es ist schwierig, mit denen zu verhandeln, die kämpfen wollen.
translations.en: It's difficult to negotiate with those who want to fight.
translations.fr: Il est difficile de négocier avec quelqu’un qui veut se battre.

examples.text: Mary briga constantemente com os pais dela.

translations.en: Mary fights constantly with her parents.
translations.fr: Mary se dispute constamment avec ses parents.

examples.text: Os adolescentes brigam muitas vezes com os seus pais.

translations.en: Adolescents often quarrel with their parents.
translations.fr: Les adolescents se disputent souvent avec leurs parents.

examples.text: Eles sempre estão brigando.

translations.en: They are always quarreling.
translations.fr: Ils sont toujours en train de se bagarrer.

more.definition: to brawl, fight; to quarrel; to argue, have an argument
more.etymology: From Gothic 𐌱𐍂𐌹𐌺𐌰𐌽 (brikan), from Proto-Germanic *brekaną, from Proto-Indo-European *bʰreg-. See also the Latin cognate derivation franger.

examples.text: Quero fazer sexo com ela.

translations.de: Ich will Sex mit ihr haben.
translations.en: I want to have sex with her.
translations.fr: Je veux coucher avec elle.

examples.text: Para alguém de oitenta anos, o sexo é sem prazer?

translations.de: Ist Sex für eine achtzigjährige Person ohne Vergnügen?
translations.en: For someone who is eighty years old, is sex without pleasure?
translations.fr: Pour une personne de quatre-vingts ans, le sexe est-il sans plaisir ?

examples.text: Independente do sexo dessa pessoa, ela é feminista.

translations.en: Regardless of that person’s gender, they are a feminist.
translations.fr: Peu importe le sexe de cette personne, il s’agit d’une féministe.

examples.text: Alguns peixes podem mudar de sexo.

translations.de: Manche Fische können ihr Geschlecht wechseln.
translations.en: Some fish are able to change their gender.

more.definition: category into which sexually-reproducing organisms are divided on the basis of their reproductive roles in their species; another category, especially for humans and often separable, based on non-physical traits or roles; gender; sexual intercourse
more.etymology: Proto-Indo-European *sek-der. Proto-Indo-European *séks-u-sder. Latin sexuslbor. Learned borrowing from Latin sexus.

senses.gloss: definição biológica de gênero de um animal ou vegetal; pode ser feminino, masculino ou hermafrodita; quando não se tem definição considera-se um ser vivo como assexuado

examples.text: Eu já tinha lido o livro que ela me deu.

translations.fr: J'avais déjà lu le livre qu'elle m'a donné.

examples.text: Acham que estão lidando com gente da laia deles.

translations.en: They think they're dealing with their own kind.
translations.fr: Ils pensent qu’ils ont affaire à des gens comme eux.

examples.text: Essa história é curta o bastante para ser lida em uma lição.

translations.de: Diese Geschichte ist kurz genug, um in einer Stunde gelesen zu werden.
translations.en: This story is short enough to read in one lesson.
translations.fr: Cette histoire est suffisamment courte pour être lue en une heure.

translations.fr: Il ne peut pas gérer la responsabilité.

translations.fr: Je continue à faire beaucoup d'erreurs, mais je ne renonce pas à apprendre le toki pona.

examples.text: O segredo da vitória é não desistir.

translations.en: The secret to victory is not to give up.
translations.fr: Le secret de la victoire réside dans le refus d'abandonner.

examples.text: Eu nunca teria desistido.

translations.en: I never would've given up.
translations.fr: Je n'aurais jamais abandonné.

translations.en: I've given up on the idea of buying a house.
translations.fr: J'ai abandonné l'idée d'acheter une maison.

more.etymology: Latin dēsisterelbor. Learned borrowing from Latin dēsistere.

examples.text: A pimenta é picante, o açúcar é doce.

translations.en: I ate a very tasty sweet.
translations.fr: J'ai mangé une délicieuse sucrerie.

translations.en: The apple tastes sweet.

translations.fr: Tes fruits sont plus sucrés que ceux de mon verger.

examples.text: Este bolo é doce.

examples.text: A beleza é fugaz instante, é perfeição imaginária – doce, onírica visão.

translations.fr: Ne le faites pas ! C'est stupide et dangereux.

translations.de: Der dumme und blutige Krieg geht zu Ende.
translations.en: The stupid and bloody war comes to an end.
translations.fr: La guerre stupide et sanglante touche à sa fin.

examples.text: Não faça isso! É estúpido e perigoso.

examples.text: Tom fez algo muito estúpido.

translations.fr: Tom fit quelque chose de très stupide.

translations.fr: J'ai été stupide de faire une telle erreur.

examples.text: Para todos nós descerá a noite e chegará a diligência.

translations.en: I fell because I went down too fast.
translations.fr: Je suis tombé parce que je suis descendu trop vite.

examples.text: Vou descer na próxima estação.

translations.de: Ich steige an der nächsten Station aus.
translations.en: I'll get off at the next station.
translations.fr: Je descends à la prochaine station.

examples.text: Vi o Espírito descer do céu como pomba e pousar sobre ele.

translations.de: Ich sah den Geist wie eine Taube vom Himmel herabsteigen und auf ihm ruhen.

translations.fr: J'ai vu l'Esprit descendre du ciel comme une colombe et se poser sur lui.

examples.text: Quero que isso seja uma surpresa.

translations.de: Ich will, dass es eine Überraschung ist.
translations.en: I want it to be a surprise.
translations.fr: Je veux que ce soit une surprise.

examples.text: Tom tem uma surpresa para você.

translations.fr: Tatoeba est une boîte pleine de merveilleuses expériences et surprises !

translations.fr: Ces choses ne sont pas mentionnées dans la loi.

translations.en: The law of life encompasses the law of death.
translations.fr: La loi de la vie englobe la loi de la mort.

translations.fr: C'est notre devoir de toujours obéir à la loi.

translations.en: The police charged Sachiyo with the murder.

examples.text: Houve um aumento no número de assassinatos.

translations.en: There has been an increase in the number of murders.

examples.text: A polícia suspeita que foi um assassinato.

translations.en: The police suspect it was a murder.

examples.text: O assassinato do prefeito chocou a comunidade.

translations.en: The mayor's murder sent shock waves through the community.

more.etymology: From assassino (“assassin”) + -ato, from Italian assassino, from Arabic حَشَّاشِين (ḥaššāšīn, “hashish users”).

senses.gloss: ato de retirar a vida de outrem

examples.text: A areia estava quente.

translations.en: Who wants some hot chocolate?

translations.fr: Aujourd'hui, il fait très chaud.

examples.text: Tom ignorou o conselho de Mary.

translations.de: Tom missachtete Marys Rat.
translations.en: Tom ignored Mary's advice.
translations.fr: Tom a ignoré le conseil de Mary.

examples.text: Meu pai nunca me deu muitos conselhos.

translations.en: My father never gave me much advice.

examples.text: Acho que podemos relaxar agora.

translations.en: I think we can relax now.
translations.fr: Je pense que nous pouvons maintenant nous détendre.

examples.text: Relaxe suas pernas. Sente-se e relaxe!

translations.de: Entlaste mal deine Beine. Setz dich nieder und entspann dich!
translations.en: Take the weight off your feet. Sit down and relax.

examples.text: Feche os olhos, relaxe e deixe sua imaginação e suas emoções correrem livremente.

translations.de: Schließen Sie die Augen, entspannen Sie sich und lassen Sie Ihrer Phantasie und Ihren Gefühlen freien Lauf.
translations.en: Close your eyes, relax and let your imagination and emotions run freely.

examples.text: Eu relaxo a escutar música clássica.

translations.en: I relax while listening to classical music.

more.definition: to relax
more.etymology: Proto-Indo-European *-h₂tiinflu. Latin relaxārelbor. Learned borrowing from Latin relaxāre.

examples.text: Baixem as armas!

translations.de: Die Waffen nieder!
translations.en: Put down your weapons!
translations.fr: Bas les armes !

examples.text: A arma disparou por acidente.

translations.de: Der Schuss löste sich versehentlich.
translations.en: The gun went off by accident.
translations.fr: Le coup est parti accidentellement.

examples.text: As armas nucleares são qual espada de Dâmocles, ameaçando de extinção a humanidade.

translations.de: Atomwaffen sind ein Damoklesschwert, das die Menschheit mit der Auslöschung bedroht.
translations.en: Nuclear weapons are like the sword of Damocles, threatening humanity with extinction.
translations.fr: Les armes nucléaires sont comme une épée de Damoclès, menaçant l’humanité d’extinction.

examples.text: Nós armamos uma armadilha para capturar uma raposa.

translations.en: We set a trap to catch a fox.
translations.fr: Nous avons posé un piège pour capturer un renard.

more.definition: to arm (to supply with weapons); to set (a trap, a timebomb, a security system or similar); to set up (a tent, a hammock, a folding table or similar)
more.etymology: Proto-Italic *armosder. Proto-Indo-European *-h₂tiinflu. Inherited from Old Galician-Portuguese armar, from Latin armāre.

examples.text: Eu tenho um barco.

translations.de: Ich habe ein Boot.
translations.en: I have a boat.
translations.fr: J'ai un bateau.

examples.text: Compara-se a vida frequentemente com uma viagem de barco.

translations.de: Das Leben wird oft mit einer Bootsfahrt verglichen.
translations.en: Life is often compared to a boat trip.
translations.fr: On compare souvent la vie à un voyage en bateau.

examples.text: Sigo o espírito que impele o barco do meu coração.

translations.de: Ich folge dem Geist, der das Boot meines Herzens antreibt.
translations.en: I follow the spirit that drives the boat of my heart.
translations.fr: Je suis l'esprit qui conduit le bateau de mon cœur.

examples.text: Havia alguns barcos no lago.

translations.en: There were some boats on the lake.
translations.fr: Il y avait quelques bateaux sur le lac.

more.definition: boat (water craft)
more.etymology: Coptic ⲃⲁⲁⲣⲉ (baare)der. Ancient Greek βᾶρῐς (bârĭs)der. Vulgar Latin -icusder. From barca (“barge”), from Old Galician-Portuguese barca, from Late Latin barca, syncope of Vulgar Latin *bārica, from Latin bāris + Vulgar Latin -ica.

examples.text: O amigo do meu inimigo é meu inimigo.

translations.de: Der Freund meines Feindes ist mein Feind.

translations.en: Tom is our mortal enemy.
translations.fr: Tom est notre ennemi juré.

examples.text: Eu não sou o seu inimigo.

translations.en: I am not your enemy.

more.etymology: Do latim inimīcus⁽ˡᵃ⁾.

examples.text: O amigo do meu inimigo é meu inimigo.

translations.de: Der Freund meines Feindes ist mein Feind.
translations.en: The friend of my enemy is my enemy.
translations.fr: L'ami de mon ennemi est mon ennemi.

examples.text: Seus amigos vêm apoiá-lo. Já seus inimigos o abandonam.

translations.de: Ich bin dir nicht feind.

translations.fr: Je ne suis pas ton ennemi.

translations.fr: Ma langue ne se trouve pas dans la liste !

senses.gloss: relação de nomes, lugares ou coisas

examples.text: O livro que estou lendo é muito interessante.

translations.fr: Le livre que je lis est très intéressant.

translations.fr: Au fur et à mesure que nous apprenons une langue, nous découvrons ses aspects les plus intéressants.

translations.fr: J'ai trouvé le livre très intéressant.

translations.fr: C'est une histoire intéressante.

senses.gloss: interface entre o mar e a terra

translations.fr: Dieu est-il la cause première ou la cause immanente ?

translations.fr: Quelle est la cause ?

translations.en: The cause of death was not revealed.
translations.fr: La cause du décès n'a pas été révélée.

examples.text: Onde se queimam livros, acaba-se queimando pessoas.

translations.fr: Là où l'on brûle les livres, on finit aussi par brûler des hommes.

translations.en: The house is burning.

examples.text: Queime o corpo.

translations.en: Burn the body.
translations.fr: Brûle le corps.

senses.gloss: sofrer combustão rápida ou consumir combustível de maneira a liberar calor, gases e luz

translations.en: That sentence contains mistakes that Artificial Intelligence would not make.
translations.fr: Cette phrase contient des erreurs que l’intelligence artificielle ne ferait pas.

translations.fr: Tom a fait beaucoup d'erreurs.

translations.de: Die Schüler dieser Sprachschule machen alle möglichen Fehler.

translations.fr: Les étudiants de cette école de langues font toutes sortes d’erreurs.

examples.text: Quanto mais me esforço, mais erros cometo.

translations.fr: Plus j'essaye, plus je fais d'erreurs.

translations.en: Can you please reduce the volume of the music?

translations.fr: Pourquoi, ma chère, regardes-tu de côté, baisses-tu la tête ?

translations.fr: La température est inférieure à zéro aujourd'hui.

translations.fr: Ils sont en retard, comme d'habitude.

translations.fr: Il était en retard à l'école hier.

translations.fr: Le train avait du retard ce matin.

more.etymology: From atrás (“behind”) + -ar.

examples.text: Minha irmã é mais baixa do que você.

examples.text: Hoje estou trabalhando para corrigir erros passados.

translations.de: Heute arbeite ich daran, vergangene Fehler zu korrigieren.
translations.en: Today I am working to correct past mistakes.
translations.fr: Aujourd'hui, je travaille à corriger les erreurs du passé.

more.definition: error; mistake; error (failure to complete a task, usually involving a premature termination); error (difference between a measured value and a true one)
idioms: dois erros não fazem um acerto
more.etymology: From Old Galician-Portuguese erro, from earlier error, borrowed from Latin errōrem; alternatively, a deverbal from errar (compare Spanish yerro).

examples.text: Uma viagem à lua em uma nave espacial não é mais um sonho.

translations.de: Eine Reise zum Mond in einem Raumschiff ist nicht länger ein Traum.
translations.en: A voyage to the moon in a spaceship is no longer a dream.

examples.text: O Tom encontrou uma das naves espaciais olmecas.

translations.en: Tom found one of the Olmec spaceships.

examples.text: O Tom desenhou uma nave espacial.

translations.en: Tom drew a spaceship.

examples.text: Esta nave pode alcançar velocidades altíssimas.

translations.en: This ship can reach extremely high speeds.

more.definition: ship; nave, aisle; car
more.etymology: Inherited from Old Galician-Portuguese nave, from Latin nāvis, ultimately from Proto-Indo-European *néh₂us. Doublet of nau.

examples.text: Todo apartamento deveria ter uma varanda.

translations.de: Jede Wohnung sollte einen Balkon haben.
translations.en: Every apartment should have a balcony.
translations.fr: Chaque appartement devrait avoir un balcon.

examples.text: Comprei alguns quadros para meu apartamento.

translations.de: Ich habe ein paar Bilder für meine Wohnung gekauft.
translations.en: I bought some paintings for my apartment.
translations.fr: J'ai acheté des tableaux pour mon appartement.

examples.text: Você vai alugar uma casa ou um apartamento?

translations.de: Werden Sie ein Haus oder eine Wohnung mieten?
translations.en: Will you rent a house or an apartment?
translations.fr: Tu loueras une maison ou un appartement ?

examples.text: As paredes do apartamento são brancas.

translations.de: Die Wände der Wohnung sind weiß.
translations.en: The walls of the apartment are white.
translations.fr: Les murs de l'appartement sont blancs.

more.definition: flat, apartment
more.etymology: Borrowed from Italian appartamento, possibly through French appartement and/or Spanish apartamento. Ultimately from Spanish apartamiento (“separation, seclusion”), from apartar (“to separate”). By surface analysis, apartar + -mento.

examples.text: Liguei hoje várias vezes para você, mas você não atendeu. Ligarei novamente amanhã.

translations.de: Ich habe dich heute mehrmals angerufen, aber du hast nicht abgenommen. Ich rufe morgen noch einmal an.
translations.en: I called you several times today, but you didn’t answer. I’ll call again tomorrow.
translations.fr: Je t'ai appelé plusieurs fois aujourd'hui, mais tu n'as pas répondu. Je rappellerai demain.

examples.text: Que esperem. Daqui a pouco eu os atendo.

translations.en: Let them wait. I'll be with them in a moment.
translations.fr: Qu'ils attendent. Je m'occupe d'eux dans un instant.

examples.text: Ninguém atendeu o telefone.

translations.en: Nobody answered the phone.
translations.fr: Personne ne répondit au téléphone.

examples.text: Este trabalho não atende aos nossos requisitos.

translations.en: This work does not meet our requirements.

more.definition: to answer (the phone, the door); to serve or answer (at a service counter or help desk); to take into account; to consider
more.etymology: Inherited from Latin attendere.

examples.text: O jogador chutou a bola.

translations.de: Der Spieler hat den Ball gekickt.
translations.en: The player kicked the ball.
translations.fr: Le joueur a frappé le ballon.

examples.text: Quantas bolas são usadas no jogo de bilhar?

translations.de: Wie viele Kugeln werden beim Billardspiel verwendet?
translations.en: How many balls are used in a game of billiards?
translations.fr: Combien de boules sont utilisées dans une partie de billard ?

examples.text: O cachorrinho branco está brincando com uma bola amarela no jardim.

translations.de: Der kleine weiße Hund spielt im Garten mit einem gelben Ball.
translations.en: The little white dog is playing with a yellow ball in the garden.
translations.fr: Le petit chien blanc joue avec une balle jaune dans le jardin.

examples.text: O gato está brincando com a bola.

translations.de: Die Katze spielt mit dem Ball.
translations.en: The cat is playing with the ball.
translations.fr: Le chat joue avec le ballon.

more.definition: ball, sphere, round object; ball; fat person
more.etymology: Inherited from Old Galician-Portuguese bola, borrowed from Old Occitan bolla, from Vulgar Latin *bolla, from a merger of Latin bulla with Frankish *bollā (compare English bowl). Doublet of bula and bolha.

examples.text: A fé pode mover montanhas.

translations.de: Der Glaube kann Berge versetzen.
translations.en: Faith can move mountains.
translations.fr: La foi peut soulever des montagnes.

examples.text: Movido pelo ciúme, ele agrediu violentamente o rival.

translations.de: Von Eifersucht getrieben, griff er seinen Rivalen heftig an.
translations.en: Driven by jealousy, he violently assaulted his rival.
translations.fr: Poussé par la jalousie, il attaqua violemment son rival.

examples.text: Me ajude a mover essa pedra.

translations.de: Hilf mir, diesen Stein zu versetzen.
translations.en: Help me move this stone.
translations.fr: Aide-moi à déplacer cette pierre.

examples.text: Um pequeno objeto se movia na escuridão.

translations.en: A tiny object moved in the dark.
translations.fr: Un petit objet s'est déplacé dans l'obscurité.

more.definition: to move (change position); to induce; to persuade; to sue (file legal action)
more.etymology: Inherited from Old Galician-Portuguese mover, from Latin movēre. Compare Spanish mover, French mouvoir.

examples.text: Parte da ilha ficou devastada pelas ondas gigantes.

translations.de: Ein Teil der Insel wurde durch die riesigen Wellen zerstört.
translations.en: A portion of the island was destroyed by the massive waves.
translations.fr: Une partie de l'île a été détruite par les vagues géantes.

examples.text: A vida sempre segue o rumo traçado pelas mãos do destino.

translations.de: Das Leben folgt immer dem vom Schicksal vorgegebenen Lauf.
translations.en: Life always follows the path set by the hands of destiny.
translations.fr: La vie suit toujours le cours fixé par les mains du destin.

examples.text: Ele perdeu todo o interesse pelas línguas artificiais.

translations.de: Er verlor jegliches Interesse an künstlichen Sprachen.
translations.en: He lost all interest in artificial languages.
translations.fr: Il a perdu tout intérêt pour les langues artificielles.

examples.text: Espero estar de volta lá pelas duas e meia.

translations.en: I expect to be back by 2:30.
translations.fr: J'espère être de retour autour de deux heures et demie.

more.definition: contraction of por + as, literally “by/through the (feminine plural)”: feminine plural of pelo

examples.text: É difícil planejar refeições para tantas pessoas.

translations.de: Es ist schwierig, für so viele Leute Essen zu planen.
translations.en: It is difficult planning meals for so many people.

examples.text: Não estamos planejando fazer isso juntos.

translations.de: Wir haben nicht vor, das zusammen zu machen.
translations.en: We're not planning to do that together.

examples.text: Sei exatamente com quem Tom planeja se casar.

translations.en: I know exactly who Tom plans to marry.
translations.fr: Je sais exactement avec qui Tom planifie de se marier.

examples.text: As coisas nem sempre saem da maneira que planejamos.

translations.en: Things don't always turn out the way we plan.
translations.fr: Les choses ne se passent pas toujours de la manière que nous avons prévue.

more.definition: to plan; to design (to create a technical drawing or instructions); to plan (to come up with a set of intended actions); to plan to; to plan on; to intend to (to have the intention of)
more.etymology: Ancient Greek -ῐ́ζω (-ĭ́zō)bor. From plano (“plan”) + -ejar.

senses.gloss: dispor em uma determinada ordem medidas ou ações a serem realizadas em um respectivo tempo espacial ou cronológico

examples.text: Tom escreve com a mão esquerda.

translations.en: Tom writes with his left hand.
translations.fr: Tom écrit avec sa main gauche.

translations.en: I parked on the left side of the street just in front of the school.
translations.fr: Je me suis garé du côté gauche de la rue, juste devant l'école.

examples.text: Você é um zero à esquerda!

translations.en: You're a fuck-up.
translations.fr: Tu es nul !

examples.text: Viro à esquerda no primeiro semáforo?

translations.en: Do I turn left at the first stoplight?
translations.fr: Je tourne à gauche au prochain feu rouge ?

more.definition: left; left-hand; on or towards the left side
more.etymology: Inherited from Old Galician-Portuguese esquerdo, from Old Spanish exquerdo, from Basque ezkerra, absolutive of ezker (“left hand; left side”), from Proto-Basque *ezkeR (“left hand”). Cognate with Asturian izquierdu, Catalan esquerre, Galician esquerdo, xiquerdo, Ladino izkierdo, Leonese esquierdu, Spanish izquierdo.

senses.gloss: que está do lado oposto ao direito, sinistro, sestro

examples.text: Meu copo está completamente vazio.

translations.de: Mein Glas ist komplett leer.
translations.en: My glass is completely empty.
translations.fr: Mon verre est complètement vide.

translations.en: A dark nightmare terrorizes the world. Humankind has gone completely mad.
translations.fr: Un cauchemar noir terrorise le monde. L'humanité est devenue complètement folle.

translations.fr: Le stade était complètement vide il y a un instant, mais il est déjà plein à craquer.

more.etymology: From completa + -mente.

examples.text: Precisamos de novas maneiras de apoiar os artistas.

translations.de: Wir brauchen neue Wege, um Künstler zu unterstützen.
translations.en: We need new ways to support artists.
translations.fr: Nous avons besoin de nouvelles façons de soutenir les artistes.

examples.text: Precisamos de novas formas de apoiar os artistas.

translations.de: Wir brauchen neue Wege, um Künstler zu unterstützen.
translations.en: We need new ways to support artists.
translations.fr: Nous avons besoin de nouvelles façons de soutenir les artistes.

examples.text: Muitas pessoas famosas apoiam o movimento.

translations.en: Many famous people are behind the movement.
translations.fr: Beaucoup de personnes célèbres soutiennent le mouvement.

translations.en: She doesn't need sympathy, but support.
translations.fr: Elle n'a pas besoin de compassion, mais de soutien.

more.etymology: Ultimately from Vulgar Latin *appodiāre. Unlikely to be inherited. Compare French appuyer, Italian appoggiare and Spanish apoyar.

examples.text: O Sol é a estrela mais brilhante.

translations.de: Die Sonne ist der hellste Stern.
translations.en: The sun is the most brilliant star.
translations.fr: Le soleil est l'étoile la plus brillante.

translations.de: Astronomie handelt von Sternen und Planeten.
translations.en: Astronomy deals with the stars and planets.
translations.fr: L'astronomie traite des étoiles et des planètes.

examples.text: Antares é uma estrela vermelha.

translations.de: Antares ist ein roter Stern.
translations.en: Antares is a red star.
translations.fr: Antarès est une étoile rouge.

examples.text: Somos pó de estrela.

translations.de: Wir sind Sternenstaub.
translations.en: We are stardust.
translations.fr: Nous sommes de la poussière d'étoiles.

more.definition: star (apparently fixed star that has its own light and heat); star (any celestial body); star (radiated figure suggesting a star)
more.etymology: Inherited from Old Galician-Portuguese estrela /strela, from Latin stēlla (probably through an unattested regional Latin *strēlla), from Proto-Indo-European *h₂stḗr. Doublet of Estela. Cognate with Aragonese estrela, Catalan estrella, French étoile, Galician estrela, Italian stella, Occitan estela, Romanian stea and Spanish estrella.

senses.gloss: corpo celeste onde ocorrem fenômenos que produzem luz

examples.text: As câmeras não costumam captar a realidade.

translations.de: Kameras pflegen nicht die Wirklichkeit einzufangen.
translations.en: Cameras don't tend to capture reality.

translations.de: Diese Kamera ist sehr teuer.
translations.en: This camera is very expensive.
translations.fr: Cet appareil photo est très cher.

examples.text: Eu tenho duas câmeras.

translations.de: Ich habe zwei Kameras.
translations.en: I have two cameras.

examples.text: Finalmente decidiu-se que as lojas seriam equipadas de câmeras de segurança.

translations.en: Eventually it was decided that the stores be equipped with surveillance cameras.
translations.fr: Finalement, il fut décidé que les magasins seraient équipés de caméras de surveillance.

more.etymology: Variant of câmara tracing back to Latin camera; compare English camera. Some sources state that the word may be a Brazilianism.

senses.gloss: aparelho usado para tirar fotografias e/ou filmar

examples.text: Obrigada a ambas.

translations.de: Danke, ihr zwei!
translations.en: Thanks to both of you.

examples.text: Obrigado a ambos.

translations.en: Thanks to both of you.
translations.fr: Merci à vous deux.

more.definition: both
more.etymology: From Old Galician-Portuguese ambos, from Latin ambōs, from Proto-Indo-European *h₂m̥bʰi (“round about, around”).

translations.fr: Quelle belle chanson ! La mélodie et les paroles, toutes deux belles, touchent nos cœurs.

translations.de: Wir lebten beide, ohne an diese genussvollen Stunden der Wärme und Leidenschaft zu denken.

examples.text: Pensei que ambas as frases fossem corretas.

translations.de: Ich dachte, dass beide Sätze richtig sind.
translations.en: I thought both sentences were correct.
translations.fr: Je pensais que les deux phrases étaient correctes.

examples.text: Ela pôs ambas as mãos em cruz sobre o peito.

translations.de: Sie legte beide Hände über Kreuz auf ihre Brust.
translations.en: She placed both hands crosswise on her chest.
translations.fr: Elle a posé ses deux mains en croix sur sa poitrine.

more.definition: both
more.etymology: From Old Galician-Portuguese ambos, from Latin ambōs, from Proto-Indo-European *h₂m̥bʰi (“round about, around”).

senses.gloss: os dois que foram enumerados anteriormente

examples.text: Elas vão a um bar.

translations.en: They go to a bar.

examples.text: Há algum bar ou restaurante neste andar?

translations.de: Gibt es auf dieser Etage ein Restaurant oder eine Bar?
translations.en: Is there a restaurant or bar on this floor?

examples.text: Ela é jovem demais para frequentar bares.

translations.en: She is too young to go to bars.

examples.text: Tom foi expulso do bar por brigar.

translations.en: Tom got kicked out of the bar for fighting.

more.definition: pub; bar (establishment that serves alcoholic beverages primarily); bar (unit of pressure)
more.etymology: Borrowed from English bar. Doublet of barra.

senses.gloss: dependência de hotel, de restaurante, de estabelecimento onde se vendem bebidas normalmente com um balcão; sala ou botequim com tal balcão

examples.text: Ele não recusava desafios. Aceitava missões que pareciam impossíveis.

translations.fr: Il n'a jamais refusé un défi. Il a accepté des missions qui semblaient impossibles.

examples.text: Espero que a sua missão na Inglaterra tenha sido um sucesso.

translations.en: I hope your assignment in England was successful.
translations.fr: J'espère que votre mission en Angleterre a été un succès.

examples.text: Tom foi forçado a abandonar a missão.

translations.en: Tom was forced to abandon the mission.

examples.text: Eu tenho uma missão importante para você.

translations.en: I have an important mission for you.

more.definition: mission (set of tasks that fulfills a purpose or duty; an assignment); quest (task that a player may complete in order to gain a reward or advance the story); mission (group of people appointed to perform a service; a delegation; an embassy)
more.etymology: Inherited from Old Galician-Portuguese misson, mison, from Latin missiōnem.

senses.gloss: função ou poder que se confere a alguém para agir

examples.text: Ai de mim! Se me abandonares, morrerei de tristeza.

translations.de: Wehe mir! Wenn du mich verlässt, werde ich vor Kummer sterben.
translations.en: Alas! If you abandon me, I will die of grief.
translations.fr: Malheur à moi ! Si tu m'abandonnes, je mourrai de chagrin.

examples.text: Ai! Fui picado por uma abelha!

translations.de: Au! Eine Biene hat mich gestochen!
translations.en: Ouch!! I've been stung by a bee!!

examples.text: Ai, se eu te pego!

translations.en: Oh, if I catch you!
translations.fr: Ah, si je te prends !

examples.text: Ai, ai! Mordi a língua!

translations.en: Ow, ow! I bit my tongue!

more.definition: ouch (expression of physical pain); oh (expression of concern)
more.etymology: Onomatopoeic.

examples.text: As laranjas são ricas em vitamina C.

translations.de: Orangen sind reich an Vitamin C.
translations.en: Oranges contain a lot of vitamin C.
translations.fr: Les oranges sont riches en vitamine C.

examples.text: A garota parece rica.

translations.de: Das Mädchen scheint reich zu sein.
translations.en: The girl seems to be rich.
translations.fr: La jeune fille semble être riche.

examples.text: Ele é rico, mas não é feliz.

translations.de: Er ist reich, aber nicht glücklich.
translations.en: He's rich, but he isn't happy.
translations.fr: Il est riche mais il n'est pas heureux.

examples.text: Nós somos ricas.

translations.de: Wir sind reich.
translations.en: We're rich.
translations.fr: Nous sommes riches.

more.definition: rich, wealthy; luxurious; tasty
more.etymology: From Old Galician-Portuguese rico (“rich”), from Gothic 𐍂𐌴𐌹𐌺𐍃 (reiks, “mighty, powerful”), from Proto-Germanic *rīkijaz (“royal, mighty, powerful”), from Proto-Celtic *rīxs (“king”), ultimately from Proto-Indo-European *h₃rḗǵs (“king, ruler”). senses.gloss: diz-se de quem tem muito dinheiro

examples.text: O Japão é um país rico.

examples.text: Meu irmão é rico.

translations.de: Mein Bruder ist reich.

translations.fr: Mon frère est riche.

examples.text: Se eu fosse rico, eu te ajudaria.

translations.de: Wenn ich reich wäre, würde ich dir helfen.
translations.en: If I were rich, I would help you.
translations.fr: Si j'étais riche, je t'aiderais.

more.etymology: :Do gótico reiks⁽ᵍᵒᵗ⁾ (poderoso).

examples.text: Esta frase deve ser verificada por um locutor nativo.

translations.de: Dieser Satz bedarf der Prüfung durch einen Muttersprachler.
translations.en: This sentence needs to be checked by a native speaker.
translations.fr: Cette phrase doit être vérifiée par un locuteur natif.

examples.text: Eu gostaria de verificar.

translations.fr: J'aimerais vérifier.

translations.en: Check that your username and password are written correctly.
translations.fr: Vérifie que ton nom d'utilisateur et ton mot de passe sont écrits correctement.

examples.text: Eles verificaram se o quarto estava vazio.

examples.text: A beleza da flor lhe acentua o perfume.

translations.de: Die Schönheit der Blume verstärkt ihren Duft.
translations.en: The beauty of the flower enhances its fragrance.
translations.fr: La beauté de la fleur rehausse son parfum.

examples.text: A beleza é inerente à estrutura da realidade.

translations.de: Schönheit ist der Struktur der Realität inhärent.
translations.en: Beauty is inherent in the structure of reality.
translations.fr: La beauté est inscrite dans la structure même de la réalité.

examples.text: O cavalo é um animal que corre com muita graça e beleza.

translations.de: Das Pferd ist ein Tier, das mit großer Anmut und Schönheit läuft.
translations.en: The horse is an animal that runs with great grace and beauty.
translations.fr: Le cheval est un animal qui court avec une grande grâce et une grande beauté.

examples.text: A singela beleza dos teus versos enterneceu-me o coração, me fez chorar.

translations.de: Die schlichte Schönheit Ihrer Verse berührte mein Herz und brachte mich zum Weinen.
translations.en: The simple beauty of your verses touched my heart and made me cry.
translations.fr: La simple beauté de vos vers a touché mon cœur et m’a fait pleurer.

more.definition: what's up? (informal greeting); all right; okay (used either as a question or answer/agreement)
more.etymology: Borrowed from Old Occitan belleza or Italian bellezza, both from Vulgar Latin *bellitia, a noun based on Latin bellus (“pretty”). By surface analysis, belo + -eza. Compare Spanish belleza and Catalan bellesa.

examples.text: Ela deixa muitas saudades, mas também muitas belezas.

translations.de: Sie hinterlässt viel Nostalgie, aber auch viel Schönheit.
translations.en: She leaves behind a lot of nostalgia, but also a lot of beauty.
translations.fr: Elle laisse derrière elle beaucoup de nostalgie, mais aussi beaucoup de beauté.

examples.text: A beleza da noiva é metade do dote.

translations.de: Die Schönheit der Braut ist die Hälfte der Mitgift.
translations.en: The bride's beauty is half the dowry.
translations.fr: La beauté de la mariée représente la moitié de la dot.

examples.text: A beleza é fugaz instante, é perfeição imaginária – doce, onírica visão.

translations.de: Schönheit ist ein flüchtiger Augenblick, eine imaginäre Vollkommenheit – eine süße, traumhafte Vision.
translations.en: Beauty is a fleeting instant, an imaginary perfection – a sweet, dreamlike vision.
translations.fr: La beauté est un instant fugace, une perfection imaginaire – une vision douce et onirique.

examples.text: Como era bom contar com a poética beleza das frases dela em Tatoeba!

translations.de: Wie schön war es, die poetische Schönheit ihrer Sätze in Tatoeba zu erleben!
translations.en: How nice it was to have the poetic beauty of her sentences in Tatoeba!
translations.fr: Comme c'était merveilleux d'avoir dans Tatoeba la beauté poétique de ses phrases !

more.definition: beauty (the condition of being beautiful); beauty (a beautiful thing or person)
more.etymology: Borrowed from Old Occitan belleza or Italian bellezza, both from Vulgar Latin *bellitia, a noun based on Latin bellus (“pretty”). By surface analysis, belo + -eza. Compare Spanish belleza and Catalan bellesa.

examples.text: Há um declínio significativo no respeito à autoridade e à tradição.

translations.de: Es ist ein deutlicher Rückgang des Respekts vor Autorität und Tradition zu verzeichnen.
translations.en: There’s a noticeable decline in respect for authority and tradition.
translations.fr: On observe un déclin significatif du respect de l'autorité et de la tradition.

examples.text: Deve-se o maior respeito à criança.

translations.de: Dem Kind gebührt der größte Respekt.
translations.en: The greatest respect is due to the child.
translations.fr: Le plus grand respect est dû à l'enfant.

examples.text: Ao traduzir, é preciso ter todo o rigor e nenhum respeito pelo original.

translations.de: Beim Übersetzen muss man mit aller Strenge vorgehen und darf keinen Respekt vor dem Original haben.
translations.en: When translating, one must have all the rigor and no respect for the original.
translations.fr: Lors de la traduction, il est nécessaire d'avoir toute la rigueur et aucun respect pour l'original.

examples.text: Isso não lhe diz respeito.

translations.de: Das geht dich nichts an.
translations.en: That's none of your business.
translations.fr: Ça ne te regarde pas.

more.definition: to respect, look up to; to revere, venerate; to honour
more.etymology: From Latin respectāre.

examples.text: Viajar é mudar o cenário da solidão.

translations.de: Reisen heißt, die Szenerie der Einsamkeit zu ändern.
translations.en: To travel is to change the scene of loneliness.
translations.fr: Voyager, c'est changer le paysage de la solitude.

examples.text: Quem muito viajou muita mentira conta.

translations.de: Wer viel reist, erzählt viele Lügen.
translations.en: Those who travel a lot tell a lot of lies.
translations.fr: Ceux qui voyagent beaucoup racontent beaucoup de mensonges.

examples.text: Elas querem viajar.

translations.de: Sie wollen reisen.
translations.en: They want to travel.
translations.fr: Elles veulent voyager.

examples.text: Eles querem viajar.

translations.de: Sie wollen reisen.
translations.en: They want to travel.
translations.fr: Ils veulent voyager.

more.definition: to travel; to not pay attention; to be nonsensical (vid. viajado)
more.etymology: From viagem + -ar.

senses.gloss: ir de um lugar para outro, geralmente distante

examples.text: Tom tem uma irmã chamada Mary e uma prima também chamada Mary.

translations.de: Tom hat eine Schwester namens Mary und eine Cousine namens Mary.
translations.en: Tom has a sister named Mary and a cousin also named Mary.
translations.fr: Tom a une sœur nommée Mary et une cousine également nommée Mary.

examples.text: Uma garota chamada Kate veio aqui te ver.

translations.en: A girl named Kate came to see you.
translations.fr: Une fille du nom de Kate est passée pour te voir.

translations.en: A woman whose husband is dead is called a widow.
translations.fr: Une femme dont le mari est mort s'appelle une veuve.

examples.text: Uma criança que perdeu seus dois pais é chamada de órfã.

translations.de: Ein Kind, das beide Eltern verloren hat, nennt man Waise.
translations.en: A child who has lost both his parents is called an orphan.

more.definition: call (telephone conversation); dressing-down (reprimand, rebuke, reprehension); roll (a list of names or an official register of names)
more.etymology: (Morfologia) chamar + -ada.

examples.text: Espero por nada. Não temo nada. Estou livre.

translations.de: Ich erhoffe nichts. Ich fürchte nichts. Ich bin frei.
translations.en: I hope for nothing. I fear nothing. I am free.
translations.fr: Je n'espère rien, je ne crains rien, je suis libre.

examples.text: A única coisa que devemos temer é o próprio medo.

translations.de: Das Einzige, wovor wir Angst haben müssen, ist die Angst selbst.
translations.en: The only thing we have to fear is fear itself.
translations.fr: La seule chose dont nous devons avoir peur est la peur elle-même.

examples.text: O Tom não teme a morte.

translations.fr: Tom n'a pas peur de la mort.

examples.text: As pessoas temem a guerra.

translations.en: The people fear war.

examples.text: Vou dar uma olhada na casa.

translations.fr: Je vais aller voir la maison.

examples.text: Por que você está tão nervoso esta noite?

examples.text: Elas ficam nervosas.

translations.de: Sie werden nervös.

examples.text: O dado está lançado.

translations.de: Der Regenbogen wirft Regen auf die Erde.
translations.en: The rainbow casts rain on the earth.
translations.fr: L'arc-en-ciel jette la pluie sur la terre.

translations.fr: Il lance plusieurs hameçons pour voir s'il peut attraper quelque poisson.

examples.text: Espero que isso não seja uma recusa.

translations.de: Ich hoffe, das ist keine Ablehnung.
translations.en: I hope this isn't a refusal.
translations.fr: J'espère que ce n'est pas un refus.

more.etymology: Inherited from Old Galician-Portuguese lançar, from Late Latin lanceāre (“to throw a spear”), derived from Latin lancea (“spear”), from Celtiberian. Doublet of lancear and lança.

examples.text: Eu vou sobreviver.

examples.text: Dentro da colmeia, cheirava a mel.

translations.de: Im Bienenstock roch es nach Honig.

Cognate to Galician cheirar, Extremaduran cheral, Catalan and Occitan flairar, Sicilian ciagurari, French flairer, and English flair (through Old French flair).

senses.gloss: aspirar o cheiro de; farejar; pesquisar; revelar

examples.text: Se há peixes em Netuno, são certamente gasosos.

translations.fr: S'il y a des poissons sur Neptune, ils sont certainement gazeux.

translations.en: You are certainly homesick.

translations.fr: L'endroit vaut certainement la peine d'être vu.

examples.text: O grande herói romano, Júlio César, foi assassinado.

translations.de: Ich bin kein Held.
translations.en: I'm not a hero.
translations.fr: Je ne suis pas un héros.

more.etymology: From Latin hērōs (“hero”), from Ancient Greek ἥρως (hḗrōs, “demi-god, hero”), from Proto-Indo-European *ser- (“to watch over, protect”).

examples.text: Os pássaros estão construindo um ninho.

translations.de: Die Vögel bauen ein Nest.

translations.fr: C'était une femme qui dirigeait l'entreprise.

translations.fr: Que faites-vous dans cette entreprise ?

translations.fr: Cette entreprise s'est développée en exploitant les travailleurs.

translations.de: Ich arbeite als Träger für diese Transportfirma.
translations.en: I work as a porter for this transportation company.

more.etymology: Italian imprenderedeverb. Italian impresabor. Borrowed from Italian impresa.

examples.text: Amanhã chegaremos à metade do ano.

translations.de: Morgen erreichen wir die Hälfte des Jahres.
translations.en: Tomorrow we will reach the halfway point of the year.
translations.fr: Demain, nous atteindrons la mi-année.

examples.text: A beleza da noiva é metade do dote.

translations.fr: Je suis sûr d'avoir depuis longtemps dépassé la moitié de ma longue vie.

translations.en: Half for you and half for me.
translations.fr: Moitié pour toi, moitié pour moi.

examples.text: Ele assinou o cheque.

translations.fr: Êtes-vous abonné à un magazine ?

translations.fr: Vous êtes impliqués.

examples.text: Sonhar não custa nada.

translations.en: Dreaming costs nothing.
translations.fr: Rêver ne coûte rien.

translations.en: How much does a kilogram of apples cost?
translations.fr: Combien coûte un kilo de pommes ?

translations.de: Wie viel kostet eine Busfahrkarte?
translations.en: How much does a bus ticket cost?
translations.fr: Combien coûte un ticket de bus ?

examples.text: A tradução é uma arte, não uma ciência exata.

translations.en: Translation is an art, not an exact science.
translations.fr: La traduction est un art, pas une science exacte.

translations.en: All the translations you suggested are good. I chose the simplest one.
translations.fr: Toutes les traductions que vous proposez sont bonnes. J'ai choisi la plus simple.

examples.text: A principal qualidade de uma tradução é a exatidão.

translations.de: Die wichtigste Eigenschaft einer Übersetzung ist ihre Genauigkeit.

senses.gloss: aquilo que é essencial ou indispensável

examples.text: Sabemos que é difícil largar o cigarro.

more.definition: to threaten (to make a threat against someone; to use threats); to endanger, menace; to portend, threaten
more.etymology: From Old Galician-Portuguese amẽaçar, a variant of mẽaçar, either from mẽaça (“threat”) + -ar, or from a hypothetical Vulgar Latin *admināciāre (“to threaten”) < *mināciāre (“threaten”), from minācia (“threat”), from Latin mināciae. Cognate with English menace. Compare Catalan and Occitan amenaçar, French menacer, Galician ameazar, Italian minacciare, Romanian amenința, Sicilian amminazzari, Spanish amenazar.

senses.gloss: advertir (alguém que algo lhe pode acontecer)

examples.text: É melhor tentar e falhar do que nunca tentar.

translations.de: Versuchen und scheitern ist besser, als nie etwas zu versuchen.
translations.en: It's better to try and fail, than never try at all.
translations.fr: Mieux vaut tenter et échouer que de ne jamais tenter.

examples.text: A estupidez é incurável. Não há pílula que ajude. Até a aspirina falha.

translations.de: Doof bleibt doof – da helfen keine Pillen. Selbst Aspirin versagt.
translations.en: Stupidity is incurable. No pill will help. Even aspirin fails.

examples.text: Eu falhei em ir lá a tempo.

translations.en: I failed to go there in time.

examples.text: Meus planos falharam um após o outro.

translations.en: My plans failed one after another.

more.definition: to fail
more.etymology: From falha, itself from a Vulgar Latin falla or falia (possibly partly through the intermediate or influence of Old French faille or Old Occitan), or from Old Galician-Portuguese fallar, from Vulgar Latin or Late Latin fallāre, from Latin fallere.

examples.text: O leite estraga rapidamente quando está calor.

translations.en: Milk spoils quickly when it's hot.
translations.fr: Le lait tourne rapidement par temps chaud.

examples.text: Todos os ovos se estragaram.

translations.en: All the eggs went bad.
translations.fr: Tous les œufs se gâtèrent.

examples.text: Em dias quentes os mantimentos se estragam mais rápido.

translations.de: An heißen Tagen verderben Lebensmittel schneller.
translations.en: Food decays more quickly in hot weather.

examples.text: A carne estragou-se.

translations.en: The meat spoiled.
translations.fr: La viande s'était avariée.

more.definition: to spoil, to damage, to corrupt, to ruin, to break; to botch, bungle; to go bad (of foods and commodities)
more.etymology: From Old Galician-Portuguese estragar, from Vulgar Latin *strāgāre, from Latin strāgēs (“defeat, slaughter”).

examples.text: Essa troca não é incorreta, mas deve ser evitada.

translations.de: Dieser Austausch ist zwar nicht falsch, sollte aber vermieden werden.
translations.en: This exchange isn't incorrect, but it should be avoided.
translations.fr: Cet échange n'est pas incorrect, mais il doit être évité.

examples.text: Em português, deve evitar-se essa expressão, pois ela pode sugerir algo ofensivo.

translations.de: Im Portugiesischen sollte dieser Ausdruck vermieden werden, da er den Eindruck einer Beleidigung erwecken könnte.
translations.en: In Portuguese, this expression should be avoided, as it may suggest something offensive.
translations.fr: En portugais, cette expression doit être évitée, car elle peut suggérer quelque chose d'offensant.

examples.text: Yara está me evitando.

translations.de: Jara weicht mir aus.
translations.en: Yara is avoiding me.

examples.text: É difícil evitar cometer erros na vida.

translations.de: Es ist kaum vermeidbar, im Leben Fehler zu machen.
translations.en: It's hard to avoid making mistakes in life.

more.definition: to avoid
more.etymology: Latin ēvītārelbor. Learned borrowing from Latin ēvītāre.

examples.text: A democracia é a ditadura da maioria.

translations.de: Demokratie ist die Diktatur der Mehrheit.
translations.en: Democracy is the dictatorship of the majority.
translations.fr: La démocratie est la dictature de la majorité.

examples.text: A maioria de seus amigos são garotas.

translations.en: Most of his friends are girls.
translations.fr: La plupart de ses amis sont des filles.

examples.text: A maioria dos meninos gosta de beisebol.

translations.en: Most boys like baseball.
translations.fr: La plupart des garçons aiment le baseball.

examples.text: A maioria das placas está em inglês.

translations.de: Die meisten Schilder sind auf Englisch.
translations.en: Most signs are written in English.

more.definition: majority (more than half)
more.etymology: From maior (“bigger; greater”) + -ia (“-y”), from Old Galician-Portuguese maior, from Latin maior (“bigger; greater”), from Proto-Indo-European *mag- (“great”) + *-yos (“comparative suffix”).

examples.text: Respirar ficou difícil.

translations.de: Das Atmen wurde beschwerlich.
translations.en: Breathing became difficult.
translations.fr: Respirer devint difficile.

examples.text: Respire mais fundo!

translations.de: Atmen Sie noch tiefer ein!
translations.fr: Respirez plus profondément !

examples.text: Ela respirou fundo e começou a falar de si.

translations.de: Sie atmete tief ein und begann, von ihrer Lage zu erzählen.
translations.en: She took a deep breath and then started to talk about herself.

examples.text: É como o ar que nós respiramos.

translations.en: It is like the air we breathe.

more.definition: to breathe
more.etymology: Inherited from Latin respīrāre.

examples.text: Estão postos naquele infante amado todos os seus cuidados de bom pai.

translations.de: All seine Fürsorge als guter Vater gilt diesem geliebten Kind.
translations.en: All his care as a good father is placed on that beloved child.
translations.fr: Tout l'amour d'un bon père se trouve dans cet enfant bien-aimé.

examples.text: Sua vida mudou naquele instante.

translations.de: Sein Leben veränderte sich in diesem Augenblick.
translations.en: His life changed at that moment.
translations.fr: Sa vie a basculé en cet instant.

examples.text: Eu fui muito feliz naquela cidade.

translations.de: Ich war sehr glücklich in dieser Stadt.
translations.en: I was very happy in that city.
translations.fr: J'ai été très heureux dans cette ville.

examples.text: Naquela época ele só tinha doze anos.

translations.de: Er war damals erst zwölf Jahre alt.
translations.en: He was only twelve years old at the time.
translations.fr: À cette période il avait seulement douze ans.

more.definition: contraction of em + aquele, literally “in that”
more.etymology: (Morfologia) em + aquele

senses.gloss: contração da preposição em com o pronome ou determinante demonstrativo aquele

examples.text: Os suíços consomem muita cerveja.

translations.de: Die Schweizer konsumieren viel Bier.
translations.en: The Swiss consume a large amount of beer.
translations.fr: Les Suisses consomment beaucoup de bière.

examples.text: Eu não bebo muita cerveja.

translations.de: Ich trinke nicht viel Bier.
translations.en: I don't drink much beer.
translations.fr: Je ne bois pas beaucoup de bière.

examples.text: Tom não bebe cerveja.

translations.de: Tom trinkt kein Bier.
translations.en: Tom doesn't drink beer.
translations.fr: Tom ne boit pas de bière.

examples.text: Eu poderia tomar outro copo de cerveja?

translations.de: Könnte ich noch ein Glas Bier haben?
translations.en: Could I have another glass of beer?
translations.fr: Pourrais-je avoir un autre verre de bière ?

more.definition: beer
more.etymology: Inherited from Old Galician-Portuguese cerveja, from Latin cervēs(i)a. Compare Spanish cerveza.

senses.gloss: bebida alcoólica fraca obtida a partir da fermentação da cevada germinada a que se junta água e flores de lúpulo

examples.text: Eu quero me tornar mais inteligente.

translations.de: Ich will intelligenter werden.
translations.en: I want to get smarter.
translations.fr: Je veux devenir plus intelligent.

examples.text: Os golfinhos são animais muito inteligentes.

translations.de: Delphine sind sehr intelligente Tiere.
translations.en: Dolphins are very intelligent animals.
translations.fr: Les dauphins sont des animaux très intelligents.

examples.text: Tom é inteligente.

translations.de: Tom ist intelligent.
translations.en: Tom is insightful.
translations.fr: Tom est intelligent.

examples.text: Eu sou inteligente.

translations.de: Ich bin intelligent.
translations.en: I am intelligent.
translations.fr: Je suis intelligent.

more.definition: intelligent (of high or especially quick cognitive capacity, bright)
more.etymology: Borrowed from Latin intelligentem, form of intellegēns (“understanding”).

examples.text: Existem manchas escuras na Lua e no Sol.

translations.de: Es gibt dunkle Flecken auf dem Mond und der Sonne.
translations.en: There are dark spots on the Moon and the Sun.
translations.fr: La Lune et le Soleil présentent des taches sombres.

examples.text: Depois do dia do Sol vem o dia da Lua.

translations.de: Nach dem Tag der Sonne kommt der Tag des Mondes.
translations.en: After the day of the Sun comes the day of the Moon.
translations.fr: Après le jour du Soleil vient le jour de la Lune.

examples.text: Um pequeno raio de sol entrou pela janela da minha vida.

translations.de: Ein kleiner Sonnenstrahl drang durch das Fenster meines Lebens.
translations.en: A small ray of sunshine entered through the window of my life.
translations.fr: Un petit rayon de soleil est entré par la fenêtre de ma vie.

examples.text: O sol brilha.

translations.de: Die Sonne scheint.
translations.en: The sun rises.
translations.fr: Le soleil brille.

more.definition: sun; sunlight, sunshine (the light and heat which are received from the sun); sun (a day); sun (a star, especially one at the center of a solar system)
more.etymology: Inherited from Old Galician-Portuguese sol, from Latin sōl (“sun”).

senses.gloss: centro e principal astro do sistema solar

examples.text: Eu não te reconheci com o seu novo corte de cabelo.

translations.de: Ich habe dich mit deiner neuen Frisur nicht erkannt.
translations.en: I didn't recognize you with your new haircut.
translations.fr: Je ne t'ai pas reconnu avec ta nouvelle coupe de cheveux.

examples.text: Ela o reconheceu pela voz.

translations.de: Sie erkannte ihn an seiner Stimme.
translations.en: She recognized him by his voice.
translations.fr: Elle l'a reconnu à sa voix.

examples.text: Reconheço que fui muito imprudente e que mereço as críticas recebidas.

translations.de: Ich gebe zu, dass ich sehr rücksichtslos war und verdiente Kritik erhalten habe.
translations.en: I admit that I was very reckless and that I received deserved criticism.
translations.fr: Je reconnais que j'ai été très imprudent et que je mérite les critiques que j'ai reçues.

examples.text: Você ainda reconhece muitas palavras de vocabulário.

translations.en: You still recognize many vocabulary words.
translations.fr: Vous reconnaissez encore de nombreux mots de vocabulaire.

examples.text: Eu acho que o Tom me reconheceu.

translations.en: I think Tom recognized me.
translations.fr: Je crois que Tom m'a reconnu.

examples.text: Eu o reconheci ao primeiro relance de olhos.

translations.en: I recognized him at first glance.
translations.fr: Je l'ai reconnu au premier coup d'œil.

more.definition: to recognize; to acknowledge
collocations: reconhecer um erro — to admit a mistake
more.etymology: Inherited from Old Galician-Portuguese reconnocer, from Latin recognōscere.

examples.text: Está quieto demais.

translations.de: Es ist zu ruhig.
translations.en: It is too quiet.
translations.fr: C'est trop calme.

examples.text: Como é a vizinhança? Quieta? Barulhenta à noite?

translations.en: How's the neighborhood? Quiet? Noisy at night?
translations.fr: Comment est le voisinage ? Calme ? Bruyant la nuit ?

examples.text: Fique quieto, por favor! Não faça nenhum barulho.

translations.de: Seien Sie ruhig, bitte! Machen Sie keinen Lärm.
translations.en: Be quiet, please! Don't make a sound.

examples.text: Fique quieto. Não fale no teatro.

translations.en: Be quiet. Don't talk in the theater.
translations.fr: Taisez-vous. Ne parlez pas dans la salle de spectacle.

more.definition: quiet (with little or no sound); quiet (having little motion or activity; calm); quiet (not talking much or not talking loudly; reserved)
more.etymology: Learned borrowing from Latin quiētus. Doublet of quedo and quite, which were inherited from Old Galician-Portuguese.

senses.gloss: que não tem ou não faz movimento

examples.text: Na política impera a corrupção.

translations.de: In der Politik herrscht Korruption.
translations.en: Corruption reigns in politics.
translations.fr: La corruption règne en politique.

translations.de: Das Ziel der Politik hängt von den Politikern ab.
translations.en: The goal of politics depends on the politicians.
translations.fr: Le but de la politique dépend des politiciens.

translations.de: Die Menschen haben diese Art von Politik satt.
translations.en: People are fed up with this kind of politics.
translations.fr: Les gens en ont assez de ce genre de politique.

translations.fr: Ces politiciens confondent vie publique et vie privée.

examples.text: Espero retornar à França.

translations.de: Ich hoffe, nach Frankreich zurückzukehren.
translations.en: I hope to return to France.
translations.fr: J'espère retourner en France.

examples.text: O Tom retornou para a Austrália.

translations.en: Tom returned to Australia.
translations.fr: Tom est retourné en Australie.

examples.text: O sorriso que você envia retorna a você.

translations.de: Das Lächeln, das du aussendest, kehrt zu dir zurück.
translations.fr: Le sourire que vous envoyez revient vers vous.

examples.text: Ele está no trabalho agora, mas retornará às sete.

translations.en: He is at work now, but will return at seven.
translations.fr: Il est au travail en ce moment, mais sera de retour à sept heures.

more.definition: to return (to come or go back); to return (give something back to its original holder or owner); to return (to take something back to the seller for a refund)
more.etymology: (Morfologia) re- + tornar.

examples.text: Uma semana tem sete dias.

translations.de: Eine Woche hat sieben Tage.
translations.en: A week has seven days.
translations.fr: Une semaine a sept jours.

examples.text: Ele tem sete filhos.

translations.de: Er hat sieben Söhne.
translations.en: He has seven sons.
translations.fr: Il a sept fils.

examples.text: Ela tem sete filhos.

translations.de: Sie hat sieben Söhne.
translations.en: She has seven sons.
translations.fr: Elle a sept fils.

examples.text: Minha mulher nasceu um ano, sete meses e uma semana antes de mim.

translations.de: Meine Frau wurde ein Jahr, sieben Monate und eine Woche vor mir geboren.
translations.en: My wife was born one year, seven months, and one week before me.
translations.fr: Ma femme est née un an, sept mois et une semaine avant moi.

examples.text: Oito é o número entre sete e nove.

translations.de: Acht ist die Zahl zwischen sieben und neun.
translations.en: Eight is the number between seven and nine.
translations.fr: Huit est le nombre entre sept et neuf.

examples.text: Ivan chegou aqui no dia sete de maio.

translations.de: Ivan kam hier am siebten Mai an.
translations.en: Ivan arrived here on the seventh of May.
translations.fr: Ivan est arrivé ici le 7 mai.

examples.text: Uma semana tem sete dias.

translations.de: Eine Woche hat sieben Tage.
translations.en: A week has seven days.
translations.fr: Une semaine a sept jours.

examples.text: Ele tem sete filhos.

translations.de: Er hat sieben Söhne.
translations.en: He has seven sons.
translations.fr: Il a sept fils.

more.definition: seven
more.etymology: Inherited from Old Galician-Portuguese sete, from Latin septem, from Proto-Italic *septəm, from Proto-Indo-European *septḿ̥.

examples.text: Escreva-lhe imediatamente!

translations.de: Schreib sofort an ihn!
translations.en: Write to him right away.
translations.fr: Écris-lui immédiatement !

examples.text: Levante-se imediatamente e se apronte.

translations.de: Steh sofort auf und mach dich bereit.
translations.en: Get up immediately and get ready.
translations.fr: Lève-toi immédiatement et prépare-toi.

examples.text: Navegue imediatamente para a Itália e funde ali uma nova Troia.

translations.de: Segle sofort nach Italien und gründe dort ein neues Troja.
translations.en: Set sail immediately to Italy and found a new Troy there.
translations.fr: Naviguez immédiatement vers l'Italie et fondez-y une nouvelle Troie.

examples.text: Me diga imediatamente, onde está minha bolsa?

translations.en: Tell me immediately, where is my bag?
translations.fr: Dis-moi tout de suite où est mon sac.

more.definition: immediately
more.etymology: From imediata + -mente.

examples.text: A tradução é experiência preciosa, aprendizado de eficácia comprovada.

translations.de: Übersetzen ist eine wertvolle Erfahrung, Lernen von nachgewiesener Wirksamkeit.
translations.en: Translation is a precious experience, learning with proven effectiveness.
translations.fr: La traduction est une expérience précieuse, apprentissage d'une efficacité prouvée.

examples.text: O resultado dessa experiência foi desastroso.

translations.de: Das Ergebnis dieser Erfahrung war katastrophal.
translations.en: The outcome of that experiment was disastrous.
translations.fr: Le résultat de cette expérience a été désastreux.

examples.text: Todos nós podemos nos beneficiar da experiência dele.

translations.de: Wir können alle von seiner Erfahrung profitieren.
translations.en: We can all benefit from his experience.
translations.fr: Nous pouvons tous bénéficier de son expérience.

examples.text: Tatoeba é uma caixinha de experiências e surpresas maravilhosas!

translations.de: Tatoeba ist ein Kästchen voller wunderbarer Erlebnisse und Überraschungen!
translations.en: Tatoeba is a box full of wonderful experiences and surprises!
translations.fr: Tatoeba est une boîte pleine de merveilleuses expériences et surprises !

more.definition: experience (event(s) of which one is cognizant); knowledge gathered throughout time; experiment
more.etymology: Proto-Indo-European *perh₃-der. Latin -nsder. Latin experientialbor. Learned borrowing from Latin experientia (“experience”).

senses.gloss: algo que se viveu, que se vivenciou

examples.text: Processo contra quem tentou aplicar golpe de estado não é caça às bruxas.

translations.de: Das Verfahren gegen diejenigen, die einen Staatsstreich versucht haben, ist keine Hexenjagd.
translations.en: Prosecuting those who attempted a coup is not a witch hunt.
translations.fr: Les poursuites engagées contre ceux qui ont tenté de renverser le gouvernement ne constituent pas une chasse aux sorcières.

examples.text: Sua transição de homem para mulher está se processando bem.

translations.en: His transition from male to female is going well.
translations.fr: Sa transition d'homme à femme se passe bien.

examples.text: Eu preferiria qualquer coisa a um processo.

translations.en: I would prefer any alternative to a lawsuit.
translations.fr: Je préférerais n'importe quoi plutôt qu'un procès.

examples.text: Você não pode processar a si mesmo.

translations.en: You cannot sue yourself.

more.definition: to process; to sue
more.etymology: From processo + -ar.

senses.gloss: colocar um processo contra alguém, alguma empresa ou algo qualquer.

examples.text: Nós temos poucas oportunidades de falar alemão.

translations.en: We have few opportunities to speak German.
translations.fr: Nous n'avons pas beaucoup d'occasion de parler allemand.

examples.text: Vou ao museu sempre que tenho a oportunidade.

translations.en: I go to the museum whenever I get the chance.
translations.fr: Je me rends au musée chaque fois que j'en ai l'occasion.

examples.text: Gostaria de aprender Inglês para oportunidades de trabalho.

translations.en: I would like to learn English for job opportunities.
translations.fr: J'aimerais apprendre l'anglais pour des opportunités d'emploi.

examples.text: Ele agarrou a oportunidade de obter um emprego.

translations.en: He grabbed the chance to get a job.
translations.fr: Il a saisi l'opportunité d'obtenir un emploi.

more.definition: opportunity (chance for advancement, progress or profit)
more.etymology: Proto-Indo-European *h₁ep-der. Proto-Indo-European *h₁épsder. Proto-Indo-European *pértusder. Latin opportūnitātemlbor. Learned borrowing from Latin opportūnitātem.

examples.text: Língua materna é cartão de identidade.

translations.de: Die Muttersprache ist wie ein Ausweis.
translations.en: Your mother tongue is your identity card.
translations.fr: La langue maternelle est une carte d'identité.

examples.text: Tom não tem cartão de crédito.

translations.de: Tom hat keine Kreditkarte.
translations.en: Tom doesn't own a credit card.
translations.fr: Tom n'a pas de carte de crédit.

examples.text: Tom enviou um cartão postal a Mary.

translations.de: Tom schickte Maria eine Postkarte.
translations.en: Tom sent Mary a postcard.
translations.fr: Tom a envoyé une carte postale à Marie.

examples.text: Esqueci de mandar cartões de Ano Novo aos meus amigos.

translations.en: I forgot to send New Year's cards to my friends.
translations.fr: J'ai oublié d'envoyer des cartes postales du nouvel an à mes amis.

more.definition: card (flat, normally rectangular piece of stiff paper or plastic); cardboard (stiff or heavy paper)
more.etymology: From carta + -ão.

examples.text: Ânimo, pois, ó bravos, nossos lares estão à vossa espera.

translations.de: Nur Mut, ihr Tapferen, unsere Heimat erwartet euch.
translations.en: Take heart, then, brave ones, our homes await you.
translations.fr: Courage, donc, braves gens, nos foyers vous attendent.

examples.text: Às vezes ele fica bravo por nada.

translations.en: He sometimes loses his temper for nothing.
translations.fr: Il se met parfois en colère pour rien.

examples.text: Por que você está tão brava?

translations.en: Why are you so angry?
translations.fr: Pourquoi es-tu si en colère ?

examples.text: Tom está bravo contigo, não está?

translations.en: Tom is angry at you, isn't he?
translations.fr: Tom est fâché contre toi, n'est-ce pas ?

more.definition: angry; furious, annoyed; brave; valiant, courageous; coarse; uneducated, uncivilized
more.etymology: Inherited from Old Galician-Portuguese bravo, possibly from Vulgar Latin *bravus or *brabus, from a fusion of Latin prāvus and barbarus.

examples.text: Por que você está tão bravo?

translations.en: Why are you so angry?
translations.fr: Pourquoi es-tu si en colère ?

examples.text: O bravo cavalheiro salvou a bela princesa do dragão malvado.

translations.de: Der tapfere Ritter rettete die holde Prinzessin vor dem bösen Drachen.
translations.en: The brave knight saved the beautiful princess from the evil dragon.

examples.text: Ele ainda está bravo.

translations.en: He is still angry.
translations.fr: Il est encore fâché.

examples.text: Nada deixa ele bravo.

translations.en: The trains are often late in winter.
translations.fr: Les trains sont souvent en retard en hiver.

translations.de: Ich war 12 Stunden im Zug.
translations.en: I spent twelve hours on the train.
translations.fr: J'étais dans le train pendant douze heures.

translations.fr: Ce train ne s'arrête pas ici.

translations.en: The train got in on time.
translations.fr: Le train est arrivé à temps.

translations.en: Tom wants to go by train.
translations.fr: Tom veut aller en train.

collocations: pegar o trem — to catch the train

examples.text: Eu me apaixonei pela língua francesa.

translations.de: Ich habe mich in die französische Sprache verliebt.
translations.en: I fell in love with the French language.
translations.fr: Je suis tombé amoureux de la langue française.

translations.fr: Je suis amoureux de toi.
