translations.de: Tom war in Maria verliebt; die wollte aber nichts von ihm wissen.
translations.en: Tom was in love with Maria, but she didn't want to know anything about him.
translations.fr: Tom était amoureux de Maria, mais elle ne voulait rien savoir de lui.

examples.text: Eu sei que o Tom está apaixonado pela Mary.

translations.de: Ich weiß, dass Tom Maria liebt.
translations.en: I know that Tom is in love with Mary.
translations.fr: Je sais que Tom est amoureux de Mary.

more.definition: to fall in love (to come to have feelings of love towards each other); to fall in love with (to come to have feelings of love towards); to make someone fall in love
more.etymology: From a- + paixão + -ar. Compare Spanish apasionar.

examples.text: A matemática é a base de todas as ciências.

translations.de: Die Mathematik ist die Basis aller Wissenschaften.

translations.fr: Les mathématiques sont la base de toute science.

translations.de: Gott ist nicht etwas, das existiert. Er ist das Fundament, die Basis der Existenz.
translations.en: God is not something that exists. It is the foundation, the basis, of existence.
translations.fr: Dieu n'est pas quelque chose qui existe. Il est le fondement, la base de l'existence.

examples.text: Cada um toma decisões com base em suas experiências pessoais.

translations.de: Jeder Mensch trifft Entscheidungen auf der Grundlage seiner persönlichen Erfahrungen.

examples.text: Estamos cobrindo todas as nossas bases.

translations.en: We're covering all our bases.

more.definition: basis; base; groundwork

translations.en: We experience life as sensations and feelings.

examples.text: O golfinho não é um peixe.

examples.text: Um senso de comunidade é importante para a faculdade.

translations.en: A sense of community is important to the college.
translations.fr: Le sens de la communauté est important pour le collège.

examples.text: Eu estudei francês na faculdade.

translations.en: I studied French in college.
translations.fr: J'ai étudié le français à l'université.

more.definition: faculty (all senses); college (institute of advanced education); power, ability
more.etymology: Learned borrowing from Latin facultātem.

examples.text: Todas as traduções que você sugeriu são boas. Escolhi a mais simples.

translations.de: Alle von Ihnen vorgeschlagenen Übersetzungen sind gut. Ich habe die einfachste gewählt.
translations.en: All the translations you suggested are good. I chose the simplest one.
translations.fr: Toutes les traductions que vous proposez sont bonnes. J'ai choisi la plus simple.

examples.text: Em português, deve evitar-se essa expressão, pois ela pode sugerir algo ofensivo.

translations.de: Im Portugiesischen sollte dieser Ausdruck vermieden werden, da er den Eindruck einer Beleidigung erwecken könnte.
translations.en: In Portuguese, this expression should be avoided, as it may suggest something offensive.
translations.fr: En portugais, cette expression doit être évitée, car elle peut suggérer quelque chose d'offensant.

examples.text: O que você sugere?

translations.en: What do you suggest?
translations.fr: Que suggères-tu ?

examples.text: Fui eu quem sugeriu isto.

translations.de: Ich war derjenige, der es vorgeschlagen hat.
translations.en: I was the one who suggested it.

more.definition: to suggest
more.etymology: Latin suggerōder. Derived from Latin suggerō.

examples.text: Eu te amo muito. Prometo que não vou jamais te abandonar.

translations.de: Ich liebe dich sehr. Ich verspreche dir, dass ich dich niemals verlassen werde.
translations.en: I love you very much. I promise I will never abandon you.
translations.fr: Je t'aime énormément. Je te promets que je ne t'abandonnerai jamais.

examples.text: Seus amigos vêm apoiá-lo. Já seus inimigos o abandonam.

translations.de: Seine Freunde kommen, um ihn zu unterstützen. Seine Feinde hingegen verlassen ihn.
translations.en: His friends come to support him. His enemies, on the other hand, abandon him.
translations.fr: Ses amis viennent le soutenir. Quant à ses ennemis, ils l'abandonnent.

examples.text: Ai de mim! Se me abandonares, morrerei de tristeza.

translations.de: Wehe mir! Wenn du mich verlässt, werde ich vor Kummer sterben.
translations.en: Alas! If you abandon me, I will die of grief.
translations.fr: Malheur à moi ! Si tu m'abandonnes, je mourrai de chagrin.

examples.text: Há muitos gatos abandonados no mundo.

translations.de: Es gibt sehr viele ausgesetzte Katzen auf der Welt.
translations.en: There are many abandoned cats in the world.
translations.fr: Il y a beaucoup de chats abandonnés dans le monde.

more.definition: to abandon (to leave behind, especially something one was responsible for or associated with); to give up (to quit an activity or attempt); to let oneself be controlled by; to put oneself in the hands of; to indulge in
more.etymology: Proto-Germanic *bannanąder. Frankish *bannder. Proto-Indo-European *-h₂tiinflu. French abandonnerbor. From French abandonner, from Old French abandoner, formed from a (“at, to”) + bandon (“jurisdiction, control”), from Late Latin bannum (“proclamation”), bannus, bandum, from Frankish *ban, *bann, from Proto-Germanic *bannaną (“to proclaim, command”), from Proto-Indo-European *bʰeh₂- (“to speak”).

examples.text: A Inteligência Artificial está transformando o mundo. Não é inteligente lutar contra ela.

translations.de: Künstliche Intelligenz verändert die Welt. Es ist nicht klug, sich dagegen zu wehren.
translations.en: Artificial Intelligence is transforming the world. It's not smart to fight it.
translations.fr: L'intelligence artificielle transforme le monde. Il n'est pas judicieux de la combattre.

examples.text: Nós transformamos leite em queijo e manteiga.

translations.en: We make milk into cheese and butter.
translations.fr: Nous transformons le lait en fromage et en beurre.

examples.text: O outono transformou-se em inverno.

translations.de: Aus Herbst wurde Winter.
translations.en: Autumn changed into winter.

examples.text: O corpo transforma as calorias de sobra em gordura.

translations.en: The body converts extra calories into fat.
translations.fr: Le corps transforme les calories en trop en graisse.

more.definition: to transform
more.etymology: Proto-Indo-European *terh₂-der. Latin trānsfōrmārelbor. Learned borrowing from Latin trānsfōrmāre.

examples.text: Eu não estou estudando inglês.

translations.de: Ich studiere kein Englisch.
translations.en: I'm not studying English.
translations.fr: Je n'étudie pas l'anglais.

examples.text: Alessia não pode falar inglês.

translations.de: Alessia kann nicht Englisch sprechen.
translations.en: Alessia can't speak English.
translations.fr: Alessia ne peut pas parler anglais.

examples.text: Você é francês ou inglês?

translations.de: Bist du Franzose oder Engländer?
translations.en: Are you French or English?
translations.fr: Es-tu français ou anglais ?

examples.text: Minha mãe não fala inglês.

translations.de: Meine Mutter spricht kein Englisch.
translations.en: My mother does not speak English.
translations.fr: Ma mère ne parle pas anglais.

more.definition: English; British
more.etymology: Proto-Indo-European *h₂enk-der. Old English Englisċder. Old French angleisbor. Inherited from Old Galician-Portuguese engres, from Old French angleis, from Old English Englisċ.

senses.gloss: relativo à Inglaterra, seu povo, cultura e língua

examples.text: Eu falo japonês, inglês e francês.

translations.de: Ich spreche Japanisch, Englisch und Französisch.
translations.en: I speak Japanese, English, and French.
translations.fr: Je parle japonais, anglais et français.

examples.text: Preciso de um dicionário japonês-inglês.

translations.de: Ich brauche ein Wörterbuch „Japanisch-Englisch“.
translations.en: I need a Japanese-English dictionary.
translations.fr: J'ai besoin d'un dictionnaire japonais-anglais.

examples.text: O Sr. Sato fala inglês bem.

translations.de: Herr Satō spricht gut Englisch.
translations.en: Mr. Sato speaks English well.
translations.fr: M. Sato parle bien anglais.

examples.text: Eles falam inglês e espanhol.

translations.de: Sie sprechen Englisch und Spanisch.
translations.en: They speak English and Spanish.
translations.fr: Ils parlent anglais et espagnol.

more.definition: Englishman; British (a British person); English language
more.etymology: Proto-Indo-European *h₂enk-der. Old English Englisċder. Old French angleisbor. Inherited from Old Galician-Portuguese engres, from Old French angleis, from Old English Englisċ.

examples.text: O Kent é um líder nato.

translations.de: Ken ist ein geborener Anführer.
translations.en: Kent is a born leader.
translations.fr: Ken est un leader né.

examples.text: Tu és um bom líder.

translations.de: Du bist ein guter Leader.
translations.en: You're a good leader.

examples.text: Ele é um grande líder religioso. Ele não teme o governo daquele país.

translations.de: Er ist ein großer religiöser Führer. Er hat keine Angst vor der Regierung dieses Landes.
translations.fr: C'est un grand chef religieux. Il ne craint pas le gouvernement de ce pays.

examples.text: Um mundo livre não tem líderes.

translations.en: A free world doesn't have leaders.

more.definition: leader
more.etymology: Latin -āriusnom. Latin -āriusbor. English leaderbor. Borrowed from English leader.

examples.text: Aquela música me obsedava. Apoderou-se implacavelmente do meu espírito.

translations.de: Diese Musik hat mich besessen gemacht. Sie hat meinen Geist unerbittlich in Beschlag genommen.
translations.en: That music obsessed me. It took hold of my spirit relentlessly.
translations.fr: Cette musique m'a obsédé. Elle s'est emparée de mon esprit sans relâche.

examples.text: Tudo é Um. Matéria e espírito são faces da mesma moeda.

translations.de: Alles ist Eins. Materie und Geist sind Seiten der gleichen Medaille.
translations.en: Everything is One. Matter and spirit are two sides of the same coin.
translations.fr: Tout est Un. La matière et l’esprit sont les faces d’une même médaille.

examples.text: Os olhos do corpo não podem ver o espírito.

translations.de: Die Augen des Körpers können den Geist nicht sehen.
translations.en: The eyes of the body cannot see the soul.
translations.fr: Les yeux du corps ne peuvent pas voir l'esprit.

examples.text: Estou começando a entender o espírito de Toki Pona.

translations.de: Ich fange an, den Geist von Toki Pona zu verstehen.
translations.en: I'm starting to understand the spirit of Toki Pona.
translations.fr: Je commence à comprendre l'esprit du toki pona.

more.definition: spirit (the soul of a person or other living being); ghost; nature; characteristic
more.etymology: Latin spīrituslbor. Inherited from Old Galician-Portuguese espirito, a learned borrowing from Latin spīritus. Cognate with Galician espírito and Spanish espíritu.

examples.text: A propósito, você toca violino?

translations.de: Spielst du eigentlich Geige?
translations.en: By the way, do you play the violin?
translations.fr: Au fait, est-ce que tu joues du violon ?

examples.text: A ciência pode ser usada para bons ou maus propósitos.

translations.en: Science can be used for good or evil purposes.
translations.fr: La science peut être employée à bon ou à mauvais escient.

examples.text: Por que alguém faria isso de propósito?

translations.en: Why would anyone do that on purpose?
translations.fr: Pourquoi quiconque ferait-il cela à dessein ?

examples.text: A propósito, qual é o seu endereço?

translations.en: By the way, what is your address?
translations.fr: Par ailleurs, quelle est ton adresse?

more.definition: purpose; target; aim; goal; purpose; motive (reason for which something is done)
more.etymology: Latin prōpositusnom. Latin prōpositumlbor. Learned borrowing from Latin prōpositum.

examples.text: Eu falo ao telefone com minha mulher todos os dias.

translations.de: Ich telefoniere jeden Tag mit meiner Frau.
translations.en: I talk to my wife on the phone every day.
translations.fr: Je parle tous les jours au téléphone avec ma femme.

examples.text: Eu não sei o telefone dela.

translations.de: Ich weiß ihre Telefonnummer nicht.
translations.en: I don't know her telephone number.
translations.fr: Je ne connais pas son numéro de téléphone.

examples.text: Um homem me telefonou esta noite.

translations.en: A man telephoned me this evening.
translations.fr: Un homme m'a téléphoné ce soir.

examples.text: Você poderia telefonar de novo mais tarde, por favor?

translations.en: Could you call again later, please?
translations.fr: Est-ce que tu pourrais retéléphoner plus tard s'il te plaît ?

more.definition: to telephone (to contact using a telephone)
more.etymology: Proto-Indo-European *kʷelh₁-der. Ancient Greek τῆλε (têle)lbor. Proto-Indo-European *bʰeh₂-der. Ancient Greek φωνή (phōnḗ)der. French téléphonebor. English telephonebor. French téléphonebor. Latin -ereinflu. From telefone + -ar. Compare French téléphoner.

examples.text: O general está acima do coronel.

translations.de: Der General steht über dem Oberst.

examples.text: O coronel disse que a situação está sob controle.

translations.de: Der Oberst sagte, die Lage sei unter Kontrolle.

examples.text: Sim, meu coronel!

translations.en: Sir, yes, sir!

examples.text: Eu sou coronel.

translations.en: I am a colonel.

more.definition: colonel (commissioned office in the armed services); a politician in rural areas
more.etymology: Borrowed from Middle French coronel, from Italian colonnello (“the officer of a small company of soldiers (column) that marched at the head of a regiment”), from compagnia colonnella (“little column company”), from Latin columna (“pillar”), from columen, contraction culmen (“a pillar, top, crown, summit”), o-grade form from Proto-Indo-European *kʷel- (“going around”).

senses.gloss: patente militar, no Brasil entre o tenente-coronel e o general (abreviação: cel.)

examples.text: Onde está a saída de emergência?

translations.de: Wo ist der Notausgang?
translations.en: Where is the emergency exit?
translations.fr: Où se trouve la sortie de secours ?

examples.text: Onde é a saída de emergência?

translations.de: Wo ist der Notausgang?
translations.en: Where is the emergency exit?
translations.fr: Où se trouve la sortie de secours ?

examples.text: A morte é a saída de uma simulação para a Realidade.

translations.de: Der Tod ist der Übergang von einer Simulation in die Realität.
translations.en: Death is the exit from a simulation into Reality.
translations.fr: La mort est la sortie d'une simulation vers la réalité.

examples.text: Aquela porta é a única saída.

translations.en: That door's the only way out.
translations.fr: Cette porte est la seule sortie.

more.definition: that came out; released, published
more.etymology: Past participle of sair.

examples.text: Se o nível do mar continuar subindo, o que os países farão?

translations.de: Was werden die Länder tun, wenn der Meeresspiegel weiter steigt?
translations.en: What will countries do if the sea level keeps rising?
translations.fr: Que feront les pays si le niveau de la mer continue de monter ?

examples.text: Os níveis de água nestes rios são diferentes.

translations.en: The water levels in these rivers are different.
translations.fr: Les niveaux de l'eau dans ces rivières sont différents.

examples.text: Eu não irei me rebaixar a seu nível.

translations.de: Ich werde mich nicht auf sein Niveau herablassen.
translations.en: I won't lower myself to his level.

examples.text: Eu não irei me rebaixar ao nível dele.

translations.de: Ich werde mich nicht auf sein Niveau herablassen.
translations.en: I won't lower myself to his level.

more.definition: level; rank, status; class, distinction
more.etymology: From Old French nivel, livel, from Vulgar Latin *libellus, from Latin lībella, from lībra.

senses.gloss: instrumento que serve para verificar se um plano está inclinado ou não

examples.text: Nós tivemos a mãe mais amorosa e sábia.

translations.de: Wir hatten die liebevollste und weiseste Mutter.
translations.en: We had the most loving and wise mother.
translations.fr: Nous avons eu la mère la plus aimante et la plus sage.

examples.text: Tom teve que engolir o sapo.

translations.de: Tom musste die Krot schlucken.
translations.en: Tom had to swallow the frog.
translations.fr: Tom a dû avaler la couleuvre.

examples.text: Se ele tivesse dito isso, deveria ter sido punido.

translations.de: Wenn er das gesagt hätte, hätte er bestraft werden müssen.
translations.en: If he had said that, he should have been punished.
translations.fr: S'il avait dit ça, il aurait dû être puni.

examples.text: Por que a vida é tão cheia de sofrimentos?

translations.de: Warum ist das Leben so voll mit Leiden?
translations.en: Why is life so full of suffering?
translations.fr: Pourquoi la vie est-elle si remplie de souffrance ?

more.definition: clipping of estar
more.etymology: De estar, por aférese

examples.text: Sente-se, você está me impedindo de ver o jogo.

translations.de: Setz dich! Du hinderst mich daran, das Spiel zu sehen.
translations.en: Sit down, you're preventing me from seeing the game.
translations.fr: Asseyez-vous, vous m'empêchez de voir le match.

examples.text: A neve impediu-me de sair.

translations.en: The snow stopped me going out.
translations.fr: La neige m'a empêché de sortir.

examples.text: O cachorro impediu que eu me aproximasse da casa dele.

translations.en: The dog kept me from approaching his house.
translations.fr: Le chien m'empêchait d'approcher sa maison.

examples.text: Tom precisa impedir Mary de fazer isso.

translations.en: Tom needs to keep Mary from doing that.

more.definition: to prevent; to impede, stop; to hinder, block
more.etymology: Borrowed from Latin impedīre. Cf. the related empecer.

examples.text: A garota está tomando chá.

translations.de: Das Mädchen trinkt Tee.
translations.en: The girl is drinking tea.
translations.fr: La fille boit du thé.

examples.text: Este chá é muito bom.

translations.de: Dieser Tee ist sehr gut.
translations.en: This tea is very good.
translations.fr: Ce thé est très bon.

examples.text: Quero chá sem açúcar.

translations.de: Ich möchte ungesüßten Tee.
translations.en: I want unsweetened tea.
translations.fr: Je veux du thé non sucré.

examples.text: Eu gosto de chá.

translations.de: Ich mag Tee.
translations.en: I like tea.
translations.fr: J'aime le thé.

more.definition: tea plant (Camellia sinensis, a bush whose leaves are used to make tea); tea (drink made by infusing parts of plants); a late afternoon meal
more.etymology: Borrowed from Cantonese 茶 (caa4, “tea”). Portuguese-language dictionaries state Mandarin as the source language, but the historical Portuguese tea trade was centered around Cantonese-speaking regions of China.

senses.gloss: planta da família das Teáceas, originária do Extremo Oriente, cultivada por causa de suas folhas que contêm um alcalóide, a teína (cafeína do chá)

examples.text: O comandante do navio decidiu mudar de rumo.

translations.de: Der Schiffskapitän entscheidet sich, den Kurs zu ändern.
translations.en: The captain of the ship decided to change course.

examples.text: O comandante Joki tem família.

translations.en: Commander Joki has a family.
translations.fr: Le commandant Joki a une famille.

examples.text: Ele é o comandante Joki.

translations.en: He is Commander Joki.
translations.fr: C'est le commandant Joki.

examples.text: Os soldados devem obedecer aos seus comandantes.

more.definition: commander (one who exercises control and direction over a group of persons); A term of address for someone
more.etymology: Proto-Indo-European *(s)meh₂-der. Proto-Indo-European *dʰéh₁tder. Latin mandōinflu. French commanderbor. From comandar + -ante.

senses.gloss: aquele que comanda, que tem o comando (de uma tropa, navio, avião, etc)

examples.text: O corpo humano se compõe de cabeça, tronco e membros.

translations.de: Der menschliche Körper besteht aus Kopf, Rumpf und Gliedmaßen.
translations.en: The human body is composed of a head, trunk, and limbs.
translations.fr: Le corps humain est composé d'une tête, d'un tronc et de membres.

examples.text: Todos os membros do gabinete estavam presentes.

translations.de: Alle Mitglieder des Kabinetts waren anwesend.
translations.en: Every member of the cabinet was present.
translations.fr: Tous les membres du cabinet étaient présents.

examples.text: Ela é um membro dessa organização.

translations.en: She is a member of this organization.
translations.fr: Elle est un membre de cette organisation.

examples.text: Alguns dos membros estavam fazendo muito barulho.

translations.en: Some of the members were too noisy.
translations.fr: Certains des membres étaient très bruyants.

more.definition: member (one who officially belongs to a group); member; limb; each part of a whole
more.etymology: Inherited from Old Galician-Portuguese membro (displacing nembro), from Latin membrum (“member; limb”), from Proto-Indo-European *memso-, *mems-ro (“flesh”).

senses.gloss: braço ou perna, no sentido popular do anatômico (técnico) membro superior ou membro inferior

examples.text: As mudanças climáticas são naturais ou causadas pela ação humana?

translations.de: Ist der Klimawandel natürlich oder durch menschliches Handeln verursacht?
translations.en: Is climate change natural or caused by human action?
translations.fr: Le changement climatique est-il naturel ou causé par l’action humaine ?

examples.text: Ele me informou sobre a mudança de planos.

translations.de: Er informierte mich über die Planänderungen.
translations.en: He informed me about the changes in the plan.

examples.text: Inteligência é a habilidade de se adaptar às mudanças.

translations.en: Intelligence is the ability to adjust to changes.
translations.fr: L'intelligence est la capacité de s'adapter aux changements.

examples.text: A linguagem está sujeita a mudanças constantes.

translations.en: Language is subject to constant change.

more.definition: change (the process of becoming different); exchange (act of exchanging); move (event of changing one's residence)
more.etymology: From mudar (“to change”) + -ança (“-ance”).

senses.gloss: o ato de trocar ou mudar

examples.text: Queres que eu te ensine qual é o dever de um juiz.

translations.de: Sie wollen, dass ich Ihnen zeige, was die Aufgabe eines Richters ist.
translations.en: You want me to teach you what a judge's duty is.
translations.fr: Tu veux que je t'apprenne ce qu'est le devoir d'un juge.

examples.text: José é o juiz que vai apitar o jogo.

translations.en: Joseph will arbitrate the game.
translations.fr: Joseph va arbitrer le match.

examples.text: Os juízes têm muita autoridade.

translations.en: Judges have a lot of authority.

examples.text: A juíza é injusta.

translations.en: The judge is unfair.

more.etymology: Inherited from Old Galician-Portuguese juiz, from Latin iūdicem. Compare Galician xuíz.

examples.text: Pode haver milhares de corpos sob os escombros das casas destruídas.

translations.de: Unter den Trümmern der zerstörten Häuser könnten Tausende von Leichen liegen.
translations.en: There could be thousands of bodies under the rubble of the destroyed houses.
translations.fr: Il pourrait y avoir des milliers de corps sous les décombres des maisons détruites.

examples.text: Este glossário bilíngue inclui milhares de termos.

translations.en: This bilingual glossary contains thousands of terms.

examples.text: Podemos ver milhares de estrelas no céu.

translations.en: We can see thousands of stars in the sky.

examples.text: Eu conseguia ver milhares de estrelas.

translations.en: I could see thousands of stars.

more.definition: thousand
more.etymology: Medieval Latin mīlliārislbor. Learned borrowing from Medieval Latin mīlliāris, from Latin mīlliārius (“a thousand paces”).

examples.text: Dê-se responsabilidade a uma mulher e esta saberá como assumi-la.

translations.en: Give a woman responsibility and she will know how to take it.

examples.text: Que forma escrita pode assumir o silêncio?

translations.en: What written form can silence take?

examples.text: Eu assumo que minha resposta está correta.

translations.en: I take for granted that my answer is correct.

translations.en: Tom took over his father's firm.

more.etymology: Latin assūmerelbor. Learned borrowing from Latin assūmere.

examples.text: Isso não é vinho, é xarope.

translations.de: Das ist kein Wein, das ist Sirup.
translations.en: This isn't wine; it's syrup.
translations.fr: Ce n'est pas du vin, c'est du sirop.

examples.text: Eu prefiro vinho tinto.

translations.de: Ich bevorzuge Rotwein.
translations.en: I prefer red wine.
translations.fr: Je préfère le vin rouge.

examples.text: Eu gosto de vinho.

translations.de: Ich mag Wein.
translations.en: I like wine.
translations.fr: J'aime le vin.

examples.text: Tom gosta de vinho.

translations.de: Tom mag Wein.
translations.en: Tom likes wine.
translations.fr: Thomas aime le vin.

more.definition: wine
more.etymology: Inherited from Old Galician-Portuguese vinho, from Latin vīnum (compare Galician viño, Spanish and Italian vino, Catalan vi, French and Romanian vin, and English wine), from Proto-Italic *wīnom, from Proto-Indo-European *wóyh₁nom.

examples.text: A vida é maluca.

translations.de: Das Leben ist verrückt.
translations.en: Life is crazy.

examples.text: Melhor ser maluco do que ser entediante.

translations.de: Lieber verrückt als langweilig.

examples.text: Ele nos diverte com suas histórias malucas.

translations.en: He entertains us with his weird stories.

translations.en: People thought we were crazy.

senses.gloss: referente a pessoa que diz ou que faz loucuras

translations.en: I told him he is crazy.

examples.text: As pessoas pensaram que nós estávamos malucos.

translations.en: People thought we were crazy.

examples.text: Eu devo confessar que sou bem maluco.

translations.en: I must confess I'm pretty crazy.

examples.text: Devo confessar que eu sou bem maluco.

translations.en: I must confess I'm pretty crazy.

more.definition: guy; dude (male person)
more.etymology: Unknown. Maybe from maluco (“moluccan”)- see Moluccas - or from a diminutive of malo.

examples.text: Nós temos um colega na Espanha.

translations.de: Wir haben einen Kollegen in Spanien.

examples.text: A investigação revelou as entranhas daquela organização criminosa.

examples.text: A prevenção é melhor do que a cura.

examples.text: O racismo é a doença mais perigosa do nosso tempo.

translations.en: Racism is the most dangerous disease of our time.
translations.fr: Le racisme est la maladie la plus dangereuse de notre époque.

translations.fr: Toutes les maladies infectieuses ne sont pas contagieuses.

examples.text: Você acha que eles suspeitam de mim?

translations.fr: Mes parents ne se sont doutés de rien.

translations.en: The woman suspected that her son was using drugs.

translations.en: The witnesses were able to refute the false testimony of the suspect.
translations.fr: Les témoins ont pu réfuter le faux témoignage du suspect.

more.etymology: Derived from Latin suspectāre.

examples.text: Ainda não vimos nada em Hiroshima, oitenta anos depois daquele horror.

translations.de: Wir haben noch nichts in Hiroshima gesehen, achtzig Jahre nach diesem Horror.

examples.text: O ônibus chega em cinco minutos.

translations.fr: Deux bus vont à l'aéroport.

translations.en: At what time does the bus come?

translations.de: Es gibt viele Dinge über meine Persönlichkeit, die du nicht weißt.
translations.en: There are a lot of things you don't know about my personality.
translations.fr: Il y a beaucoup de choses que tu ne sais pas sur ma personnalité.

examples.text: Diga-me a verdade sobre o amor.

translations.de: Sag mir die Wahrheit über die Liebe.
translations.en: Tell me the truth about love.
translations.fr: Dis-moi la vérité sur l'amour.

examples.text: Eu estou lendo um livro sobre animais.

translations.de: Ich lese ein Buch über Tiere.
translations.en: I am reading a book about animals.
translations.fr: Je lis un livre sur les animaux.

more.definition: to remain, be left
more.etymology: Inherited from Old Galician-Portuguese sobrar, from Latin superāre. Doublet of superar.

examples.text: Minha casa fica de frente para a praia.

translations.de: Mein Haus liegt direkt am Meer.
translations.en: My house faces the sea.
translations.fr: Ma maison fait face à la mer.

examples.text: As crianças vão à praia hoje.

translations.de: Die Kinder gehen heute an den Strand.
translations.en: The children are going to the beach today.
translations.fr: Les enfants vont à la plage aujourd'hui.

examples.text: Nós brincamos nesta praia.

translations.de: Wir haben an diesem Strand gespielt.
translations.en: We have played at this beach.
translations.fr: Nous avons joué sur cette plage.

examples.text: Ela vai se bronzear na praia durante as férias.

translations.de: Sie wird sich während ihres Urlaubs am Strand bräunen.
translations.en: She will tan on the beach during her vacation.
translations.fr: Elle bronzera sur la plage pendant ses vacances.

more.definition: beach (shore of a body of water, especially when sandy or pebbly); one's object or area of interest or fondness
more.etymology: Inherited from Old Galician-Portuguese praia, from Medieval Latin plagia, possibly from Latin plaga + Ancient Greek πλάγια (plágia). Doublet of plaga. Cognate with Galician praia, Sicilian praja, Spanish playa, Catalan platja, Occitan plaja, French plage and Italian spiaggia.

senses.gloss: faixa de terra que é coberta pelo mar quando acontece a maré cheia e que é descoberta quando acontece a maré baixa

examples.text: Não desafie o destino.

translations.de: Fordere das Schicksal nicht heraus.
translations.en: Do not defy destiny.
translations.fr: Ne défiez pas le destin.

examples.text: Dominar o sistema aglutinante da língua turca é estimulante desafio.

translations.de: Die Beherrschung des agglutinierenden Systems der türkischen Sprache ist eine spannende Herausforderung.
translations.en: Mastering the agglutinative system of the Turkish language is an exciting challenge.
translations.fr: Maîtriser le système agglutinatif de la langue turque est un défi passionnant.

examples.text: Eu gosto do desafio de traduzir o intraduzível.

translations.de: Ich mag die Herausforderung, das Unübersetzbare zu übersetzen.
translations.en: I like the challenge of translating the untranslatable.

examples.text: Eu aceito o desafio!

translations.de: Ich nehme die Herausforderung an!
translations.en: I accept the challenge!

more.definition: to challenge, to defy; to dare, to incite
more.etymology: From des- + afiar, from Vulgar Latin *afidāre (“to trust”). Compare English defy.

examples.text: Te acompanho até a estação.

translations.de: Ich begleite dich zum Bahnhof.
translations.en: I will go along with you as far as the station.
translations.fr: Je vais t'accompagner jusqu'à la gare.

examples.text: Você deveria ler jornais para acompanhar os acontecimentos.

translations.de: Du solltest Zeitung lesen, um die Ereignisse mitzuverfolgen.
translations.en: You should read the newspaper to follow the events.

examples.text: Se você tiver tempo, acompanhe-me.

translations.en: If you have the time, come along with me.
translations.fr: Si tu as le temps, accompagne-moi.

examples.text: John acompanhou Mary até o concerto.

translations.de: Johannes begleitete Maria auf das Konzert.
translations.en: John accompanied Mary to the concert.

more.definition: to accompany; to follow, to monitor
more.etymology: Inherited from Old Galician-Portuguese acompanhar, from Vulgar Latin *accompāniāre. By surface analysis, a- + companha + -ar.

examples.text: Não há nenhum banco aqui?

translations.de: Gibt es hier keine Bank?
translations.en: Is there no bank here?
translations.fr: Il n'y a pas de banque ici ?

examples.text: O banco está aberto?

translations.de: Ist die Bank offen?
translations.en: Is the bank open?
translations.fr: La banque est-elle ouverte ?

examples.text: Onde é o banco?

translations.de: Wo ist die Bank?
translations.en: Where's the bank?
translations.fr: Où est la banque ?

examples.text: Onde fica o banco?

translations.de: Wo ist die Bank?
translations.en: Where is the bank?
translations.fr: Où est la banque ?

more.definition: to fund, to finance; to behave like [some kind of person], to play
more.etymology: Proto-Indo-European *bʰeg-der. Lombardic bankbor. Italian bancobor. From banco + -ar.

examples.text: É uma honra!

translations.de: Es ist eine Ehre!
translations.en: It's an honor!
translations.fr: C'est un honneur !

examples.text: Escolho honrar minha beleza, minha única maneira de ser.

translations.en: I choose to honor my beauty, my only way to be.

examples.text: Mas ele disse que muito poucas nações honraram os seus compromissos.

translations.en: But he said, too few nations have abided by their commitments.

examples.text: Agradecemos honrarias se nos falta o que comer.

more.definition: to honor
more.etymology: Proto-Indo-European *-h₂tiinflu. Inherited from Old Galician-Portuguese onrar, from Latin honorāre.

examples.text: Meu bisneto tem alergia a ovo.

translations.de: Mein Urenkel hat eine Eierallergie.
translations.en: My great-grandson has an egg allergy.
translations.fr: Mon arrière-petit-fils est allergique aux œufs.

examples.text: Os mamíferos têm mamas, os ovíparos põem ovos.

translations.de: Säugetiere haben Zitzen, Ovipare legen Eier.
translations.en: Mammals have breasts, oviparous lay eggs.
translations.fr: Les mammifères ont des mamelles, les ovipares pondent des œufs.

examples.text: Meu irmão está comendo um ovo.

translations.de: Mein Bruder isst ein Ei.
translations.en: My brother is eating an egg.
translations.fr: Mon frère mange un œuf.

examples.text: Ele sempre come ovos sem sal nem pimenta.

translations.de: Er ißt die Eier immer ohne Salz und Pfeffer.
translations.en: He always eats eggs without salt or pepper.
translations.fr: Il mange les œufs toujours sans sel ni poivre.

more.definition: egg (cell that results from the fertilization of the female gamete by the male gamete); egg (rounded body produced by oviparous females consisting of a membrane and outer shell that contains the embryo); this body, particularly that of chickens, when it has not yet been fertilized and is intended for food
more.etymology: Inherited from Old Galician-Portuguese ovo, from Vulgar Latin *ŏvum, from Classical Latin ōvum. Doublet of ova.

senses.gloss: célula reprodutora feminina dos animais, macrogameta

examples.text: Não quero que ponham o Tom na cadeia.

translations.en: I don't want Tom to go to jail.
translations.fr: Je ne veux pas qu'ils mettent Tom en prison.

examples.text: Ele foi condenado a três anos de cadeia.

translations.de: Er wurde zu drei Jahren Gefängnis verurteilt.
translations.en: He was sentenced to three years in jail.

examples.text: Eu nunca passei um dia na cadeia.

translations.en: I've never spent a day in jail.

examples.text: Tom está na cadeia agora, não está?

translations.en: Tom is in jail now, isn't he?

more.definition: prison (place of long-term confinement for those convicted of serious crimes); chain (series of interconnected rings or links made of metal); chain (series of interconnected things)
more.etymology: Inherited from Old Galician-Portuguese cadea, from Latin catēna, from Proto-Italic *katesnā. Compare Galician cadea, Spanish cadena, and English chain. Doublet of the direct borrowing catena.

senses.gloss: local que serve de detenção temporária para criminosos de baixa periculosidade

examples.text: Traduzir literalmente nem sempre é a melhor opção.

translations.de: Wörtliches Übersetzen ist nicht immer die beste Option.
translations.en: Translating literally is not always the best option.
translations.fr: Traduire littéralement n’est pas toujours la meilleure option.

examples.text: Não quero ser a sua segunda opção.

translations.de: Ich will nicht eure zweite Wahl sein.
translations.en: I don't want to be your second option.

examples.text: Há várias opções.

translations.de: Es gibt mehrere Möglichkeiten.
translations.en: There are several options.

examples.text: Eu não vejo outra opção.

translations.en: I don't see another option.
translations.fr: Je ne vois pas d'autre option.

more.definition: option
more.etymology: Learned borrowing from Latin optiōnem.

examples.text: Quem consegue ser eloquente diante do Mistério que é Deus?

translations.de: Wer kann angesichts des Mysteriums, das Gott ist, beredt sein?
translations.en: Who can be eloquent before the Mystery that is God?
translations.fr: Qui peut être éloquent devant le Mystère qu’est Dieu ?

examples.text: O acidente de trânsito aconteceu diante dos meus próprios olhos.

translations.en: The traffic accident happened before my very eyes.
translations.fr: L'accident de la circulation s'est passé devant mes propres yeux.

examples.text: A solução estava diante dos meus olhos, mas eu não a vi.

translations.de: Die Lösung stand mir vor den Augen, doch ich sah sie nicht.
translations.en: The solution lay before my eyes, but I didn't see it.

examples.text: Levarei meu plano em diante, seja lá quem seja que se oponha.

translations.de: Möge sich wer auch immer will gegen meinen Plan wenden, ich werde ihn dennoch ausführen.
translations.en: Whoever may oppose my plan, I will carry it out nonetheless.

more.definition: in front of; before; ahead (in time)
more.etymology: From Old Galician-Portuguese deante, from de + enante. Enante from Late Latin in ante, from Latin in ante. Cognate with Galician diante, Asturian, Leonese, and Mirandese delantre and Spanish delante.

examples.text: Quem consegue ser eloquente diante do Mistério que é Deus?

translations.de: Wer kann angesichts des Mysteriums, das Gott ist, beredt sein?
translations.en: Who can be eloquent before the Mystery that is God?
translations.fr: Qui peut être éloquent devant le Mystère qu’est Dieu ?

examples.text: O acidente de trânsito aconteceu diante dos meus próprios olhos.

translations.en: The traffic accident happened before my very eyes.
translations.fr: L'accident de la circulation s'est passé devant mes propres yeux.

examples.text: A solução estava diante dos meus olhos, mas eu não a vi.

translations.de: Die Lösung stand mir vor den Augen, doch ich sah sie nicht.
translations.en: The solution lay before my eyes, but I didn't see it.

examples.text: Levarei meu plano em diante, seja lá quem seja que se oponha.

translations.de: Möge sich wer auch immer will gegen meinen Plan wenden, ich werde ihn dennoch ausführen.
translations.en: Whoever may oppose my plan, I will carry it out nonetheless.

examples.text: A débil chama tremeluz e já se apaga.

translations.de: Die schwache Flamme flackert und erlischt dann.
translations.en: The weak flame flickers and goes out.
translations.fr: La faible flamme vacille puis s'éteint.

examples.text: Apagada a luz, todas as mulheres são iguais.

translations.de: Wenn das Licht aus ist, sind alle Frauen gleich.
translations.en: With the light out, all women are equal.
translations.fr: Une fois la lumière éteinte, toutes les femmes sont égales.

examples.text: Você quer que eu apague a luz?

translations.de: Soll ich das Licht ausmachen?
translations.en: Do you want me to turn the light off?

examples.text: Ela apagou todas as luzes às dez.

translations.de: Sie löschte um zehn alle Lichter.
translations.en: She turned off all the lights at ten.

more.definition: to put out; to extinguish (to stop something from burning); to go out (to stop burning); to turn off (to deactivate a device)
more.etymology: From Old Galician-Portuguese, from a Vulgar Latin *appācāre, from Latin ad- + pācāre.

examples.text: A coruja tem os filhotes mais belos da floresta.

translations.de: Die Eule hat die schönsten Küken im Wald.
translations.en: Owl chicks are the most beautiful in the forest.
translations.fr: La chouette a les plus beaux poussins de la forêt.

examples.text: O silêncio das florestas nos convida à reflexão.

translations.de: Die Stille der Wälder lädt uns zum Nachdenken ein.
translations.en: The silence of the forests invites us to reflect.
translations.fr: Le silence des forêts nous invite à la réflexion.

examples.text: Dois pequenos esquilos, um branco e um preto, viviam em uma grande floresta.

translations.de: Zwei kleine Eichhörnchen, ein weißes und ein schwarzes, lebten in einem großen Wald.
translations.en: Two little squirrels, a white squirrel and a black squirrel, lived in a large forest.
translations.fr: Deux petits écureuils, l'un blanc et l'autre noir, vivaient dans une grande forêt.

examples.text: O garoto foi encontrado no meio da floresta.

translations.de: Der Junge wurde mitten im Wald gefunden.
translations.en: The boy was found in the middle of the forest.
translations.fr: Le garçon a été retrouvé au milieu de la forêt.

more.definition: forest (dense collection of trees)
more.etymology: Ultimately from Early Medieval Latin foresta. Influenced by flor (“flower”).

senses.gloss: extensão de terra onde existem muitas árvores

examples.text: O gênio está fora da garrafa.

translations.de: Der Geist ist aus der Flasche.
translations.en: The genie is out of the bottle.
translations.fr: Le génie est hors de la bouteille.

examples.text: Tom comprou três garrafas de vinho tinto.

translations.en: Tom bought three bottles of red wine.
translations.fr: Thomas a acheté 3 bouteilles de vin rouge.

examples.text: Tem um restinho de uísque nessa garrafa.

translations.de: Da ist noch etwas Whisky in der Flasche.
translations.fr: Il reste un fond de whisky dans cette bouteille.

examples.text: Minha garrafa de água está vazia.

translations.de: Meine Wasserflasche ist leer.
translations.en: My water bottle is empty.

more.definition: bottle
more.etymology: Arabic غَرَّافَة (ḡarrāfa)bor. Borrowed from Arabic غَرَّافَة (ḡarrāfa).

senses.gloss: recipiente de gargalo e boca estreitos, geralmente de vidro, cristal ou louça e sem alça(s), destinado a conter líquido

examples.text: Qual é o peso de sua mala?

translations.de: Wie viel wiegt Ihr Koffer?
translations.en: What's the weight of your suitcase?
translations.fr: Combien pèse ta valise ?

examples.text: Quantas malas o senhor está levando?

translations.de: Wie viele Gepäckstücke geben Sie auf?
translations.en: How many pieces of luggage are you checking in?
translations.fr: Combien de bagages comptez-vous enregistrer ?

examples.text: A minha mala está quebrada.

translations.en: My suitcase is broken.
translations.fr: Ma valise est cassée.

examples.text: Deixe-me carregar sua mala.

translations.en: Let me carry your suitcase.
translations.fr: Laisse-moi porter ta valise.

more.definition: suitcase; luggage; boot, trunk
more.etymology: Borrowed from French malle (“large suitcase; trunk”), from Middle French malle, from Old French male (“leather bag, leather or wooden travel-case”), from Frankish *malha (“leather bag”), from Proto-Germanic *malhō (“leather bag”), from Proto-Indo-European *molko- (“leather bag”).

examples.text: A dona Smith é professora de inglês?

translations.de: Ist Frau Smith Englischlehrerin?
translations.en: Is Miss Smith an English teacher?
translations.fr: Est-ce que madame Smith est professeur d'anglais ?

examples.text: Os cães têm donos. Os gatos têm empregados.

translations.en: Dogs have masters. Cats have staff.
translations.fr: Les chiens ont des maîtres. Les chats ont des employés.

examples.text: Eu sou o dono deste restaurante.

translations.de: Ich bin der Besitzer dieses Restaurants.
translations.en: I'm the owner of this restaurant.

examples.text: Ela é uma dona de casa perfeita.

translations.de: Sie ist eine perfekte Hausfrau.
translations.fr: Elle est une femme au foyer parfaite.

more.definition: owner; patriarch; head of a home or family; master (used by a slave to address his owner)
more.etymology: Inherited from Old Galician-Portuguese dono, from Late Latin domnus, from Latin dominus (“lord”), from domus (“house”), ultimately from Proto-Indo-European *dṓm (“house”), from *dem- (“to build”). Compare Galician dono and Spanish dueño. Doublet of Dom and dominó.

examples.text: A justiça é cega, mas não é tola.

translations.de: Die Gerechtigkeit ist blind, aber sie ist nicht dumm.
translations.en: Justice is blind, but it is not foolish.
translations.fr: La justice est aveugle, mais elle n’est pas stupide.

examples.text: O rei é um tolo.

translations.de: Der König ist ein Narr.
translations.en: The king is a fool.
translations.fr: Le roi est un imbécile.

examples.text: Ele não é tão tolo a ponto de acreditar nessa história.

translations.de: Er ist nicht so dumm, diese Geschichte zu glauben.
translations.en: He is not such a fool as to believe that story.
translations.fr: Il n'est pas stupide au point de croire à cette histoire.

examples.text: Computadores tornam as pessoas tolas.

translations.en: Computers make people stupid.
translations.fr: Les ordinateurs rendent les gens stupides.

more.definition: foolish; silly (having or characterised by poor judgement or little intelligence); a whiny kid
more.etymology: Unknown. Maybe from Latin stolidus (“foolish”) or tōles (“tonsilitis”).

examples.text: A justiça é cega, mas não é tola.

translations.de: Die Gerechtigkeit ist blind, aber sie ist nicht dumm.
translations.en: Justice is blind, but it is not foolish.

translations.de: Der König ist ein Narr.
translations.en: The king is a fool.

translations.en: He is not such a fool as to believe that story.
translations.fr: Il n'est pas stupide au point de croire à cette histoire.

examples.text: O mundo está cheio de tolos.

translations.de: Die Welt ist voller Dummköpfe.
translations.en: The world is full of fools.

more.definition: fool, idiot (foolish person)
more.etymology: Unknown. Maybe from Latin stolidus (“foolish”) or tōles (“tonsilitis”).

examples.text: A arma disparou por acidente.

translations.de: Der Schuss löste sich versehentlich.
translations.en: The gun went off by accident.
translations.fr: Le coup est parti accidentellement.

examples.text: O fuzil disparou.

translations.de: Das Gewehr ging los.
translations.en: The rifle went off.

examples.text: Os preços da comida estão a disparar.

translations.en: Food prices are skyrocketing.

examples.text: Não há evidências de que Tom tenha disparado a arma.

translations.en: There's no evidence Tom was the one who fired the gun.

more.definition: to shoot, to fire (a weapon); to shoot up, to soar (to grow rapidly: prices etc.); to go off (an alarm), to trip (a circuit breaker)
more.etymology: From alteration of Old Galician-Portuguese desparar, from Latin disparāre (“to separate”), from dis- + parō (“make equal”), although it was taken as the negative of parō (“prepare, arrange”) in Romance.

examples.text: Foi assim que o incidente ocorreu.

translations.de: Das ist so wie der Vorfall geschehen ist.
translations.en: This is how the incident happened.

examples.text: O acidente ocorreu numa encruzilhada.

translations.en: The accident happened at a crossroads.
translations.fr: L'accident a eu lieu à un carrefour.

examples.text: Nunca me ocorreu que minhas palavras pudessem magoá-la.

translations.en: It never occurred to me that my words would hurt her feelings.
translations.fr: Je ne me suis jamais rendu compte que mes mots pouvaient la blesser.

examples.text: Sob o reinado de Tibério, em Roma, ocorreu um enorme terremoto.

translations.de: Während Tiberius' Regentschaft wurde Rom von einem starken Erdbeben erschüttert.
translations.en: A great earthquake occurred in Rome during the reign of Tiberius.

more.definition: to occur, happen
more.etymology: Borrowed from Latin occurrere (“to run to”) (based on Portuguese correr), from currō (“to run”).

examples.text: O xadrez é um bom companheiro para toda a vida.

translations.de: Schach ist ein guter Begleiter fürs Leben.
translations.en: Chess is a good companion for life.
translations.fr: Les échecs sont un bon compagnon pour la vie.

examples.text: Eles torceram por seu companheiro de equipe.

translations.en: They cheered for their teammate.

examples.text: Seu cachorro é o seu bom companheiro.

translations.en: His dog is his good companion.

examples.text: Um bom livro é um ótimo companheiro.

translations.en: A good book is a great companion.

examples.text: O xadrez é um bom companheiro para toda a vida.

translations.de: Schach ist ein guter Begleiter fürs Leben.
translations.en: Chess is a good companion for life.
translations.fr: Les échecs sont un bon compagnon pour la vie.

examples.text: Esse texto se inspira em nossas mais distintas e dedicadas companheiras de trabalho.

translations.de: Dieser Text ist von unseren herausragendsten und engagiertesten Kolleginnen inspiriert.
translations.en: This text is inspired by our most distinguished and dedicated female coworkers.
translations.fr: Ce texte s'inspire de nos collègues féminines les plus distinguées et les plus dévouées.

examples.text: A inveja é a companheira da honra.

translations.en: Envy is the companion of honour.

examples.text: Tom e John são companheiros de cela.

translations.en: Tom and John are cellmates.

more.definition: companion, comrade; partner
more.etymology: Latin -āriusnom. Inherited from Old Galician-Portuguese companneiro. By surface analysis, companha + -eiro. Compare Spanish compañero and Galician compañeiro.

senses.gloss: aquele que acompanha ou faz companhia

examples.text: O Mike sabe se defender.

translations.en: Mike knows how to defend himself.
translations.fr: Mike sait comment se défendre.

examples.text: A marinha defende nossa costa.

translations.de: Die Marine verteidigt unsere Küste.
translations.en: The navy defends our seacoast.

examples.text: Meus amigos me defenderão.

translations.en: My friends will defend me.
translations.fr: Mes amis me défendront.

examples.text: Ele se defendeu com unhas e dentes.

translations.en: He defended himself tooth and nail.

more.definition: to defend (repel an attack); to defend (represent as a legal professional); to defend
more.etymology: Inherited from Old Galician-Portuguese defender, from Latin dēfendere.

examples.text: O menino parado na porta é meu irmão.

translations.de: Der Junge, der an der Tür steht, ist mein Bruder.
translations.en: The boy standing by the door is my brother.

examples.text: Quantas paradas daqui?

translations.en: How many stops from here?
translations.fr: Combien d'arrêts à partir d'ici ?

examples.text: Você vai simplesmente ficar aí parado o dia todo?

translations.en: Are you just going to stand there all day?
translations.fr: Est-ce que tu vas juste rester là debout toute la journée ?

examples.text: Você só precisa ficar parado ali sem se mexer.

translations.de: Du musst nur dort stehen bleiben, ohne dich zu rühren.
translations.en: You just need to stand there without moving.

more.definition: stopped, halted, immobile; standing
more.etymology: Past participle of parar.

translations.de: Der Junge, der an der Tür steht, ist mein Bruder.

translations.en: Are you just going to stand there all day?

examples.text: Há quanto tempo isso está parado aí?

translations.en: For how long has this been standing there?

more.etymology: Particípio passado do verbo parar.

senses.gloss: pára de correr (dito geralmente intimidando com uma arma a pessoa interpelada, durante uma perseguição)

examples.text: Ele morreu em idade avançada.

translations.de: Er starb in hohem Alter.
translations.en: He died at a very old age.
translations.fr: Il mourut très âgé.

examples.text: A inteligência avança a passos largos. A verdade, porém, pode ser alcançada?

translations.en: I'm not ugly, but I'm not pretty either.

examples.text: Não sou feio, mas também não sou bonito.

examples.text: Girafas têm pescoços muito longos.

translations.de: Giraffen haben sehr lange Hälse.

examples.text: Tom empurrou a jangada para dentro da água.

Cognate with Galician empurrar and, according to Joan Coromines, Asturian emburriar. Coromines claims the word is unrelated to empuxar and ultimately connects it to Latin porrigere.

examples.text: Este bolo tem gosto de queijo.

examples.text: O vento enfunava as velas da embarcação.

senses.gloss: o ar atmosférico em movimento natural

examples.text: Você podia ter derrubado todos os pratos.

examples.text: O que é um auto da fé?

translations.de: Was ist ein Autodafé?
translations.en: What is an auto-da-fé?
translations.fr: Qu'est-ce qu'un autodafé ?

translations.fr: La religion est déformée, la foi s’étiole.

examples.text: Não negues um favor a quem necessita, se tu podes fazê-lo.

translations.fr: Les livres récemment imprimés ont une odeur agréable.

examples.text: O Grego Moderno é uma língua encantadora.

translations.fr: Le grec moderne est une langue charmante.

examples.text: Eu gosto muito de estudar línguas on-line.

translations.de: Ich lerne sehr gerne Sprachen im Internet.
translations.en: I really enjoy studying languages ​​online.
translations.fr: J'aime beaucoup étudier les langues en ligne.

examples.text: Na língua latina, os advérbios precedem os verbos.

translations.en: Portuguese is Carlos' mother tongue.
translations.fr: Le portugais est la langue maternelle de Carlos.

idioms: dar com a língua nos dentes:

translations.en: The hailstorm ruined crops.

examples.text: Gato de luvas não pega rato.

translations.de: Eine Katze mit Handschuhen fängt keine Maus.

translations.fr: Un chat avec des gants n'attrape pas une souris.

translations.de: Ich sah eine Ratte in der Küche herumlaufen.

translations.fr: J'ai vu un rat courir dans la cuisine.

translations.fr: Le chat a vu une souris et a couru après elle.

examples.text: Quero uma fita amarela gravada com o nome dela.

translations.fr: Je veux un ruban jaune sur lequel son nom est inscrit.

translations.fr: Qui êtes-vous pour me juger ?

translations.fr: Ne juge pas un livre à sa couverture.

translations.fr: Où as-tu passé tes vacances ?

translations.fr: Nous avons une théorie.

translations.de: Das Experiment bestätigte seine Theorie.

translations.fr: L'expérience a confirmé sa théorie.

examples.text: Há eclipse da Lua.

translations.fr: Il y a une éclipse lunaire.

translations.en: The moon revolves around the earth.
translations.fr: La Lune tourne autour de la Terre.

translations.fr: Les animaux sont des êtres purs et naturels.

translations.fr: L'école est une perte de temps.

translations.de: Zweifellos ist dieses Leben mehr Verlust als Gewinn.
translations.en: Without a doubt, this life is more loss than gain.
translations.fr: Sans aucun doute, cette vie est plus une perte qu’un gain.

examples.text: Os computadores nos salvam de perdas de tempo e de problemas.

translations.de: Computer ersparen uns eine Menge Zeit und Ärger.
translations.en: Computers save us a lot of time and trouble.
translations.fr: Les ordinateurs nous épargnent beaucoup de temps et d'ennuis.

examples.text: Isso foi uma perda de tempo.

translations.en: That was a waste of time.
translations.fr: Cela a été une perte de temps.

translations.en: This couple represents the union of two great assets.
translations.fr: Ce couple représente l'union de deux atouts majeurs.

translations.de: Sie repräsentieren nicht nur sich selbst, sondern auch diese Institution.
translations.en: They represent not only themselves but this institution as well.

translations.en: His speech did not represent the party's wishes.
translations.fr: Son discours ne reflétait pas les volontés du parti.

examples.text: Quem já foi rei não perde nunca a majestade.

Vossa Majestade pode perdoar-lhe esta pequena falha.
Diante dessa majestade nós renunciamos.

examples.text: Este é o novo modelo.

translations.en: This is the new model.
translations.fr: C'est le nouveau modèle.

translations.en: It's difficult to choose between so many beautiful models.

examples.text: Este novo modelo está disponível no mercado?

translations.fr: Puis-je vous emprunter trois cents dollars ?

more.definition: to lend; to loan (to give temporarily); to borrow (to obtain temporarily)
more.etymology: From em- + prestar.

senses.gloss: ceder por algum tempo sem qualquer ónus

examples.text: Tom foi acusado de tentativa de homicídio.

translations.en: Tom was charged with attempted murder.

examples.text: O dragão é uma criatura imaginária.

translations.fr: Le dragon est une créature imaginaire.

examples.text: Os cães são criaturas nobres.

examples.text: Quantos maços de cigarro ele fuma por dia?

translations.de: Wie viele Zigarettenpackungen raucht er am Tag?
translations.en: How many packs of cigarettes does he smoke a day?

more.definition: cigarette (thin roll of tobacco made for smoking); locust

translations.fr: Le temps perdu est irrécupérable.

more.definition: extra (beyond what is due, usual, expected or necessary)

examples.text: Teremos uma aula extra em breve, pessoal!

translations.en: We're going to have an extra class soon, guys!

examples.text: Ele pediu algumas comidas extras.

translations.en: He asked for some extra food.

examples.text: Eu tive de fazer hora extra ontem.

translations.en: I had to work overtime yesterday.

examples.text: Eu não quero fazer hora extra.

translations.en: I don't want to work overtime.

more.definition: anything that is extra; bonus (extra amount of money given as a premium); extra; walk-on (actor in a small role with no dialogue)

examples.text: Vista seu casaco. Faz frio lá fora.

translations.en: Put your coat on. It's cold outside.
translations.fr: Mets ton manteau. Il fait froid dehors.

examples.text: Gostei deste casaco. Posso prová-lo?

translations.de: Mir gefällt dieser Mantel. Kann ich ihn mal anprobieren?
translations.en: I like this coat. May I try it on?

examples.text: Tom abotoou o seu casaco.

translations.de: Tom knöpfte seine Jacke zu.
translations.en: Tom buttoned up his coat.

examples.text: Tom precisa de um casaco.

translations.de: Tom braucht einen Mantel.
translations.en: Tom needs a coat.

more.definition: coat
more.etymology: From casaca (“white tie”), from French casaque or Italian casacca.

senses.gloss: peça de vestuário que os homens usam sobre a camisa ou o colete e as mulheres por cima do vestido

examples.text: Quando era moço, ele queria ser cantor.

translations.en: When he was young, he wanted to be a singer.
translations.fr: Quand il était jeune, il voulait être chanteur.

examples.text: Eu quero me casar com uma moça como ela.

translations.en: I want to marry a girl like her.
translations.fr: Je veux me marier avec une fille comme elle.

examples.text: Tom é moço tímido e solitário.

translations.de: Tom ist ein schüchterner und einsamer Junge.
translations.en: Tom is a shy and lonely boy.

examples.text: A moça não gosta de suco.

translations.en: The girl doesn't like juice.
translations.fr: La fille n'aime pas le jus.

more.definition: girl, young lady
more.etymology: Inherited from Old Galician-Portuguese moça.

examples.text: A bruxa está mexendo seu caldeirão.

translations.de: Die Hexe rührt ihren Kessel um.
translations.en: The witch is stirring her cauldron.
translations.fr: La sorcière mélange son chaudron.

examples.text: Processo contra quem tentou aplicar golpe de estado não é caça às bruxas.

translations.de: Das Verfahren gegen diejenigen, die einen Staatsstreich versucht haben, ist keine Hexenjagd.
translations.en: Prosecuting those who attempted a coup is not a witch hunt.
translations.fr: Les poursuites engagées contre ceux qui ont tenté de renverser le gouvernement ne constituent pas une chasse aux sorcières.

examples.text: Só falta uma semana para o Dia das Bruxas.

translations.de: In einer Woche ist schon Halloween.
translations.en: Halloween's only a week away.

examples.text: Não sou uma bruxa.

translations.en: I am not a witch.
translations.fr: Je ne suis pas une sorcière.

more.definition: witch; an evil woman
more.etymology: Uncertain. Possibly from Iberian/Celtiberian *bruxtia (compare Galician, Mirandese, Aragonese, and Asturian bruxa; Spanish bruja; Catalan bruixa and Occitan bruèissa), from Proto-Celtic *brixtā (“spell, magic”) (compare Old Irish bricht (“charm”), Old Breton brith (“magic”)). It could instead be akin to a different Celtic word such as Old Irish Brigit (literally “high, exalted”).

senses.gloss: mulher que faz bruxarias; feiticeira; maga; mágica; vidente:

examples.text: Estou com dor de cabeça. Vou me deitar.

translations.de: Ich habe Kopfschmerzen. Ich werde mich hinlegen.
translations.en: I have a headache. I'm going to lie down.
translations.fr: J'ai mal à la tête. Je vais m'allonger.

examples.text: A que horas você costuma se deitar à noite?

translations.de: Wann gehst du normalerweise abends ins Bett?
translations.en: What time do you usually go to bed at night?
translations.fr: À quelle heure vous couchez-vous habituellement le soir ?

examples.text: Deitar-se é o contrário de levantar-se.

translations.de: Sich hinlegen ist das Gegenteil von aufstehen.
translations.en: Lying down is the opposite of getting up.
translations.fr: S'allonger, c'est le contraire de se lever.

examples.text: Eu me deitei para descansar.

translations.en: I lay down to rest.
translations.fr: Je me suis allongé pour me reposer.

more.definition: to lie down (to rest in a horizontal position); to go to sleep; to lay (to place in a horizontal position)
more.etymology: Inherited from Old Galician-Portuguese deitar, from a Vulgar Latin *dēctāre, from Latin dējectāre, frequentative of dējicere (“to throw, hurl down”).

examples.text: A casa é grande, mas o jardim é pequenininho.

translations.de: Das Haus ist groß, aber der Garten ist winzig.
translations.en: The house is big, but the garden is tiny.
translations.fr: La maison est grande, mais le jardin est minuscule.

examples.text: Vá ajudar sua mãe. Ela está no jardim.

translations.de: Geh und hilf deiner Mutter. Sie ist im Garten.
translations.en: Go and help your mom. She's in the garden.
translations.fr: Va aider ta mère. Elle est dans le jardin.

examples.text: Os cães estão no jardim.

translations.de: Die Hunde sind im Garten.
translations.en: The dogs are in the garden.
translations.fr: Les chiens sont dans le jardin.

examples.text: Amanhã vou ajudar minha mãe por meia hora no jardim.

translations.de: Morgen werde ich meiner Mutter eine halbe Stunde im Garten helfen.
translations.en: Tomorrow, I'm going to help my mother in the garden for half an hour.
translations.fr: Demain, je vais aider ma mère au jardin pendant une demi-heure.

more.definition: garden; ellipsis of jardim de infância
more.etymology: Proto-Indo-European *gʰerdʰ-der. Frankish *gardōbor. Old French gardinbor. From Old Galician-Portuguese jardin (“garden”), from Old French jardin (“garden, enclosure”), from Medieval Latin jardinus (“garden”), from Old Frankish *gardin, oblique case of *gardo (“enclosure, yard”), from Proto-Germanic *gardô (“enclosure, garden, house”), from Proto-Indo-European *gʰordʰos (“hedge, enclosure”), from Proto-Indo-European …

senses.gloss: terreno onde se cultivam plantas de adorno

examples.text: Ela não participou da nossa conversa.

translations.en: She did not participate in our conversation.
translations.fr: Elle n'a pas participé à notre conversation.

examples.text: Ele queria participar na competição.

translations.en: He would like to take part in the competition.
translations.fr: Il voudrait participer à la compétition.

examples.text: Cerca de trinta mil pessoas participaram da corrida.

translations.de: Über 30 000 Leute nahmen an dem Rennen teil.
translations.en: About thirty thousand people took part in the race.

examples.text: Qualquer um pode participar.

translations.en: Anybody can participate.
translations.fr: N'importe qui peut participer.

more.definition: to take part, to participate
more.etymology: Proto-Indo-European *-h₂tiinflu. Latin participārelbor. Learned borrowing from Latin participāre.

examples.text: Ele fez isso só por diversão.

translations.de: Er hat es nur zum Spaß gemacht.
translations.en: He did it just for fun.

examples.text: Demorou dez anos para construir o parque de diversões.

translations.en: It took ten years to build the amusement park.
translations.fr: Cela a pris dix ans de construire le parc d'attractions.

examples.text: O trabalho é mais divertido que a diversão.

translations.de: Arbeit macht mehr Spaß als Spaß.
translations.en: Work is more fun than fun.

examples.text: Essa é uma diversão cara.

translations.de: Dies ist ein teures Vergnügen.
translations.en: That's an expensive way to have fun.

more.definition: the act or result of diverging (to tend into different directions); diversion (tactic used to draw attention away from the real threat or action); the act of entertaining
more.etymology: Borrowed from Medieval Latin dīversiōnem, from Latin dīversus (“opposite; apart; diverse”), past participle of dīvertō (“to divert; to separate”).

examples.text: O trabalho serve para identificar o personagem.

translations.fr: C'est par le travail que le personnage est identifié.

examples.text: Os homens que procuraram Tom não se identificaram.

translations.en: The men who came looking for Tom didn't identify themselves.

examples.text: A polícia identificou Dan por suas impressões digitais.

translations.en: The police identified Dan by his fingerprints.

examples.text: A criança desaparecida foi identificada por sua roupa.

translations.en: The lost child was identified by his clothes.

more.definition: to identify; to recognize; to relate (to identify with; to understand)
more.etymology: Proto-Indo-European *dʰeh₁-der. Proto-Indo-European *-h₂tiinflu. Medieval Latin identificārelbor. Learned borrowing from Medieval Latin identificāre.

examples.text: A bola rolou para baixo do sofá.

translations.en: The ball rolled under the couch.

examples.text: A rola-turca é uma ave.

translations.fr: La tourterelle turque est un oiseau.

examples.text: Rindo de alegria, a criança rolava pelo chão.

translations.de: Das Kind rollte sich auf dem Boden und lachte vor Vergnügen.

examples.text: As lágrimas continuavam a rolar pelo rosto de Daniel.

translations.en: Tears kept rolling down Daniel’s cheeks.

more.definition: to roll (to revolve or cause to revolve); to move; to roam; to wander
more.etymology: Borrowed from French rouler, from Old French roler, from Medieval Latin rotulāre (“to roll, to revolve”), from Latin rotula (“a little wheel”), diminutive of rota (“a wheel”).

examples.text: O quadro de revisores de Tatoeba é eficientíssimo.

translations.de: Das Prüfungsgremium von Tatoeba ist äußerst effizient.
translations.en: Tatoeba's review board is extremely efficient.
translations.fr: L'équipe de correcteurs de Tatoeba est extrêmement efficace.

examples.text: Comprei alguns quadros para meu apartamento.

translations.de: Ich habe ein paar Bilder für meine Wohnung gekauft.
translations.en: I bought some paintings for my apartment.
translations.fr: J'ai acheté des tableaux pour mon appartement.

examples.text: O quadro está pendurado na parede.

translations.de: Das Bild hängt an der Wand.
translations.en: The picture is hanging on the wall.
translations.fr: L'image est accrochée au mur.

examples.text: Estou sentado a contemplar o belo quadro na parede.

translations.de: Ich sitze und betrachte das schöne Bild an der Wand.
translations.en: I'm sitting looking at the beautiful picture on the wall.
translations.fr: Je suis assis en regardant la belle image sur le mur.

more.definition: painting; picture; square; rigid, generally rectangular mounting for a painting
more.etymology: From Latin quadrum. Compare Galician cadro, Spanish cuadro, and Italian quadro.

examples.text: Nadando com a rapidez do raio, os peixes passavam rente aos meus ouvidos.

translations.de: Die Fische schwammen blitzschnell und dicht an meinen Ohren vorbei.
translations.en: Swimming as fast as lightning, the fish passed close to my ears.
translations.fr: Nageant à la vitesse de l'éclair, les poissons passaient près de mes oreilles.

examples.text: Um pequeno raio de sol entrou pela janela da minha vida.

translations.de: Ein kleiner Sonnenstrahl drang durch das Fenster meines Lebens.
translations.en: A small ray of sunshine entered through the window of my life.
translations.fr: Un petit rayon de soleil est entré par la fenêtre de ma vie.

examples.text: Nossa casa foi atingida por um raio. Felizmente temos para-raios.

translations.de: Bei uns hat der Blitz eingeschlagen. Zum Glück haben wir einen Blitzableiter.
translations.en: Our house was struck by lightning. Fortunately we have a lightning rod.

examples.text: Passamos por colinas verdejantes que brilhavam à luz dos primeiros raios de sol.

translations.de: Wir zogen vorüber an grünenden Hügeln, die im Licht der ersten Sonnenstrahlen leuchteten.
translations.fr: Nous sommes passés par des collines verdoyantes qui brillaient à la lumière des premiers rayons du soleil.

more.definition: ray; beam, ray (of light or radiation); lightning
more.etymology: Inherited from Old Galician-Portuguese rayo, from Latin radius. Doublet of rádio.

senses.gloss: descarga elétrica que ocorre entre uma nuvem e o solo

examples.text: Tom ignorou o conselho de Mary.

translations.de: Tom missachtete Marys Rat.
translations.en: Tom ignored Mary's advice.
translations.fr: Tom a ignoré le conseil de Mary.

examples.text: Tanto em vida quanto depois de morto, ele foi desconhecido e ignorado.

translations.de: Sowohl im Leben als auch nach dem Tod war er unbekannt und wurde ignoriert.
translations.en: Both in life and after death, he was unknown and ignored.
translations.fr: De son vivant comme après sa mort, il était inconnu et ignoré.

examples.text: Eles deveriam ser ignorados.

translations.en: They should be ignored.
translations.fr: Ils devraient être ignorés.

examples.text: Se você ignora o passado, põe o futuro em jogo.

translations.en: If you ignore the past, you jeopardize the future.
translations.fr: Si vous ignorez le passé, vous mettez l'avenir en péril.

more.definition: to ignore (to deliberately pay no attention to); to lack an important quality
more.etymology: Proto-Indo-European *ǵneh₃-der. Latin īgnōrārelbor. Learned borrowing from Latin īgnōrāre (“not to know; to ignore”).

examples.text: Tom tem talento.

translations.de: Tom hat Talent.
translations.en: Tom has talent.
translations.fr: Tom a du talent.

examples.text: Admiro seu talento.

translations.de: Ich bewundere Ihr Talent.
translations.en: I admire your talent.
translations.fr: J'admire ton talent.

examples.text: Temos que desenvolver nossos talentos.

translations.de: Wir müssen unsere Talente entfalten.
translations.fr: Nous devons développer nos talents.

examples.text: Ela tem um talento natural para a música.

translations.en: She has a natural talent for music.
translations.fr: Elle a un talent naturel pour la musique.

more.definition: talent (Classical unit of weight and money); talent (marked natural ability or skill)
more.etymology: Borrowed from Latin talentum (“a Grecian weight; a talent of money”), from Ancient Greek τάλαντον (tálanton, “balance; a particular weight, especially of gold; sum of money; a talent”), from Proto-Indo-European *tl̥h₂ent-, from *telh₂-.

senses.gloss: engenho; uma habilidade especial de fazer algo

examples.text: Hoje é domingo.

translations.de: Heute ist Sonntag.
translations.en: Today is Sunday.
translations.fr: Aujourd'hui c'est dimanche.

examples.text: Eu nasci num domingo de janeiro.

translations.de: Ich bin an einem Sonntag im Januar geboren.
translations.en: I was born on a Sunday in January.
translations.fr: Je suis né un dimanche de janvier.

examples.text: Segunda-feira é o dia que vem depois do domingo.

translations.de: Montag ist der Tag nach Sonntag.
translations.en: Monday is the day that comes after Sunday.
translations.fr: Le lundi est le jour qui suit le dimanche.

examples.text: Domingo, segunda, terça, quarta, quinta, sexta e sábado.

translations.de: Sonntag, Montag, Dienstag, Mittwoch, Donnerstag, Freitag und Samstag.
translations.en: Sunday, Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday, Friday, and Saturday.
translations.fr: Dimanche, lundi, mardi, mercredi, jeudi, vendredi et samedi.

more.definition: Sunday
more.etymology: From Old Galician-Portuguese domingo, from a shortening of Late Latin diēs Dominicus (“Sunday”, literally “day of the Lord”). Doublet of domínico, which is a borrowing.

senses.gloss: denominação dada ao último ou primeiro dia do calendário semanal em português; é o dia que vem depois de sábado e antes de segunda-feira

examples.text: Tatoeba não é uma escola — é uma universidade!

translations.de: Tatoeba ist keine Schule — es ist eine Universität!
translations.en: Tatoeba is not a school — it is a university!
translations.fr: Tatoeba n'est pas une école — c'est une université!

examples.text: As escolas e universidades estão fechadas.

translations.de: Die Schulen und Universitäten sind geschlossen.
translations.en: Schools and universities are closed.

examples.text: Juli está na universidade porque é estudante.

translations.de: Juli ist in der Universität, weil sie Studentin ist.
translations.en: Juli is in the university because she is a student.

examples.text: A biblioteca da universidade está aberta agora?

translations.de: Hat die Universitätsbibliothek im Moment geöffnet?
translations.en: Is the university's library open now?

more.definition: university
more.etymology: Inherited from Old Galician-Portuguese universidade, possibly borrowed from Old Spanish universidat, a learned borrowing from Medieval Latin ūniversitās, from Latin ūniversus + -tas.

senses.gloss: instituição que tem por objetivo fornecer ensino de nível superior, graduação, e pós-graduação, além de fazer pesquisas científicas

examples.text: Ela fala chinês.

translations.de: Sie spricht Chinesisch.
translations.en: She speaks Chinese.
translations.fr: Elle parle chinois.

translations.de: Er fragte, ob ich chinesisches Essen möge.

translations.en: Please reply in Chinese or English.
translations.fr: S'il vous plaît, répondez en chinois ou en anglais.

translations.de: Ich mag chinesisches Essen.

translations.fr: J'aime la nourriture chinoise.

more.etymology: From China + -ês.

senses.gloss: relativo à China, sua cultura e seu povo

examples.text: Ela fala chinês.

translations.de: Sie spricht Chinesisch.
translations.en: She speaks Chinese.
translations.fr: Elle parle chinois.

examples.text: Gosto de comida chinesa.

translations.de: Ich mag chinesisches Essen.

examples.text: Por favor, responda em chinês ou em inglês.

translations.de: Ich unterrichte Chinesisch.
translations.en: I teach Chinese.
translations.fr: J'enseigne le chinois.

more.definition: Chinese person; Chinese language; ellipsis of loja do chinês

examples.text: Há uma ponte de corda sobre o rio.

translations.de: Über den Fluss führt eine Seilbrücke.
translations.en: There's a rope bridge over the river.
translations.fr: Il y a un pont de corde sur la rivière.

examples.text: Segurei firme na corda para não cair.

translations.en: I held on to the rope tightly so I wouldn't fall.
translations.fr: Je me suis fermement tenue à la corde pour ne pas tomber.

examples.text: A corda é muito fraca.

translations.en: The string is very weak.
translations.fr: La corde est très fragile.

examples.text: Nós cortamos a corda.

translations.en: We cut off the rope.
translations.fr: Nous avons coupé la corde.

more.definition: rope, string; winding mechanism; cord, heartstring
more.etymology: Proto-Indo-European *ǵʰerH-der. Ancient Greek χορδή (khordḗ)bor. Inherited from Latin chorda (“cord”), borrowed from Ancient Greek χορδή (khordḗ, “guts, tripe”).

senses.gloss: cabo de fios vegetais unidos e torcidos uns sobre os outros

examples.text: Aprendi muitas lições importantes neste livro.

translations.de: Ich habe aus diesem Buch viele wichtige Lektionen gelernt.
translations.en: I learned many important lessons from this book.
translations.fr: J'ai appris beaucoup de leçons importantes dans ce livre.

examples.text: Você deve ministrar-lhe uma lição!

translations.de: Du musst ihr einmal eine Lektion erteilen!
translations.en: You need to teach her a lesson!
translations.fr: Tu dois lui donner une leçon !

examples.text: Nós aprendemos a nossa lição.

translations.de: Wir haben unsere Lektion gelernt.
translations.en: We've learned our lesson.
translations.fr: Nous avons appris notre leçon.

examples.text: Essa história é curta o bastante para ser lida em uma lição.

translations.de: Diese Geschichte ist kurz genug, um in einer Stunde gelesen zu werden.
translations.en: This story is short enough to read in one lesson.
translations.fr: Cette histoire est suffisamment courte pour être lue en une heure.

more.definition: lesson (section of learning or teaching); lesson (something learned); lesson (something that serves as a warning or encouragement)
more.etymology: Inherited from Old Galician-Portuguese liçon, from Latin lēctiōnem.

senses.gloss: tarefa que o professor passa ao aluno para solidificar o aprendizado

examples.text: Você gosta da chuva?

translations.de: Magst du Regen?
translations.en: Do you like rain?
translations.fr: Aimes-tu la pluie ?

examples.text: A chuva chove mansamente como um sono.

translations.de: Der Regen fällt sanft wie ein Schlaf.
translations.en: The rain falls gently like sleep.
translations.fr: La pluie tombe doucement comme un sommeil.

examples.text: Com a chuva, os rios crescem.

translations.de: Mit dem Regen wachsen die Flüsse.
translations.en: With the rain, the rivers grow.
translations.fr: Avec la pluie, les rivières grossissent.

examples.text: Acho que vai chover. Vou levar o guarda-chuva.

translations.de: Ich glaube, es wird regnen. Ich nehme meinen Regenschirm mit.
translations.en: I think it's going to rain. I'll take my umbrella.
translations.fr: Je crois qu'il va pleuvoir. Je vais prendre mon parapluie.

more.definition: rain
more.etymology: Latin tempestās pluviaellip. Inherited from Old Galician-Portuguese chuvia, from Latin pluvia. Compare Galician choiva, Spanish lluvia.

senses.gloss: fenômeno recorrente em que ocorre precipitação de água em estado líquido em volume maior ou igual a gotas

examples.text: Espero vê-la de novo.

translations.de: Ich hoffe, Sie wiederzusehen.
translations.en: I hope to see you again.
translations.fr: J'espère vous revoir.

examples.text: Toki Pona é uma língua muito fácil. Dominá-la porém é bem difícil.

translations.de: Toki Pona ist eine sehr einfache Sprache. Es zu meistern ist jedoch sehr schwierig.
translations.en: Toki Pona is a very easy language. Mastering it, however, is very difficult.
translations.fr: Toki pona est une langue très simple. La maîtriser, cependant, est très difficile.
