translations.de: Was für eine kalte, kleine Hand! Erlauben Sie mir, sie aufzuwärmen.
translations.en: What a cold little hand! Allow me to warm it up.
translations.fr: Quelle petite main froide ! Permettez-moi de la réchauffer.

examples.text: Tenho vontade de beijá-la mil vezes.

translations.de: Ich möchte sie tausend Mal küssen.
translations.en: I want to kiss her a thousand times.
translations.fr: J'ai envie de l'embrasser mille fois.

examples.text: Espero vê-la de novo.

translations.de: Ich hoffe, Sie wiederzusehen.
translations.en: I hope to see you again.
translations.fr: J'espère vous revoir.

examples.text: Depois de assim queixoso censurá-la, ele os passos dirige até a cidade.

translations.de: Nachdem er sie so getadelt hat, macht er sich auf den Weg in die Stadt.
translations.en: After reprimanding her, he heads toward the city.
translations.fr: Après s'être ainsi plaint et l'avoir réprimandée, il poursuit son chemin vers la ville.

examples.text: Toki Pona é uma língua muito fácil. Dominá-la porém é bem difícil.

translations.de: Toki Pona ist eine sehr einfache Sprache. Es zu meistern ist jedoch sehr schwierig.
translations.en: Toki Pona is a very easy language. Mastering it, however, is very difficult.
translations.fr: Toki pona est une langue très simple. La maîtriser, cependant, est très difficile.

examples.text: Por Interlíngua novamente apaixonado, prometo nunca mais abandoná-la.

translations.de: Da ich mich wieder in Interlingua verliebt habe, verspreche ich, sie nie wieder zu verlassen.
translations.en: Having fallen in love with Interlingua again, I promise I'll never abandon it.
translations.fr: Étant retombé amoureux d'Interlingua, je promets de ne jamais l'abandonner.

examples.text: A vovó não gostava de pensar nisso.

translations.en: Grandma didn't like to think about that.

examples.text: Nós estamos preocupados com vovô e vovó.

translations.en: We're worried about Grandpa and Grandma.

examples.text: No Museu da Inocência, a lembrança do amor foi conservada.

translations.en: At the Museum of Innocence, the memory of love has been preserved.
translations.fr: Au Musée de l'Innocence, le souvenir de l'amour a été préservé.

examples.text: A vida é frágil e efêmera. Hoje estamos aqui, amanhã nos tornamos lembrança.

translations.de: Das Leben ist zerbrechlich und vergänglich. Heute sind wir hier, morgen sind wir nur noch eine Erinnerung.
translations.en: Life is fragile and fleeting. Today we are here, tomorrow we become a memory.
translations.fr: La vie est fragile et éphémère. Aujourd'hui nous sommes là, demain nous ne serons plus qu'un souvenir.

translations.de: Die Zeit ist eine flüchtige Kombination aus Erinnerung und Hoffnung.
translations.en: Time is a fleeting combination of memory and hope.

translations.de: Die Vergangenheit ist Erinnerung, die Zukunft ist Hoffnung, die Gegenwart ist Illusion.
translations.en: The past is memory, the future is hope, and the present is an illusion.

translations.fr: Tout le monde n'a pas compris l'humour de l'auteur de cette phrase.

examples.text: Você tem senso de humor.

translations.en: You have a sense of humor.
translations.fr: Tu as le sens de l'humour.

examples.text: Um senso de comunidade é importante para a faculdade.

translations.en: A sense of community is important to the college.
translations.fr: Le sens de la communauté est important pour le collège.

more.definition: conscious awareness; sound practical judgement; natural appreciation or ability
more.etymology: Learned borrowing from Latin sēnsus (“sense”), perfect passive participle of sēntiō (“to feel, to perceive”), from Proto-Indo-European *sent- (“to head for, go”). Doublet of siso.

examples.text: A torre é tão importante assim no jogo de xadrez?

translations.de: Ist der Turm im Schach so wichtig?
translations.en: Is the rook that important in the game of chess?
translations.fr: La tour est-elle si importante dans le jeu d'échecs ?

examples.text: A torre Eiffel é feita de aço.

translations.en: The Eiffel Tower's made of steel.
translations.fr: La Tour Eiffel est en acier.

examples.text: A casa do Tom tem uma torre.

translations.de: Toms Haus hat einen Turm.
translations.en: Tom's house has a tower.

examples.text: Eu nunca vi a Torre Eiffel.

translations.de: Ich habe nie den Eiffelturm gesehen.
translations.en: I've never seen the Eiffel Tower.

more.definition: tower; rook; skyscraper
more.etymology: Inherited from Old Galician-Portuguese torre (“tower”), from Latin turrem (“tower”), from Ancient Greek τύρσις (túrsis, “tower, bastion”). Cognate with Galician, Spanish, Catalan, Occitan, Italian, and Ladino torre and French tour.

examples.text: As borboletas são leves, mas os elefantes são muito pesados.

translations.de: Schmetterlinge sind leicht, Elefanten hingegen sehr schwer.
translations.en: Butterflies are light, but elephants are very heavy.
translations.fr: Les papillons sont légers, mais les éléphants sont très lourds.

examples.text: A mesa é pequena, mas é pesada.

translations.de: Der Tisch ist klein aber schwer.
translations.en: The table is small but heavy.
translations.fr: La table est petite mais lourde.

examples.text: Este livro é pesado.

translations.de: Dieses Buch ist schwer.
translations.en: This book is heavy.
translations.fr: Ce livre est lourd.

examples.text: Ela é muito mais pesada que ele.

translations.de: Sie ist viel schwerer als er.
translations.en: She's much heavier than him.

more.definition: heavy (having great weight); heavy, deep, intense (of great force or intensity)
more.etymology: Past participle of pesar. From Old Galician-Portuguese pesado.

examples.text: Os médicos removeram a bala.

translations.en: Doctors removed the bullet.
translations.fr: Les médecins ont extrait la balle.

examples.text: O enfermeiro está removendo os meus pontos.

translations.en: The nurse is removing my stitches.

examples.text: As plantas removem o carbono da atmosfera.

translations.en: Plants remove carbon from the atmosphere.

examples.text: As manchas de café podem ser removidas?

translations.en: Can coffee stains be removed?

more.definition: to remove
more.etymology: Inherited from Old Galician-Portuguese remover, from Latin removēre (“to remove”).

examples.text: Há quase sete bilhões de pessoas no mundo.

translations.fr: Il y a près de sept milliards de personnes dans le monde.

examples.text: Um bilhão de pessoas falam inglês.

translations.en: One billion people speak English.

examples.text: Há bilhões de estrelas no céu.

translations.en: There are billions of stars in the sky.

examples.text: Zero, dez, cem, mil, um milhão, um bilhão.

translations.fr: Zéro, dix, cent, mille, un million, un milliard.

more.definition: billion (10⁹); billion (an unspecified very large number); billon

examples.text: O que você faria se tivesse um bilhão de dólares?

translations.en: What would you do if you had a billion dollars?

examples.text: Segundo um levantamento, um bilhão de pessoas sofrem de pobreza no mundo.

translations.en: According to a survey, 1 billion people are suffering from poverty in the world.

examples.text: A companhia sofreu uma perda de um bilhão de ienes no ano passado.

translations.en: The company suffered a loss of one billion yen last year.

examples.text: Um bilhão de pessoas falam inglês.

translations.en: One billion people speak English.

more.etymology: Do francês billion⁽ᶠʳ⁾.

examples.text: Ela vai ao salão de beleza pelo menos uma vez por semana.

translations.en: She goes to the beauty salon at least once a week.
translations.fr: Elle va au salon de beauté au moins 1 fois par semaine.

examples.text: É necessário que os homens também frequentem salões de beleza?

translations.fr: Faut-il que les hommes, eux aussi, fréquentent les salons de beauté ?

examples.text: Este salão pode abrigar até trezentas pessoas.

translations.de: Dieser Saal hier kann dreihundert Menschen fassen.

examples.text: Minha mãe foi ao salão de beleza.

translations.de: Meine Mutter ist in das Kosmetikgeschäft gegangen.

more.definition: hall, salon, parlour, saloon; ellipsis of salão de beleza
more.etymology: From sala + -ão.

examples.text: Hoje o Cristianismo celebra o primeiro advento.

translations.de: Die Christen feiern heute den ersten Advent.
translations.en: Today, Christianity celebrates the first Advent.

examples.text: Como você celebrou o seu aniversário?

translations.en: How did you celebrate your birthday?
translations.fr: Comment as-tu fêté ton anniversaire ?

examples.text: Celebramos o Festival das Estrelas em julho.

translations.en: We celebrate the Star Festival in July.
translations.fr: Nous célébrons le Festival des Étoiles en juillet.

examples.text: Tom celebrou seu vigésimo aniversário na semana passada.

translations.de: Tom feierte vergangene Woche seinen zwanzigsten Geburtstag.
translations.en: Tom celebrated his twentieth birthday last week.

more.definition: to celebrate (all senses)
more.etymology: Proto-Indo-European *-h₂tiinflu. Latin celebrārelbor. Learned borrowing from Latin celebrāre.

examples.text: O carro não está na garagem. Quem o tirou de lá?

translations.de: Das Auto ist nicht in der Garage. Wer hat es von dort mitgenommen?
translations.en: The car isn't in the garage. Who took it from there?
translations.fr: La voiture n'est pas dans le garage. Qui l'a prise ?

examples.text: A bicicleta dos meninos está na garagem.

translations.de: Das Fahrrad der Jungen ist in der Garage.
translations.en: The boys' bicycle is in the garage.

examples.text: O carro está em frente à garagem.

translations.de: Das Auto steht vor der Garage.
translations.en: The car is in front of the garage.

examples.text: Ponha meu carro na garagem.

translations.de: Stell meinen Wagen in die Garage.
translations.en: Put my car in the garage.

more.definition: garage (place to store a car); garage (place where cars are repaired)
more.etymology: Proto-Indo-European *wer-der. Frankish *warōnbor. Old Norse varabor. French garagebor. Borrowed from French garage (“garage”).

senses.gloss: casa ou local para a recolha de veículos

examples.text: O quadro está pendurado na parede.

translations.de: Das Bild hängt an der Wand.
translations.en: The picture is hanging on the wall.
translations.fr: L'image est accrochée au mur.

examples.text: Onde eu poderia pendurar esse calendário?

translations.de: Wo könnte ich diesen Kalender aufhängen?
translations.fr: Où pourrais-je accrocher ce calendrier ?

examples.text: Eu me pergunto onde pendurar a foto que ele me deu.

translations.en: I wonder where to hang the picture he gave me.
translations.fr: Je me demande où accrocher la photo qu'il m'a donnée.

examples.text: Por favor pendure seu casaco na antessala.

translations.en: Please hang your coat in the anteroom.

more.definition: to hang (cause (something) to be suspended); to give up or retire from a profession (followed by the name of a piece of clothing associated with the profession); to put on one's tab (informal credit account in a bar or shop)
more.etymology: Inherited from Old Galician-Portuguese pendurar, pendorar, from Medieval Latin pendulāre, from Latin pendulus (“hanging”), from pendeō (“to hang”).

examples.text: Os elevadores em arranha céus são sistemas vitais.

translations.de: Die Aufzüge eines Wolkenkratzers sind lebenswichtige Systeme.
translations.en: The elevators in a skyscraper are vital systems.
translations.fr: Les ascenseurs d’un gratte-ciel sont des systèmes vitaux.

examples.text: O elevador está quebrado novamente.

translations.en: The elevator is broken again.
translations.fr: L'ascenseur est à nouveau en panne.

examples.text: Minha mãe tem medo de elevadores.

translations.de: Meine Mutter hat Angst vor Aufzügen.
translations.fr: Ma mère a peur des ascenseurs.

examples.text: Eu peguei o elevador.

translations.en: I took the elevator.
translations.fr: J'ai pris l'ascenseur.

more.definition: something which elevates (agent noun of elevar); elevator, lift (mechanical device for vertically transporting goods or people)
more.etymology: Proto-Italic *breɣʷisinflu. Proto-Indo-European *-h₂tiinflu. Latin ēlevārelbor. From elevar (“to elevate”) + -dor.

examples.text: A vila onde vivo é consideravelmente pequena.

translations.en: The town in which I live is rather small.

examples.text: O ônibus parou em todas as vilas.

translations.fr: Le bus s'est arrêté dans chaque village.

examples.text: Tom cresceu em uma vila de pescadores.

translations.en: Tom grew up in a fishing village.

examples.text: Os três homens deixaram a vila juntos.

translations.en: The three men left the villa together.

more.definition: town; country house; a low-class residential area, like row houses, but in a self-managed community around a cul-de-sac
more.etymology: From Old Galician-Portuguese vila (“village”), from Latin villa (“country house”). Cognate with Galician vila, Spanish and Italian villa, and French ville. The sense of a slum is a semantic loan from Spanish villa.

senses.gloss: povoação de tamanho intermédio entre aldeia e cidade

examples.text: Ela recusou nossa proposta.

translations.de: Sie lehnte unseren Vorschlag ab.
translations.en: She turned down our proposal.
translations.fr: Elle refusa notre proposition.

examples.text: Sua proposta está completamente fora de questão.

translations.en: His proposal is completely out of the question.
translations.fr: Sa proposition est complètement hors de question.

examples.text: A maioria não aceitou a proposta.

translations.de: Die Mehrheit nahm den Antrag nicht an.
translations.en: The majority didn't accept the proposal.

examples.text: Estou de acordo com sua proposta.

translations.en: I agree with your proposal.
translations.fr: Je suis d'accord avec sa proposition.

more.definition: proposal
more.etymology: Learned borrowing from Latin prōposita.

examples.text: Ele também se orgulha do que seus alunos realizaram.

translations.en: He, too, is proud of what his students have accomplished.
translations.fr: Il est également fier de ce que ses étudiants ont accompli.

examples.text: Eu quero que os meus pais se orgulhem de mim.

translations.en: I want my parents to be proud of me.
translations.fr: Je veux que mes parents soient fiers de moi.

examples.text: Fiz coisas das quais não me orgulho.

translations.en: I've done some things I'm not proud of.
translations.fr: J'ai fait des choses dont je ne suis pas fier.

examples.text: Orgulha-te de ti.

translations.en: Be proud of yourself.
translations.fr: Sois fière de toi.

more.etymology: From orgulho (“pride”) + -ar.

examples.text: O palhaço está com medo do escuro.

translations.en: The clown is afraid of the dark.

translations.en: Not all clowns are funny.

examples.text: O palhaço tem medo do escuro.

translations.en: The clown is afraid of the dark.

translations.en: Congratulations! You're a clown.

more.etymology: Borrowed from Italian pagliaccio, from paglia (“straw, Portuguese palha”). Compare Spanish payaso and Sicilian pagghiazzu.

examples.text: Sei que sou um palhaço.

translations.en: I know I'm a clown.

examples.text: O grupo de palhaços começou a tropeçar enquanto corria.

translations.en: The group of clowns began stumbling as they ran.

examples.text: Estavam todos fantasiados de palhaço.

translations.en: They were all dressed up as clowns.

examples.text: O palhaço caiu de propósito.

translations.en: The clown fell down on purpose.

more.definition: clown; any funny or amusing person; a silly or stupid person; imbecile
more.etymology: Borrowed from Italian pagliaccio, from paglia (“straw, Portuguese palha”). Compare Spanish payaso and Sicilian pagghiazzu.

examples.text: Eu devo ter me expressado mal.

translations.en: I must have expressed myself badly.
translations.fr: J'ai dû mal m'exprimer.

translations.en: Can it be phrased in another way?

translations.fr: Pouvez-vous exprimer votre réponse d'une manière compréhensible ?

translations.en: Dan expressed his racist beliefs in public.

translations.en: This circle was drawn by a compass.

more.etymology: Proto-Indo-European *(s)ker-der. Ancient Greek κίρκος (kírkos)bor. Latin circuluslbor. Learned borrowing from Latin circulus.

examples.text: O médico o aconselhou a diminuir a bebida.

translations.en: Maybe I drank too much.

translations.fr: Tu as besoin d'une boisson.

examples.text: Tom é um perdedor.

translations.en: Tom is a loser.

examples.text: Tom é um perdedor.

translations.de: Tom ist ein Verlierer.
translations.en: Tom is a loser.

translations.en: You're a loser, too.

translations.en: We are not losers!

examples.text: Honestamente, eu preferia estar errado.

translations.en: Honestly, I would rather be wrong.
translations.fr: Honnêtement, je préfèrerais me tromper.

examples.text: A minha irmã brinca de boneca.

translations.fr: Tom a caché la poupée de Mary derrière la porte.

senses.gloss: figura de qualquer material que imita senhora ou menina utilizada como adorno ou brinquedo

translations.fr: Elle maintient la flamme de la démocratie allumée au milieu de l'obscurité grandissante.

translations.en: Light combined with other light can produce darkness.
translations.fr: La lumière combinée à d'autres lumières peut produire de l'obscurité.

translations.en: The boy was afraid of the dark.
translations.fr: Le garçon avait peur des ténèbres.

examples.text: Ela foi com as amigas ao centro comercial.

translations.en: She went to the mall with her friends.
translations.fr: Elle est allée au centre commercial avec ses amies.

translations.en: What are the business hours?

translations.en: The United States has a large trade deficit.

examples.text: Ela foi com as amigas ao centro comercial.

translations.en: She went to the mall with her friends.
translations.fr: Elle est allée au centre commercial avec ses amies.

translations.en: The two nations have strong trade ties.

translations.en: I'm working for a trading firm.

translations.en: There are many commercial firms in New York.

more.etymology: Latin -iusnom. Late Latin commerciālislbor. Learned borrowing from Late Latin commerciālis. By surface analysis, comércio + -al.

senses.gloss: propaganda, particularmente na televisão e no rádio

examples.text: Felipe tem dois carros e uma moto.

translations.en: Felipe has two cars and one motorcycle.
translations.fr: Felipe a deux voitures et une moto.

translations.en: There are two motorcycles at the gate of the park.

translations.en: Why don't you buy a motorcycle?

translations.en: The dog started running after the motorbike.

examples.text: O futebol é o meu esporte preferido.

translations.de: Fußball ist mein Lieblingssport.

translations.fr: Le football est mon sport préféré.

translations.fr: Quel est ton sport préféré ?

translations.en: Do you play any sports?
translations.fr: Pratiques-tu un sport ?

senses.gloss: conjunto de exercícios físicos praticados com método, individualmente ou em equipe

examples.text: Eles analisaram os resultados.

translations.en: They analyzed the results.
translations.fr: Ils ont analysé les résultats.

translations.en: At this time, we're looking into every possibility.

translations.en: We need to assess the situation objectively.

examples.text: Isto nem merece ser analisado.

translations.en: This is not even worth analyzing.

more.etymology: Proto-Indo-European *lewh₁-der. Ancient Greek ἀνάλυσις (análusis)bor. Medieval Latin analysislbor. From análise + -ar.

examples.text: Fizemos isso como uma jogada de marketing.

translations.en: We did that as a publicity stunt.

translations.de: Die Partie endete remis nach Zugwiederholung.

translations.en: I think that this shirt can be thrown away.

translations.en: The bell announces the end of the classes.

translations.en: They advertised that they had a house for sale.

translations.fr: Le génie meurt un jour. La légende est immortelle.

examples.text: Comprei um livro de lendas folclóricas.

more.etymology: From Old Galician-Portuguese cela (“cell”), from Latin cella (“small room”), from Proto-Indo-European *ḱelnā.

examples.text: Estou muito animado para amanhã. Acredito que meu time vai ganhar.

translations.en: I'm really excited about tomorrow. I think my team is going to win.
translations.fr: J'ai vraiment hâte d'être à demain. Je suis convaincu que mon équipe va gagner.

examples.text: Estou tão animado!

translations.de: Ich bin ja so aufgeregt!
translations.en: I'm so excited.

examples.text: As pessoas bebem café para ficarem animadas.

translations.fr: Les gens boivent du café pour se donner la pêche.

examples.text: As crianças gostam de ver desenhos animados.

translations.en: Children like to watch cartoons.

more.definition: cheerful; joyful; vivacious (noticeably happy and optimistic); lively; vigorous (endowed with life); animated (in the format of an animated cartoon)
more.etymology: Borrowed from Latin animātus, perfect participle of animō.

examples.text: Tudo é Um. Matéria e espírito são faces da mesma moeda.

translations.de: Alles ist Eins. Materie und Geist sind Seiten der gleichen Medaille.
translations.en: Everything is One. Matter and spirit are two sides of the same coin.
translations.fr: Tout est Un. La matière et l’esprit sont les faces d’une même médaille.

examples.text: O Tom tinha uma equimose na face.

translations.en: Tom had a bruise on his face.

examples.text: Sami revelou sua verdadeira face à Layla.

translations.en: Sami revealed his true self to Layla.

examples.text: Em tuas faces rosadas repousa a inocência.

translations.fr: Tes joues rouges respirent l'innocence.

more.definition: face; the cheek
more.etymology: From Old Galician-Portuguese façe, faz, from Latin faciēs. Doublet of fácies.

senses.gloss: parte do corpo humano onde se encontram os olhos, nariz e boca

examples.text: Se a frase tem bom ritmo, está certa.

translations.de: Wenn der Satz einen guten Rhythmus hat, ist er richtig.
translations.en: If the sentence has a good rhythm, it's alright.
translations.fr: Si la phrase a un bon rythme, c'est juste.

examples.text: Esta frase tem um ritmo quaternário.

translations.de: Dieser Satz hat einen quaternären Rhythmus.
translations.en: This phrase has a quaternary rhythm.
translations.fr: Cette phrase a un rythme quaternaire.

examples.text: Há diferentes ritmos nas línguas.

translations.en: There are different rhythms in languages.

examples.text: Eu preciso encontrar o meu próprio ritmo.

translations.en: I need to find my own rhythm.

more.definition: rhythm
more.etymology: From Latin rhythmus, from Ancient Greek ῥυθμός (rhuthmós), from ῥέω (rhéō, “to flow”).

senses.gloss: movimento ou procedimento com recorrência uniforme de uma batida, marcação, etc

examples.text: Assim estabelece a lei.

translations.en: That's the law.
translations.fr: Ainsi établit la loi.

examples.text: Podemos estabelecer um assentamento humano em Marte?

translations.en: Can we establish a human settlement on Mars?

examples.text: Ele se estabeleceu como político.

translations.en: He established himself as a politician.

examples.text: Decidiram estabelecer-se na Virgínia naquele ano.

translations.en: They decided to settle down in Virginia that year.

more.definition: to establish
more.etymology: From Old Galician-Portuguese estabelecer, from Vulgar Latin *stabilēscere, from Latin stabilīre.

examples.text: Não se pode fazer a tradução de uma expressão idiomática literalmente.

translations.de: Eine Redewendung kann man nicht wörtlich übersetzen.
translations.en: An idiomatic expression cannot be translated literally.
translations.fr: On ne peut pas traduire littéralement une expression idiomatique.

examples.text: Traduzir literalmente nem sempre é a melhor opção.

translations.de: Wörtliches Übersetzen ist nicht immer die beste Option.
translations.en: Translating literally is not always the best option.
translations.fr: Traduire littéralement n’est pas toujours la meilleure option.

examples.text: Eu traduziria um pouco menos literalmente.

translations.de: Ich würde es etwas weniger wörtlich übersetzen.
translations.en: I would translate it a little less literally.
translations.fr: Je le traduirais un peu moins littéralement.

examples.text: Nós somos, literalmente, o universo olhando-se a si mesmo.

translations.de: Wir sind buchstäblich das Universum, das sich selbst betrachtet.
translations.en: We are, quite literally, the universe looking at itself.
translations.fr: Nous sommes, littéralement, l'univers qui se contemple lui-même.

more.definition: literally, word for word; literally (used to intensify or dramatize non-figurative statements)
more.etymology: Proto-Indo-European *h₂leyH-der. Ancient Greek διφθέρᾱ (diphthérā)bor. Late Latin litterālislbor. From literal + -mente.

examples.text: Saiu fumaça da chaminé.

translations.de: Aus dem Schornstein kam schwarzer Rauch.
translations.en: Black smoke came out of the chimney.
translations.fr: De la fumée noire sortit de la cheminée.

examples.text: Saía fumaça da chaminé.

translations.de: Aus dem Schornstein stieg Rauch auf.
translations.en: Smoke was rising from the chimney.
translations.fr: De la fumée sortait de la cheminée.

examples.text: Uma fumaça negra saiu da chaminé.

translations.de: Aus dem Schornstein kam schwarzer Rauch.
translations.en: Black smoke came out of the chimney.
translations.fr: De la fumée noire sortit de la cheminée.

examples.text: Onde há fumaça há fogo.

translations.en: There's no smoke without fire.
translations.fr: Là où il y a de la fumée, il y a du feu.

more.definition: smoke (particles and vapor/vapour given off by burning material)
more.etymology: From fumo + -aça, from Old Galician-Portuguese fumo, from Latin fūmus (“smoke”), from Proto-Indo-European *dʰuh₂mós (“smoke”).

senses.gloss: os gases e vapores visíveis que exalam de um corpo em chamas

examples.text: Tom deve estar furioso com Maria.

translations.en: Tom must be furious with Mary.
translations.fr: Tom doit être furieux contre Marie.

examples.text: Minha mãe estava furiosa.

translations.en: My mother was furious.
translations.fr: Ma mère était furieuse.

examples.text: Ela estava furiosa.

translations.en: She was furious.
translations.fr: Elle était furieuse.

examples.text: O Tom e a Mary ainda estão furiosos.

translations.en: Tom and Mary are still angry.

more.definition: furious; enraged; furious (moving or occurring with violence)
more.etymology: Borrowed from Latin furiōsus (“furious”), from furia (“rage”).

examples.text: Não conheço a bandeira deste país.

translations.de: Ich kenne die Flagge dieses Landes nicht.
translations.en: I don't know this country's flag.
translations.fr: Je ne connais pas le drapeau de ce pays.

examples.text: Verde, amarelo e azul são as cores da bandeira do Brasil.

translations.de: Grün, Gelb und Blau sind die Farben der brasilianischen Flagge.
translations.en: Green, yellow and dark blue are the colors of the Brazilian flag.
translations.fr: Le vert, le jaune et le bleu sont les couleurs du drapeau brésilien.

examples.text: A frase estava escrita em catalão. A bandeira, porém, indicava o Esperanto.

translations.de: Der Satz wurde auf Katalanisch geschrieben. Die Flagge zeigte jedoch Esperanto.
translations.en: The sentence was written in Catalan. The flag, however, indicated Esperanto.
translations.fr: La phrase a été écrite en catalan. Le drapeau indiquait cependant l'espéranto.

examples.text: A bandeira francesa é azul, branca e vermelha.

translations.en: The French flag is blue, white and red.
translations.fr: Le drapeau français est bleu, blanc et rouge.

more.definition: flag; each journey or travel of the bandeirantes; motto; ideal
more.etymology: Inherited from Old Galician-Portuguese bandeira, of uncertain origin.

senses.gloss: peça de tecido, geralmente presa na ponta superior de um mastro, com cores diversas e outros símbolos, usada como representação dum Estado, duma facção, dum grupo, duma nação ou dum país

examples.text: Tom encostou sua bicicleta em uma árvore.

translations.en: Tom leaned his bicycle against a tree.

examples.text: Quem é o homem encostado no portão?

translations.en: Who's the man leaning against the gate?

examples.text: Ele consegue encostar a língua no nariz.

translations.en: He can touch his nose with his tongue.

examples.text: O caminho subia a encosta íngreme em ziguezague.

translations.en: The path zigzagged up the steep slope.

more.definition: to support (physically); to touch; to close (a door) without locking it
more.etymology: Morfologia: en- + costa + -ar.

examples.text: A moça engravidou antes que o padre pudesse dizer Amém.

translations.en: The girl was pregnant before the priest could say Amen.

examples.text: Parece que os anjos disseram amém.
Ela diz amém a tudo o que ouve do marido.

more.definition: amen
more.etymology: Biblical Hebrew אָמֵן (āmên)bor. Koine Greek ᾱ̓μήν (āmḗn)bor. Latin āmēnlbor. Inherited from Old Galician-Portuguese amen, a learned borrowing from Latin āmēn, borrowed from Koine Greek ᾱ̓μήν (āmḗn), borrowed from Biblical Hebrew אָמֵן (āmên, “so be it”, “surely”).

examples.text: A moça engravidou antes que o padre pudesse dizer Amém.

translations.en: The girl was pregnant before the priest could say Amen.

examples.text: Parece que os anjos disseram amém.
Ela diz amém a tudo o que ouve do marido.

more.definition: assent, approval, agreement
more.etymology: Biblical Hebrew אָמֵן (āmên)bor. Koine Greek ᾱ̓μήν (āmḗn)bor. Latin āmēnlbor. Inherited from Old Galician-Portuguese amen, a learned borrowing from Latin āmēn, borrowed from Koine Greek ᾱ̓μήν (āmḗn), borrowed from Biblical Hebrew אָמֵן (āmên, “so be it”, “surely”).

examples.text: Não poderei consertá-lo sem minhas ferramentas.

translations.de: Ohne mein Werkzeug werde ich es nicht reparieren können.
translations.en: I won't be able to repair it without my tools.
translations.fr: Je ne pourrai pas le réparer sans mes outils.

examples.text: Com ferramentas ruins o operário trabalha pior.

translations.de: Mit schlechtem Werkzeug leistet der Arbeiter schlechtere Arbeit.
translations.en: With poor tools, workers perform worse.
translations.fr: Avec de mauvais outils, le travailleur est moins performant.

examples.text: Tatoeba é uma ferramenta incrivelmente útil para praticar tradução.

translations.en: Tatoeba is an incredibly useful tool to practice translation.
translations.fr: Tatoeba est un outil incroyablement utile pour s'entraîner à traduire.

examples.text: Bicicletas são ferramentas para sustentabilidade urbana.

translations.de: Fahrräder sind Hilfsmittel für städtische Nachhaltigkeit.
translations.en: Bicycles are tools for urban sustainability.

more.definition: tool (mechanical device intended to make a task easier); penis
more.etymology: From Old Galician-Portuguese, from Vulgar Latin ferrāmenta, from the plural of Latin ferrāmentum.

examples.text: Por que a vida é tão cheia de sofrimentos?

translations.de: Warum ist das Leben so voll mit Leiden?
translations.en: Why is life so full of suffering?
translations.fr: Pourquoi la vie est-elle si remplie de souffrance ?

examples.text: Os dois poemas exprimem o sofrimento humano.

translations.de: Die beiden Gedichte drücken das menschliche Leid aus.
translations.en: The two poems express human suffering.

examples.text: Aprendi observando os sofrimentos alheios.

translations.en: I learned by observing the sufferings of others.
translations.fr: J'ai appris en observant les souffrances des autres.

examples.text: O sofrimento devora o coração e também a coragem.

translations.de: Leid frisst das Herz und auch den Mut.
translations.en: Suffering devours your heart, and also your courage.

more.definition: suffering (the condition of someone who suffers); a prolonged physical or emotional distress; poverty (quality or state of being poor)
more.etymology: From sofrer (“to suffer”) + -mento, from Old Galician-Portuguese sofrer, from Latin sufferō (“to carry under; to suffer”).

examples.text: Tom estacionou o seu carro em frente a um hidrante.

translations.en: Tom parked his car in front of a fire hydrant.
translations.fr: Tom gara sa voiture en face d'une bouche d'incendie.

examples.text: Você pode estacionar aqui.

translations.de: Hier kann man parken.
translations.en: You can park here.

examples.text: Meu carro foi roubado. Ele já não está onde o estacionei.

translations.en: My car was stolen. It's no longer where I parked it.
translations.fr: Ma voiture a été volée. Elle n'est pas où je l'ai stationnée.

examples.text: Eu estacionei no lado esquerdo da rua justo em frente à escola.

translations.en: I parked on the left side of the street just in front of the school.
translations.fr: Je me suis garé du côté gauche de la rue, juste devant l'école.

more.definition: to stand still for a long time; to park (bring to a halt)
more.etymology: Latin stātiōnemlbor. Latin -ereinflu. From estação + -ar.

senses.gloss: deixar o veículo parado à beira da estrada ou do passeio

examples.text: Você aprenderá a usar esses dispositivos.

translations.en: You'll learn to use these devices.

examples.text: Como é que este dispositivo funciona?

translations.en: How does this device work?

examples.text: Por favor, desliguem seus dispositivos eletrônicos.

translations.en: Please turn off your electronic devices.

examples.text: Esta máquina não tem um dispositivo de segurança.

translations.en: This machine doesn't have a safety device.

more.definition: disposing; normative
more.etymology: From Latin dispositus + -ivo (compare French dispositif).

examples.text: O dispositivo cabe na palma da mão.

translations.en: The device fits in the palm of your hand.

examples.text: Este adaptador permite conectar até quatro dispositivos USB.

translations.en: This adapter lets you plug in up to four USB devices.

examples.text: Este dispositivo pode mostrar-se bem útil.

translations.fr: Ce dispositif peut se révéler bien utile.

examples.text: Vocês aprenderão a usar esses dispositivos.

translations.en: You'll learn to use these devices.

more.definition: device (piece of equipment), apparatus; mechanism; disposition
more.etymology: From Latin dispositus + -ivo (compare French dispositif).

senses.gloss: mecanismo utilizado para obter um certo resultado

examples.text: Como é o clima em Boston?

translations.de: Wie ist das Wetter in Boston?
translations.en: How's the weather in Boston?
translations.fr: Comment est le temps à Boston ?

examples.text: O clima muda.

translations.de: Das Klima verändert sich.
translations.en: The climate is changing.
translations.fr: Le climat change.

examples.text: O clima está mudando.

translations.de: Das Klima verändert sich.
translations.en: The climate is changing.
translations.fr: Le climat change.

examples.text: O clima deste país é frio e seco.

translations.de: Das Klima dieses Landes ist kalt und trocken.
translations.en: This country's climate is cold and dry.
translations.fr: Le climat de ce pays est froid et sec.

more.definition: climate (long-term manifestations of weather); mood; atmosphere (as in the situation)
more.etymology: Learned borrowing from Late Latin clīma, from Ancient Greek κλῐ́μᾰ (klĭ́mă, “region, zone”), from κλῐ́νω (klĭ́nō, “to slope, incline”), from Proto-Indo-European *ḱley- (“to lean”).

senses.gloss: as condições médias do tempo geralmente presentes numa região, como a temperatura, pressão do ar, umidade, precipitação, presença ou ausência do sol, ventos, etc

examples.text: As asas da borboleta se assemelham a pétalas de diáfana flor.

translations.de: Die Flügel des Schmetterlings ähneln den Blütenblättern einer durchsichtigen Blume.
translations.en: The butterfly's wings look like the petals of a diaphanous flower.
translations.fr: Les ailes du papillon ressemblent aux pétales d'une fleur diaphane.

examples.text: O medo dá asas aos pés.

translations.de: Angst verleiht den Füßen Flügel.
translations.en: Fear gives wings to the feet.
translations.fr: La peur donne des ailes aux pieds.

examples.text: Se nós tivéssemos asas, não mais haveria aviões.

translations.de: Wenn wir Flügel hätten, gäbe es keine Flugzeuge mehr.
translations.en: If we had wings, there would be no more planes.
translations.fr: Si nous avions des ailes, il n'y aurait plus d'avions.

examples.text: É um crime cortar as asas de uma águia.

translations.de: Es ist ein Verbrechen, einem Adler die Flügel abzuschneiden.
translations.en: It is a crime to cut off an eagle's wings.
translations.fr: C'est un crime de couper les ailes d'un aigle.

more.definition: wing (part of an animal or airplane); handle (part of an object which is held in the hand when used or moved)
more.etymology: Old Galician-Portuguese aainflu. Inherited from Old Galician-Portuguese asa, from Latin ānsa (“handle”). Merged with Old Galician-Portuguese aa (“wing”), from Latin āla (“wing”). Cognate with Galician asa (“handle”), Spanish asa (“handle”). Doublet of ansa.

senses.gloss: membro de um animal que serve para o voo

examples.text: O cérebro é plástico. O ser humano é o escultor do seu cérebro.

translations.de: Das Gehirn ist formbar. Der Mensch ist der Bildhauer seines eigenen Gehirns.
translations.en: The brain is plastic. Human beings are sculptors of their own brains.
translations.fr: Le cerveau est plastique. Les êtres humains sculptent leur propre cerveau.

examples.text: Nenhuma das flores é feita de plástico.

translations.de: Keine der Blumen ist aus Kunststoff gemacht.
translations.en: None of the flowers are made of plastic.

examples.text: Tom asfixiou Maria com uma sacola de plástico.

translations.de: Tom erstickte Maria mit einer Plastiktüte.
translations.en: Tom suffocated Mary with a plastic bag.

examples.text: Estas caixas são de plástico.

translations.de: Diese Schachteln sind aus Plastik.
translations.en: These boxes are made of plastic.

more.definition: plastic, malleable; mouldable; plastic surgery; plastic arts
more.etymology: Ancient Greek πλᾰστῐκός (plăstĭkós)der. Latin plasticusder. From Latin plasticus (“of molding”), from Ancient Greek πλαστικός (plastikós), from πλάσσειν (plássein, “to mold, form”).

translations.de: Das Gehirn ist formbar. Der Mensch ist der Bildhauer seines eigenen Gehirns.
translations.en: The brain is plastic. Human beings are sculptors of their own brains.

examples.text: Pode esquecer meu comentário.

translations.de: Du kannst meinen Kommentar vergessen.
translations.en: You can forget my comment.
translations.fr: Vous pouvez oublier mon commentaire.

examples.text: Por favor, não façam comentários insultuosos.

translations.de: Bitte macht keine beleidigenden Kommentare.
translations.en: Please do not make insulting comments.
translations.fr: Veuillez ne pas faire de commentaires insultants.

examples.text: Os comentários têm uma forma misteriosa de se perderem na vastidão da Tatoebalândia.

translations.de: Kommentare haben die mysteriöse Angewohnheit, in den Weiten Tatoebalands verloren zu gehen.
translations.en: Comments have a mysterious way of getting lost in the vastness of Tatoebastan.
translations.fr: Les commentaires ont la mystérieuse habitude de se perdre dans l'étendue de la Tatoébadie.

examples.text: Desculpe, porém devo confessar que não entendi bem seu comentário.

translations.de: Es tut mir leid, aber ich muss gestehen, dass ich Ihren Kommentar nicht ganz verstanden habe.
translations.en: Sorry, but I must confess that I didn't quite understand your comment.
translations.fr: Désolé, mais je dois avouer que je n'ai pas bien compris votre commentaire.

more.definition: comment, observation, remark; commentary; note, annotation
more.etymology: Latin commentāriuslbor. Learned borrowing from Latin commentārius (“notebook”).

examples.text: O jogador torceu o tornozelo ao cair.

translations.en: The player twisted his ankle when he fell.
translations.fr: Le joueur s'est tordu la cheville en tombant.

examples.text: Enquanto lamentamos a derrota do nosso time, a torcida adversária dança e ri.

translations.de: Während wir die Niederlage unserer Mannschaft beklagen, tanzen und lachen die gegnerischen Fans.
translations.en: While we lament our team's defeat, the opposing fans dance and laugh.
translations.fr: Alors que nous déplorons la défaite de notre équipe, les supporters adverses dansent et rient.

examples.text: Eu torci o tornozelo.

translations.en: I twisted my ankle.
translations.fr: Je me suis foulé la cheville.

examples.text: Ele torceu o tornozelo.

translations.en: He sprained his ankle.
translations.fr: Il s'est foulé la cheville.

more.definition: to twist (to turn the ends in opposite directions); to wring (to squeeze or twist tightly so that liquid is forced out); to twist (to injure a body part by bending it in the wrong direction)
idioms: aqui é que a porca torce o rabo
é de menino que se torce o pepino
more.etymology: Inherited from Vulgar Latin *torcĕre.

examples.text: A minha esposa adora torta de maçã.

translations.de: Meine Frau liebt Apfelkuchen.
translations.en: My wife loves apple pie.
translations.fr: Ma femme adore la tarte aux pommes.

examples.text: Vocês gostam de torta de maçã?

translations.en: Do you like apple pies?
translations.fr: Aimez-vous les tartes aux pommes ?

examples.text: Os dentes de Tom sempre foram tortos.

translations.en: Tom's teeth have always been crooked.

examples.text: Pau que nasce torto nunca se endireita.

translations.en: A leopard cannot change his spots.

more.definition: twisted, bent, crooked; awry; wrong, dishonest
more.etymology: From Old Galician-Portuguese torto, from Latin tortus, from torqueō. Cognate with Galician torto, Spanish tuerto, Catalan tort, French tordu, Italian torto and Romanian tort.

examples.text: Temos maçãs amarelas.

translations.de: Wir haben gelbe Äpfel.
translations.en: We have yellow apples.
translations.fr: Nous avons des pommes jaunes.

examples.text: A pobreza é cinzenta, o amarelo dourado é a cor da riqueza.

translations.de: Armut ist grau, Goldgelb ist die Farbe des Reichtums.
translations.en: Poverty is gray, golden yellow is the color of wealth.
translations.fr: La pauvreté est grise, le jaune doré est la couleur de la richesse.

examples.text: Em meu jardim há lindas flores amarelas, vermelhas, azuis e brancas.

translations.de: In meinem Garten gibt es wunderschöne gelbe, rote, blaue und weiße Blumen.
translations.en: In my garden, there are beautiful yellow, red, blue, and white flowers.
translations.fr: Dans mon jardin, il y a de belles fleurs jaunes, rouges, bleues et blanches.

examples.text: O cachorrinho branco está brincando com uma bola amarela no jardim.

translations.de: Der kleine weiße Hund spielt im Garten mit einem gelben Ball.
translations.en: The little white dog is playing with a yellow ball in the garden.
translations.fr: Le petit chien blanc joue avec une balle jaune dans le jardin.

more.definition: yellow in colour; wry; forced; unnatural
more.etymology: Proto-Indo-European *h₂eh₃mósder. Inherited from Old Galician-Portuguese amarelo (“yellow”), from Early Medieval Latin amārellus (“yellowish, pale”). Compare Galician amarelo, Fala amarelu, Mirandese amarielho, Spanish amarillo.

senses.gloss: que tem cor do ouro, do açafrão, do limão, da gema do ovo, do enxofre, do topázio, entre outros; que é da cor que se situa, no espectro solar, entre o verde e o alaranjado

examples.text: Nossa casa é um submarino amarelo.

translations.de: Unser Haus ist ein gelbes U-Boot.
translations.en: Our house is a yellow submarine.
translations.fr: Notre maison est un sous-marin jaune.

examples.text: Nossa casa era um submarino amarelo.

examples.text: Para ser justo, vai pelo caminho reto.

examples.text: Quais são os sintomas?

translations.de: Was sind die Symptome?
translations.en: What are the symptoms?

translations.en: Their symptoms are subsiding.

examples.text: Há muitas galáxias no Universo.

examples.text: Esta fábrica recicla trinta toneladas de plástico anualmente.

translations.en: This factory recycles thirty tons of plastic every year.

examples.text: A fábrica recicla trinta toneladas de plástico todo ano.

translations.en: This factory recycles thirty tons of plastic every year.

more.definition: metric ton, a unit of mass equal to 1000 kg; British or American ton, a unit of mass equal to 20 hundredweight, 2,240 or 2,000 pounds; tonelada, a traditional unit of mass, usually equivalent to 793 kg
more.etymology: From tonel (“tun”) + -ada (“-ful”), from Old Galician-Portuguese tonel, from Old French tonel (“little tun, cask”), from tone + -el (“-elle: forming diminutives”), from Late Latin tunna (“tun”), from Proto-Celtic *tunna (“hide, skin”). In reference to the English unit, calqued from English ton. Doublet of tunel. Cognate with Galician and Spanish tonelada.

examples.text: As palavras emocionam. Os olhos encantam. As mãos matam.

translations.de: Worte wecken Gefühle. Augen verzaubern. Hände töten.
translations.en: Words evoke emotion. Eyes enchant. Hands kill.
translations.fr: Les mots suscitent des émotions. Les yeux enchantent. Les mains tuent.

examples.text: Atenas me encantou, pelo menos a cidade.

translations.de: Athen hat mich verzaubert, zumindest die Stadt selbst.
translations.en: Athens enchanted me, at least the city itself.
translations.fr: Athènes m'a enchantée, du moins la ville elle-même.

examples.text: Fiquei encantado com ela. Marcamos novo encontro para amanhã à noite.

translations.de: Ich war von ihr bezaubert. Wir haben uns für morgen Abend wieder verabredet.
translations.en: I was charmed by her. We've arranged to meet tomorrow night.
translations.fr: J'ai été charmé par elle. Nous avons prévu de nous revoir demain soir.

examples.text: Estou realmente encantado.

translations.en: I'm very happy about this.
translations.fr: J'en suis positivement ravi.

more.definition: to enchant, charm; to delight; to bewitch, put a spell on
more.etymology: Proto-Indo-European *-h₂tiinflu. Inherited from Old Galician-Portuguese encantar. By surface analysis, en- + cantar.

senses.gloss: lançar encantamento ou magia sobre alguém; enfeitiçar alguém

examples.text: Meu teclado está cheio de sujeira.

translations.en: My keyboard is full of dirt.

examples.text: Tom limpou a sujeira da calça.

translations.en: Tom brushed the dirt off his pants.

examples.text: Limpe a sujeira de seu cachorro em espaços públicos.

translations.en: Please clean up after your dog in public spaces.

examples.text: Arrume alguma coisa para limpar esta sujeira.

more.definition: filth; dirt; something which causes things to become dirty, such as a speck of dust or a stain; corruption; disloyalty; dishonesty
more.etymology: From sujo (“dirty”) + -eira, from Latin sūcidus (“juicy; sappy”), from sūcus (“juice”).

examples.text: Uma abelha só pica se for atacada.

translations.de: Eine Biene sticht nur, wenn sie angegriffen wird.
translations.en: A bee only stings if it is attacked.
translations.fr: Une abeille ne pique que si elle est attaquée.

examples.text: Por que as abelhas morrem depois de picar?

translations.en: Why do bees die after stinging?
translations.fr: Pourquoi les abeilles meurent-elles après avoir piqué ?

examples.text: Até agora, somente duas pessoas atingiram o pico desta montanha.

translations.en: Up to now, only two people have reached the summit of that mountain.
translations.fr: Jusqu'à maintenant seulement deux personnes ont atteint le sommet de cette montagne.

examples.text: As abelhas picam.

translations.en: Bees sting.
translations.fr: Les abeilles piquent.

more.definition: to sting (pierce with a small, sharp point); to punch (to make holes); to mince; to shred (chop into small pieces)
more.etymology: From Vulgar Latin *pīccāre (“to puncture”), itself a derivative of Frankish *pikkōn or of onomatopoeic origin.

examples.text: O Verbo Divino fez a luz.

translations.de: Das göttliche Wort machte Licht.
translations.en: The Divine Word made light.
translations.fr: La Parole Divine a fait la lumière.

examples.text: Em tudo opera a inteligência do Divino.

translations.de: Göttliche Intelligenz wirkt in allem.
translations.en: Divine intelligence operates in everything.
translations.fr: L'intelligence du Divin opère en tout.

examples.text: Errar é humano, perdoar, divino.

translations.en: To err is human, to forgive divine.
translations.fr: Se tromper est humain, pardonner, divin.

examples.text: Nada há sem vontade divina.

translations.en: There's nothing without divine will.

more.definition: divine (pertaining to god); divine (exceptionally good)
more.etymology: Latin dīvīnuslbor. Learned borrowing from Latin dīvīnus.

examples.text: Essa é uma conspiração interessante.

translations.en: That's an interesting conspiracy.

examples.text: Eu sou vítima de uma conspiração generalizada para me desacreditar.

translations.en: I am the victim of a widespread conspiracy meant to discredit me.

examples.text: Nós somos vítimas de uma conspiração generalizada para nos desacreditar.

translations.en: We are the victims of a widespread conspiracy meant to discredit us.

examples.text: É tudo uma conspiração.

translations.en: It's all a conspiracy.

more.definition: plot, conspiracy (act of working in secret to obtain some goal)
more.etymology: Latin cōnspīrātiōnemlbor. Learned borrowing from Latin cōnspīrātiōnem (“conspiracy, plot”).

examples.text: O filho de Laila nasceu nesta clínica.

translations.en: Laila's son was born in this clinic.
translations.fr: Le fils de Laila est né dans cette clinique.

examples.text: Ele teve sorte de encontrar uma clínica tão boa.

translations.en: He was lucky to find such a good clinic.
translations.fr: Il a eu la chance de trouver une si bonne clinique.

examples.text: Tom foi para a clínica de manhã.

translations.en: Tom went to the clinic this morning.

examples.text: Sou eu o responsável por esta clínica.

translations.fr: C'est moi qui suis responsable de cette clinique.

more.definition: clinic (small medical facility); medicine; healthcare (the practice of treating disease)
more.etymology: From clínico (“clinical”).

examples.text: Não me denuncie.

translations.en: Don't tell on me.
translations.fr: Ne me dénoncez pas.

examples.text: Você tem que denunciar para a polícia.

translations.fr: Il faut que tu fasses tout de suite un rapport à la police.

examples.text: Seu sotaque denuncia que ele é francês.

translations.en: His accent betrays him to be a Frenchman.

examples.text: Quatro pessoas foram denunciadas à Justiça.

translations.en: Four people were reported to the law.

more.definition: to denounce
more.etymology: Proto-Indo-European *-h₂tiinflu. Latin dēnūntiārelbor. Learned borrowing from Latin dēnūntiāre.

examples.text: Comovido, vê Príamo a estender ao algoz do seu filho as mãos inermes.

translations.de: Bewegt sieht er, wie Priamos hilflos die Hände nach dem Henker seines Sohnes ausstreckt.
translations.en: Moved, he sees Priam extending his helpless hands to his son's executioner.
translations.fr: Ému, il voit Priam tendre ses mains impuissantes vers le bourreau de son fils.

examples.text: Ele estendeu a mão.

translations.en: He held out his hand.
translations.fr: Il tendit la main.

examples.text: O corpo dele estava estendido no chão.

translations.fr: Son corps gisait sur le sol.

examples.text: Tom e Mary sempre estendem roupas juntos.

translations.en: Tom and Mary often hang up the laundry together.

more.definition: to extend; to broaden; to widen (to increase the extent or size of); to extend; to broaden; to widen (to increase in extent or size); to extend (to cause to last longer)
more.etymology: Inherited from Old Galician-Portuguese estender, from Latin extendere.

examples.text: A formação da juventude é a renovação do mundo.

translations.de: Die Bildung der Jugend ist die Erneuerung der Welt.
translations.en: The formation of youth is the renewal of the world.
translations.fr: La formation de la jeunesse est le renouveau du monde.

examples.text: Os médicos de hoje não recebem uma boa formação.

translations.de: Die Ärzte von heute erhalten keine gute Ausbildung.
translations.fr: Les médecins d'aujourd'hui ne sont pas bien formés.

examples.text: O Tom frequenta uma escola de formação profissional.

translations.en: Tom goes to vocational school.

examples.text: Ela sempre se gaba de sua formação acadêmica.

translations.en: She always prides herself on her academic background.

more.definition: formation; organization; development
more.etymology: Learned borrowing from Latin fōrmātiōnem. By surface analysis, formar + -ção.

more.definition: a type of porch
more.etymology: Borrowed from Old Tupi kopiara.

examples.text: Você deve copiar esta frase cem vezes.

translations.de: Du musst diesen Satz hundertmal kopieren.
translations.en: You must copy this sentence one hundred times.
translations.fr: Il faut que tu copies cette phrase cent fois.

examples.text: Eu não estou copiando a sua tarefa.

translations.en: I'm not copying your homework.

examples.text: Tom copiou tudo em um disco rígido externo.

translations.en: Tom backed everything up on an external hard drive.

examples.text: Os bons artistas copiam, os grandes artistas roubam.

translations.en: Good artists copy, great artists steal.

more.definition: to copy; to produce something identical; to copy; to imitate; to copy (to place a copy of an object in memory for later use)
more.etymology: Latin -ereinflu. From cópia + -ar.

examples.text: Tom merece uma promoção.

translations.en: Tom deserves a promotion.
translations.fr: Tom mérite une promotion.

examples.text: Esse supermercado, às vezes, tem promoções.

translations.en: That supermarket sometimes has sales.

examples.text: Tom disse que não quer uma promoção.

translations.en: Tom said that he doesn't want a promotion.

examples.text: O Tom comprou uma câmera na promoção.

translations.en: Tom bought a camera on sale.

more.definition: promotion (advancement in position); promotion (event intended to increase the reach or image of a product or brand); special offer (retail)
more.etymology: From Latin promotiōnem, from prōmoveō (“to move forward”).

senses.gloss: atividade que visa exibir um produto e aumentar a sua venda

examples.text: O encontro é realizado anualmente.

translations.de: Das Treffen wird jährlich abgehalten.
translations.en: The meeting is held annually.
translations.fr: Le meeting se tient annuellement.

examples.text: Quanto mais frases leio, mais erros encontro.

translations.de: Je mehr Sätze ich lese, desto mehr Fehler finde ich.
translations.en: The more sentences I read, the more errors I find.
translations.fr: Plus je lis des phrases, plus je trouve des erreurs.

examples.text: Ainda encontro em minhas frases muitos erros.

translations.de: Ich finde immer noch viele Fehler in meinen Sätzen.
translations.en: I still find many mistakes in my sentences.
translations.fr: Je trouve encore beaucoup d'erreurs dans mes phrases.

examples.text: Em teus olhos, eu encontro um pedaço do paraíso.

translations.de: In deinen Augen finde ich ein Stück Paradies.
translations.en: In your eyes I find a piece of paradise.
translations.fr: Dans tes yeux je trouve un coin de paradis.

more.definition: meeting; gathering; get-together; meet-up; date (romantic meeting); the act of finding something
more.etymology: Deverbal from encontrar (“to find; to meet with”).

examples.text: Uma linguagem polida, de certa forma, atrapalha uma atmosfera informal.

translations.de: Eine höfliche Ausdrucksweise kann, in einem gewissem Sinne, einer ungezwungenen Stimmung Abbruch tun.
translations.en: Polite language, in a sense, spoils a casual atmosphere.

examples.text: A cidade tem uma atmosfera europeia.

translations.en: The town has a European air.

examples.text: Há uma atmosfera amigável no escritório.

translations.en: There's a friendly air around the office.

examples.text: Marte tem uma atmosfera muito fina.

translations.en: Mars has a very thin atmosphere.

more.definition: gases surrounding the Earth (or another astronomical body); the air in an environment; the apparent mood felt in an environment
more.etymology: Borrowed from New Latin atmosphaera, from Ancient Greek ἀτμός (atmós, “steam”) + σφαῖρα (sphaîra, “sphere”). By surface analysis, atmo- + esfera.

senses.gloss: camada gasosa que envolve a Terra

examples.text: Ela está pirada.

translations.en: She's nuts.
translations.fr: Elle est dingue.

examples.text: Ele colocou o saquinho de chá no pires.

translations.en: He put the teabag on the saucer.

examples.text: Ela pirou quando ouviu a notícia.

translations.en: She had a cow when she heard the news.

examples.text: O Tom está me fazendo pirar.

translations.en: Tom is driving me crazy.

more.definition: to go nuts; to become crazy; to quickly leave; to go away

examples.text: A encomenda pesa mais de uma libra.

translations.en: The parcel weighs more than one pound.
translations.fr: Le colis pèse plus d'une livre.

examples.text: Cortei o dedo tentando abrir a encomenda.

translations.en: I cut my finger while trying to open the package.
translations.fr: Je me suis coupé le doigt en tentant d'ouvrir le colis.

examples.text: Ele encomendou um novo terno para si.

translations.fr: Il s'est fait faire un nouveau costume.

examples.text: Eu encomendei um livro da Inglaterra.

translations.en: I've ordered a book from England.

more.definition: to order; to instruct; to commission; to recommend
more.etymology: From en- + Old Galician-Portuguese comendar, from Latin commendāre. Compare comandar, a doublet borrowed from French.

examples.text: Vejo a cruz de ouro.

translations.de: Ich sehe ein goldenes Kreuz.
translations.en: I see the golden cross.
translations.fr: Je vois la croix dorée.

translations.de: Sie legte beide Hände über Kreuz auf ihre Brust.
translations.en: She placed both hands crosswise on her chest.
translations.fr: Elle a posé ses deux mains en croix sur sa poitrine.

examples.text: A Cruz Vermelha socorre as vítimas de desastres sem demora.

translations.en: The Red Cross gets help to disaster victims without delay.
translations.fr: La Croix Rouge apporte sans retard de l'aide aux victimes de désastres.

examples.text: Um sinal de adição lembra uma cruz.

translations.en: An addition sign resembles a cross.

more.definition: cross (geometrical figure); cross (the symbol of Christianity); cross (ancient device used for the execution of criminals)
more.etymology: Inherited from Old Galician-Portuguese cruz, from Latin crucem (“cross”), from Proto-Indo-European *(s)ker- (“to turn, to bend”). Doublet of Curuçá and Crux.

senses.gloss: símbolo formado por dois planos, normalmente linhas, um orientado horizontalmente e outro na vertical, cruzando-se e formando um ângulo de 90 graus; a linha é, por vezes, maior para baixo do cruzamento

examples.text: Estão atrasados, como de costume.

translations.fr: Ils sont en retard, comme d'habitude.

examples.text: No meu país os costumes são diferentes.

translations.en: In my country the customs are different.
translations.fr: Dans mon pays les coutumes sont différentes.

examples.text: Os maus costumes geram boas leis.

translations.de: Schlechte Angewohnheiten führen zu guten Gesetzen.
translations.en: Bad habits breed good laws.
translations.fr: Les mauvaises habitudes engendrent les bonnes lois.

examples.text: Isso é um velho costume canadense.

translations.de: Das ist ein alter kanadischer Brauch.
translations.en: That's an old Canadian custom.

more.definition: custom; tradition (traditional practice or behavior); custom; habit (common or frequently repeated behavior); custom (long-established practice, considered as unwritten law)
more.etymology: PIE word *ḱóm PIE word *swé Inherited from Latin consuētūdinem. Cognate with Spanish costumbre f, Catalan costum m, French costume m, Italian costume m, Romanian costum n, and English costume.

translations.en: I like mathematics.

examples.text: Você não devia jogar beisebol aqui.

translations.de: Ihr dürft hier nicht Baseball spielen.

examples.text: A vida sempre segue o rumo traçado pelas mãos do destino.

translations.de: Das Leben folgt immer dem vom Schicksal vorgegebenen Lauf.
translations.en: Life always follows the path set by the hands of destiny.

translations.de: Der Schiffskapitän entscheidet sich, den Kurs zu ändern.
translations.en: The captain of the ship decided to change course.

examples.text: Antigamente os navegadores usavam os astros para definir seus rumos.
Não gosto do rumo para onde isto vai.

examples.text: O olhar dela reflete águas profundas.

translations.de: Ihr Blick spiegelt tiefe Gewässer wider.
translations.en: Her gaze reflects deep waters.
translations.fr: Son regard reflète les profondeurs de l'eau.

examples.text: Enquanto o espelho reflete sem falar, ele, ao contrário, fala sem refletir.

translations.fr: Le prix reflète la demande.

examples.text: Vai nevar hoje.

translations.fr: Il va neiger aujourd'hui.

examples.text: Amai-vos uns aos outros.

translations.de: Liebt einander.
translations.en: Love one another.
translations.fr: Aimez-vous les uns les autres.

translations.fr: Je ne veux pas vous offenser.

translations.fr: Prolétaires de tous les pays, unissez-vous !

translations.fr: Vous rappelez-vous qui je suis ?

translations.en: Envious people die, but envy never does.

translations.de: Das Leben ist eine immense Reihe von Wundern.

translations.en: What would happen if a large asteroid struck the earth?
